name: Decasa Hotel Nairobi
address: Upper River Road opposite KCB Bank, Nairobi, Kenya
editorial_summary: Simple rooms, some with city views, in a relaxed hotel offering a restaurant/bar & free Wi-Fi.

reviews.author: GATANA MICHEAL
reviews.text:
Located. In the Nairobi central business along. River road. Street  opposite  KCB  the. Hotel. Is quite. Secure and. Well equipped with. Lift and. Very. Friendly staff .
The. Rooms. Are quite spacious and. Well cleaned. .the prices are quite friendly also.u can easily access the. CBD and the town from this location it's quite. Close to Westland and. Upper hill for. Business  and. From and to the airport

reviews.author: Simon Mureithi
reviews.text:
this was place was just wonderful for me
have very good service especially form the person who served me by the name Elizabeth
congratulations 🎉👏 willing to come back again 🙏

reviews.author: Moshen Hussein
reviews.text: Located within Nairobi cbd, the place is nice budget friendly. It's good for a short and long stays mostly for travellers.

reviews.author: Calvin Mngatana
reviews.text: It’s exaclty what you can expect for the price they charge. The bigger rooms are much better than the single rooms.

reviews.author: Muindi Felix
reviews.text: Decasa Hotel is a convenient and budget-friendly choice in the heart of Nairobi. The rooms are clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, offering good value for money. Staff are friendly and helpful, always ready to assist with check-in and local tips. Its central location makes it easy to access key areas of the city, restaurants, and transport. The hotel also provides reliable Wi-Fi and decent dining options, making it a practical stay for both business and leisure travelers

name: INKS HOTEL
address: Latema Junction, River Rd, Nairobi, Kenya
editorial_summary: Unpretentious budget hotel featuring a bar & a restaurant, along with Wi-Fi & breakfast.

reviews.author: Godfrey Simiyu
reviews.text: Cool and private place within the city

reviews.author: Allan Odaba
reviews.text: A great hotel with amazing service and surprisingly fast delivery

reviews.author: Elvis Munene
reviews.text: You can get all party stuff there.

reviews.author: Mary Lynn
reviews.text: Didn't like it at all. It's in the middle of a busy Nairobi street. Also unfortunately, there is weird sexual services approaches from ladies....!! My friend wasn't amused. This happens just as you're climbing the stairs. Not for foreigners or if you treasure peace of mind. The rooms are just ok for a local night sleep

reviews.author: JKim
reviews.text: Cheapest place to buy all sorts of braids, weaves and hair products and accessories in Nairobi.  Better deal than supermarkets or beauty shops .  But be prepared for shoving and long waiting as the space is too small and customers are many.

name: Hotel Boulevard Nairobi, City Centre CBD
editorial_summary: Low-key rooms in a hotel with a garden & tennis, plus a restaurant, a bar & an outdoor pool.

reviews.author: Chemutai Ruto
reviews.text:
It definitely looks better than it did before. You can see the effort to refresh the space, and that’s commendable. The menu pricing is friendly, which makes it accessible, and there’s ample seating so it’s comfortable for casual meetings or relaxed hangouts.
That said… something still feels missing.
I can’t quite put my finger on it, but the overall experience lacks a certain warmth or identity. It’s improved physically, yes, but it hasn’t fully transitioned into a space that feels curated or memorable. It feels functional rather than distinctive.
Not bad. Just not yet compelling.
With a bit more attention to ambience, service energy, or signature detailing, it could easily move from a 3 to a strong 4.

reviews.author: carol njihia
reviews.text: The hotel is a hidden gem in Nairobi especially during New Years Eve. We requested for accomodation at 5pm on new years eve and we were quickly offered a room as well as access to the pool. The facilities are very modern, clean pool and well priced tasty food. Breakfast is awesome. For New Years Eve....this is exactly where you want to be with direct view to the GTC fireworks display........ it was remarkable. Thanks to the team there, Edith and Sharon. We had a great stay.

reviews.author: muthoni ngugi
reviews.text:
Thank you for a well organised Xmas brunch. Your team pulled it off admirably 👏👏

A small review:
Ambiance ✅️
Entertainment ✅️
Service: Felix was great✅️
Food ✅️
Desserts. Extremely sweet.Greater variety  and quality would have been nice❎️
Swimming ✅

Overall 9/10

reviews.author: Julia Nyakundi
reviews.text: Surprisingly good! All my years in Nairobi and I'd never visited this hotel. The garden restaurant bands are beautiful. The food is good and they always run offers. Had some challenges with our first waiter, but then we got Boniface and his service was great. We had the curry with naan. 2 for 1 cocktails and mocktails with free bitings, nice pool. I got takeaway chicken tikka pizza. The BEST pizza I've ever had! I highly recommend this iconic hotel.

reviews.author: Evelyn Karobia (Ev3)
reviews.text:
Good hotel within the CBD but not in the middle of the CBD noise. ... Outdoor at the pool can be noisy coz the road and the express highway are it's neighbour in quote... On a sunny day it's a good place to just hang at the pool.
Their monthly offers served at the pool .. very good on IG but different when you are there. They should offer their services as advertised.
Other dinning .. ok and affordable.

name: Radisson Blu Hotel, Nairobi Upper Hill
editorial_summary: Classy hotel offering an African restaurant, an outdoor pool & spa services, plus free Wi-Fi.

reviews.author: Ngumbau Samuel (Shammah)
reviews.text:
The scenery is beautiful and serene, offering a calm and professional atmosphere that is perfect for meetings. The environment is quiet, well-maintained and thoughtfully designed.

What stood out most was the amazing staff - warm, professional and very attentive. Their hospitality made the visit even more enjoyable.

Definitely a great venue for meetings and business engagements. I look forward to visiting again!

reviews.author: Rahab Githinji
reviews.text:
I would like to take a moment to sincerely appreciate Hillary, who served us during our visit. From the very beginning, he made us feel welcome with his warm smile and calm, professional manner. He took the time to explain the menu, offered helpful suggestions, and was very patient with our questions, which immediately set a positive tone for the entire experience.

Throughout our time there, Hillary was extremely attentive without ever being intrusive. He checked in at just the right moments, ensured everything was well coordinated, and handled his responsibilities with impressive efficiency and care. Even during busier moments, he remained composed, courteous, and genuinely pleasant, which speaks volumes about his professionalism and dedication to excellent service.

I would also like to highlight how great the tea snacks were fresh, well presented, and absolutely delicious. They were the perfect complement to our meeting and were thoroughly enjoyed by everyone. In addition, the boardroom was amazing: well set up, comfortable, and ideal for a productive and pleasant session. The overall environment felt organized, welcoming, and thoughtfully prepared.

What truly made the experience stand out was the combination of excellent service, quality refreshments, and a well-maintained space. Because of Hillary’s outstanding service and the overall setup, our visit was not only smooth but memorable. He is truly an asset to the establishment, and I would highly recommend both the service and the facilities to anyone considering a visit.

Thank you, Hillary, for making our time here so enjoyable. I will definitely be returning.

reviews.author: amol katkade
reviews.text:
The only reason any one would want to bomb this hotel is because their unnecessary security checking!

I stayed at this hotel for a week and had to go out frequently due to work but every time I would enter hotel premises, I needed get out of the car along with driver and my bagpack for security scanning which is ridiculous considering the fact that we again had to sit in the car to just to drive 30 metres? Complete waste of time every time. Why don’t you put that machine at that entrance door instead of gates?

My stay included bed and breakfast. Despite being the costliest hotel in Nairobi, other hotels had much better breakfast food. Your food was bland and often time, stale. Many times I wanted to skip that breakfast and just eat outside.

Also they try to extract every penny out of you. Mini bar is not free and simple peanuts cost you more than 500 KES. If you order breakfast to your room, they charge you for the service.

Room view was good but the bathroom was not upto the mark. Also the furniture was too user unfriendly and clusmy person like me could have easily injured myself.

Totally not recommended unless you want utter humiliation, money and time wastage.

reviews.author: Gad Juma
reviews.text:
Had a great experience at Radisson Blu thanks to the amazing team — Pravin, Lesley, Wycliffe, and Judith.
They were all very kind, warm, and welcoming from the moment I arrived. Pravin especially set the tone with a friendly and professional reception.

They know their products and services. You can tell they truly understand hospitality and take pride in what they do.

Top-tier service all around. Keep it up.

reviews.author: Sophie Mwangi
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Exceptional service from start to finish! Mary, the hostess, is absolutely incredible—warm, welcoming, and genuinely kind. She made us feel at home from the moment we arrived and was especially amazing with the kids, which meant so much to us. Her friendliness and grace set the perfect tone for our experience.

Salad, our waiter, was equally phenomenal! He was attentive, energetic, and incredibly detail-oriented. He made sure we had everything we needed before we even asked and delivered service with such professionalism and genuine care. His presence truly elevated our dining experience.

Because of Mary and Salad, our experience at this property was unforgettable. Their outstanding service alone is reason enough to return again and again. Truly top-tier hospitality

name: The Boma Nairobi
address: Red Cross Road Nairobi KE, Bellevue, Off Mombasa Road, Nairobi, Kenya
editorial_summary: Sophisticated lodging offering 2 restaurants & bars, plus a spa, a gym & a rooftop outdoor pool.

reviews.author: Lenard Vatamaniuk
reviews.text: We seized the opportunity to relax and enjoy a well deserved stay-cation in Nairobi, Kenya 🇰🇪,  on Saturday, February 7th! After great great deliberation, we unanimously decided to patronize the Nairobi Boma Hotel! The Boma Hotel 🏨 didn't disappoint us. The front desk receptionist, Joy, was a consummate professional. She addressed all of our questions and concerns expeditiously in an ultra-friendly manner! The concierge and porters provided us with reliable and impeccable service escorting us to our room. The swimming pool, spa, and workout facilities were clean and well maintained. The rooms were exceptionally clean and spacious!  The scrumptious complementary buffet breakfast from 6:30 am until 10:00 am was to live for!!!! 😋We were not penalized for checking out 30 minutes past the scheduled time to vacate our room! We would gladly recommend the Boma Hotel our worst enemies!!! 👍🏾

reviews.author: Esther Amoit
reviews.text: The Valentine's dinner 🍽  was amazing. The ambience was perfect. The food was on point and we really love the performance by Kayamba Africa. It was the perfect night. Thank you 😊

reviews.author: Rose
reviews.text: I thoroghly enjoyed the Boma Christmas brunch. The food was very tasty.  Special thanks to Chef Felix who attended to us with utter most care and patience. The whole staff in general was splendid. I will definitely continue dining n making merry at the Boma hotel.

reviews.author: Cynthia Imali
reviews.text:
We visited for the Christmas brunch and had an amazing time. The staff were very attentive, kudos to our waiter Amos and Chef Peter.
The only downside was that some items, such as ice cream, ran out at the buffet and were not replenished. Additionally, when I went to get the choma, the chef was not at the station. I waited for almost 10 minutes, and when he returned, I was asked to go inside to get plates as there were none available at that section.
I hope these issues can be addressed, especially ensuring that plates are available at all buffet areas. Overall, we had a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Victoria Muli
reviews.text:
The services are bad ,especially the room service no response at all despite trying several times.
The bathroom is quite small and only one hand towel.
Johar Restaurant has amazing breakfast buffet but the waiters are unreasonable slow and at a point felt like they were being forced to serve.
You can do better for a 5 star hotel

name: Sheratton Regency Hotel Nairobi
address: Malvi Mansion, Mfangano Street, Nairobi, Kenya

reviews.author: ROGER 24
reviews.text: ✨ Nestled in the vibrant heart of Nairobi’s CBD, Sheraton Regency Hotel offers a cozy retreat with breathtaking views and exceptional services. It’s the perfect destination to relax, unwind, and enjoy a truly memorable experience filled with comfort and hospitality.

reviews.author: Márk Nagy
reviews.text:
Staff is useless and they lie, they cheated us, they made us pay twice: I booked and paid through booking, the price was really cheap because booking made an offer for us, that's why I decided to book in there, because of the price. Once we arrived to the hotel they wanted us to pay for the room 23$ because apparently there was a mistake with booking. We refused and told them we have already paid, how they sort that behind with booking is not my business and I shouldn't pay more, and they said ok and let us check in and pass the night. In the morning when we tried to check out it happened the same, they force us to pay in this case 27$, they told us they said the night before that we would need to pay (they didn't), they just agree to let us check in, they treated us as a criminal and they kept us there waiting for phone calls for half hour, knowing we were rushing and had to go for a tour. In the end just because we didn't want to lose the tour and they wouldn't let us leave, we had to pay. And I hope we will receive a refund from booking because is their fault they offer something for a price that apparently it wasn't.
Plus after of course, the tour I also booked through booking cheated us as well, they didn't show up in the pickup point when we have already paid. So we paid for the room just to make it in time for a tour that we couldn't even make, thanks to booking, what a shame!
The room was... Ok but noisy, the reception was far to look with a minimum of quality, if you count you are paying for a really expensive room in a location miles away to feel it safety.

reviews.author: Faith Kasyoka
reviews.text: Place is okay, but their washrooms are pathetic

reviews.author: Vyntine Kate
reviews.text: Lovely hotel right in the CBD! Very convenient with friendly Staff.

reviews.author: Mehetabel Gacheri
reviews.text: A very cool place to hangout when around town. The food is amazing and the menu items are cost-friendly. The services are quite good. You can have your meals and order your drinks as well. Accommodation is also available.

name: Sochati Casa Resort Kileleshwa, Nairobi
address: PQFQ+C48 Nairobi, Near Kandara Road, Nairobi, Kenya
editorial_summary: Laid-back hotel offering an outdoor pool, a restaurant & a cocktail bar, plus event space.

reviews.author: Mr. Bogorodskiy
reviews.text:
A rather unfortunate experience

They had no electricity, we couldn’t charge our phones or take a hot shower, and the outlets in the room didn’t work. All of this was critical because we were traveling with a 10-month-old baby.

A tiny, cold room, mosquitoes, a strong smell of marijuana, and broken window latches. A disgusting breakfast for 1,600 shillings.

The booking app listed a free baby cot, but upon arrival they asked us to pay 10,000 shillings for it. We refused. The cot was still in the room — completely broken and unsafe. Naturally, we didn’t use it.

We had initially paid for two nights and planned to extend our stay, but due to the lack of electricity and hot water, we checked out a day early. We asked for a refund, but they refused. We simply left that dump.

I didn’t expect such terrible service in the center of Kileleshwa.

reviews.author: Ejan O'Rea
reviews.text:
First room had large and aggressive ants. They moved me without complaint to a new room with had black mold on the ceiling of the bathroom and mosquitoes that came seemingly out of nowhere.

Place is cheap to stay per night and most staff is nice. The gate guy can be very weird though.

reviews.author: Rosemary Maina
reviews.text: A perfect budget accomodation in a serene neighborhood with attached restaurant service. Quiet and ample outdoor space for a social or business catch up. Available conference hall for an event or meeting.

reviews.author: joanne wambui
reviews.text: The food was so expensive yet tasted so bad.The rooms are so tiny and some guest smoked all over the place if travelling with kids it's not a good place at all.There was no light or hot water for the two days we stayed.

reviews.author: Patricia Gathigia
reviews.text: It's a lovely place. They allow birthday parties to be hosted at the venue. The place was clean, friendly staff

reviews.author: Mary Mueni Madam
reviews.text: Quiet and serein environment conducive for guets

reviews.author: Eugyn Ochieng'
reviews.text: Great staff but takes ages to get your food after ordering. Had  roasted potatoes with pan steak,, nothing like I expected it to be. Potatoes were big fried pieces,pan steak lacked any flavour, overall very disappointing experience 😔

reviews.author: Irvine Musau
reviews.text: It is usually a good experience in Mercury Hotel,....nice food, nice service from the waiters. Enough space, good charging ports for laptops and phones. I love the place .....Big up to the security guy who always greets me whenever he finds me there 👏..I'd always recommend the place to everyone

reviews.author: Anitta .M.
reviews.text: The choma here is sweet and tender

reviews.author: Shem Kigen
reviews.text: I've visited this place several times when in Nairobi. It is quite convenient for people from outside Nairobi as it is located near shuttles. The place is adjacent to North Rift and a 2 minute walk to Easy coach among others. Place is pretty old and you can see it from old floors, ceiling e.t.c The cost is relatively cheap at ksh2100 per night as of 2024(less than $15). There is a hotel and a bar inside. The hotel is top class but the bar is open late and there can be a lot of loud music especially for light sleepers. During rainy season the water leaks inside and the corridors become slippery so probably avoid during rainy season.

reviews.author: abhishek shetty
reviews.text:
Wonderful stay. Very homely vibes with a cute garden. The owners are nice people. Breakfast was fresh & clean.

Location can be quite out of the way from the center but its an area where the elite folks of Nairobi live in so you are also out of traffic + close to giraffe center.

Recommended for budget travelers.

And also for Asians who want a jet spray in their toilets 👍🏼

reviews.author: Jessica Hunter
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at Edaala Comfort while in Nairobi! The service from Esther and Jane was amazing - so friendly and caring. The room was very clean and comfortable, the breakfasts were delicious, and the grounds were peaceful and lush. We really enjoyed the walkability of the location to nearby amenities like a cafe, pharmacy, and grocery store. I would absolutely recommend staying here.

reviews.author: Ben Barreto
reviews.text: We took Nairobi as base for traveling in Kenya, even though we were not interested in the city, so it was an excellent choice this amazing place. Close to airport, easy access to uber (and uber eats) , located in a residential area close to Giraffe center and mostly excellent place to rest in the garden or inside of the cabin. Sometimes we had the cabin only for us, another time you need to share the living room without any issue and last time we were hosted inside main house. The owner helped us to keep part of our luggage during our trips and winter jackets, she is a lovely person. Breakfast quite good (pancakes, eggs, fruit). Don't worth to be in downtown while you can relax here

reviews.author: Virginia L
reviews.text: This little paradise in Nairobi is the best way for a relaxing holiday! Jane the host was very welcoming and helpful. She cooked me this delicious breakfast before my departure. The cottage was so comfortable and clean. I loved the shared kitchen on the cottage to fix something quickly! The garden around is gorgeous. Jane helped me with airport transfer, her son William pick me up. It was a great way to get to learn about the area. It certainly felt like visiting friends. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Liz Mukui
reviews.text:
Jane and Bernard are the perfect couple host and hostess. The fact that they personally meet you on arrival and check you in and then make the perfect breakfast for the guests is so adorable. They are also great at conversations. We loved our stay there and we will definitely be back.
Thanks Jane for always checking on me about my girl, your empathy is a notch high and was grateful to have a mother speaking another mother. God bless you.

name: The Concord Hotel & Suites
address: 31 Wangapala Road, Fifth Parklands Ave, Nairobi, Kenya
editorial_summary: Elegant rooms & suites in a polished hotel with an open-air pool & a spa, plus breakfast.

reviews.author: PegiTa (PegiTa)
reviews.text: The hotel is almost big and has a good layout. The rooms are a good size and generally clean, though unfortunately, the sheets on our bed didn’t feel very fresh and we found some spot on them. Parking is available, which is convenient, and the staff were very nice and welcoming. The room itself was a bit cold, which made it less comfortable, and breakfast was fairly normal, nothing special but decent. Overall, a decent stay with some room for improvement.

reviews.author: Nick Kariuki
reviews.text:
The stay was great and relaxing!!
Very nice rooms!!
Very very nice food!!
Very friendly staff!!.
I will recommend and come back many more times!!

reviews.author: Robert Gregory
reviews.text: A great stay with amazing staff, I was here for 1 night after landing in nairobi and it’s the best hotel in the city which I’ve been too. I highly recommend the stay, good food and rooms are large and nice. 10/10 for me for the hotel

reviews.author: Naveen K
reviews.text: The highlight is the staff - they are helpful, kind and a joy.  Location is walkable to diamond plaza with many restaurants and shops.  Beds are big and nice.  Restaurants serve a variety of foods.  And live jazz music which was the best!!!

reviews.author: Amd Kagera
reviews.text:
Very good hotel. Excellent service from all level of staff
Good breakfast wide range of choice

name: Adenbay City Hotel
address: Luthuli avenue junction of munyu road, and, Luthuli Ave, Nairobi, Kenya

reviews.author: Cecil Ward
reviews.text: Roach infestation, mosquito infestation, a horrible smell in my room, and it's very noisy. I booked the hotel through my Expedia app. When I arrived at the hotel, the receptionist informed me that my reservation could not be found. I was instructed to present the payment receipt from my credit card, as requested by the hotel manager. I should have my Expedia itinerary, the Expedia payment receipt, and the payment from my credit card. After thirty to forty-five minutes in the lobby, I was told that I needed to pay again because my $20.39 hotel room payment could not be found and validated.

reviews.author: lameck lemeto
reviews.text: No towel, no tissue paper no soap, no slippers, the blankets are dirty. Automated doors are jamming every now n then. The hotel is well conveniently situated but has poor  management. I had to buy a tissue paper n wipe maself with my t-shirt instead of a towel 😂😂

reviews.author: mathew
reviews.text: Cool chilling place enjoyed DJ lingala music 🎵 was superb

reviews.author: Jacinta Mwende Jane
reviews.text: Very comfortable

reviews.author: Wilunda Bonface
reviews.text: Good front office. Clean room. Noisy at night. Poor WiFi, faulty warm shower system.

reviews.author: Dalmar Saleban
reviews.text:
I had an excellent stay at this hotel. The crew were incredibly respectful, friendly, and always ready to help with anything I needed. Their professionalism and kindness really made the stay comfortable.

The food was absolutely delicious — every meal was well-prepared and full of flavor. I truly enjoyed dining here.

Overall, the hospitality was outstanding. From check-in to check-out, everything was smooth and pleasant. I highly recommend this hotel and would definitely choose it again.

reviews.author: Bartek Kleszcz
reviews.text:
1/5 – Extremely Disappointing Stay, Not Worth 4 Stars

Our stay at this hotel was unfortunately one of the worst experiences we’ve had in a so-called 4-star property. The hotel is actually located inside a shopping mall, which already sets a very different tone than what was advertised.

From the moment we arrived, the problems started:
•	Elevator barely working, often getting stuck or malfunctioning.
•	Air conditioning in the hotel was weak and barely cooled the room.
•	Room was not properly cleaned – dust, stains, and an overall feeling of poor maintenance.
•	The breakfast was almost inedible, with very limited and low-quality options.
•	Instead of a relaxing atmosphere, we had to walk through an active construction site every day just to reach the restaurant.
•	The swimming pool was closed for re-tiling, even though the hotel advertises itself as having a pool – a key reason we booked in the first place.
•	The restaurant furniture was falling apart, including cabinets and fixtures. The whole place felt old, outdated, and in desperate need of a major renovation.

We informed the hotel about all these issues, provided photos and details, and kindly asked for a refund. Despite the clear evidence and the unacceptable conditions, the hotel refused to return our money. We ultimately canceled our second night and left early because the conditions were simply not tolerable.

This hotel is nowhere near 4-star quality. It felt neglected, misrepresented, and poorly managed. Sadly, it ruined what was meant to be a relaxing stay. We strongly advise other travelers to avoid it until serious renovations and management improvements are made.

reviews.author: S K79
reviews.text: I would like to thank Mr. Hussein and his team for all their support and understanding. The staff are brilliant, so ready to help and very polite.  The house keeping staff found my father in law's money on the bed. She was so honest and made sure we were made aware of it.  Breakfast was good and menu frequently changed. Room service was excellent, with large food portions. The location is so convenient. Everything is nearby and the hotel itself is situated on the 9th floor of diamond plaza which has all shops and restaurants on the ground floor and a food court too that caters for a variety of foods .The supermarket Food plus has everything you need. You don't need to go anywhere out of diamond plaza for anything. The taxi drivers are parked outside gate 2 of diamond plaza. Please ask anyone for Francis outside gate 2. He has a 7 seater car. We hired him for the 2 weeks we stayed at cloud . Francis is a kind, honest and helpful man. He came every time we called him. He is perfect with his timing.

reviews.author: Bill Lincicome
reviews.text:
It was...sawasawa for the most part. Nice room overall, but bathroom needs maintenance. The staff was pleasant and helpful where they could. Unfortunately, saw some staff members (mostly young women) berated by management for minor issues. Staff members would greet you warmly...management just stared to the point of discomfort.
Restaurant breakfast was nice. Lots to see around the area, including the food court on the grounds outside. Hindi temple and school across the street, a muezzin calling loud and clear 5x a day and churches nearby -- this is Nairobi Parklands.

reviews.author: Rohan Patel
reviews.text: Worst hotel I've ever been to. To start we had check in at 1 and we were a bit late because of our flight and they said that our room wasn't ready at 2. Then at 5 which is 4 hours later than we should have gotten the room we were told that we'll get another room as ours wasn't ready. Then it turned out to be someone else's room so we were given another room which was my parents and then was changed to another room. After we went our for dinner our bathroom reeked of paint so we had to switch again to another room. Next the breakfast evert morning is the same basic stuff like stale pastrys and oddly textured fruits aswell as an array of ok warm food which overall is pretty bad. Also the tv is basically useless. None of the channels work and nor does netflix sp you have to watch either prime or youtube. Lasty the pool is awful and dirty. It looks like nothing from the pictures and the room of the pool is cold not steamy and warm. So overall don't come here as it's unorganised and just very poor

name: Nairobi Safari Club by Swiss-Belhotel
editorial_summary: Warm quarters, some with balconies, in an upscale all-suite hotel offering dining & an outdoor pool.

reviews.author: Sharon Mwende
reviews.text: The location is very strategic as it is opposite UON so accessing it ain't a problem. Loved the hotel especially the vintage look of it. I live how the management has maintained it. For a hotel built in the 80s it's standing pretty well.

reviews.author: Nelson Mandela
reviews.text: Great exemplary service from the conference rooms to the accomodations. The staff are very professional and cordial especially Leah. Thank you so much Leah  and Latifah for your warmth service.

reviews.author: Ham Omollo
reviews.text:
I must say it was a fantastic experience, the rooms are spacious and clean and the location is perfect for exploring the city.

Their customer service was exceptional, thanks to Ms. Abisaki who was warm, welcoming and incredible attentive.

Thanks to the entire team at the hotel for making my visit truly memorable.

reviews.author: Jia Hui Lee
reviews.text: Spacious rooms and the staff are very warm, welcoming, and strive to make your stay excellent! The rooms are on the older side but everything was very comfortable. Also enjoyed the facilities (gym and sauna). Highlight of my trip to Nairobi.

reviews.author: Wangui
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful especially the night views from 16th floor. I highly recomend our Waiter Wangare who was very exceptional, professional, patient and keen.

My hotel of choice anytime I'm in Nairobi.

reviews.author: Osagie Omon
reviews.text: This is not a place you would want to stay long time. It clean and would serve your short time stay. The rooms are not spacious and the bed could be better, like really better. I think it's an okay value for the price but if you are looking for comfort and class, find another one.

reviews.author: kevin karuga
reviews.text:
Geed is a great place to stay while visiting the city. The hotel is clean, it has good and professional staff and affordable rooms.

The restaurant offers great food and it has nice furniture. The hotel is also strategically located within the town centre

Geed hotel is ideal for business travellers and city tourists. I would gladly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Ndinyah Delanyo
reviews.text: Enjoyed my stay. Lovely crew who are always willing to help. Nice rooms with all the necessary facilities to make your stay comfortable.

reviews.author: Allan Musyoki
reviews.text: from the reception to the accommodation everyone is ready to offer a helping hand, by far the best hotel i have been in the cbd

reviews.author: Ken okech
reviews.text: Wonderful place to check into, delicious dishes and a day starter breakfast experience.

reviews.author: Yuna Charlotte Shimizu
reviews.text: Staff are very friendly and suppotive, making this hotel feel very comfortable. It’s not a luxury hotel, but if you’re looking for good value and a convenient location, I’m  highly recommend this hotel. I stayed here four times in between visiting other cities, and every time I returned to Nairobi, I came back to this hotel! If I have the chance to stay in Nairobi again, I’ll definitely choose this place again. Asante!

reviews.author: Fedor Ivanov
reviews.text: At 3 am someone on my floor started chatting full voice. Tried to call the reception to ask them to deal with it - surprise surprise, phone was not connected. Easy solution. 1 star

reviews.author: Ori Yakobovich
reviews.text: Staff was incredible kind and supportive. A great value for money.

reviews.author: Nick
reviews.text: Exceeded all my expectations! From the pristine rooms to the impeccable service, every detail was perfect. The central location made it easy to explore the city, and the rooftop pool offered stunning views. The cocktails 🍹 at the bar were fantastic. Highly recommend for a luxurious and unforgettable stay!"

reviews.author: asacha godfrey
reviews.text: Your visit is treated with the utmost respect you deserve,  their service perfect and food .

name: Kahama Hotel
editorial_summary: Homey, air-conditioned rooms in a casual hotel offering a restaurant, a bar & meeting space.

reviews.author: Martin Matúšů
reviews.text: The "garden" side rooms are great, not so noisy.. love to sit at the circular window in the restaurant and watch the hustle outside.. managed to get early 6am checkin, checked out 5am next day and paid only one night, was looking for such hotel specifically, since with the traffic is best to travel at night.. love the big mirrors in the rooms..

reviews.author: Julius Wanyaga
reviews.text: If you value clean rooms, get your accommodation here. True value for money

reviews.author: Lilian Gatwiri
reviews.text:
I visit this hotel once every week. The rooms are okay but not all of them, some don't have hot showers but u will be told to wait for five minutes but still they will not warm the water.
Again there are friendly staff and also very unfriendly staff who will not listen to your concern until u request for your refund. U will call them early before 4pm to request for iron box only for u to get there at 9pm and ur told ironbox is kept by housekeeper and they will come in at 7 in the morning.
Rooms pricing is not standard as there days ur given rooms near the road at a specific price and the ones at the center at a higher price. Also the rooms are dusty.
Even buying a drink with big note u will be requested to look for a smaller note and when u decide to leave  the drink is when the receptionist goes to look for loose money from colleagues...as i said have been sleeping here for sometimes and am looking forward to getting a different one going forward. But u can give a trial maybe it was a bad day for me!

reviews.author: Tony “Arne Norrby” Klasson
reviews.text: Har to obtaining the correct address Uber Bolt don't want to pick up often a huge way around back to the right side of Murang'a Road

reviews.author: Moayad
reviews.text: The hotel was easy to find and centrally located which makes going to other places in Nairobi very convenient. The staff were warm and helpful and the facilities were great. Would definitely come back again if I'm in Nairobi

name: Red Buffalo House Hotel
editorial_summary: Simple rooms, some with balconies, in a relaxed hotel featuring a restaurant & a pair of bars.

reviews.author: Jagpal Sandhu
reviews.text: Since yesterday am trying to book 2 rooms in this hotel by phone. Your receptionist is very rude and unhelpful. Perhaps you don't need the business

reviews.author: Ata Haghighi
reviews.text:
I am traveling 20 times annually. this hotel was the worst experience in my whole life . awful and dangerous location. rude staff. late and poor breakfast . horrible room service. almost no washroom. extremely noisy.
even one star also too much for this hotel

reviews.author: Ivone Akinyi
reviews.text: Clean,great location and super customer service. I highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Paul Kagiri
reviews.text: Such a nice hideout for those in need of privacy,, but they need to expand the parking space

reviews.author: Marcos O. Diogo
reviews.text:
Poor service; delicious breakfast

Our experience here was not the best, starting with how hard it is to find the hotel itself but also how surprisingly hard it is to do the check-in, the reception was not found and we had to go to the bar to find someone to check us in. We arrived at 9 pm and the room wasn’t ready!!! We had to wait 30 mins when they gave us our room the floor was all wet from mapping. We got into our room only not to sleep since they had people talking in the alley, horrible. That wasn’t all, they had a problem with the water pump of whatever and only hot water was working, pardon me I mean boiling water. I couldn’t shower and I couldn’t barely sleep. The only good thing about it was the apology of the manager next morning while we had a delicious and natural breakfast (included) Be aware, we might have had bad luck

name: Radisson Blu Hotel & Residence, Nairobi Arboretum
editorial_summary: Relaxed quarters with balconies in a polished property offering an outdoor pool, a gym & a spa area.

reviews.author: Bryzon Hermann
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of experiencing outstanding service from Stephen Matundura during my stay at the Radisson Blu, and I would like to commend him for his exceptional housekeeping skills. Stephen demonstrated remarkable attention to detail, ensuring that my room was always impeccably clean, well-organized, and welcoming.

What truly stood out was his professionalism, dedication, and warm attitude. He went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect, responding promptly to any requests and maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness and comfort.

Stephen’s commitment to excellence reflects very positively on the Radisson Blu team. His hard work and genuine care for guests create a truly pleasant and memorable experience. I highly recommend recognizing him for his outstanding service and dedication to hospitality.

reviews.author: Noel Wanyonyi
reviews.text:
I stayed at Radisson Blu for a few days, and the entire experience was exceptional from start to finish. The hotel offers a perfect balance of comfort, elegance, and calm—ideal for both rest and productivity. The room was spacious, spotless, and thoughtfully designed, making every night restful. Food and drinks were excellent, with great variety and quality, and the overall atmosphere felt safe, organized, and welcoming. The location was also convenient and easy to walk around.
What truly made my stay memorable was the service. On the day of checkout, Vitalis kindly assisted me by carrying my bag to the reception. It was a small gesture, but it spoke volumes about his character—genuine, caring, and professional. That simple act of kindness left a lasting impression and perfectly reflected the hospitality standards of Radisson Blu.

reviews.author: Susy Esenti
reviews.text:
During my stay at Radisson Blu Hotel, I had a truly pleasant experience, and one person who stood out was Vitalis, a Public Area Attendant.
From the moment I arrived, the public areas were spotless, fresh, and very well maintained. Vitalis was always visible, working diligently with a positive attitude and a warm smile. He was polite, respectful, and very attentive to details, making sure guests felt comfortable and welcomed at all times.
It’s clear that Vitalis takes pride in his work, and his professionalism reflects the high standards of Radisson Blu. Staff members like him play a big role in creating a great guest experience.
Thank you, Vitalis, for your excellent service and dedication. You truly represent the Radisson Blu brand well. 👏

reviews.author: Ruth Mawia
reviews.text: I had a pleasant two-day stay at Radisson Blu Hotel & Residence Nairobi Arboretum. During checkout, it was raining at the canopy and I was struggling to pull my two bags as floor mats had been placed. Vitalis kindly stepped in and assisted me with one of the bags all the way to reception. This level of attentiveness is something I have rarely experienced in my travels. Thank you to the Radisson Blu team for the exceptional service. I will definitely be back soon

reviews.author: Vundi Kilonzo
reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well maintained, and the staff were extremely friendly and professional throughout my visit. The service was prompt, and the overall atmosphere was calm and welcoming. The location is convenient, making it easy to access nearby amenities. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a comfortable and pleasant stay, and I look forward to visiting again.

reviews.author: Ashley Ongera
reviews.text:
The restaurant offers a great overall experience, especially in terms of ambience and food variety. The buffet was impressive, neatly arranged and regularly replenished, which adds to a pleasant dining experience.
The live band created a warm and lively atmosphere without being overwhelming. The only downside was the grill section which was noticeably slow compared to the rest of the service but the meat was worth the wait.👌🏾

reviews.author: Wangari
reviews.text:
Ambience 10/10
Meals 5/10, their buffet for Friday all you can eat was quite basic and limited, the only meats were ribs, chicken leg and skewers. The dessert options were also very limited. Not good value for money compared to other hotels charging the same

reviews.author: Mary Racho
reviews.text: It was great,  especially the late check-out of 1pm. This is a top game! I was able to have my breakfast at ease and prepare at my pace. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Joyce Kamau
reviews.text: With Terry the experience was so awesome. She is eloquent and very well spoken. She took us on a small tour of the hotel. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: pauline nyaga
reviews.text:
Was here for dinner on a Friday, which is their barbecue day. The place was packed, now i know why, the meat/ choma was tender, juicy and so flavourful. Paired my meats with salads which were there in plenty and prepared ecxeptionally well. Reserve as early as Monday since slots ran out fast! Decided to try my luck with no reservation in place, found it full but a kind lady by the name Sophie (I hope my memory serves me right) asked us to give her 15 minutes and true to her word she got us a table.
Their basement parking is inconvenient- no lift so you have to walk up to the entrance, and given the rains, that was not cute. Maybe offer valet parking.

name: ibis Styles Nairobi Westlands
editorial_summary: Simple rooms in a relaxed budget hotel offering a rooftop bar, a restaurant & free Wi-Fi.

reviews.author: Peter King'ori
reviews.text:
What a wonderful experience!

The kids absolutely loved every moment of our stay. The dining area was beautiful, the rooms were spotless, and the breakfast was simply amazing.

The staff were warm, friendly, and very professional. They made us feel truly welcome.

Highly recommended

reviews.author: esther njoki
reviews.text: Had an amazing stay with my kids. They loved the aesthetics. The restaurant staff were friendly and breakfast was excellent with lots of variety. The housekeeping team did a great job. There was no concierge upon check in and we had to carry our own luggage from the car. Provide smart Tv in the rooms. A swimming pool would have made our stay even better. Overall, I had a great stay and I would definitely recommend the hotel.

reviews.author: Maryann Mathenge
reviews.text:
We’ve just wrapped up the most beautiful little family staycation at Ibis Styles Nairobi Westlands from Friday to Sunday, and honestly it was such a memorable experience for all of us myself, my husband, and our 4-year-old son. ✨

From the moment we arrived, the hospitality from the entire team truly stood out..Everyone was warm, welcoming, and genuinely kind. You can always tell when people enjoy what they do, and the team here really made us feel comfortable and at home throughout our stay.

Our son had the best time! The tuktuk ride was definitely a huge highlight for him 🛺, and he also loved the play area and the lively atmosphere around the hotel. One of the sweetest moments was the spontaneous birthday celebrations happening in the restaurant the singing, clapping, and cheerful energy made the whole place feel so joyful, and he was completely fascinated by it 🎉

The food was also such a big part of our experience. With the different dining options like utamu Restaurant and Kilele Nyama there was great variety throughout the stay. I’m vegetarian and I was pleasantly surprised that every day there was something delicious for me to enjoy which made things so easy. The kids’ meals were also perfect for our son, and my husband really enjoyed exploring the different options as well. Every meal felt relaxed and enjoyable for the whole family.

A very special thank you to Tamara, the marketer, who kept checking in on us and making sure everything was going well that personal touch really meant a lot.

And a big thank you to some of the wonderful team members who made our stay even more special:
• Fred from Utamu Restaurant for the warm service
• Kelvin -Kilele nyama for  always being so helpful and welcoming
• Perpetual from Kilele Nyama for the great hospitality
• And of course the lovely tuktuk driver who absolutely made our son’s day with that fun ride 🛺

It’s always the people who make a place truly special and this team did exactly that. We left feeling relaxed, happy, and grateful for such a wonderful family staycation. We truly loved every moment and can’t wait to come back again. 💛✨

reviews.author: Vivian Muhura
reviews.text: I had a girls date with my friend at the roof top bar. I enjoyed a sparkling winr and my friend a honey ginger stinger. My server was amazing  - Anne mugo. Marc the chef made nice tapas and we enjoyed. I recommended you bring your friends

reviews.author: ngongo blaise
reviews.text: Had a very lovely stay. Really enjouyed n'y stay. Met awesome staff. Very welcoming and professional. Elinah was Always at the breakfast. Always ready to help. Phillip at the breakfast was si professionnel.Interacted with Peter at the rooftop. Good services. Not yo forget Hellen who  had such good services

name: Mombasa Beach Hotel
address: Mt Kenya Rd, Beach Hotel, Links Rd, Mombasa, Kenya
editorial_summary: Laid-back beachfront hotel offering an outdoor pool & ocean views, plus 2 bars & free breakfast.

reviews.author: Isaac Ikay
reviews.text: Unforgettable stay at Kenya Safari Resort Hotel Mombasa! 🏨 The rooms were spacious, the pool was refreshing, and the staff were super friendly 😊. Loved the beach access and sunset views 🌅. Perfect mix of relaxation and adventure! 🌴 Would definitely recommended 🥰.

reviews.author: Paula W
reviews.text: The location is very close to Nyali Mall. The beachfront is excellent, and I got a nice room with a great view. Downsides include room for improvement. The grounds are not well maintained. The shower pressure is also excellent despite rusted bathtubs and showers.

reviews.author: Stephanie von Kanel
reviews.text: Ground staff tried to charge us 1,000 kes just to access a public beach that is free to access. They were incredibly rude when we tried to ask how to access the beach as we had been dropped off in the wrong place. When I questioned why we needed to pay for accessing the beach (as east Africa residents) they couldn’t answer. Will not be recommending this spot - total scam.

reviews.author: pawel c
reviews.text: Poor service. We had to wait 30 minutes for simple drinks, and the prices on the receipt were different from the menu.

name: The Reef Hotel Mombasa
editorial_summary: Informal oceanfront hotel offering casual rooms, plus 3 restaurants & a pool with a swim-up bar.

reviews.author: Maya Nadya
reviews.text:
Very Disappointing Experience – Poor Hospitality
Our experience at Reef Hotel Mombasa was extremely disappointing and exhausting. We arrived at the hotel at 4:00 AM after a long journey. We understood that check-in time was 12:00 PM and were willing to wait, but the way we were treated was unacceptable.
Instead of allowing us to rest in the lounge, we were told we could not stay there. We were exhausted, yet the staff placed us in a run-down restroom, which was in terrible condition and did not even have running water. This showed a complete lack of basic hospitality and care for guests.
Because of this, we decided to leave the hotel to go eat and return later, expecting our rooms to be ready by check-in time. We came back at 3:00 PM, well past the official check-in time, only to be told that our rooms were still not ready. It was only after we started complaining that the staff suddenly said the rooms were available.
This entire experience was frustrating, unprofessional, and far below the standards expected from a hotel. Proper communication, basic cleanliness, and simple courtesy were all missing. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone looking for comfort, respect, or decent customer service.

reviews.author: Lucindah Njoroge
reviews.text:
My family and I stayed at Reef hotel for a couple of days during our vacation and here is my true review.
The reception was generally okay , friendly staff and nuthing much . The rooms are very old and could do with renovations. The bathrooms handles and taps are spotted with rust and the give the impression of uncleanliness. The room I was in wasnt thoroughly cleaned  and I had to mention to the cleaner to do . The towels are very old and disgusting .  The beddings were okay but the beds are very old and you can see the dirty spots on them (I wish I took a pics). Due to high corrosion the door lock are also rusted and It can be a task to open the doors and sometimes stay jammed and you have to use the balcony door( we were on the ground floor) to access the room meaning we had to leave it unlocked. The balcony door was also falling apart.

The pool is very very clean and they had very attentive pool guards thus as a parent I had no worry (but still keep an eye on your kids😊). The tanga bar had great cock tails and the food wasnt soo bad maybe 3/5. But as for the staff 4/5.

Dinner and breakfast was well catered and there was a variety of food to choose from. We had an issue with one chef situated at barbecue spot that had a sour attitude but we appreciate the other staff member.

Reef hotel has a night club which is close to the accommodations and could get very noisy at night. The loud music could go on till wee hours of the morning which was kinda annoying when trying to sleep.

Personally I found the rates abit high in comparison to the services and the amenities rendered.

Accommodation: 2/5
Food: 3/5
Staff: 3/5
Rates:2/5
Accessibility:5

reviews.author: Isaura Minage
reviews.text:
The service is really wanting. I really hope you could read the reviews and implement them.
The rooms are not as pleasant as advertised, the bathroom situation is not good as well , some toilets don’t flush and the water pressure is lacking.
The food is lacking in variety.Tip: Ask for bacon during breakfast, there’s no kid friendly meals at the buffet at any given time.
Front office staff could do better in matters customer service and satisfaction it’s hospitality maybe make it hospitable?
However the location is good 10/10 , the gardens are clean and very pleasant to look at, pool is clean they have attendants round the clock to watch the kids

reviews.author: wilfred kim
reviews.text:
I stayed at the hotel for 3 days and generally enjoyed my stay.
The food was okay, especially the rice.
The staff were polite, very friendly, and warm.
The rooms were okay, though some improvements can still be made.

Overall, it was a pleasant experience.

name: Ocean View Nyali Boutique Hotel
editorial_summary: Simple quarters in a laid-back hotel offering a restaurant, an outdoor pool & a garden.

reviews.author: Mohsin Wazir Ali
reviews.text:
It's a residential property converted into a somewhat hotel.it had advertised that it has beach access which it doesn't. Apparently it did but recently construction around the hotel has totally blocked the access which they should have updated or advised us when we called them. The pool water has a salty taste and is not a family friendly pool as the shallow end is nearly 5ft and no safety railings on the sides of the pool so if you have kids who are still learning to swim it not advisable as there is no life guard and only one floater available.

We were given a double room with a twin bed and single bed which was located in the basement of the property with little ventilation. The room did not have an AC, only a wall mounted fan that rotated only 45°. The beds had mosquito nets but were small and not covering the beds at all. The bathroom most of the times didn't have water and when one showered the floors would be so slippery hight risks of taking a fall. They provide drinking water and towels in the rooms but the towels are old and torn.

The place is not for Muslims when it comes to food as they serve pork. The menu is limited and if you want any extra service from the kitchen like heating food stuff you bought from outside you have to pay extra. They have a bar which located centrally on the property and play loud music till after 10 pm. The toasts of bread are made in a sandwich maker. They don't have butter and serve jam with the bread.

Location wise it's a 10 minute walk from city mall and 15 minutes walk from nyali mall. Taxis, tuk tuks and motorbike are easily available as they pass by the property and can stop one outside the gate.

I'd give this property zero stars but the option was not there. Don't pay in advance id advise one to check out the place and room they going to give you before making any decision. Don't recommend the place to anyone.

reviews.author: Robert Storbacka
reviews.text: Very good value for your money.  Not the best location with alot of building going around. The pool was not very attractive.  The beach is 10 min a way and was a totalt disaster.

reviews.author: Eden Mezgebe
reviews.text: The place is a scam. We paid for aircon but the air-conditioning was not working. But when we asked for refund they refused. Please don't go there if you want to use air-conditioning. The place is also over priced and rooms don't have enough lighting. We wasted our nine days there.

reviews.author: David Gachoki
reviews.text: Most poor customer service I have ever experienced in a hotel and they don't seem to care. One would be mad to come back again

It's not a luxurious at all.
We've been visiting each day the beach and as much as you can get rid of sand and seaweed there's always something that ends up in your bed, the staff are not allowed to change everyday the bedding but rather every other day.
I'm not happy about this at all.
I thought it was included the breakfast but now we had to pay separately. The food is 1 out of 10.

We had the best week in that hotel. The service was outstanding and the breakfast alone is worth the stay. The restaurant attached to the hotel had great food and drinks too. The room was spacious and spotless clean.
W would always come back.

reviews.author: Benoit Hazard
reviews.text: I love this place ...quiet, nice people ( no well paid unfortunatly), biutifull pool... The hôtel i prefer in mombasa and....very safe

reviews.author: Hellen Brahane
reviews.text: We stayed at Kahama over the Christmas holidays and had a wonderful time at this cozy hotel. The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive, which we truly appreciated. The breakfast buffets were delicious, and the rooms were spacious and clean. The hotel also has a restaurant that serves excellent à la carte meals. Plus, it’s conveniently close to the beach. We’re already looking forward to coming back again soon!

reviews.author: niwils
reviews.text: I have stayed here many times. The staff are amazing.

name: PrideInn Paradise Beach Resort & Spa Mombasa
editorial_summary: Casual rooms, some offering ocean views, in a relaxed beach resort with a water park & a nightclub.

reviews.author: Sera Muli
reviews.text: Our stay was absolutely amazing. The hospitality was exceptional and the atmosphere warm and welcoming. Special thanks to Nesta from the F&B and the team for the outstanding service and friendly attitude every meal was a pleasure. Rodney made water aerobics so much fun with his energy and positivity. The dancers delivered incredible entertainment, full of life and talent, and the security team was professional and reassuring throughout our stay. This resort truly feels like home away from home. Highly recommended I can’t wait to bring my mom again❤️

reviews.author: Vimalkumar Chauhan
reviews.text:
I stayed at PrideInn Paradise Beach Resort and had an excellent experience. The property is very spacious, well designed, and extremely well maintained. The rooms are luxurious and comfortable. The staff is genuinely warm, helpful, and professional throughout the stay.

The food is outstanding and easily the best in its category. The resort has three restaurants, Dau, Bistro, and Infinity. The variety is impressive with many options across cuisines. Every meal was high quality and well presented. Chef Shailendra deserves special mention for making us feel truly at home.

The service level is clearly superior compared to other resorts in the same price range around Mombasa. You get true value for money here. As a bonus, they serve the best Long Island I have had in Mombasa.

I would strongly recommend this resort for comfort, food, service, and overall experience.

reviews.author: Adhiambo Catherine
reviews.text:
The rooms are well kept.
Clean and everything well explained in case you need to reach out or need something extra.
The service is a bit wanting, drinks take long to prepare if it’s not your normal bottled drink, found them slow.
Communication is also poor and contradicting between what you are told at the reception and the actual event.
They also don’t communicate in case there’s a change of venue so you have to figure it out on your own.

The location is serene and quiet and quite the distance for someone who never likes going beyond City Mall. Hopefully with the completion of the road works it will be faster

reviews.author: Nadia Njeri
reviews.text: Prideinn paradise is one of the best resorts I have visited so far. Everyone is so friendly from the gate. They make you feel valued. The environment is clean and the rooms are cozy. It's a family friendly resort. Caroline checked on us everyday and my kids ended up liking her so much. Good work. Will surely be back.

reviews.author: Beatrice Laizer
reviews.text:
We had a family holiday during New Year and it was wonderful experience for all of us.
Great customer service with every staff your meet.. Marino club was really fun with Ms. Knight taking great care of the children..Mr. David was keen watching our children at the pool, alway smiling and making us feel at home.. Mr. John Baraza handled us very well when we needed to upgrade our accommodation and daily checked on us to ensure we enjoyed our stay.. The whole Prideinn family made us feel at home.. reviews.author: Juma Alex
reviews.text: I like the place splendid

reviews.author: Home Fleek
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Al Yusra Restaurant in Mombasa was such a great experience. The food was delicious, full of flavor, and served fresh. The atmosphere was warm and comfortable, making it a lovely place to enjoy a meal.

A special thank you to Rachel, who was incredibly welcoming and kind. She took the time to talk with us, made us feel at home, and even shared about the amazing work she’s doing with her church on Sundays — truly inspiring and heartfelt. Her hospitality really stood out and made our visit memorable.

Highly recommend this place for both the food and the wonderful service. Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Mohamed Ahmed
reviews.text:
It was great to be here for 5 days in Mombasa. Al Yusra Restaurant in Mombasa has great staff, good food, and very nice hospitality. The people are amazing – you will not miss home if you are at Al Yusra.

There was a lady waiter who helped us, Rocheal. She was wonderful and gave us very good service.

Please, if you come to Mombasa, pass by Al Yusra – you will not regret it.

Mohamed ahmed  from london

reviews.author: Hassan Weheliye
reviews.text:
Review for Palm Tree Hotel, Mombasa

I had a wonderful stay at the Palm Tree Hotel in Mombasa. The rooms are spotless, very well maintained, and provide a comfortable and relaxing environment. What really stood out was the friendliness of the staff – everyone went out of their way to make me feel welcome. A special thanks goes to the restaurant team, who were exceptionally helpful and attentive throughout my stay. Their warm service and professionalism made my experience even more enjoyable. I highly recommend this hotel for anyone visiting Mombasa and will definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Chris Reichartz
reviews.text:
Very competitive prices. The Chai tea was amazing. The waiters and waitresses are patient and courteous. We had a head of restaurant greet us with a smile.
Great hospitality in restaurant.I only ate at restaurant no stay.

reviews.author: Ebrahim Jaffer
reviews.text: The best Mandi I have ever tried. The service is quick and staff very polite. The restuarant is very spacious. Good choice in the menu but Mandi is the best. For dessert you must try their Khunafa. Highly recommended when in Mombasa. Centrally located.

name: Baobab holiday resort ltd

name: Royal Court Hotel, Mombasa
editorial_summary: Warm rooms & suites in an informal property offering 2 restaurants, a casino & an outdoor pool.

reviews.author: Sea, Sand, and Sun
reviews.text:
Our recent stay at the Royal Court Hotel offered a mix of positive interactions and significant issues. While the hotel staff were consistently friendly and accommodating, a clear lack of maintenance and modern amenities detracted from the experience.

​The room itself was spacious but fell short on basic comforts. The absence of a bar fridge was notable, and the bathroom presented several problems, including inconsistent hot water, moldy shower tiles, and weak water pressure. The small television, old and stained towels, and an uncomfortably hard bed further contributed to a disappointing stay. The tiled floors and poor sound insulation meant that external noise was a constant disturbance.

​Dining was a low point. The food quality was poor, and guests should be prepared to eat elsewhere. We also discovered a lack of takeaway cups for coffee, so bringing a travel mug is a necessity for those who enjoy a hot drink on the go.

​In terms of other services, the Wi-Fi speed was average at around 20Mbps. Parking is limited, with only a few off-street spots available. While amenities such as a swimming pool, gym, and bar are listed, we did not use them.

​Overall, the Royal Court Hotel appears to have seen better days. Despite its historic charm, the lack of investment in modernizing and maintaining the property is evident and significantly impacts the quality of a guest's stay. For those considering this area, a more modern and well-maintained alternative like the Premium Inn Hotel may be a better choice.

Did an overnight stay on a Saturday night with my girlfriend and her child.  Booked online previously.  Arrived before 12 check-in and they were very helpful, checking us in as a room was available. The room (ocean view) was lovely.  Classic furniture (not old as such, just classic) was combined with a very clean room and bathroom.  Balcony had a great view obviously.
Service overall was fantastic in the lobby, at the pool and in the restaurant.

I definitely will return.  I had been there on day passes before so kind of knew what to expect.  So it was really just confirming the room situation for me.  It somewhat reminded me a Caribbean resort but on the Indian ocean.

reviews.text: The hotel’s location in Nyali offers beautiful beach views, the rooms are spotless and thoughtfully designed, and the food is fresh and tasty, although the menu lacked variety. However, what truly overshadowed the experience was the reception staff. They were unfriendly and unaccommodating, I was late for checkout for an hour but the way I was rushed out of the room felt dismissive and condescending. Despite the appealing setting and comfortable rooms, the poor service left a lasting negative impression. In hindsight, I regret not choosing a different hotel for my stay.

reviews.author: Emily Gonthier
reviews.text:
I attended a week-long conference there so while I cannot speak for the rooms, I can share my experience about the place in general and the service.
The hotel itself is quite nice. It is basically on the beach. There is a lovely view of the ocean and the way the hotel is built on the natural rock formations is very interesting and beautiful. The beach is not great but I am a bit biased about beaches. There is a bit of natural debris (seaweed and such) on the beach and in the water so the beach did not entice me. But it is a lovely view.
The conference facilities are adequate. The meeting room we were in was well equipped and comfortable. We did have a few power outages especially on one of the days in particular, but I am not sure if that is attributable to the hotel or an issue beyond their control. However, it was quickly restored each time, I'm assuming because they have a backup generator.
We ate lunch at the restaurant on all the days, and it was quite a decent buffet. The staff are quite nice and friendly, and it is a nice atmosphere.
I also used their spa - specifically the hair salon and I can say I had a good experience. Very friendly ladies and good service.

reviews.author: Maureen Msaky
reviews.text:
The Hotel is just by the shore of the Beach,  with great view of the ocean from different angles. The staff are friendly and quick to respond. Though noticed at the time of our stay, there were many on Job training. Not all rooms have the beach front view and we got the standard room, the size is okay for a couple only with a balcony view of the hotel. The bedding, towels and other amenities in the room were not to standard, old and low quality. The food options were limited especially for lunch and dinner, but if you're a vegetarian you're sorted. Food quality was nothing to write home about, if you don't like spices, then this is for you.
The have a few activities like swimming,  table tennis, Beach  kayaking and the likes.

reviews.text: They charge higher than any 5* hotel, but the rooms aren't good and the service is even worse. I booked sea view hotel room 15 days, they provided garden view, citing that the sea view rooms aren't available. I mean, if I have booked it, how come you give it to someone else! Not very hygeinic, lot of insects, ants, flies and mosquitoes. However, the hotel is located at an excellent location. You can go to the beach, just below the hotel and enjoy.

reviews.author: Eveliina Molin
reviews.text:
Amazing boutique hotel right by the sea, small, peaceful, and beautifully maintained. With around 20 rooms, it feels private and safe, especially with a 24/7 guard by the pool ensuring only guests can enter from the beach.

Our room was spacious, spotless, and very comfortable. Daily cleaning, AC, mosquito nets, and even bug‑spraying every day made the stay incredibly comfortable.

Breakfast was delicious—mostly local dishes that changed every morning, plus you can order eggs, bacon, or anything you want freshly made by the staff.

The whole team was wonderful, but Pauline at reception truly made our stay unforgettable. Even before we arrived, she sent us the number of a trustworthy taxi driver who picked us up from the airport and ended up being our go‑to driver for the whole trip. When our bags didn’t arrive from Nairobi, she calmed me down, took charge of calling everywhere, and had them back the next day. She gave fantastic tips, made us feel incredibly welcome, and we had great chats and laughs throughout our stay.

Because of her and the entire team, we wouldn’t stay anywhere else in Mombasa. Highly recommend!

The staff were dismissive and made no effort to offer an alternative. For the price I paid, I expected at least a little hospitality. I will not be staying here again, and I would not recommend it to anyone who values even the simplest form of guest care

reviews.author: Viktor Kozma
reviews.text:
The place is in the center of Mtwapa Town but in a nice, silent street. It's like a peaceful hideout. The hotel was built two years ago so everything is new. The staff is kind, smiling and helpful. The breakfast included is however the reason I don't give 5 star for the review. Breakfast is poor: two thin toasts, one egg, one small sausage and half banana with a cup of chai. If you want to eat one more egg, they charge you.
The rooms are clean, no insects, no dirt they clean every day and they give you extra towel and water if needed. Two things however are missing : air conditioner and a smaller fridge. There's a ceiling fan top of the bed which is good.
Overall, the place is good, not expensive and if they improve the mentioned, they become perfect. I recommend this place.

name: Serena Beach Resort & Spa
address: Shanzu Beach Homes, Serena Rd, Mombasa, Kenya
editorial_summary: Beachfront spa resort with a Swahili village vibe, offering dining, water sports & entertainment.

reviews.author: Ivette Vure
reviews.text:
We are leaving from the most amazing stay at Serena Beach Resort in Mombasa, and I cannot recommend it highly enough. From the moment we arrived, everything was simply wonderful. The hotel itself is beautiful, with stunning surroundings, relaxing atmosphere, and impeccable attention to detail that truly makes it feel like a little piece of paradise.

What made our holiday especially memorable was the incredible staff. Every single member of the team was warm, professional, and genuinely caring. A special thank you to Sylvester for his outstanding service — attentive, friendly, and always going the extra mile to make sure we were comfortable and happy. It’s staff like him who turn a lovely holiday into an unforgettable one.

The food, hospitality, and overall ambiance were exceptional. You can really feel the heart and pride that goes into making guests feel welcome.

If I could make one small suggestion, it would be for the Nyota Terrace to be made more welcoming with vibrant colours and a stronger African theme. Adding richer tones, cultural patterns, and more local-inspired décor would truly elevate the space and make it feel even more connected to the beautiful coastal surroundings.

Thank you to the entire team for giving us such special memories. We are already looking forward to coming back!

reviews.author: Chalwe Mwewa
reviews.text: My family and I had a great time here. The service from the staff was exceptional. They were always happy to help. The half board option went a long way. The food was amazing and the chef was always ready to tend to a family members special diet. The children emjoyed the kids club. My stay here will definitely be one to remember

reviews.author: Carl
reviews.text:
Beautiful beach side resort in beautiful Mombasa. The staff is extremely friendly and attentive. The restaurants on property are top tier with food selection. The view from your room is amazing and I love how the local wildlife comes up to the patio. Keep an eye out for the cute monkeys that roam property, they will try to party with you. I love Serena resorts, they never disappoint.

***Update on the review, the final day unfortunately overshadowed all the great I experienced while staying at the resort. The lack of organization at the front desk is ridiculous. Random charges ending up on the incorrect rooms, double charging for services that were prepaid, and the dishonesty of charging multiple guests in the group for vehicle service that was already taken care of. Very disappointed in how the checkout process was handled. I highly recommend keeping track of anything you are signing for and make sure to settle the room bill every night to ensure nothing new gets added.

reviews.author: A L.
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time at Serena. Serena is beautiful as always, staff are amazingly friendly and passionate to bring happiness to their guests. The only downside was the rooms are a little outdated and facing the ocean make them very damp, but I guess that’s part of the weather here in Mombasa. Everything else was perfect and we really enjoyed our time here.

They really went out of their way to create unforgettable memories for us, which was completely unexpected and a surprise for us. The restaurant hostess Rosemary and our waiter Mikky prepared such a sweet and romantic breakfast by the sea for us to celebrate our honeymoon, which really made our day. They’re into every detail to ensure this lovely experience, thank you so much :)

Our flight also got cancelled on the day we checkout due to an industry-wide strike, Romano and Anne from the reception and guest relations helped us to navigate quickly through the chaos and quickly secured another flight that works for our travel plan, which we wouldn’t be able to do without all the local information and knowledge. Thank you for ensuring us a smooth travel, and helping with something that’s outside your responsibility.

I lived in Mombasa 23 years ago and Serena was part of my childhood experience where we sometimes came for a drink/meal and enjoy the lovely views. This time staying for our honeymoon makes it even more meaningful and special. Thanks Serena for treating us well, we’ll be back :)

reviews.author: Johnstone T
reviews.text:
Was hosted at hotel for the #AMRKenya2026 conference. Serene, calming ambience of the location, excellent rooms with great views of the sea and such a warm, efficient and friendly staff!

Conference amenities superb; fresh and splendid variety of meals and snacks, on-site conference room outside kitchen! Lovely experience!

Certainly best value for money!

name: Jumeirah Beachfront Apartments, Hotel & Venue Space

reviews.author: Shabir Bharadia
reviews.text: It's a well designed and quality built complex on Nyali Beach. The beach is very clean as is the sea water with several water activities available through the front office. The service from the staff is exceptional throughout this large complex. It's a gated community with good security. Transportation is reasonable and accessible. The office personnel is available to meet any needs.

reviews.author: Valentine Ayuko
reviews.text:
Went here for Christmas with family. The Location is great, great beach front view. Pool area is also great. However the service was terrible. Took almost 2 hours to get food and 3 hours for drinks. Only for the waiters to tell us to go serve, buffet style and carry our own food 200 meters away. The lamb chops were undercooked...with blood oozing off it. They served us on paper plates like it was a toddler birthday party. Food was blown away cuz those paper plates couldn't hold. I wonder how such a beach front hotel would use paper plates and cups yet there's a beach we need to protect, I know nema doesn't approve.

The head of client relations, Mohamed...tried to calm that fire from guests including us. He was attentive and took our complaints nicely. He refunded us two plates of food that had been blown away. Hopefully he raises these issues with management and they're looked into.

reviews.author: S ss (Wanderer)
reviews.text:
I had an amazing room right next to the beach—serene, rustic, and close enough to hear the waves from my room. The room was relatively clean, the service good, and the price better than most hotels in the area. None of the nearby hotels offer this kind of beach proximity. There’s also an on-site restaurant with decent food options.

The only downside is that many non-guests come in during the evening, so it can get quite crowded.

reviews.text: Nice hotel with clean rooms and a beautiful beach view. You can easily walk to the beach, and the morning view from the room is amazing. The restaurant food was good and the place is well maintained. At night, especially on weekends, the restaurant gets crowded with partying, drinking, and some hookah smoking—so it’s not ideal if you want a quiet stay. If you enjoy a lively vibe, it’s a good place to stay.
