Kudos North coast beach hotel and keep it up 🙏,kudos

reviews.author: Justin Munene
reviews.text: Not bad for a government owned (KU). Great staff. Do something about maintenance. Overgrown lawn grass maybe due to bureaucracy but overly the staff are great and welcoming. They were also kind enough to check us in after we arrived many hours early

reviews.author: Aggie Blessed
reviews.text:
Anyone who values good food, excellent services and a good relaxing place away from home.
The staffs are so friendly and welcoming in all departments,been to several hotels bit North coast beach staff are out of this world,they are the real meaning of hospitality industry.
Family friendly.
I wish the government can tarmac their road from where the tarmac road ends at Sun and sand hotel

reviews.author: Emma B
reviews.text:
Love this place. Anytime I come to Kenya and Mombasa I stay here! It’s right in the center.
From arriving you’re greeted by friendly staff, the people in the bar, the guards, the cleaners and the reception. Everyone is great!
The rooms are big, clean and nice furniture and complementary drinking water in the room. Good Ac, tv, fridge.
There is a nice pool and lounge area on the roof. Very peaceful despite the heavy traffic outside.

reviews.author: Miss Courage
reviews.text: Amazing place ! Great pool and rooms. But the food and menu requires improvement with quality of cooking  and the wine can be served stale or old. Chef and Bar need a boost. This does not stop me returning. Great hotel and lovely staff.

reviews.author: Denis Kioko
reviews.text: Had a pleasant stay at Sentrim Castle Royal. The hotel has a classic charm and is conveniently located in the heart of Mombasa, making it easy to access nearby attractions. The staff were friendly and professional, and the rooms were clean and comfortable. The restaurant also serves great meals, and the breakfast options were impressive. A great choice for both business and leisure stays in Mombasa.

reviews.author: Habiba
reviews.text:
Worse treatment ever.
I wasn't welcome well at all since I'm from Kenya,they said I didn't book the room n told me to look for somewhere else to sleep until I gave my partner who is from abroad the phone and after talking to him they changed and became polite. Bad manners.how can you treat your fellow Kenyan badly and treat a foreigner better. Sad 😔. I'll never ever recommend it nor set my foot there

reviews.author: Nav Star (Elite Produxions Ltd)
reviews.text: I cannot fault this hotel at all . Staff ,security , room cleaness everything 5Star ,highly recommended place to stay . Just 20mins from the airport located on Moi Ave right in the middle of mombasa .

name: Diani Reef Beach Resort & Spa
address: Diani Beach Road, Diani Beach, Kenya
editorial_summary: Upmarket beachfront resort offering gardens, a spa & an outdoor pool, plus 8 bars & restaurants.

reviews.author: Lance R
reviews.text: We were scared off by some of the reviews for an overnight stay.  So we arrived mid-morning to get a day pass to check it out as we really just wanted a place to park ourselves for a day.  On check-in we were told we can use beach but not pool because the resort was full.  Pool is relatively small for a resort that size.  But we were able to have our small child use the kids pool and play area...we only saw 1 other kid in that over the several hours we were there.  It was helpful to have a secure beach area to leave our backpacks while walking the beach.  Only real disappointment, other than being refused the pool, was finding out several hours later in mid-afternoon a friend of my girlfriend was allowed pool access for the day pass. I can't comment on rooms, but food service was adequate.  All we had were sandwiches/burgers; and they were fine.  Staff was also very polite and helpful.  No issues there at all.  Maybe on a future trip we will overnight and try a room.

reviews.author: Alina Bostan
reviews.text:
We have stayed here for 7 days, all inclusive (full bord). The hotel needs upgrades regarding the rooms (old and used-up furniture), especially in the bathrooms (very old and rusted amenities - sink batteris, showers, wood dors etc). There was no hairdryer in the room. The beach towels were old & torn, the beach lounge sofas were also in bad shape (the stufing was coming out). ...definetly not a 4* quality anymore.
The staff was friendly but very very slow in bringin your order, so come here with a lot of patience.
The best point of the hotel was the food - very good, diverse, with enough selection  for both meat/vegetable options. At evey meal we had also 3 selections of fruits and some cakes. A bit disapointed were the fruit juices, not the best.
Every day they had some program at the pool. At 4pm they offer a "snack" (cakes, tea, coffee). Every evening they had an evening attraction (acrobats, bands etc) *consider a budget for tips
If you do not have lunch in your initial reservation, you can order an 'a la carte' lunch (from their restaurant menu) or 'buy' the buffet-lunch (20$ per day).
Is a good place to enjoy the sun and perfect water, but not at 4* rank quality.

reviews.author: Bea
reviews.text:
Hotel is just lovely! Has a good vibe and staff is amazing. Everyone is helpful, super polite, smiling. They are a sell for this hotel.

Rooms are a bit 'tired', I would expect more activities like yoga etc as well.

All in all I recommend stay in this hotel.

reviews.author: Yacwasthere
reviews.text:
Arrival was smooth with a nice setting and a friendly, efficient welcome. However, the rooms feel quite dated, and the room phone was not working properly, making it difficult to request services like towels.

Breakfast is fairly varied with a good selection. The outdoor areas, including the pool and beach, are very pleasant with a beautiful view. Unfortunately, the frequent presence of vendors approaching or staring at guests is uncomfortable and takes away from the overall charm. The spa was also closed during my stay.

reviews.author: Anthony Nyamu
reviews.text:
Diani Reef is a heartbreak of a property. The location is world-class, but the resort itself is badly maintained and falling apart.

The Good: The staff are the only reason this place functions. They are exceptional, hardworking, and kind, but they are clearly stretched way too thin by management.

The Bad: The infrastructure is crumbling. Between the peeling paint, dated rooms, and general lack of maintenance, the "luxury" title no longer fits.

The Reality: Poor management has let this beautiful spot slide into a state of neglect. It’s run-down and desperately needs a renovation.

Verdict: Go for the beach, but expect a property that has seen much better days. I'd NOT recommend or be going back!!!

name: Diamonds Leisure Beach & Golf Resort
address: Diani Road, South, Coast, Kwale, Kenya
editorial_summary: Bright rooms & suites in a beachfront resort offering 4 pools, diving lessons, a casino & dining.

reviews.author: Stella S
reviews.text:
Lovely beachfront hotel, enormous but lots of break out spaces and some music performances  beachside in the evenings. Made  awesome new friends and had some wonderful days and evenings. We will revisit.!
Poolside DJ and bar is a cool feature and there's lots of activities throughout the day across the 3 pools.  Great for families and couples. Very nice course across the road is part of the resort. Bang on the main strip at the South coast ( but set way back from the road of course)  and a few minutes from delicious local cuisine, pubs, numerous Italian restaurants and cafes

reviews.author: Mary Mungai
reviews.text:
Diamond leisure and golf resorts review..
Where should I start. Let me start from the very beginning. We were walk-ins in October 2025. The place is beautiful. Clean . Everything is gorgeous, interior designer deserves some award.We met Lucy at the front desk and the angel girl showed us around , showed us a room. She was so lovely kind . And we were completely sold and decided to book our next vacation there.  So January comes and we are so excited. This is where it goes downhill. Lucy Ngunjiri remember that name cause this lady was a pure professional angel. We came in at around 12pm, check in was to be Abt 2pm. Tell me why the rooms were unavailable till around 4:30pm. So we are just so tired we can't get to the room and rest. My child can't have a nap. Why did it take so long?. And mind youu they claim they can't give you a late check out but they can delay you . We finally get the rooms and it the wrong rooms. We been discussing and fully paid since October and now it's the wrong rooms. We were frantic. Again lovely Lucy came to the rescue . But the whole day already been wasted with the back and forth! .
Personally I can say the staff at the front desk were polite but from then on every other one I met  was aloof. Have to call out Juma. Very aloof and rude.  The activities are lacking. The night entertainment beyond mediocre. The food also honestly not a variety.( In comparison to baobab and southern palm) . The kept the plates in one location during dinner . So every time u have to go all the way to this one place with the plates. Why not keep the plates in several places. ( Near the dessert, fruits, barbeque)  . Honestly I would not revisit the vibe was not there. This may sound off bt I also missed seeing more kenyans here , made me wonder if reason I did not love it is because am not the target market.

reviews.author: Artur
reviews.text:
Overall a great hotel, with an amazing view and location. Friendly staff and nice food.
Great beach and beach bar spot, very clean and comfy sunbeds.

Cons:
- The bathroom in the room is very old, the shower is like in a hostel - not a 4 star hotel.
- The drinks on All-Inclusive take forever to be made by the bartenders. Sometimes they even forget about your order at all. The average wait time for 2 drinks is around 20 minutes or more (without queues). Most of the time they would say that some ingredients for the drink are missing and they would have to go look for it in some other bars. There is also sth called All-Inclusive Premium, with “premium” alcohol. So on normal AI you won’t even be able to order Aperol Spritz or Whiskey.
- The cleaning staff forgot something every day. Sometimes we were not given new water bottles in the room, or no towels at all.
- The hair dryers is available at special request at the reception

reviews.author: Simona Oancea
reviews.text: We came here 3 days with a day pass and it was a nice experience. They have 4 pools and a large access to the beach, the entire area is relaxing, no loud music, everything is clean. Staff is really friendly and polite. The full day pass is 3000 kes, half day 1500 kes and they offer access to beach, sun-bed, towel, access to pools (which is a plus compared to nearby resorts). There is no food or drink included, but you can eat at the a la carte restaurant on the beach or pay the access to the buffet meal - 3500 lunch and 4000 dinnner.

reviews.author: Piotr Kargol
reviews.text:
I totally recommend this Hotel. Our room was spotless. Breakfast
, lunch and dinner were delicious 😋
staff were attentive and always ready to help. It has very wide and well-kept beach. I would especially like to give my thanks to Ms. Joyce the receptionist and Alfonso the bartender.

reviews.author: Y Lu
reviews.text: Amazing and hospitable staff ...warm and helpful. Professional. I especially commend Philes for making up my room beautifully. She took time to make me feel special....lovely flower arrangement when I got back to my room one evening..... The food was so tasty too....better than most hotels.

reviews.author: Nexalle
reviews.text:
Guys, anyone who has not stepped at prideinn hotel is time to experience the best you haven't in this world.
There rooms are super nice, service is topnotch, and very much strategically and conveniently located.
I say again it's truly a nice place.

reviews.author: Mary Kinyanjui
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ PrideInn Diani – Excellent Service!

I’ve been staying at PrideInn Diani from Monday until today, and my experience has been wonderful. The service has been very good throughout my stay. The staff were friendly, attentive, and always willing to assist, which made the entire visit smooth and enjoyable.

The environment is calm and welcoming, and everything was well taken care of. I truly appreciated the warm hospitality and would gladly recommend PrideInn Diani to anyone looking for a pleasant and comfortable stay.

reviews.author: Cryptic Maniac
reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, the rooms were clean and comfortable, and the overall atmosphere made me feel right at home. I really appreciated the smooth check-in process and the great service throughout my stay. I’d happily recommend this place to anyone looking for a relaxing and enjoyable experience.”

reviews.author: Marilyn Nyabuti
reviews.text:
My family and I generally had an amazing stay at Pride inn, Diani. I was specifically impressed by the warm and baby friendly service we received at the restaurant and pool. I want to specifically appreciate Aunty Popo the lifeguard at the pool for her patience with the kids and the restaurant staff for accommodating our meal requests for our 1 year old.

One thing that really inconvenienced us was being allocated two separate rooms yet we had booked and paid for the family room. The hotel should have communicated to us as they realized they had “double booked” the room as opposed to waiting for us to find out on arrival. Having to operate from 2 separate rooms with young children was a great inconvenience .

reviews.author: Corporate Gushers
reviews.text:
This’s a beautiful neat place to be. Rooms are clean and surprisingly quiet even with the roadside traffic!

Guys were very friendly and relatable. This particular guy James is staff extraordinaire! He goes extra miles with his warm personality.

I took a walk to the beach which isn’t far from there and I loved the view.

I’ll be back!

reviews.author: Michael Njogu
reviews.text: As a first timer, I thought the service was really good. The staff members were very friendly and made us feel comfortable. The food was savoury and the portions were good. I believe it's an ideal place for small groups and families visiting Diani.

reviews.author: Hellen Koopman
reviews.text: Although it's not a beach front hotel or resort, it's the perfect hotel to be around Mombasa!!! Very clean, food is good (although some staff misinformed us regarding the food prices: ask for the menu and order food according to your budget, don't be misled that the food there is expensive)! The rooms are not as big but they are very comfortable and cozy with the perfect air conditioning which is a must in Mombasa

reviews.author: Onyango Kevin
reviews.text: The service from their staff is top notch, the rooms are spacious with absolutely comfy beds. The experience was great and one not to forget. Also amazing, fresh quality breakfast.

reviews.author: Cynthia Muriithi
reviews.text: We had an amazing honeymoon filled with little surprise from this team. The food was fresh and the staff were very accommodating. The hotel  is conveniently close to the beach and shopping centre.

name: Southern Palms Beach Resort
address: Plot LR 13430, Diani Beach Road Diani, Ukunda, Kenya
editorial_summary: All-inclusive, beachfront resort with airy quarters & a dive centre, plus 12 restaurants & bars.

reviews.author: Dorothy Lewis
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful stay at Southern Palms Beach Resort. From the moment I arrived, everything was smooth, welcoming, and very well organized. The resort is beautiful, clean, and perfectly located on the stunning Diani Beach.

My Oceanfront Deluxe room was amazing—spacious, comfortable, spotless, and with incredible views of the ocean. It was the perfect place to relax and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of the resort and the beautiful beachfront.

A special thank you goes to Regina, Guest Experience Assistant, who truly made my stay unforgettable. She helped with my check-in and went above and beyond to arrange several incredible experiences for me. Regina organized an amazing private dinner on the beach, which was beautifully set up and absolutely magical. She also helped arrange a fantastic beach cabana experience and a jet ski activity, which were highlights of my visit.

Zakia, my cabana attendant, was wonderful and very attentive. And although I unfortunately don’t remember his name, the gentleman who served my Dinner on the Beach provided excellent service and made the evening even more special.

The entire staff was friendly, professional, and welcoming, and you can tell the team takes pride in creating a great guest experience.

I highly recommend Southern Palms Resort to anyone visiting Diani Beach. It’s a beautiful property with excellent service and unforgettable ocean views.

reviews.author: Riaan Gould
reviews.text:
Absolutely beautiful resort!! Extremely Friendly staff. The food on buffet and Grill restaurant are exceptional!! The Italian restaurant needs some attention & supervision, the food and service were below average.
Amazing pools, always kept clean and there's constantly one of the pool attendants fishing out leafs or things that tend to blow into the pool (WELL DONE TO YOU GUYS!!!)
Stunning views of the beach and lots security always around to make sure that you feel safe.

reviews.author: JAISHREE PATEL
reviews.text:
All excellent food and waiters very responsive and friendly. Enjoyed their services and warm welcome.
Music is superb enjoyed it thoroughly.
Chefs have been very accommodating with personal requests for special dietary requirements. Keep it up***
Towels are worn out also linen, you need to change them please.
At certain places after it's dark the lights are missing. Please look into this urgently as accident can happen and the holiday will end in hospital.

reviews.author: Miay Sray
reviews.text:
Southern Palms Beach Resort is not just a hotel – it truly feels like a home away from home. From the very first moment, Big Mama Mercie takes care of the guests as if they were her own children, making everyone feel welcomed, safe, and deeply cared for.
The owner and his family are wonderful, warm-hearted, kind, and incredibly hospitable people who create the unique family atmosphere of this place.
Kamal, the head chef, is a true master of his craft – every meal is prepared with passion, heart, and exceptional skill, and the food is simply unforgettable.
Special appreciation also goes to the security team, especially Juma, who ensures guests’ safety with great professionalism and kindness.
Staying at this hotel truly makes you feel like part of one big family. It is a place that stays in your heart and calls you back. Highly recommended from the bottom of my heart.

reviews.author: Rudi Mehta Photography
reviews.text:
I’ve just come back from a stay at Southern Palms Beach Resort in Mombasa, and I have to say — the experience inside the resort was fantastic. The choice of food is on another level, with a huge variety of both vegetarian and non-veg dishes, plus plenty of beverages to keep you going throughout the day. You won’t go hungry here, that’s for sure.

The staff truly make the place. Customer service from Mercie was exceptional and friendly, attentive, and always ready to help. The chefs, serving staff, and even the security guards deserve a mention; they made sure we were always comfortable and never troubled. It’s rare to see this level of care, and they genuinely take pride in what they do.

Now, the only downside  and it’s outside the resort’s control  is the beach walk in the early morning. It’s simply not peaceful. Local beach sellers approach you constantly, and it does get a bit much when all you want is a quiet stroll. It’s part of the local culture, but still, it can be off-putting.

All that said, the resort itself is excellent and absolutely worth visiting. Great hospitality, great food, and a solid place to unwind. I’d definitely recommend Southern Palms Beach Resort for anyone visiting Mombasa.

name: Bahari Dhow Beach Villas
address: Diani, Diani Beach Road, Diani Beach, Kenya
editorial_summary: Relaxed beachfront hotel featuring an outdoor pool, an international restaurant & a bar.

reviews.author: Aluoch Okumu
reviews.text:
The swimming pool was constantly dirty. The cleaning started around 10 am when everyone was already awake.
The rooms are big enough and were kept clean although the facilities are very old. The taps are totally rusty, one of the villas was constantly without electricity making it unbearably hot. The TVs in the villas did not function at all. Wifi is very poor.

The management is responsive to queries and complaints.

Breakfast was without varieties. They served tasteless fruits. No sausages for kids at all for the five days we were there.
Facilities like pool table, table tennis are not always available for guests. At some point we had to beg the lady in charge to allow us.

The location is at the beach front making it one of the attractions about the villas

reviews.author: BARBRA MUDUDA
reviews.text: This is a great place for a vacarion, whether you're travelling solo or with a large group. The villas were clean, well-maintained and regularly serviced throughout my stay. The staff were friendly,attentive and truly made the experience even better. Being right on the beachfront, the views were absolutely stunnjng. Amazing massive pool. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Redi Ouss
reviews.text:
The staff are friendly and the restaurant itself is not bad. It is also understandable that many businesses are struggling, but there should still be a visible effort to improve the overall experience.

Some of the infrastructure raises serious concerns. The manholes near the restaurant appear old and unsafe, and there is a noticeable stench coming from them. The toilets are poorly lit, and there is a notice instructing guests not to enter with sand from the beach. However, guests are required to walk all the way to the pool area to clean off, which makes little sense. A simple cleaning tap at the toilet entrance would easily solve this.

Inside the bathrooms, there are no hanging poles, and the separation between gents and ladies is poorly designed. Outside seating areas do exist and are pleasant in concept, but the shade is inadequate. The sisal poles are worn out and spaced too far apart to provide meaningful cover from the sun.

With some basic upgrades and better planning, this place could offer a much better experience. Right now, it feels like missed potential.

reviews.author: Veljko Zivanovic
reviews.text: Cleaning, bed linen and towels only on request. The staff is very slow, kindness is not their strong point. There is no hairdryer in the room, the TV doesn't work. There is no seafood, tonic, or gin in the restaurant for days. It was not possible to use the pool for 10 days, because it was so dirty, and they were cleaning it for days. The price is affordable, but the quality of everything is poor.

reviews.author: Martin J
reviews.text: Housekeeping staff don’t have room keys, so you must be present while they clean or leave your room unlocked. All three pools were treated at the same time, making them unusable, and even afterward they looked murky due to low water level and poor circulation. There were several maintenance issues around the resort. Breakfast at the beach restaurant was unpleasant with too many cats and flies, and the card machine didn’t work, so you can’t charge purchases to your room. You have to request a safe, which is very small—too small for a laptop. Security is lax compared to other resorts, allowing people in without checks. Even though it’s cheaper than other resorts in the area, it still feels overpriced (“Mzungu rates”).

name: Swahili Beach Resort
address: Ukunda, Diani Beach Road, Kwale, Kenya
editorial_summary: Upscale rooms in a beachfront resort featuring free breakfast, plus fine dining, a spa & pools.

reviews.author: Lisa Fernandes
reviews.text: Me and my partner stayed at Swahili beach for 4 nights between Christmas and new years in December 2025. For the duration of our stay and from the moment we checked in we were greeted with smiles, warmth and made to feel at home and at ease. Every member of staff was so friendly and helpful. Our executive room was super luxurious with a super king bed, huge living room, balcony, rainfall shower, robes, two toilets. We were even given handmade gifts and hand written notes to take home the night before NYE which was a really nice touch. I loved our days by the pool and evenings in each restaurant. I highly recommend the couples aromatherapy massage in the spa too. One day we left the hotel to explore another local beach and restaurant but after one hour we soon came back to Swahili as the service was not the same and we did not feel as welcome. If you are looking for a place to unwind, rest and re-charge and a place that you feel pampered and well looked after - look no further. The hotel and staff worked so hard setting up the NYE lights, dinner, band, music, DJ + fireworks and personalised table settings, which was the icing on the cake of our stay and a great way to start the new year. We really appreciated every single member of staff in the lobby, restaurants, bars, poolside, chefs, housekeepers and servers that made our stay extra special, thank you so much. It was a NYE we will never forget :)

reviews.author: דלית דנציגר
reviews.text:
We stayed at the  Swahili Beach resort for a week as a couple, and the experience was simply wonderful. The hotel is beautiful and well maintained, with plenty of pools, a stunning beach, and a relaxing, luxurious atmosphere.

The food was excellent – a wide variety of delicious restaurants, all included in both half-board and full-board options. The spa was fantastic and added an extra level of indulgence to our stay.

Above all, the service was excellent. The staff genuinely see and care for each guest, paying attention to every detail. Special thanks to Sila, the head waiter manager, and to Adam, Stevie, and Abdallah for their exceptional service, professionalism, and constant smiles.

A perfect vacation – we would happily return and highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Salma Mcramzi
reviews.text:
Overall it's a beautiful place. The first room they gave me was smelling paint so I had to change it. The rooms of course are spacious and love it. Love the turn down service too. The only 2 issues I have with Swahili is at restaurants or the beach side, they run after tourists (white) to serve them meanwhile leaving other kenyans tourists  (black) i.e. me for long periods without any service. You literally have to call them all the time for any type of service. I come to Diani every year and haven't experienced this in any hotel.  This was the first time, I was shocked, flabbergasted and very disappointed. Unfortunately, I'm not going to endure this where I live plus in my own country.
And the other issue was just lack of variety of food.

Other than that, my stay was wonderful because there were people (masseuses/staff from Swahili spa, Zanzibar staff and Clinton who went above and beyond.😎

reviews.author: Tania Petrulis
reviews.text:
If you are looking for a 5 star resort you might want to look elsewhere.  While the grounds are lovely and the staff is friendly, the expectation is being set for a 5 star experience, but it is not being delivered.

The food is not great and a lot of it tastes the same.  The 1st room they gave us was very tired and in much need of a renovation.  Dirty floor (the material originally used has cracks and spaces in it that hold dirt;  black shoe marks on the benches; absolutely no place to hang clothing or towels in the bathrooms OR wet bathing suits on the balcony; very loud ceiling fan; and they “bleach spray” the rooms at night as insect repellent during turndown and only 2 bottles of water are provided in the room Per day.

Also, if you want quiet, don’t go over the weekend as they play music loudly until 12:00 am each weekend night.

While the staff is very nice and tell you “yes” to almost everything, it takes forever for things  to happen and you may or may not get what you need from Your request.  A good dose of improved leadership and 5 star hospitality training could be very helpful for this resort.

I would like to mention that Chikoza was a 5- star barista and a bright spot in our stay and made us excellent espressos and cappuccinos! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Paul Thomas
reviews.text:
Fantastic coastal resort.
Stunning gardens, which are so well looked after.
Great food, especially the spice route restaurant.
But its the staff who really make it perfect, special mention to -
Francesca, Daisy, Sila, Gilbert, Eva, the chef in the Indian restaurant, Junias. Grace who cleaned our room brilliantly and Emanuel for sorting our sunbeds.

reviews.author: K&J
reviews.text: Popped in to see the facilities and check if day guests are allowed. The hotel grounds and services are extensive and well kept. Day guests pay Kes 2500 to enter, which is redeemed against food and drinks. Day guests can use the pool, the small private beach and enjoy the facilities and atmosphere.

reviews.author: Manjiri Gaikwad
reviews.text: It’s a decent but a very old property. When you ask for packed lunch, make sure you specifically ask them what they are going to pack for you. Otherwise they’ll pack any dry snack (not a real food) and give it to you although you must have paid huge cost for your lunch under full board booking.

reviews.author: Berit Elizabeth
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time. Beautiful lay out of the resort with so many scenic areas to photograph and enjoy. We had a 5 star experience and Namim went above and beyond to make our anniversary special.

reviews.author: Steve Munguti
reviews.text: If in Kenya l, it's a must visit place. Excellent location  whitesand beach hotel. Exquisite food. Continental breakfast. Great swimming pool to complement the 30+ degrees temperatures.

reviews.author: Ally
reviews.text:
Mark ,a waiter, is the best server and definitely deserves a senior position.

The rooms are impeccable, so clean, sheets so soft, enough towels and well maintained.

I location is breathtaking, literally nothing like it. You have to see it to believe it.

100% recommend!!

name: Tombo House
address: Diani Beach Road, Diani Beach, Kenya

reviews.author: Casey Stubbs
reviews.text:
My experience at the tombo house was fantastic!

The rooms were absolutely amazing they had two big ceiling fans the balcony really nice architecture and they didn't hold back on anything.

I really enjoyed the view from my balcony I had several visitors including a monkey ha ha.

It was very peaceful and quiet.

I highly recommend staying here.

reviews.author: Estanis Bouza
reviews.text:
We are just over halfway through our six-night stay here.
This place is simply stunning. Located in its own lush little piece of jungle, with a beautiful swimming pool, great breakfast, and a wonderful room with a balcony overlooking the tree canopy where monkeys swing around.
Walking to the beach will take you around 20 minutes, although we prefer taking a tuktuk to Galu beach further south.
We were given a very warm welcome by Vanessa, and the whole team are just as personable and friendly.
We love the Kenyan made toiletry range provided in the rooms, and having done a bit of research, we will certainly be buying some GC branded shampoo, body wash, and hand wash.
We have enjoyed every minute of our stay here so far. Thank you, team!

reviews.author: C.B.
reviews.text:
We had a great stay in Diani at the Tombo House. The hotel is very casual and nicely equipped. It is run by a friendly and helpful German couple, ready to give you some tips and to have small talks with guests, what we appreciated especially. The rest of the personal was also kind and attentive with all the guests.

The hotel in itself is composed of different buildings, the main one with common areas and the “old” charming rooms, and the new buildings with new rooms. Both are very well equipped and nicely decorated with a mix of Arabic and Kenyan tropical vibes, just as the coast is. We had the opportunity to stay in 2 different rooms during our stay and we loved both.
The pressure of the shower is very good, you don’t spend 2 hours trying to wash your hair ! The WiFi is fast and working everywhere properly. Besides that, you can borrow / use yoga mats and some weights to do sport. The pool is well maintained and integrated within the vegetation. We spent a lot of time chilling around. It was also nice to see the monkeys walking freely around, though we needed to be cautious with our belongings.

We were also happy about the food and the breakfast. You can get pancakes, scrambled eggs freshly prepared. There are always different breads (homemade sourdough, gluten free) and a local “pastry”. There were different spreads (marmalades, peanut butter, etc) and fresh fruits, tomatoes, a bit of cheese. We got also some snacks during the day, everything was good. The price is however a bit above Kenyan average but on the coast, it seems to be in range.
A stay at Tombo House is definitely to be recommended. Thank you !

reviews.author: Chloe Viton
reviews.text:
I don’t have enough great things to say about Tombo House. While it is a struggle to join the WiFi, and there aren’t many “modern amenities” (like tvs or central AC), its charm and views more than compensate. The jungle is peaceful, and the pool area is beautiful. The food at the hotel is amazing - the best shawarma we have ever had. And we got a kick out of the wildlife on the property - the monkeys would make frequent appearances.

But the real diamonds of this hidden gem are the staff. When our tour guides picking us up would get lost, security would call them to help give directions. When we wanted to go to a popular spot for dinner, Veronica called ahead to make sure we had a table. Every night  we ate at the hotel, Nelly would serve us dinner and never needed to ask our room number. And when we got sunburnt, Marcy offered to make us fresh aloe Vera. They even made custom to-go breakfast boxes for our early days.

I’m sure there are more that I just can’t name now but everyone at the hotel was the friendliest person we’ve ever met. We’ve never been treated with such hospitality, and if we ever are lucky to come back to Diani beach, we know we would come back here.

reviews.author: Thomas Munier
reviews.text:
Fantastic place. A relaxed refined, intimate place where you feel at home immediately. Room 13 with a great view, every little detail is perfect. The food selection is great. The staff is so kind, from the man guarding the gate to every single person we spoke to.
Pool is stunning. Asante !

name: Jacaranda Indian Ocean Beach Resort
address: Jacaranda Indian Ocean Beach Resort Diani, Diani Beach Road, Diani, Kenya

reviews.author: Iga Czajka
reviews.text:
Wonderful stay in Jacaranda! We had a beautiful time in your hotel. Thank you.
Excellent room service, amazing location next to the beach, unforgettable atmosphere.
The biggest advantage is the staff: friendly, always smiling and ready to help. Special thanks for the service provided by your wonderful waitress Chanze who made our stay in Jacaranda unforgettable. See you soon!

reviews.author: Februus Wang
reviews.text: Overall, the room was clean and tidy, and housekeeping standards were satisfactory. However, the facilities appear somewhat outdated. There was no handheld shower head, only a fixed overhead shower. The drainage was not very efficient and water tended to accumulate easily. The air conditioning did not provide sufficient cooling. Although the room was equipped with power sockets compatible with several international standards, they were located at some distance from the bed, and no adapter was provided.

reviews.author: claudia tranca
reviews.text: Everything at Jacaranda Resort Beach was absolutely amazing! The entire staff is incredibly helpful, friendly, and always smiling, which made our stay even more special. The service, atmosphere, and overall experience were outstanding. I will definitely recommend this resort and would love to come back!

reviews.author: Beatrice Washuka
reviews.text: This was my second stay at Jacaranda, and it was just perfect again! The staff are professional and friendly, the food is great, and the rooms are beautiful. The beachside location and peaceful atmosphere make it such a relaxing place to stay. As the team organizer, I appreciated how efficient the staff were — they made everything so easy. My team loved it and can’t wait to return. The pool was sparkling clean too!

reviews.author: Werner Neufeld
reviews.text:
they pretend that they own the beach and wanna charge you 15$ a person to stay at the beach if you are just a tourist. the beach is public and they can’t chase you away.

the manager is polite but obviously very annoying trying to get you off the beach.

name: The Villa Luxury Suites Hotel
address: Off Diani Beach Road, Diani Beach, Kenya
editorial_summary: Upscale property featuring refined suites, an outdoor pool & a chic restaurant, plus a garden.

reviews.author: Lara Fattah
reviews.text:
I read a review saying it looks better in real life and I can honestly agree. Beautiful hotel, attentive staff, and great facilities. I travelled solo here and was the perfect boutique hotel. Delicious seafood, fresh and great value for money. Felt safe the whole time. A security guard always at the door to welcome you. The room was spacious and comfortable, beautiful art work on the walls. Everything you want from a hotel.

The location of the hotel is relatively close to everything eg. Beach and shopping centre. However at night the off road is pitch black and would recommend transport going down. I never had any issues walking down there but as a heads up when staying here, it is off road.
Otherwise there is 24/7 security and cameras once approaching the property

reviews.author: Catherine Maundu
reviews.text:
My family and I just enjoyed six absolutely wonderful days at the villa. Our stay was nearly perfect, and the one small hiccup—an issue with our room's AC—was handled with exceptional grace. The staff promptly moved us to another room for the night and had our original unit replaced and working perfectly by the next day.

What truly made our Christmas holiday special, however, was the incredible team. The staff were not only professional but genuinely kind and attentive. They provided fantastic local tips for exploring Diani and arranged convenient transportation to the beach. Combined with the consistently clean rooms and the villa's beautifully serene atmosphere, every detail contributed to a relaxing and joyful getaway.

Thank you to the wonderful staff for going above and beyond to make our family's stay so memorable. We couldn't have asked for a better holiday.

reviews.author: Lior Rousso
reviews.text:
A sweet place, the team is super responsive and welcoming.
They have agreed in a very short time to adjust themselves to our needs.
Very family friendly, and serene.
With a nice small private pool on the room balcony.
Definitely reccomand for a serene location in diani off the beach front but still with the beach vibes.

reviews.author: Ida G
reviews.text: Perfect little lovely Hotel, the staff are the sweetest and the facilities are much better then the photos. All really clean and super big TV and rooms. One of our best stats in Kenya.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.text:
What a hidden gem! We spent a whole week because it was so quiet and good. The rooms are spacious and clean. Only the bathroom has only a curtain as a door. The pool is big and the garden is well maintained. The hotel only has about 10 rooms and we had a few nights where we were the only guests or only 2-3 rooms booked, which was good for us but bad for the hotel and employees. I hope they get more work in high season. But therefore was the service really slow and scarce during the day at the pool. The breakfast was ok but every day the same: eggs and bacon, fruits, toast, oats, pancakes. The restaurnat in the evening was excellent in quality but a bit expensive in comparison to outside restaurants.
But I would definitely book again.
And all personnel were very nice and accomodating.

reviews.author: Kimberley Mbugua
reviews.text:
Oh my gosh, I'm seeing so many 5 stars...until I'm wondering whether we were at the same Morning Star Hotel.
The AC is not working, I addressed it 6 times in 3 days and one day before I check out is when it's fixed
No water in the toilets
Food generally okay
Staff (not all) are not really motivated
WiFi keeps coming and going, when I was at the stay.

Honestly the 1 star is because the rooms look neat and accommodating

reviews.author: Antonio Resto
reviews.text: Nice place where you can spend the winter away from the icy Europe. The apartments are comfortable and clean and in the swimming pool you can relax whenever you want. A lot of shops are also available in the nearbyes if you forgot something.

reviews.author: Sylvia Mbugua-Schusterbauer (Sheke)
reviews.text: Great spacious apartments with pool view...the beach is walking distance near Maji Resort.  Great African breakfast. Excellent staff. Linda was amazing 👏🏾 🤩

reviews.author: Winnie Wanzetse
reviews.text: Beautiful balance of sea and offbeach. Perfect location, great ambience, wonderful facilities, attentive service. Joachim is a great host!

reviews.author: Charles Owira
reviews.text:
I had to step out of the car to press the doorbell because the guards at the gate couldn't hear the car beeping.
Or is it a policy to only use the doorbell even if you are not a pedestrian?

name: Kenya Charming Villas
address: Diani Beach Road, Ukunda, PHPW+R48, Diani Beach, Kenya

name: The Safiya Hotel, Diani Beach, "Formerly Diani Palm Resort"
address: Diani Beach Road, Diani Beach, Kenya

reviews.author: Gicharu Ndung'u
reviews.text:
Had a fantastic 3-day stay at Safiya!

The swimming pool is absolutely lovely and was the perfect spot to unwind each day.
The staff are truly amazing - so kind, welcoming, and professional throughout my visit.

The sugar cane juice is a must-try!

Location-wise, it’s ideally situated near the road, which made getting transport and making connections for my trips incredibly easy. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a seamless and friendly stay!

reviews.author: Mackenzie Harvey
reviews.text:
Pros: More of a family atmosphere. You don't see the "unsavory dating practices" as much like you will in others. The staff are very very nice and accommodating. (Expect to be chased down for bills though. It's common all over Kenya. Best to pay for things immediately and check that they've included everything you asked for in the bill.)

Cons: The elevator doesn't work and the stairs are steep and in some disrepair. Avoid the restaurant at all costs unfortunately. They're very nice but the food was inedible (meat was overcooked. "Fried" means deep fried without skin or breading. Prawns were so fresh they still had sand on them.)
The rooms were interesting... Only sheets, no duvets or blankets available. There are windows from the bathroom to the public hallway. They're up high, frosted, and can be shut but you can hear everything going on inside and they let in the bright hallway light that shines through the sliding glass bathroom door all night. The rooms aren't soundproof at all.

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.text: I rarely write Google reviews but I have to make an exception for Safiya. The staff really went above and beyond to make my stay comfortable. Bonus points for having AC in the room that chills extremely well(came to learn that they service it weekly) and the Swahili full breakfast was excellent. The beach was just a 5 min walk away and the neighborhood seemed to be quite safe. Many thanks to the entire team for the pleasant hospitality, Keep it up!

reviews.author: Melanie Whittick
reviews.text: Great place. Beautiful rooftop with view of ocean. Relaxing quiet pool area. Rooms are clean and comfortable. AC and TV. Owner is the best. She knows how to provide customer service and goes above and beyond. Their fruit yogurt was really good. I did not get a chance to try their other food but was told it was very good. Rates are reasonable. This will be my home every time I go to Diani. Doreen I cannot thank you enough for your personal attention to everything. Asante sana!

reviews.author: Hawa Dafala
reviews.text:
The Safiya hotel is place to be which turned to be me and my daughters home.
I would like to thank the owner of the place very friendly and so caring you are the best.
Secondly I thank all the staffs they were all friendly it feels like we have been together for years.
The rooms and pools superb we enjoyed our time there for 1 week.
The hygiene is great bedsheets changed daily that was good everything was just wow.
I can’t wait to get back and enjoy the life back in the safiya hotel.

reviews.author: Wambui Mugo
reviews.text:
If you’re looking for a private, peaceful, and quiet getaway, this is absolutely the place for you. The location is convenient as well, with tuk-tuks easily accessible right at the gate whenever you need transport.
The staff were amazing — warm, attentive, and professional throughout the stay. The rooms were cleaned daily and looked exactly like the photos: beautiful, comfortable, and thoughtfully prepared. Every morning breakfast was a highlight — fresh, delicious, and the perfect way to start the day.
Sitara Retreat feels less like an Airbnb and more like a home away from home. would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Diani.

reviews.author: Luca Hanout
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at The Afters Diani. From the very first moment, the whole staff welcomed us with such kindness and warmth that we immediately felt at home. Everyone was always ready to help us with a smile, from arranging our transfer from Mombasa to making sure our stay was comfortable in every detail.

The rooms were clean, spacious, and cozy, and the location is great — peaceful yet close to the beach and the main spots in Diani. The food at the hotel was also excellent, and the team went out of their way to help us celebrate a birthday, making it a very special memory.

What really makes the difference here is the genuine cordiality and friendliness of all the staff — they truly care about their guests. This was without any doubt the best accommodation of our entire stay in Kenya, and we would love to come back!

reviews.author: Mike Bowen
reviews.text: Superb little place that we only recently heard about. We love a good curry and this place is a 'Curry Gem'!! Spotlessly clean and well laid out report, very nice accommodation set around a sparkling pool. Lady owner was truly helpful with guidance thru her delicious menus of Indian and non Indian dishes. Wines at very reasonable prices and super efficient Abdul takes your orders and looks after all your needs. Very enjoyable and been back twice in very quick succession!

reviews.author: Massama Batema
reviews.text: Amazing place especially for couples. The location is very nice and working remote from this place was amazing. Also special shoutout to the staff which was very attentive and kind. The included breakfast was very good as well. We enjoyed our stay and will come back hopefully.

reviews.author: nahil dave
reviews.text: A wonderful 10 roomed hotel with ac in every room, a large swimming pool and a restaurant cum bar. Quiet and classy.

name: Kaskazi Beach Resort
address: Opposite Nakumatt - Diani, Next To Swahili Beach Hotel, Ukunda Diani Beach Rd, Diani Beach, Kenya
editorial_summary: Elegant rooms & suites with balconies in an oceanside hotel offering dining & live entertainment.

reviews.author: Becky Wanjiru
reviews.text:
Kaskazi is a very big and beautiful beach front hotel. I agree with most if not all of the reviews that the hotel does need a lot of renovation and maintenance. However, the food was absolutely fresh and very filling!! The staff is very kind and professional and ever willing to help out. I loved that the supervisor would frequently visit our table to ask for feedback. The hotel just needs to be renovated, properly maintained, there needs to be more life eg music and entertainment needs to be on throughout the day and for the most part in the night, WiFi needs to work everywhere, the hotel needs to advertise itself more bc it’s genuinely a good hotel with just a few issues that could be sorted out very easily.
It’s a very good hotel honestly- location 10/10, services 20/10 WiFi 5/10 activities and life 4/10. If they do take our reviews into consideration, the hotel will do better, will have more guest residences and will be among the top destinations for individuals, families and organizations touring Diani.

reviews.author: Mark Nelson
reviews.text:
Extremely Disappointing Huge Potential Wasted

This was a very poor experience overall. From arrival, there was a complete lack of hospitality   no welcome drinks and an extremely slow, unorganized check-in.

The food was bad and did not taste fresh at all. The dining experience was poorly managed, and even basic items like napkins were missing, which shows a lack of attention to guests.

The rooms were honestly repulsive, Outdated, uncomfortable beds, non-working TVs, and bathrooms in terrible condition with visible dirt. The shower barely worked, the water was salty, there was no soap, and the overall hygiene and maintenance were unacceptable. Because of this, we left immediately.

Though the views are genuinely amazing.

This hotel has serious potential due to its location, but it urgently needs major renovations, better management, and higher service standards. Partnering with reputable international hotel brands could completely transform this place. I would consider coming back only if it is fully upgraded, luxurious, and run at a professional international level. Until then, I do not recommend it.

reviews.author: Maureen
reviews.text: Rooms are basic and echo a time when the hotel was well maintained. There's no room service or phones in the room which means you need to walk to the reception every time you need something. Further the cleaning schedule is haphazard as staff walk in whenever you leave, to tidy up, which means you can't leave anything out in the open. . I left my room for two hours and came and found the door unlocked. There are no do not disturb signs and the doors use the old fashioned keys to open (a security issue imo). Also, forget about the WiFi signal especially on the higher floors. The TVs that depend on it don't work either. Maintenance person has to check it every now and the. For this reason. The sea view is amazing and I wish the mgt could do more to up the experience of clients because they charge rates right up there with other 4star hotels,while the experience to put it frankly is 3 star at best.

reviews.author: CAROL MUTTINDA
reviews.text:
ROOMS❌FOOD 👍🏾
We went there for a small get away and I really loved the food especially their breakfast. So many choices and healthy foods. I was a bit disappointed by the rooms. The shower was not functional and I almost got boiled while showering lol. I was also excited to play table tennis (they had a table) but they didn’t have the net, bat and balls. This place needs to be renovated no wonder we were very few in that place.

reviews.author: Yasmin Malik
reviews.text:
Disappointment I have no words
Rooms are basic, no dryer or iron you have to keep asking and walking to and from the reception. They have no phones in the room. My shower was broken and taps are old and rusty. Tiolet holder was broken. You also have to share the iron. I have to manually turn my kettle off and unplug. The switch was broken. Kept on turning on itself. The fans in the room and dinning area felt they were about to come off on the last thread.

Breakfast was the same everyday. Same menu no variation or creativity. Management is least bothered. No sports activities for kids. My kids got bothered. We got stomach upsets eating the food at the hotel.

This is the 3rd day I have no wiifii in my room. I have to sit in the reception area with my 4 year old for wiifii. Get bitten by mosquitoes.

Hotel is dead, food is awful, not kept to a 4 star hotel. Great views and garden however mantained very poorly. Don't book. Bitten multiple times by mosquitoes also in the room my net was broken no one fixed it. Italian Restaurant and Sea food Restaurant are far from the resort. Beach boys will add things to the trip to Wasini Island to see Dolphines be aware. You dont swim with dolphins. See them at a distance on the boat. Coral not that great.

I was exhausted chasing Management. No one cares as long as you have paid in advance.

Booking.com don't check and verify the hotels. Its at your own risk.

I asked for a refund since Tuesday so that I can change my accommodation mid way to be told it has to be discussed with Booking.com and refund will be given to booking.com.  I had no hope to get a better accommodation with my family on holiday which was meant to enjoy. Forced to stay here.

name: Aqua Resort
address: Diani Beach Road, Diani Beach, Kenya

reviews.author: galatix Design
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at the resort. The front desk staff were incredibly kind, welcoming, and friendly. The apartments were spacious and impeccably clean, and the location is very convenient, with easy access to nearby amenities. We will definitely be visiting again.

reviews.author: Florence Ngungu
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay at aqua. Its a cool, quite resort conveniently located along the beach road. The rooms were fresh & clean, with a big open balcony doubling up as the dining area. However, the experience would have been better if there was a restaurant or resident chef.

reviews.author: Sarah Alexis Dyer
reviews.text:
The apartment was near enough perfect, minus the lack of kettle and no plug sockets near the sofa.
Also, the limitation of one free bottle of water for the dispenser, for the entire stay, when that water is used for cooking is also an area for improvement.
Despite these minor issues, I had a great stay… it is a quiet, peaceful, well maintained resort. The staff professionalism, attentiveness, support and customer service is 10/10.
Location is perfect; quiet, but in reach to amenities within minutes.
Overall an amazing stay, with some general room for improvement.
Thank you to all staff for their efforts!
Kind regards,
Sarah

reviews.author: Lilian W K
reviews.text:
We had an amazing stay at Aqua Resort! 😀 The location was perfect, just steps away from the beach.  The apartment itself was spotless, beautifully decorated, and equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The kitchen had all the essentials, the beds were super comfy, and the living space was cozy and inviting.
The host was incredibly welcoming and responsive, making check-in and check-out a breeze. Loved the hospitality from Mercy the receptionist and the rest of staff. We also especially loved how peaceful and relaxing the area was, yet still close to great restaurants and major supermarkets.
Waking up to the  breathtaking views of the pool, green nature and enjoying morning coffee on the balcony was truly a dream. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a relaxing  family getaway. Can't wait to return☺️!

reviews.author: Derek Nabutola
reviews.text: Great place with amazing facilities like the pool, walking distance to the beach. Friendly staff

name: Diani Sea Lodge
address: Near Shakatak Disco, Diana, MHVH+7PH, Diani Beach Road, Diani Beach, Kenya

reviews.author: Andrew Brown
reviews.text:
Had a fantastic Christmas here with my family, all over the age of 20.
Staff were amazing, all were happy and seemed to genuinely enjoy their jobs.
Food was very good with a decent choice to suit most people., more than adequate drinks choice too.
The hotel is situated right on the beach with plenty of sun beds, the security were pretty good at discouraging people from "reserving" beds without any bad feelings (mostly :).
If I'm being "picky" I would say the rooms could do with an update but the air conditioning worked well and, quite honestly,  we only used the rooms to sleep in so not too fussed about having the latest gadgets to play with.
They say that you know how good somewhere is in how they act when something goes wrong. The staff here were exemplary, my sons appendix burst 3 days from the end of our stay. They went above and beyond in helping us, not just with getting our son the medical care he needed but also helping with extending his and his partners stay and helping with contact with his insurance company. We were so surprised at how all the staff seemed to know of our predicament and how keen they were to help.
We will be going back

reviews.author: Aga
reviews.text: The hotel is located on the beach. It's intimate and has friendly service. The rooms were cleaned regularly, quite clean for a 4-star hotel. The food was okay. There were power outages, but that's Africa.

reviews.author: KC C.
reviews.text: Beautiful place....all inclusive. Great beach access, and best part - great service from start to finish in every aspect. Staff was polite, courteous and accommodating- from the from desk to maintenance to the bar and the restaurant- even the security staff was great....loved it. Keep up the good work

reviews.author: Ema Kapov
reviews.text:
This was the best hotel we ever visit. Beautifull beach, great resort with lot of activitys, big choice of delicius food and dear, warm and friendly people, all of them.
So, thank you lovely Joyce, dear Mark, security guys, barmens and all other people who work there, you make our vacation more special❤️

reviews.author: Eden Ologure
reviews.text:
The hotel needs to be renovated, so many things are old fashioned and outdated. Also the bathrooms need serious work done on them.

The environment is nice and relaxing, the staff provided reasonably good service. They also had evening entertainment that was nice

name: Zarafa House
address: Kwitu Cottages Rd, Diani Beach, Kenya

reviews.author: Becca Thomas
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at Zarafa House. It is this beautiful, calm oasis in Diani. The pool was perfect for relaxing by and the garden is full of beautiful plants. The breakfasts were so delicious! It was easy to access all that Diani Beach has to offer. Ann was kind and considerate and helped organise for us a driver to see the Africa Pools and Tiwi Beach and had lots of recommendations. We would happily come back again and have already recommend them to family and friends!

reviews.author: Winnie Yagan
reviews.text: This bed and breakfast feels like home away from home. The rooms are spacious and have all the amenities including eco-friendly products. The pool is large and perfect for quiet night swims. They serve a different breakfast everyday. I will definitely return.

reviews.author: frank osserez
reviews.text: Zarafa house is the perfect place to relax and enjoy. Ann is the lovely host who takes care of everything. Breakfast is a feast with fresh fruits and so much more. The rooms are spacious and the beds are very good. I highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Richard Marshall
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful, peaceful oasis in bustling Diani Beach. Ann & her team were fantastic, breakfast was delicious, rooms are spacious & comfortable & the pool & poolside areas are a lovely place to relax & chill after a busy day out on the beach or sightseeing, we wouldn’t want to stay anywhere else in Diani & will definitely return.

reviews.author: Oliver Rodriguez
reviews.text: Wonderful guesthouse slightly away from the noise and beach. Super friendly host with valuable tips, great recommendations and with a good network of partners for activities. Impeccable rooms, lovely garden / terrace / swimming pool. Can only recommend.

name: Flamboyant Diani
address: Diani Beach Road – Ali Barbour’s, Beach Road, Diani Beach, Kenya

reviews.author: Alpbatuhan Bükmen
reviews.text:
Our stay was absolutely perfect from start to finish. The service quality and the staff’s friendliness, attention, and care were truly outstanding. Cleanliness was excellent   the rooms were cleaned and well organized on a daily basis.
The food was delicious; I especially recommend the lamb kofta and the mango smoothie.
Staying in a villa building (Cape Blush) was a wonderful experience. Having our own house private pool, enjoying the peace and quiet, and feeling the comfort of a private space made our stay incredibly relaxing.
Everything exceeded our expectations, and this is a place I would highly recommend without any hesitation.

reviews.author: Kanorio Eve
reviews.text:
The restaurant has a calm atmosphere and great views.
Staff are friendly.
I ordered Asian style chicken wings which were great.
It’s a great place for a quiet, relaxed stay where you read a book by the beach.

The pool could be a bit cleaner.

reviews.author: Kent Ekeroth
reviews.text:
Great hotel and even better value for money. I liked everything about it:
Location: great, by the sea and in the center of the Diani strip
Facilities: very nice pool area, very comfy beach beds, working wifi, clean and nice
Staff: very friendly and helpful and kind and nice :)
Rooms: we stayed in 4-5 rooms since we kept prolonging our trip. All rooms were nice, spacious, clean. Most of them overlooking the pool area.
Food: it’s hard to get really good food in Diani, but we enjoyed theirs and their breakfast was really nice with many good options.

So all in all: great value for money in a nice hotel with great staff

reviews.author: Lily Muriuki
reviews.text:
This hotel offers great value for money. We spent four nights here in December 2025 and had an amazing time. The food was delicious, although the service is average as is most of Diani, slow.

Our stay didn’t start off perfectly. When we arrived, our room had a musty smell, which was disappointing after a long journey. My heart sank, but I decided not to let it spoil our time in Diani.

Then came the highlight of our stay: Lena from housekeeping. She was absolutely outstanding; genuinely eager to help and incredibly proactive. Before we went to bed that first night, she ensured everything was fixed, including refreshing the room, replacing the shower head and knobs with brand-new ones and adding a light to the wardrobe. Her kindness and professionalism were such a relief.

Arty, the owner, is very hands-on and ensures everything runs smoothly, while Angie is quite resourceful and helpful.
Three things that make this place exceptional:
• Location, right along the beach and close to many great spots and activities in Diani.
• The swimming pool is quite refreshing
• Value for money

reviews.author: Colin Russell
reviews.text:
A wonderful little boutique hotel right on Diani Beach. Not pretentious, perhaps a little rough round the edges, but quiet, informal, relaxed.and charming.
The staff are super friendly, the rooms spacious and well appointed. Excellent pool, but even better access to the beach,  with a garden full of places to recline (attentive attendants, too, giving you thick comfortable mattresses to put on the wooden recliners).
It's straight onto the white sands of Diani Beach and into the turquoise sea.
The Restaurant next door, belonging to the hotel, "Faulty's" (sic) offers an amazing dining experience under a huge tree in tbe garden (indoors also possible). Great food at good prices.

name: Golden Palace Resort Nakuru
address: London, off Kanu St, Nakuru, Kenya

reviews.author: Adeea Suites
reviews.text:
Adeea Suites Naivasha is truly a gem. From the moment you walk in, you can feel the warmth, comfort, and attention to detail that makes this place stand out. The rooms are spotless, beautifully furnished, and designed to give that perfect blend of homely comfort and hotel luxury. The fresh, clean bedding and serene atmosphere make every stay feel refreshing.

The staff are incredibly welcoming and professional—always ready to assist and ensure your stay is smooth and enjoyable. What I appreciate most is their reliability and efficiency; everything from check-in to service delivery is done with genuine care.

The location is peaceful and convenient, making it perfect whether you're on a short getaway or a long stay. Adeea Suites is the kind of place you come back to again and again because it consistently delivers great value and an amazing experience.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for comfort, cleanliness, and exceptional hospitality in Naivasha!

reviews.author: Chalton Aloe
reviews.text: You get bed-and-breakfast at KES 1500. This is an old building. Showers are a bit cooler even when turned on - old technology. But the rooms are spacey with furniture like chairs and tables. At this price, I think it is a steal (you are stealing from them 😁).

reviews.author: Maik Albrecht
reviews.text: The Golden Palace Hotel was recommended to us, but . . . Unfortunately, it is quite old and some things are broken. However, it is adequate for the price. The staff are very friendly and courteous. The breakfast was also quite okay.

reviews.author: Rafael Grillo
reviews.text:
Pros: Attentive staff - I had an injury that needed to be taken care of and a staff member took me to a trusted pharmacy to attend to it, and also indicated to me where the hospital was; dinner and breakfast were ready within 15 minutes of the indicated time and they were prompt with requested coffees and teas
Cons: One set of plugs in the room was burnt out, hot water was not available during the day and there was a paint smell in the day dueto renovations, the sink faucet was dislodge from the sink such that it moved around making it difficult to wash hands.

reviews.author: Kevin Thuo
reviews.text:

reviews.author: benjamin simiyu
reviews.text:
Rock Hyrax Hotel offers an enjoyable stay in Nakuru, especially for guests looking for comfort, convenience and value. I visited with my family and we were all well-accommodated, and I also hosted a small party with my staff from Royal Smiles Dental Clinic — the hotel handled both family leisure and group hospitality very well. The hotel is located in a strategic spot—close to town, yet slightly tucked away—making it quiet enough for rest but still accessible for errands and travel.

Rooms & Comfort
The rooms are clean, adequately furnished, and spacious enough for a comfortable stay. Bedding is fresh, water is reliable, and the general housekeeping is consistent.

Service & Staff
The staff are polite, responsive and willing to assist. Check-in is smooth, and requests are handled without unnecessary delays. Their hospitality is one of the biggest strengths of the hotel.

Dining
There is a good variety of fresh meals, with decent portions and fair pricing. Service time is reasonable and the dining area is clean.

Amenities & Experience
The environment is calm, security is good, and parking is available. Wi-Fi works fine for basic browsing and business needs.

Overall
Rock Hyrax Hotel is a reliable, comfortable option for short or extended stays in Nakuru. It’s ideal for guests who want affordability, cleanliness, and good service without compromising peace and convenience.

reviews.author: Kevin Bett
reviews.text:
Exceptional service and a warm atmosphere

I had a fantastic experience. The entire staff was incredibly professional and attentive from the moment I arrived. I want to give a special mention to Alice, who provided exceptional care and made sure every detail of my stay was perfect. Her hospitality really stood out. The hotel is well-maintained and provides a peaceful environment. Highly recommend it to anyone visiting Nakuru

reviews.author: Frank Simon
reviews.text:
Rock Hyrax Hotel is a gem worth visiting! The rooms are clean and comfortable - boy, they are spotless. The warmth of the staff—gracefully led by Cate—adds a personal touch that lingers beyond your stay. Every meal feels like a thoughtful masterpiece - simply sumptuous.
The hotel is set in a serene environment, surrounded by nature’s quiet beauty, perfect for reflection, renewal, and rediscovering calm....Would definitely visit again!

reviews.text: Found two guys at the reception and their service was/is impeccable. I loved and enjoyed everything about the place,only one thing was a miss. The bottled water. Kindly work on that.

reviews.text: I enjoyed quality alone time in this very clean hotel, had sound sleep in your comfy rooms and filled my stomach to your well cooked tasty meals. The staff are friendly and well groomed. I highly recommend a visit here.

name: Buraha Zenoni Hotel & Resort
editorial_summary: Informal hotel featuring straightforward rooms & suites, plus a restaurant & an outdoor pool.

reviews.author: Sayanha Halder
reviews.text:
Had a comfortable stay at Buraha Zenoni Hotel & Resort. The property is well-located and offers a calm, relaxed atmosphere, making it a comfortable stop while exploring Nakuru and nearby attractions.
The rooms were spacious and neat, providing a comfortable space to unwind. The staff were courteous and helpful throughout the stay, always ready to assist when needed.

reviews.author: Levi Litman
reviews.text:
We stayed here as part of a budget safari and it turned out to be a much‑welcomed treat. On arrival, we were greeted with a complimentary drink, which was a lovely touch and set the tone for our stay.

The rooms were modern and comfortable, with showers that had excellent water pressure—something you really appreciate after a long day. The location is ideal, about a 30‑minute drive to Lake Nakuru, making it convenient for exploring the area.

The rooftop bar was a highlight, open until fairly late and offering a great spot to relax in the evening. The food was fine overall; while the buffet wasn’t extensive, the quality was good and satisfying. There’s also a decent pool, perfect for cooling off.

What really stood out was the staff. They made a genuine effort to ensure we felt welcome and taken care of, and their warmth and attentiveness made a big difference to our experience.

Overall, this hotel exceeded expectations for a budget safari stay—comfortable, well‑located, and with service that truly impressed.

reviews.author: Orianna Annunziata
reviews.text: We came to Buraha Hotel as part of our safari trip, and it was a great experience to relax before continuing our journey. The pool is perfect for refreshing, the room was very comfortable and clean, and there were mosquito nets on the windows. The staff is very polite, kind, and always available, making us feel truly welcome. Thank you very much! Asante✨

reviews.text: Such a great time at this beautiful hotel! Nice rooftop patio to have a drink before dinner. We were also greeted with welcome tea upon arrival. Our room was massive for the price! 3 beds and 2 bathrooms for just 2 people. Highly recommend!

reviews.text:
Terribly below expectation. No value for money at all! The rooms are old, unmaintained and just a bad experience. The water in the toilet cistern leaked the whole night. I had to do some fixing for my family to have some rest. Door knob of the inside room was broken. There was no light bulb on the corridor area. In the morning there was no water in the bathroom and toilet. I had to go ask for them to check and restore. We spent there because we had paid beforehand, and the refund policy was ridiculous (they keep 75%). I will not recommend at all. Online photos that are maybe 5 years old can be totally misleading. The food in the morning was just alright. The wedges and fried eggs were cold. I have never been keen to checkout and leave for home. Not returning, and not recommending.

Positives: The swimming pool is good, the kids had a good time splashing around. The kids area also has several activities for the younger kids.

Overall experience was underwhelming, and below expectation.

reviews.text: Spent a night at this wonderful place. Service is very good and the staff are extremely courteous. The buffet breakfast spread is very good. Strongly recommended especially if you are into birding. The feeders attract a large variety of birds which can be photographed from close quarters. The spacious rooms are well appointed.

reviews.author: Ed Wright
reviews.text: This was our best lodging experience of our 2-week stay in Kenya. Every detail thoughtfully attended, very friendly and professional staff, immaculately clean, in a perfect location for Nakuru wildlife. A simple mention of my wife's birthday brought a full-scale celebration with beautiful and delicious cake to the dinner experience. Would definitely return.

reviews.author: Spencer Stone
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time at the resort overall. The grounds are absolutely beautiful, with a garden, archery range, volleyball net, lookout point, and a beautiful buildings. We had stellar service throughout our stay, bar is open until midnight and showed the Liverpool match while we played cards! The meals were some of the best we had anywhere in Kenya and were buffet style at each meal we had. The lodging itself felt more along the lines of a 3 star resort, but still definitely nice.

Lake Nakuru itself doesn’t have near the wildlife that Samburu or Maasai Mara do, but the scenery is stunning. There is a ton of beautiful flora and you will also likely see giraffes, zebras, and flamingos.

There were quite a few kids that were simply given free rein to run around the dining area, and eventually the bar, but maybe that was just our experience there. Keep in mind if you are booking for a more romantic trip!

reviews.author: Andreas Heinrich
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful lodge just above Lake Nakuru. The gardens are extensive and very well maintained.
The rooms are all individual chalets with a view over the lake. Very clean and comfy.
The service is high level although I found the uniforms with ties a bit outdated.
The food at the buffet was excellent.
This is a real tourist lodge including a dance troupe performance in the evening, which I found a bit out of place - hence the 4 stars.
We did two game drives and saw lots of wildlife including a lioness getting ready for her evening hunt. The birds are spectacular - although the flamingo population is going down since the water level of the lake is rising and the chemical composition is changing.

name: The Legacy Hotel & Conference Centre, Nakuru
editorial_summary: Straightforward rooms & suites in a modern hotel offering a restaurant & a bar, plus meeting rooms.

reviews.author: Kaufman Kigame
reviews.text:
The Legacy Hotel & Conference Centre in Nakuru strikes a fine balance between elegance and comfort from the moment you step inside. Located on Maralal Road, it is well placed for both business travellers and tourists wanting proximity to the city’s highlights yet not far from nature.

Welcome & Reception
What stands out immediately is the warm, genuine welcome. Guests frequently comment on the reception staff’s friendliness and professionalism—how they greet you, help with your luggage, explain options, and ensure you feel immediately at ease.  The front desk seems to go beyond just checking in: there’s a sense of being cared for, with staff attentive to your needs.

Service & Assistance
Throughout one’s stay, the assistance provided is consistent. Whether assistance means guiding you to nearby sights, helping with room requests, or ensuring meals suit dietary preferences, the staff do well. Reviewers often note how prompt and helpful personnel are.  The restaurant service also gets praise—not just for the food, but for how service staff attend with courtesy and sometimes go the extra mile (special requests, setting up for events, etc.).

Facilities & Ambience
Rooms are described as spacious, clean, and decently equipped. The fitness centre, conference halls, free parking, and lift amenities add to the overall comfort.  The hotel’s ambience is calm and polished despite being in a busy area, which helps guests relax.

I went to eat in the crappiest places in Kenya, such as in barracs on the side of the road and I never had a problems with food hygiene or with food quality.

I‘m still trying to find out what gave me stomach flu, but please take care of following things:
- Ice Machine must be cleaned and desinfected at least once a month

reviews.author: Carolyne Cianciola
reviews.text:
I’ve stayed at this hotel multiple times with my family whenever we visit Kenya, and we’ve always enjoyed the nice rooms, great food, and overall atmosphere. It’s usually our go-to place, and we genuinely like it here.

Unfortunately, during my most recent stay in February, the service fell short in a few key areas, which was disappointing as a returning guest.

On arrival, the staff member who offered to help with my luggage took it to the lift area and then simply abandoned it there instead of ensuring it reached my room or handing it off properly. I had to sort it out myself, which wasn’t the warm welcome I’ve come to expect.

Later, while waiting for my brother near the steps on the right side of the entrance (standing as a guest, not loitering), a security staff member approached me quite abruptly. I was told to vacate the area immediately because I was visible on CCTV. When I explained that I was a guest at the hotel, the response was that it didn’t matter and I needed to get in the car to wait. The poor security guard was obviously following commands from his manager who lacks courtesy!!! The whole situation left me feeling embarrassed and unwelcome.

The hotel itself and the food remain excellent. However, respect and courtesy toward guests—especially loyal returning ones—should be consistent, regardless of the situation. A little more training for security and their manager and the porter staff on guest interaction and basic hospitality would go a long way.

reviews.author: Peter Maina
reviews.text:
I would like to take a moment to commend Mathew for the excellent service he provided to my family yesterday. He was attentive, courteous, and went out of his way to ensure we had a wonderful experience. His thoughtful choice of a spot with a beautiful view of the lake made our time truly memorable.

We greatly appreciated his professionalism and warm demeanor, which made us feel welcome and well cared for. Please extend our gratitude to him for his outstanding service.

reviews.text: 800KES for a single room per night is OK for this place. Its 8km from city center so do keep that in mind. There are also crocodiles at the place and some other animals so you can pay them a visit. They were pretty steady posing for me , not a single one moved while I was there. It can be a little bit noisy because it is near the road which is somewhat busy. But nothing to serious. All in all totally RECOMMEND 👌

reviews.text: I booked into this hotel for my four-week stay in Korando. My expectations were exceeded.
