The rooms are also in top condition with comfortable large beds, TV, shower and toilet. The entire hotel staff goes to great lengths to ensure that guests feel comfortable. For Europeans who are looking for a comfortable hotel near Kisumu, the Somerset Gardens Resort is the first choice.

reviews.author: Peter Namanya
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of staying at Somerset Gardens, and I can't say enough about how incredible Henrietta and Ruth are as hosts! From the moment me and my team arrived, they made us feel right at home with their warm hospitality and attention to detail. Henrietta’s welcoming nature and thoughtful recommendations helped us settle in, while Ruth’s kindness and efficiency made the entire experience feel seamless. Their personal touches throughout the stay truly made it special—whether it was a delicious homemade treat (very tasty samosas and chai) or an insightful local tip, they went above and beyond to ensure I had a comfortable, memorable time. If you're looking for a place where you’re treated like family, Somerset Gardens with Henrietta and Ruth is the perfect choice!

reviews.author: ERASTUS SINOTRUK HOWO.
reviews.text: Overlooking the calm waters near the shores of Lake Victoria in Kisumu, Hotel Riversand offers a quiet, refreshing escape for travellers seeking simplicity and comfort. The hotel combines clean, spacious rooms with essential modern amenities, providing reliable Wi-Fi, comfortable bedding, and peaceful views ideal for relaxation or focused work. Its intimate restaurant serves freshly prepared local and continental dishes, while the outdoor seating areas create a pleasant space for evening conversations. Conveniently located within the city, guests enjoy easy access to business centres, shopping zones, and transport links. Friendly, attentive staff ensure personalised service, making every stay feel welcoming, secure, and unhurried for both business visitors and holidaymakers throughout their memorable time in western Kenya today and beyond always returning.

reviews.author: ZANELE HLUBI
reviews.text: Budget hotel in the town centre. Clean and I had a room with the view of Lake Victoria. The staff were so nice and let me checked in without payment as I didn't have cash with me and they don't take card payments. I literally walked everywhere around town without the use of the taxi. Will definitely use the place again in future. There's a restaurant adjacent to the hotel with nice affordable food.

reviews.author: Hellevi Estama
reviews.text:
My answer to your answer: Could you please mention during booking that your facilities, such as the hallway and conference rooms, are also allowed to be used for partying at night? I wouldn't have stayed for a weekend. The other guests probably didn't complain about the noise, because the other guests were mainly these students. Booking.com states that the hotel has a quiet hours from 10pm to 7am. Why are you lying on the site or not acting according to your own rules?

It's true that I stayed at the hotel for over a week, but I've stayed at worse places at night, so I'm not surprised by dust, dirt and mold. The location of the hotel was also good. The fact that your staff did nothing at all to the students partying in the hallway at night was the last straw and we changed hotel. We were not offered a quieter room. You also said in your response that the hotel was full. How could you have moved us to a quieter room at 2am? Be honest. Luckily, a nice hotel was found 400 meters away for half the price :)

You could have mentioned the renovation the day before instead of waking me up by knocking several times in the morning.

I hope you learn your lesson and either be an honest and open party hotel where you can party at night in the hallways or train your staff to direct students to the club or to their rooms after midnight.

Original post:

Do not stay at this hotel. Definitely not worth 2000 shillings. I have stayed at a better place that cost 800. A group of students were partying in the conference room and hallway until 2am and the staff did nothing to stop it, despite repeated requests. Another morning they were renovating and the staff came knocking on the door to make sure I woke up and got up, only to tell me they were renovating now. Thank you, I heard it half an hour ago.

The rooms are dirty, shabby and smell musty. The bathroom is moldy. The sheets are torn and too small for the beds. The fan does not work. The window was broken and it rained in the room, and you can hear traffic noise in the room as early as 6am.

I highly recommend that you choose another hotel.

reviews.author: JOSEPH OTIN
reviews.text:
I recently heard about a deeply troubling incident at Millimani Resort in Kisumu, which has left me with serious concerns about the safety and privacy of guests. A friend of mine was harassed on three separate occasions by a staff member—a dark-skinned lady whose name she wasn’t sure of (it could be Emily or Milly).

The most alarming incident occurred after my friend finished swimming. This staff member forcefully entered her private changing space without permission, accusing her of doing something wrong. This behaviour is not only invasive but also completely unacceptable. Guests should feel safe and respected at all times, especially in private spaces like changing rooms.

This kind of conduct is a serious violation of privacy and raises significant concerns about guest safety at your establishment. I urge the management to take immediate disciplinary action against the staff member involved and put measures in place to ensure such incidents never happen again. Until this issue is addressed, I can not recommend Millimani Resort to anyone seeking a safe and respectful environment.

I hope you take this feedback seriously and take steps to protect the privacy and dignity of your guests

reviews.author: Migwi G.
reviews.text:
Hotel Double N in Kisumu is a fantastic place to stop by, whether you're passing through or looking for a comfortable place to stay. Conveniently located along the highway, it is easily accessible, making it a great spot for travelers and locals alike.

One of the standout features of this hotel is its ambient and well-maintained space. The atmosphere is calm and inviting, perfect for relaxing, catching up with friends, or even having a quiet meal alone. The layout and décor create a welcoming environment that makes you want to stay longer.

Their food and hot drinks are well-priced, offering great value for money. Whether you're in the mood for a hearty meal or just a cup of tea or coffee, you’ll find their menu satisfying without breaking the bank. The portions are generous, and the quality of the food is commendable.

The service here is exceptional! The waitresses are very welcoming, friendly, and attentive, ensuring that you feel at home from the moment you walk in. Their professionalism and warm hospitality add a personal touch to the experience.

Additionally, Double N Hotel offers accommodation for those looking for a place to stay. Whether you're in town for business, a short visit, or just need a comfortable rest stop, their rooms provide a convenient and cozy option.

Overall, Double N Hotel is a great choice for good food, excellent service, and comfortable accommodation in Kisumu. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Anne Hoogers
reviews.text: We attended our friends wedding at Ciala Resorts on December 13th and stayed five nights. We were 12 guests in total including the bride and groom and their family and other friends.  When me and my husband were packing up to leave on Sunday night, we noticed that we couldn’t get into the safe as the code didn’t work anymore. After both me and my husband tried to open it without success, we called the reception. The night manager came and opened the safe with a master key. We took our things out and realised that there was $500 missing! After contacting the hotel management, they showed very little interest in helping us. They told us that we must have forgotten the code, which is not the case. We left to go home to Sweden but my friend, the bride tried to help us and has gone back on several occasions to talk about it. The hotel management says that they are still investigating, they won’t let us se the CCTV recordings and acts like they think we are lying. I have never been treated like this at any other hotel/resort I’ve been to. Don’t go there! Someone there is using a master key to get in to the safes and puts in a random code to lock it so you don’t notice, and you risk losing your valuables and or money and they won’t help you solve it!

reviews.author: Beryl Nyameyo
reviews.text:
I traveled to Kenya in December 2025 to attend my friend’s wedding at Ciala Resort, Kisumu. I was a bridesmaid, and we had spent over a year planning and looking forward to this special occasion. While the wedding itself went well and the venue is visually appealing, what followed completely overshadowed the experience.
One of the guests in our group had money stolen from the hotel safe, the very place guests are told is secure, while she was at Dinner. When this was reported to management at Ciala Resort, the response was shocking. The hotel denied responsibility outright, insisted that “such things do not happen here,” and suggested the guest must have spent the money and forgotten, effectively accusing her of lying.
The guest was visiting Kenya for the first time, making the experience even more distressing. Rather than investigate or show empathy, the hotel refused to probe the matter further, offered no accountability, and provided absolutely no customer service or support.
The theft itself is serious. What is even more alarming is the lack of ownership, professionalism, and concern for guest safety. A hotel safe is meaningless if management is unwilling to act when a breach occurs.
I am sharing this review to warn future guests to exercise extreme caution when booking at Ciala Resort, Kisumu, especially if you plan to use their in-room safes or are visiting from abroad. I also hope this public review pressures the hotel to do the right thing—acknowledge the incident, conduct a proper investigation, and refund the affected guest.
Until that happens, I cannot recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Vivian Amondi
reviews.text:
⚠️ Not Recommended – Warning to Brides

I checked in as a happy bride but left very disappointed. Despite paying early, Ciala Resort attempted to resell our confirmed wedding venue. I also booked rooms for 12 guests, and $500 went missing from a room safe. Management was informed but did not handle the matter seriously. Due to poor professionalism and serious security concerns, I strongly advise couples not to book this venue or their rooms.

reviews.author: morerays general supplies
reviews.text:
The experience in this hotel was horrible was checked in and at night someone accessed my room like drugged me and frisked all my bags just to wake up at night  and find everything all over and to my surprise the cctv was not working.
I lost my phone and money, Id and ATM. I later found  the ATM and  ID at the ground floor of the hotel but I lost  a phone.The same I reported at the Kondele police station and got  an OB number .
The hotel management have never called me or given a report 3 weeks down now..
Disappointed.

reviews.author: Bets Liz
reviews.text: The rooms are splendid. Perfect Ambience. Clean and neat. The receptionist was very hospitable. Everything is good except the kitchen and the waiter services. We waited for food for more than 3 hours. The waiter will lie to you food would be ready in 45 minutes. We had to make noise at the kitchen. We got to the hotel a bit late and tired and ordered food. We waited for food from 7:03 pm & ate past 10pm. In a nut shell, the hotel is a go to anytime but plan to eat or order food from outside unless you have the time to wait for more than 3hrs. Anyway, they said they were sorry.

name: Sovereign Hotel
address: Lolwe Drv, Aput Ln, Kisumu, Kenya
editorial_summary: Refined rooms in a sleek hotel offering 2 restaurants, a bar & an outdoor pool, plus a spa.

reviews.author: Micaëla Boone
reviews.text: I booked a room for our beloved friends. They stayed in the hotel beginning of November. They had a marvelous time. Rooms were great, spacious and clean. Diner and breakfast very good. The staff really impressed them. Gave also extra attention to the very small one. Our friends felt very welcome and taken care of. Next time I am in Kisumu, I ll certainly stay in this hotel.

reviews.author: Matthew Wambua
reviews.text: A hidden gem worth discovering. From the gate to your room, everything wows you. Spectacular view of the lake and sunset from the top floor.

reviews.author: Paula Kasuboski
reviews.text: Used the pool facility for a birthday party for my son and His university friends. The food and catering was excellent. Cynthia and Elizabeth took care of all the plans and did an amazing job. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: WuodAgoro
reviews.text:
**Review of Sovereign Hotel, Kisumu, Kenya**

Rating: ★★★★☆

The Sovereign Hotel in Kisumu is a remarkable accommodation option that stands out for both its hospitality and location. Nestled near the shores of Lake Victoria, it offers guests a picturesque view that is hard to beat.
Location
The hotel's location is one of its biggest assets. Situated close to the lake, it provides easy access to various attractions, including the Kisumu Impala Sanctuary and local markets.
Room Quality:
I stayed in one of the deluxe rooms, which was spacious and well-appointed. The decor is stylish yet comfortable, featuring modern amenities such as a flat-screen TV, a mini-fridge, and a comfortable bed.
Service:
The staff at Sovereign Hotel were friendly and attentive, providing excellent customer service throughout my stay. From the reception to the restaurant, everyone was eager to assist and make my experience enjoyable.

reviews.author: Austin Muendo
reviews.text: TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE WITH THE FOOD SERVICE. I wish i could put a ZERO star on service, because they have made me feel very disrespected and not cared for yet i pay for it. The kitchen staff should really learn communication to avoid people missing meals and not getting any form of compensation for incompetency.

reviews.author: Martin Verrev
reviews.text: Good hotel - everything needed was there. Excellent service.

reviews.author: William Ward
reviews.text: Excellent!  The rooms are clean, the people are welcoming, the free breakfast is awesome!!  A very safe place for guests as well.  Special thanks to Duncan(Dan) and Trecy for their kind hospitality.  I also loved the soft worship music in the morning on the patio.  Bill Ward - United States

reviews.author: Theunis Coetzee
reviews.text: Room wasn't serviced. No Aircon, no convenience bar.

reviews.author: joachim rotich
reviews.text: Excellent food, and hospitable staff

reviews.author: wikus scheepers
reviews.text:
The Staff was very friendly and helpful.
Rooms are very neat and comfortable.
Breakfast was not the best, it s like last nights meals, saved for the next day to serve as Breakfast.

reviews.author: Joni
reviews.text: Terrible service.

reviews.author: bouphine ochieng
reviews.text: A place to visit

name: Enashipai Resort & Spa
address: Moi S Lake Rd, Naivasha, Kenya
editorial_summary: All-inclusive lakefront resort offering chic dining, bars & a disco, plus a spa & an outdoor pool.

reviews.author: Nemanja Nedović
reviews.text:
A truly fantastic hotel in a stunning lakeside setting. The gardens surrounding the lake are beautiful and perfectly maintained, creating a peaceful and elegant atmosphere. The property feels very well organized, with direct access to the lake, which makes the experience even more special.
The rooms are spacious and tastefully decorated, offering both comfort and style. The food was excellent throughout our stay.
We only wish we could have stayed longer.

reviews.author: Anannya Bania
reviews.text: This property is extremely beautiful and huge .They have a huge walking trail and I loved walking by the lakeside area it was really calm,windy and breathtaking !.I just wish they had a temperature controlled pool ,a better lunch /dinner buffet with more varities. I honestly didn't find it a 5 start level dining experience . The room was decent but it was really hot in the night  so instead of the small fan which is not even on the ceiling above the bed it's better if there was an Ac in the room also i didn't like the bed being decorated with rose petals it only makes the room messy. Rest everything else was really great . It is indeed a beautiful property where sadly I could stay only one day but definitely I'll be back again :)

reviews.author: Tom
reviews.text:
Great staff. Exceptional customer service. Huge resort, nice to walk around or bike. Nice pool and small gym.

Boats directly to creset island game reserve. Food in the cafe was very good and reasonably priced.

Only negative was the electric service needs to be upgraded. Many of the switches in the room were not functioning or hard wired to be on all the time. The ceiling fan was very old and noisy. You would expect these to be upgraded for the high cost of this resort.

reviews.author: peter kamau
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The amenities are excellent, the staff are very friendly and helpful, and the food was consistently good. The environment is serene and well maintained. Accommodation offers both comfort and privacy. The team-building activities were exceptionally well planned and engaging - the best we have experienced. Overall, it was a relaxing and memorable experience, and we would highly recommend the hotel.

reviews.author: Madhu Sen
reviews.text:
We stayed for one night at Enashipai Resort & Spa during our visit to Lake Naivasha and truly enjoyed our experience. The resort is beautifully designed and has direct access to the lake, with boats usually dropping guests right at the property’s jetty (around 1 km from the main area).

We appreciated seeing a separate Indian section in the restaurant, which made it easy for us to enjoy our preferred meals. The resort also has a kids’ play area, spa, boutique shop, and even a small museum, making it a perfect place for both families and couples.

The staff were very helpful — upon our request, they kindly allotted a room near the restaurant for our convenience since we were traveling with our child. The rooms were clean and comfortable, and our daughter loved her cute little bed.

We did quite a bit of shopping at the resort’s store, which had beautiful items, though we regret not being able to buy some larger ones due to luggage space limits. Overall, a wonderful stay in a stunning property — wish we had planned a longer stay!

name: Sweet Lake Resort
address: Moi S Lake Rd, Karagita, Kenya
editorial_summary: No-nonsense quarters in an unpretentious hotel offering breakfast, a restaurant & a bar.

reviews.author: Basheer Rehman
reviews.text:
We stayed at sweet lake resort for 1 night. The people who work at this facility are very kind and accommodating and this overall review has nothing to do with them. the employees were helpful and kind throughout our stay.

When we first arrived to our room, we noticed our mattress was sunken in very deeply, it would have definitely not be comfortable to sleep on and the person who walked us to our room was also astonished by the mattress therefore we were then given a new room.

New room was also pretty bad, overall I think sweet lake resort really needs serious renovations. The main door has a 2 inch gap from the floor so anything can crawl into the room, the windows don't fully close, the bathroom door doesn't open fully nor does it close since the door latch has no hinge to fit in to.

I was happy they provided a mosquito net however there were so many dead bugs in it, it really needed a wash. Pillow cases smelled like body odor, needed better washing. Overall room was very dirty.

Dinner food we ordered from menu, we ordered chicken sandwich and asian chicken with rice. chicken for both entrees was dry, waitress forgot the rice so it came out much later unfortunately. Fries were good. Breakfast was a buffet and it was good.

Overall, I would not recommend staying here and we were not happy to stay here either. Who ever owns this, please renovate the people who work for you deserve better!

reviews.author: Kenneth Macharia
reviews.text: We went here during the new years celebrations. What i liked most is the fact that they have various games within the compound. I.e pool table, volleyball pitch and a football pitch. They also have a swimming pool.

reviews.author: maureen kamau
reviews.text: The service was great. But kindly you need to do something about the rooms...the wash rooms to be specific....Aslo address the issues of not having water in those rooms...it's very uncouth. Thanks

reviews.author: Keshy
reviews.text:
The hotel is nice, good food and quiet room.
Most of the staff are friendly and willing to help, especially the student attachés.
The bathroom, however, might need some renovation, esp because water from the shower fills the entire room.

reviews.author: AMBROSE SUSWA
reviews.text: A good place for ala cate and walki inn. Also accommodation

reviews.author: Valentine Makali
reviews.text: Kind staff apart from the Director. My kids had food poisoning ,he never bothered to address it,we spent rest of the afternoon in hospital after check out. What made me wonder the most is  the spa rates which are charged in USD and rates fluctuate daily. There is no standard rate. So this means that everyday massage rate could change depending on Dollar rate. This should be a standard charge for a period of time then reviewed once in a while. I asked the Director to speak to the owner but he refused. Wasn't happy, That was my first and  last time visiting Mwanzo.

reviews.author: Lauri 5000
reviews.text: Very nice experience overall! The place is clean, genuinely friendly staff and the food is great!

reviews.author: Luxury
reviews.text: Like the tag line says, True Taste of Africa! It's a hidden gem, tucked in the heart of an expansive flower farm,  on the outskirts of Naivasha town. Caters to a mixed clientele, from locals, to foreigners. Ideal to visit weekdays, to get a true feel of the place. Staff are friendly and service is spot on. Must try the swimming whilst there.  Its an affordable 200ksh per client. They have spacious and clean changing rooms offering hot showers. Meals and drinks can be served at the poolside. Make a point to carry camera or smart phone. The views are amazing!

reviews.author: Peter Murdoch
reviews.text: Beautiful rooms, immaculate and welcoming.  The staff is eager to please and takes pride in serving their guests.  I am so glad I found this gem only 15 minutes from Naivasha.  The private security gave me and my family comfort during the more tensive days of protests during our stay in Kenya.  We also stayed in the tents, it is glamping at its best with lots of blankets, comfortable bedding, and access to showers and other amenities the facility has to offer.  Do not hesitate to come here for an affordable retreat, you will not be disappointed!!

reviews.author: Reuel yeo
reviews.text: Our 1st stop for our safari tour! The staff that served us set the standards really high. The food was very local and delicious, they take their service standards really serious and make sure every guest is comfortable and well taken care of. We had a great balcony view. Wifi is strong and fast.

name: Lake Naivasha Resort
address: Moi S Lake Rd, Naivasha, Kenya

reviews.author: Geoffrey Nevine
reviews.text:
It's located on a huge plot of land. Hotel rooms are spacious and welcoming.
✨ Elegant resort comfort
✨ Beautiful manicured lawns & open spaces
✨ Peaceful lakeside ambiance
Experiences that go beyond travel — connecting people, creating memorable moments, and showcasing the best of Kenya.

reviews.author: Kristy Rapes
reviews.text: We stayed here for 2 nights and the rooms were updated, clean, modern, and spacious. The afternoon tea overlooking the lake is delightful and all of the staff were extremely attentive. We took a boat ride and saw countless birds including pelicans, ibis, cranes, cormorans, and many more. We also saw zebra, waterbuck, gazelle, and impala while near the island. The hippo viewing area was incredible, we got to see the hippos just a few feet away.

reviews.author: Eliška
reviews.text: This accommodation by the Hippo Lake took a piece of my heart. ❤️ Upon arrival, we were looking at the resort with our mouths open and I think we didn't close it. The hotel grounds are beautiful, as are the interior spaces and rooms. Everyone is very nice here, from the staff at the reception, in the restaurant or the staff who transport guests to their accommodation in a "golf" cart. We didn't have the opportunity to fully experience the hotel as we would have liked, we would have needed more days for that due to its size. And we were very sorry that we couldn't stay longer.

reviews.author: J H
reviews.text:
We had a workshop at this place. It was a horrible experience.
First entering the gate was like entering a prison. The security guards want all details which is a total breach of data privacy.  In the end the general manager had to come to grant entry.
Our meeting room was not properly attended, no serious manager ever came, they could not properly clean up the room, the snacks for coffee breaks always came late, even the coffee came often after the break and everything was immediately removed although we asked several time for continous coffee.
Lunch food was not attractive at all. The buffet was very boring and very expensive.
Overall the place has far too many groups and they seem overwhelmed resulting in bad service.
The noise in the corridors was really disturbing even with closed doors.
I can not recommend this place as a conference venue, too expensive for what it is and not the service which makes you comfortable.
The worst of all was the extremly bad internet. We could not even have a proper teams call and at times it disappeared completely!! How can you have such a bad internet in a conference facility in 2026??????

reviews.author: Shoubhik Mukhopadhyay
reviews.text: Luxurious stay indeed. Plush property just beside Lake Naivasha. The waterbody and hippo-watching add value to their hospitality. Food is super good. They have their own facilities for boating on the lake. Rooms are spacious, and they use golf carts for pick-up and drop-off from the dining area.

name: Panorama Park Hotel
address: Off Moi S Lake Rd, Naivasha, Kenya
editorial_summary: Relaxed hotel overlooking a lake offering an outdoor pool & a spa, plus free breakfast & Wi-Fi.

reviews.author: Ann Nyokabi Mwega
reviews.text:
Of all the hotels I’ve visited, this one truly stands out. The food was absolutely delicious, every dish on the buffet felt thoughtfully prepared, with a wide variety that you’re genuinely spoilt for choice.

And the views… breathtaking. I honestly couldn’t get enough of them. Every glance felt like a postcard moment.

The staff were incredibly warm and welcoming, not just professional, but genuinely kind. It felt less like a hotel stay and more like being received at home.

Their tree house restaurant overlooking Lake Naivasha is something special. Dining there with those views is an experience on its own.

I will definitely be visiting Panorama again and again 🙌

reviews.author: Anne Njuguna
reviews.text: If I could give them 0 stars I would happily do it. The staff was hostile and rude. The reservations manager had no quirks about insulting us and speaking rudely to us. They lied about our bills all while speaking rudely to our faces and being uncooperative. The only good thing about this hotel was the treehouse restaurant which had a scenic view of Naivasha. There were some staff who were nice but majority would stare at you and be outright rude. This place was very disappointing as there were not many activities to do and when my room was cleaned a member of staff opened our bedside drawers to do what I can’t imagine a big part of the hotel was under construction and this is during the Christmas holiday season it wasn’t the best place to bring kids. Overall the place was very bad would not recommend to anyone spend your money better elsewhere please. The hotel was not very good it was plain the elevator wasn’t in commission the lights disappeared more than 2 times a day. The food wasn’t the best their menu didn’t have a wide variety and their buffet was mediocre at best. I have stayed many hotels which were bad but I think this takes the cake for the worst hotel.

reviews.author: NANCY NJERI
reviews.text: Lovely hotel. The tree house restaurant is a winner..if comfort had a flavor, their pumpkin soup would be it, simply liquid perfection!..service was warm and welcoming and the views, let's just say my camera roll is now 80% trees. Beautiful setting and good value for money!!

reviews.author: Martha
reviews.text:
I stayed here in September for a conference meeting. Panorama Park Hotel offers beautiful views, including a stunning glimpse of Lake Naivasha. If you enjoy a rustic and laid-back atmosphere, this is the place for you.
However, the rooms and amenities could really use some upgrading to enhance overall comfort and experience.

reviews.author: MyAgrovet Kenya
reviews.text:
Disappointing place, totally ran-down, nothing works. Next to the tree hotel reeks of urine and sewer. The reception is dark and sooty, children area is a deathtrap: broken swings, dirty pool and carpets which have reached the end of their purposeful life.

The staff are just getting by, unenthusiastically. They don’t care, you can tell they are unpaid or underpaid, if paid.

Don’t waste your time and money, there are better hotels around.

name: Burch's Resort Naivasha
address: Moi South Lake Rd, Naivasha, Kenya
editorial_summary: Rural property offering cottages & tents, plus lake views, a 24/7 eatery & conference facilities.

reviews.author: terry kaba
reviews.text: I had a disappointing experience while trying to book a stay at this resort. The marketing manager was unprofessional and quite rude, which left a bad taste in my mouth. I decided to book another resort instead. I expected better communication and courtesy, especially from someone representing the establishment.

reviews.author: PARTHA BHATTACHARJEE
reviews.text:
A great hotel at Lake Naivasha located on the bank of the lake.

The rooms were good with adequate supply of water both hot and cold. The food was quite good and somewhat matched Indian tastebuds of ours. The service was also very good. The Masai group performed a show during dinner time with their typical attire and song and dance.

Saw many birds of which the Hamerkop was unique. Brown feathers and the size of the bird was quite large.

There is a small swimming pool inside with green lawn and quite a few number of trees. There was a bar at the lake side on the bank and it was great sitting there and enjoying the lake view during evening.

Recommended.

reviews.author: likanari
reviews.text: Was here for a corporate team building. The location is excellent only 40 minutes from Nairobi, in the heart of Kiambu County. Beautiful scenery with lots kf tea plantation. The food is fresh and flavorful, however the service and organisation skills of the hotel staff needs improvement. The staff were rather slow and looked overwhelmed by our numbers. Guess we were one of the few companies to visit the resort. This is a cool place one can visit with family, because they have a pool

reviews.author: Rebeccah ANDEKA
reviews.text: I have been at Burch's Camp so many times, yet every time it gets only better. The reception is warm, friendly and professional. The service is excellent and the food is sumptuous and so fulfilling. It is truly home.... The view of  the African sunset on Lake Naivasha while at the balcony of my room was breathtaking! I would love to go back again and again!!!

reviews.author: Caroline Kieru
reviews.text: Our family booking process was seamless, addressing all our concerns and fostering high expectations for a positive experience.  The location is ideal, boasting stunning scenery.  The rooms were clean and spacious, and the staff provided exceptional, friendly service, resulting in a wonderful family stay.

name: Wonderland Destinations Resort
address: Off Kenyatta Avenue. Next to Naivasha police Station, Naivasha, Kenya

reviews.author: Juan Andres Bello Perez
reviews.text:
Our stay at Wonderland Destinations Resort was truly wonderful. The attention and service from everyone were excellent, and every staff member treated us with such kindness and care.

We had a small situation with our original room, but the manager handled it immediately and upgraded us to the best room at no extra cost. This gesture made us feel incredibly valued and turned our stay into an unforgettable experience.

We are so grateful for the hospitality and professionalism of the entire team. We would definitely recommend Wonderland Destinations Resort to anyone looking for comfort, great service, and genuine care during their trip.

reviews.author: Dan F
reviews.text: Great location in town. Workers are friendly. Chef is very good and makes delicious meals. Pool is very refreshing !

reviews.author: Regina Muthoni
reviews.text: Place is ideally located near town yet very quiet. The staff were very friendly yet professional. If you're in Naivasha make them your host.

reviews.author: Lucia Waithera
reviews.text: My husband and I enjoyed our night at Wonderland. The service was amazing and the place was quiet. The room was very clean and big. The food was also amazing and we were especially blown away by the breakfast they prepared for us. We would definitely recommend this hotel and if we are ever back to Naivasha, we won't hesitate to take up room with them again. Keep up the good service!

reviews.author: Judith Chepngetich
reviews.text:
Had a great experience at this hotel. We took a family suite of 4 pax, bed and breakfast. Quiet and peaceful you won't even believe you are in Naivasha town. The police station is a few metres so is a plus for security. Cons: The shower head for one room sprayed in all directions, while for the kids room was directed to the wall hence a little bit inconveniencing. They should also provide dustbins for all rooms.
Overall the service was excellent, Brenda and Billy were so kind and helpful. Will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Alice Wanjiku
reviews.text: Their services are top notch and the place is located in a serene environment near a highway so it's easier to locate it..is recommend anyone to go there 😌🫰

reviews.author: Coach Roy Okonji
reviews.text: Nice place located on the Nairobi Nakuru highway. Nice rooms. Unfortunately on the day we visited, there was a kesha in a church neighboring the hotel and they were really loud. We hardly slept.

reviews.author: Kathleen Mwangi
reviews.text: The service is bad.Theyve really become bad over the years and if you’re going there please be aware that youll almost have to beg for things.

reviews.author: Simon Mosiro
reviews.text:
The rooms were the best. Deluxe option is private. I enjoyed my stay.

The service team was on point.. I especially give 5 star to the receptionist.

The food was ok. Fries 🍟🍟 and chicken 🍗. Please work on the portion.

Looking forward to coming back.

reviews.author: Joseph Karani
reviews.text: Its a beautiful place for chilling with family

name: Lake View Resort
address: Drive Mama Ngina Rd, Naivasha, Kenya

reviews.author: Brian Simiyu
reviews.text: Ooh the place is pretty admirable, talk of the services offered rn ooooooo 🔥 et.al

reviews.author: Martin Njuguna
reviews.text: Brief visit -now Matamans Garden.The staff were helpful,friendly and prompt to serve-keep it up. Place was serene, quiet,with good Wi-Fi. Food was served hot and fresh. Management good work.

reviews.author: NELLIE WANJIKU
reviews.text: I loove the aesthetics… location and privacy 🤭 just a hidden gem

reviews.author: Stella Mbeliv
reviews.text: It was calm and soothing. Brian, the chef had a tremendous charisma.And all the others were amazingly welcoming.

reviews.author: Antony kimingich
reviews.text: Fantastic place to be in terms of indoor & outdoor activities. Swimming, restaurant,conferences, accommodations and camping 🏕️

reviews.author: Josantos Safaris (Masaimara Serengeti)
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Nest Boutique Hotel and it stood out as a true gem. The friendly staff went above and beyond, from warm welcomes to personalized tips on local safaris, making us feel right at home.

The awesome buffet meals were a highlight: fresh, flavorful Kenyan dishes with plenty of variety, perfect fuel for our adventures. And those rooms? Spacious, comfy, and with stunning, clear views of Lake Naivasha.
As Josantos Safaris we'll be back and do recommend The Nest Boutique to anyone who's looking to stay closer to the lake Naivasha.

reviews.author: Miriam Guy
reviews.text:
Awesome place to be, The rooms are amazing, warm and comfy. The staffs are so helpful , friendly and very welcoming, the night games was so interesting. The food was  mouth watering and delicious 😋😋😋. Can't wait to book again with you guys. The Next Boutique  Hotel is the place to be.
Regards Miriam
Mk Fitness And Adventure

reviews.author: M. J.
reviews.text:
Good place to sit down and relax and the cocktails at the bar are very good.

One star has to be subtracted because we were there at 4.50 p.m. and we waited to order. The waitress kept us waiting till shortly after 5 p.m. to tell us then, that there was a 2 for 1 cocktail offer till 5 p.m.

reviews.author: Chalton Aloe
reviews.text: This is a 5-story building that is not that complete. It doesn't have a front yard or back yard. The space is constrained. The washrooms are dilapidated. 4th floor doesn't have any washroom, so good luck with your meeting there. The stairs has been hidden at the back. I don't know why. The hotel feels broke; why pay a premium for a broke hotel? Even the lift wobbles and squeak a lot (poor maintenance). Anyway, I pity the employees who are kind and responsive.

reviews.author: Wanjiku Kimani
reviews.text: I love the services, world class services, the food was amazing, Beatrice at the reception was very helpful, she answered and attended to us, and made sure we were comfortable throughout our stay. I highly recommend the Nest Boutique Nairobi

reviews.author: MAGRET MUTHONI
reviews.text: Its a relatively good place and budget friendly for room and would definately recommend

reviews.author: Joni
reviews.text: Maybe it's because Christmas was approaching and therefore the absence of guests made the staff switch to really low gear.

reviews.author: Shanice M
reviews.text: The outside environment was so nice. Even the pool. Very calming. The rooms however a different story! Very old, everything from the bedding to the floors seemed unhygienic and outdated. If they worked on the rooms, it would easily be paradise!

reviews.author: Millicent Apondi
reviews.text: Very warm and efficient staff.the place is safe and very clean

reviews.author: julius
reviews.text: They need to upgrade their bathrooms. The toilets are not clean and barely work

name: Lake Naivasha Sopa Resort
editorial_summary: Airy quarters in a laid-back, lakeside resort on lush grounds, offering dining & an outdoor pool.

reviews.author: Maureen Gatwiri
reviews.text:
My stay at Lake Naivasha Sopa Resort was truly wonderful. The resort is set on stunning grounds filled with acacia trees, and seeing giraffes and zebras roaming freely around the cottages makes the experience feel incredibly special.

The rooms are spacious, clean, and very comfortable, with beautiful views of the gardens and wildlife. The staff are warm, welcoming, and always ready to help, which made the stay even more enjoyable.

The food was delicious with a good variety, and the overall atmosphere of the resort is calm and relaxing. It’s  perfect for anyone looking to unwind and enjoy nature.

reviews.author: M Green
reviews.text:
We had amazing times walking around wild animals, zebras, massive dear, monkeys, tortoise, rabbits, giraffe, eagles, wild water birds, and we didn't catch the night hippos as we only visited during the day.
The entrance is free, you can see all this animals for free, just have a drink and they made wonderful fresh fruit juice. Lovely place indeed.

reviews.author: Jahnavi
reviews.text:
Loved everything about this stay!

Having giraffes and zebras roaming the grounds while you walk to breakfast is an incredible sight to wake up to. The resort is so close to the lake, so the views are absolutely stunning.

The food was amazing, and the staff were so welcoming. A special thanks to Diana from Customer Relations for her lovely hospitality.

Whether you're here for the lake safaris or just to chill, this place is a total gem. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jasmine Tyzack
reviews.text: We stayed here on our honeymoon and the staff, the grounds and accommodation have all been outstanding. Special touches were made for us and the grounds are stunning. There are animals roaming the grounds; we were greeted by a giraffe at the entrance, and had a cold drink on the balcony watching the zebras. We would love to come back!

reviews.author: Basit A
reviews.text:
The rooms and the property is excellent. The property has giraffes, zebras and waterbucks on the property. The garden opens up to the Naivasha Lake, so the location is wonderful.
Highly recommended property. All amenities available in the room.
We went on a nature/ birdwatching walk with the naturalist - Denis. He is an absolute gem, amazing knowledge and is great at sharing his knowledge.

name: Enkapune Resort Naivasha
address: Moi S Lake Rd, Karagita, Kenya

reviews.author: Njuguna patrick
reviews.text: A classic 5 star hotel with affordable tailored menu to suit all

reviews.author: mash fred
reviews.text: Recently rehabilitated, there is no staff during the night. You have to book in advance. Rooms are stuffy.

reviews.author: paul mwangi
reviews.text: Its cool place for either climate conditions

reviews.author: SOS RONO (sos)
reviews.text: Astonishing look,

reviews.author: Rosemary Gakii
reviews.text: Beautiful place

reviews.author: Lwanda Keya
reviews.text: A very serene and clean facility. The host was highly supportive and available throughout. We will visit again! Thanks Margaret and your team

reviews.author: Kelvin Gathirimu
reviews.text: The rooms were very dirty with snails and broken beds, broken showers, the bed sheets and pillow cases were dirty and the rooms were smelly

reviews.author: Nauphrage Compilers
reviews.text: A lovely place away from home.

reviews.author: Ali Morsali
reviews.text: Very kind staff...

reviews.author: Njoroge Nginyayu
reviews.text: Superb views if Lake Naivasha, the houses are clean, well kept and has cottage like feel. The staff in property are kind and will go above and beyond. Money we'll spent.

reviews.author: joseph kigamwa
reviews.text: Nice place has a lift especially if have challenges going through stairs. Good food.

reviews.author: George Wanjiru
reviews.text: Wisbon have top notch services from restaurant, ballroom for meetings and also the night club have good atmosphere ambiance. Prices are moderately fair.

reviews.author: King'uru Wahome
reviews.text:
Fairly a good hotel according to their standards.

Have some elaborate security arrangements, in particular the control of entry and exit of patrons; a way of keeping off those not welcomed.

However, the same security initiative is a threat to residents in an event of emergency. Need to evaluate how in such circumstances, the residents could be evacuated safely within the shortest possible time.

There is urgent need to relook at the management and operationalization of the lift and stares

reviews.author: Angelina Wanjiru
reviews.text: I was amazing,the ambiance the service and the food.

reviews.author: Dennis Mwangi
reviews.text:
Nice rooms
Bed and breakfast
Also has a pub

reviews.author: Charles Thiong'o
reviews.text:
Nice view, nice for stopovers
Wonderful salon and barbershop
Area very windy and dusty

reviews.author: Daniel Wairegi
reviews.text: It's located on nakuru nairobi highway and the price are friendly to everyone

reviews.author: Wanjiku J
reviews.text: The hotel is fantastic. Very clean room with extra blankets, relaxing hot showers, balcony, accessible and delicious all rounded breakfast. The superior customer service was the cherry on top. Pauline at the front desk is amazing. I would definitely want to go back and would recommend a stay here.

reviews.author: Bosibori Abaya
reviews.text:
Amazing rooms, great breakfast. Have spacious and well equipped conference facilities.
Easily accessible from the main highway. Has a restaurant, lounge with a beautiful view of the lake.

reviews.author: Skyric Performing Arts Lab
reviews.text: Great food, spacious, nice service.

name: Montana Guest Resort Naivasha
address: 7CMJ+4CC, Moi S Lake Rd, Naivasha, Kenya

reviews.author: Recreasport Agency
reviews.text: beautiful scenes on the way to the greatriftvalley scenery

reviews.author: uwazi digital
reviews.text: FABULOUS

reviews.author: Samantha Meister
reviews.text: This little hidden gem was a sanctuary for our team. We felt the peaceful atmosphere as soon as we went through the gate. The meals were all lovely, the staff caring, and the property a unique treasure hunt of eclectic local art and paintings. It is definitely a place we will be staying again.

reviews.author: Hanna Crockett
reviews.text:
Aloe Park is beautiful, welcoming, and cozy. The property is incredible, all of the rooms are comfortable, well maintained, and decorated with furniture and art from local artists! The owner was so incredibly lovely, and the staff were so kind. They made us incredible food, started and maintained a campfire for us, and checked in with us regularly.

The animals were also such a highlight! Two of the sweetest dogs ever, a lovely calico kitty, and two funny little chickens all roam around and keep you company!

I hope to return whenever I find myself in Naivasha!!!

reviews.author: mihaela istrate
reviews.text:
AloePark Art Hotel is our peaceful and super relaxing little corner in Naivasha.
We love it for its authentic style, the explosion of color inside (the rooms are decorated by local artists with great taste), and also outside (the garden is full of trees and plants that are almost always in bloom and a joy to the eyes).
Sari, the entire staff, the lovely dogs, the cat, the chickens, and the rabbits :) – they’re all wonderful. Every time we go to Naivasha, we’re warmly welcomed by everyone here.
Of course, the food is also delicious, and when everything is offered with a big smile, it just can't be anything but perfect.
We wholeheartedly recommend this place, and we always return with great pleasure whenever we get the chance.

reviews.author: Pauliina Penttilä
reviews.text: The hotel was cozy, the yard was beautiful and staff very kind. The owner was extremely nice and helpful. We had many activities including school visits, cooking class, safari trips etc. The owner took us to the pharmacy when we had a flu and helped in all our concerns

reviews.author: Bekah Stroik
reviews.text:
I had a lovely stay here. The property is beautiful and peaceful and the staff were very friendly and helpful. It's in a quiet neighborhood and easy to walk into town.

My only disappointment was that I couldn't find any nearby restaurants/bars on the lakefront so I didn't get to see the hippos come out at night (it seems like I would have had to stay at one of the campgrounds along the lake in order to see them).

name: Mara Serena Safari Lodge
address: The Mara Triangle Conservancy, Maasai Mara Game Reserve, Serena, Kenya

reviews.author: prakash dara
reviews.text:
It’s an awesome place. Stayed here this month for 3 nights and the entire experience was incredible.
The rooms are well decorated and maintained giving a real plush feel. The staff has high standards of hospitality. The spread of meals is excellent.
We being vegetarians from India were delighted to have Indian meals everyday.
Highly recommended for families.

reviews.author: Natasha D
reviews.text:
Mara Serena Lodge is nothing short of magical. From the moment you arrive, you are wrapped in warmth, care, and an atmosphere that makes you feel completely at home. The setting itself is superb—breathtaking views, serene surroundings, and a sense of timeless beauty that makes the entire experience feel truly special.

What really sets Mara Serena apart, however, is the people. The staff are without question some of the friendliest, most attentive, and genuinely kind individuals we have ever encountered. A very special mention must go to the incredible team who make every guest feel like family: Wilson the manager, along with Duncan, Pamella, Daniel, Belina, Anne, and the wonderful team behind them. Their attention to detail, warmth, and professionalism elevate the experience to a level that is simply second to none.

The New Year’s entertainment was outstanding—easily the best we have ever experienced. The dancing and acrobatic performances were world-class, vibrant, and unforgettable, creating an electric atmosphere that had everyone smiling and celebrating together.

And then there is the food—truly exceptional. The variety, quality, and presentation of the buffet were incredible, with every meal feeling like a feast. The attention to detail in both flavor and service was impeccable, and it was clear how much care goes into every dish.

Mara Serena Lodge is not just a place to stay—it is an experience. Magical, heartfelt, and unforgettable. We cannot recommend it highly enough and will cherish the memories made here for a very long time

reviews.author: RMZ
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at this property. The views overlooking the Mara are absolutely stunning, especially at sunrise. The service was excellent, and the food was decent considering the lodge is located right in the heart of the Mara. It is conveniently situated just five minutes from the Serena airstrip. On the downside, the room was quite warm and the in-room fan was not working. The staff did provide an extra fan, but it ended up making the room feel cramped.

reviews.author: Niladri Haldar
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience of the Masai Mara with Serena Safari Lodge. Each and every one of the staff is extremely helpful, well mannered and knowledgeable. Rooms well small/cramped but the beds were extremely comfortable and the rooms had views to die for. The meals at the buffet were decent, breakfasts were particularly great. Bush lunch was wonderfully organised and a great experience to be had. The property’s elevated location gave us lovely views and a calm atmosphere and central location in Mara Triangle meant all our game drives began literally minutes from outside the property, in every direction. During our stay I experienced no issues with mosquitoes at all, and flies and other insects were also quite minimal at the property, which is a great USP with having a resort perched atop a hill I guess.

I definitely recommend families to go for the Serena lodge due to its central location and marvellous staff alone. The views are a massive bonus.

reviews.author: Swatti Daalmia
reviews.text: Good place for vegetarian Indian food, courteous staff. Special thanks to Jacinta M- Restaurant manager, felt at home, she ensured our kid got his comfort food and also got us connected to chef Stephen Kacheru who patiently listened and matched our food preferences, thanks Stephen K. Property manager - Wilson C. Will be remembered for his humility, who doesnot mind getting his hands a bit dirty in extending his support to make our stay safe and comfortable. Wilson, you went out of the way, thanks for your down to earth attitude, it was warm to see you around :) Thank you restaurant & reception team!

name: Sarova Mara Game Camp - Safari Lodge in Kenya
address: Off C12 Road, Maasai Mara, Kenya
editorial_summary: Tented quarters in an upscale all-inclusive lodge with an outdoor pool, a kids' club & game drives.

reviews.author: Rad
reviews.text:
We had an unforgettable stay at Sarova Mara Game Camp. The camp’s amenities, service, and location for game drives made our time in the Maasai Mara exceptional. We saw an incredible amount of wildlife, and falling asleep in a comfortable tent while lions roared in the distance was an experience we’ll never forget.
We stayed at the Olchani Club Lounge within the camp, which made our visit even more special. Our tent was spacious, elegant, spotless, with a beautiful bathroom with a shower and a bathtub. The staff’s kindness stood out throughout our stay.
A heartfelt thank you to Caroline and the manager at reception for their kindness, generosity and for being so welcoming. George, our butler, made everything effortless and arranged a wonderful private supper for us. Thank you to Sordo for driving us and our luggage around the camp, to Douglas and Damaris and the entire kitchen team for the delicious meals, and to Jack for taking care of our tent. The restaurant and bar staff were so friendly and attentive.
I celebrated my birthday at the camp, and the surprise cake and singing at our table made the evening memorable. The live singer–guitarist during supper added a lovely touch.
Asante sana to everyone at Sarova Mara Game Camp for an extraordinary experience. We can’t wait to return.

reviews.author: Naqiuddin Kutbuddin
reviews.text: Our family really enjoyed our stay here. The rooms/tents are well equipped and comfortable. Staff are friendly and attentive to all our needs. There are also many wildlife present at the resort. Special shout out to Mathias for taking the extra effort to make the stay memorable for my son. Also, would like to acknowledge the kitchen crew who were attentive to all our needs. Our only wish would be for the swimming pool to be heated.

reviews.author: Camilla Randell
reviews.text:
Our first visit to Kenya and after 2 nights at the Sarova Panafric Nairobi we spent 3 magical nights at the Sarova Mara Camp
Again a wonderful warm welcome by all at reception we stayed in the fabulous luxury tents ours had a view over the lake and was absolutely beautiful all set in lush gardens with many small animals and beautiful birds. A beautiful pool to relax in yet so much to see. The service everywhere as with the Panafric was excellent everyone so friendly courteous and helpful.
Food at the restaurant was again excellent and the fact you can speak to and interact with the chefs really adds to the experience. The Camp is actually in the park so we felt we had been on a game drive by time we arrived.
All facilities in the room and round Camp were excellent a fabulous place to stay perfect to relax between game drives we were so lucky to see so many amazing animals then enjoy the excellent hospitality at the camp.
I would highly recommend a stay here
Thanks to all the wonderful staff

reviews.author: Chloe Hall
reviews.text:
Lovely game camp in the Mara. Staff were super friendly and attentive, the food was plentiful and some of it was super tasty - the curries and salads in particular! The rooms were amazing - proper toilets and showers in a luxury tent. There was a pool table and darts table as well to occupy you when it was raining - which it did quite a lot when we stayed as rainy season started early.

The only negative really was that because of the rain and lack of sunlight on the tent, the room felt quite damp so wasn’t super comfortable to sleep. Ours was right next to the stream as well so probs didn’t help. I’d suggest they air out the rooms more during the day.

reviews.author: Terry Hein
reviews.text: This is the most beautiful camp we have ever been to. Tents are glamping plus with flush toilets and super soft screened in beds. The staff is sensational, they can't do enough for you. A huge thank you to Nelson, the buggy driver, he was always there to give us a ride, even anticipating when we would need to be picked up. We were in tent 55, last one out on one side, a long way from reception but not to worry, there are lots of buggies (golf carts) to take you back and forth. The food is wonderful, lots of variety and very plentiful. Right in the park so lots of animals to view on Safari. This is a #1 pick for me.

name: Mara Sopa Lodge
editorial_summary: Unfussy game reserve offering free breakfast, an outdoor pool & a lounge bar, plus game drives.

reviews.author: Shivani Alva
reviews.text:
We had the best time here. Masai Mara is such a surreal experience. And having a great stay after a drive is so essential. Thank you so much to the whole staff. You guys are great!
Special shout out to David, our bartender at the pool bar. 10/10 - knowledgeable, patient and such a vibe! Cherry on top - his music❤️

reviews.author: Sally Kamau
reviews.text:
We had such a wonderful stay at Mara Sopa Lodge. From the moment we arrived, the service was phenomenal and so personalized. The staff are incredibly warm, helpful, and attentive, and they truly go out of their way to make sure you are comfortable throughout your stay.

The food was excellent with a great variety for both breakfast and dinner, and everything was fresh and well prepared. On our safari days, they also packed us lovely picnic lunches which made the experience even more special.

The rooms were very clean, comfortable, and well maintained, making it such a relaxing place to return to after a day out in the Mara.
Overall, it was an amazing stay and we would absolutely recommend Mara Sopa Lodge to anyone visiting the Maasai Mara.

reviews.author: Basit A
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience. The food was amazing, both veg and non-veg options available. The rooms were comfortable (not amazingly fancy but clean with all necessities - coffee, tea etc in the room) ,with warm water (always available at the right times, not 24 hours), and 24 hours electricity. The rooms had ample charging points to charge all devices.
The Sopa Lodges is just inside the Masai Mara Park, so the location was good.
Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Santosh Kaur
reviews.text: Very nice stay. Staff are very friendly and welcoming, everything was good. Could have more vegan options but chef was very accommodating. Authentic vibe but a bit outdated compared to other lodges. Shower water was very very hot without warning but good mixer and shower pressure. Wifi in the lodge and rooms, overall good stay with zebras outside the rooms!

reviews.author: Patricia Terris
reviews.text: First, Joyce and Brett at the Spa: fantastic, both days! Edward in the dining room: excellent. We enjoyed our 3 night stay here tremendously. Thank you to the guards who kept us safe at night, as we heard the hyenas not too far away. We like that there is no TV in the room. Also no AC, but not needed as it cools down at night. Sufficient outlets but adapter is needed. No USB or C options. Food is abundant: there's something for everyone. And we very much enjoyed the lecturers and traditional Maasai Dance! We would definitely come back.

name: Sala's Camp
address: Maasai Mara Game Reserve, Narok, Kenya

reviews.author: Sarah Harris
reviews.text:
Sala’s Camp in the Masai Mara was an absolute dream, and experiencing it during our honeymoon made it even more special. From the moment we arrived, everything about the camp felt intimate, thoughtful, and deeply connected to the magic of the Mara.

The camp itself is stunning—elegant yet understated, blending seamlessly into the landscape along the Sand River. The tents are beautifully designed, incredibly comfortable, and perfectly positioned to make you feel immersed in nature while still enjoying true luxury. Waking up to the sounds of the Mara and watching wildlife pass through felt surreal and deeply romantic.

What truly made our experience exceptional was the people. Our guide, Dominic, and spotter, Jonathan, were outstanding. Their knowledge, intuition, and teamwork were unmatched, leading to some of the most incredible wildlife sightings we could have imagined. Beyond their expertise, they brought so much warmth, humor, and care to every game drive, making each moment feel personal and unforgettable.

The entire staff at Sala’s Camp went above and beyond to make our honeymoon feel celebrated in the most genuine way. The service was impeccable—warm, attentive, and effortless—creating an atmosphere where you can fully relax and soak in every moment.

The food was exceptional, with beautifully prepared meals enjoyed in breathtaking settings, from a hot breakfast in the bush to the riverside lunches and dinners at the camp. Every detail, big and small, was handled with intention and heart.

Sala’s Camp is not just a safari lodge—it’s an experience that feels soulful, romantic, and profoundly special. As a honeymoon destination, it exceeded every expectation, and thanks to the incredible team, it will forever be one of the most meaningful trips of our lives.

reviews.author: Laura Traylor
reviews.text: Our stay at Sala's Camp was truly the best vacation ever, thanks to the people and the place. Caroline and Eric were the best hostesses, making us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. The luxury tents were exceptional, offering both comfort and a unique experience in the wilderness. The food was extraordinary, each meal a delightful culinary adventure. The game drives were the highlight of our trip, led by our outstanding guides Dominic and John. They were so fantastic at tracking and finding wildlife. We will always treasure our memories from our rides! We have made lifelong friends among the staff and fellow guests, proving that the warm and welcoming people in Africa truly make all the difference. We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Logan DeBord
reviews.text: This lodge with a focus on conservation is the best that Kenya has to offer! Our safari guides Jackson and Freddy are WORLD-CLASS animal experts and spotters. They allowed us to experience animal behavior up close and personal in the Mara, and always in a safe manner. We saw a cheetah kill, babies of all species (lions, elephants, hyenas) and even uncommon sightings such as a lion pride stealing a leopard kill, a boomslang and spitting cobra, and serval cats. The open-air safari vehicles made viewing easy, and the guides kindly positioned me for photos of birds such as the lilac-breasted roller, ostrich, and Marabou stork. All of the Maasai staff were extremely kind, hospitable, and went out of their way to provide guests with an amazing experience. James was our server and shared both lifelong knowledge of the Mara and his recipe for chicken kienyeji soup! Eric and William shared their stories around the nightly campfire and helped us spot some giraffes. Maasai “night warriors” safely escorted us between our tents and the common areas in the dark hours. Dominic was also a very hospital server and the food from the chef is top-notch! The camp manager Caroline oversaw everything seamlessly. Sala’s is located far away from other camps at the south part of the park. Hippos and crocodiles venture into the riverbed which you can view from the common areas, and baboons and mongoose roam freely around camp during the daytime. You will not regret your stay at Sala’s and a few nights is the perfect safari addition for those wishing to stay at Giraffe Manor.

reviews.author: Angela C
reviews.text:
Unforgettable Experience at Sala’s Camp – A Conservation-Driven Gem

If you are considering a safari in the Maasai Mara, look no further than Sala’s Camp. From the moment we arrived, we were met with such genuine warmth that it truly felt like staying with family. Eric, the manager, and his wife Caroline were the most welcoming hosts—their hospitality went beyond exceptional, and their heartfelt care created an atmosphere that made the camp feel like home.

Our safari experience was elevated by our incredible team in the field. Samson, our guide, was absolutely phenomenal, sharing his unmatched knowledge of every animal we encountered. David, our spotter, was equally impressive, working seamlessly alongside Samson to locate wildlife and give us front-row insight into animal behaviors and instincts. Their combined expertise was extraordinary—they are deeply knowledgeable about the animals and their habits, and their passion for the Mara shines through every moment.

The food was nothing short of amazing, offering a beautiful variety of options at every meal. Each menu was carefully curated, flavorful, and diverse—something we looked forward to after every game drive.

The camp itself is stunning. The rooms are beautiful and thoughtfully designed, with each tent having its own unique personality and aesthetic. With only 7 tents in total, the experience is intimate and peaceful—you never feel like it’s crowded, which is a rare luxury when choosing a safari camp.

My personal highlight was seeing a cheetah—a breathtaking, powerful, and graceful encounter that I will cherish forever. Watching such a magnificent creature in the wild was an absolute privilege.

There are many safari camps in the Maasai Mara, but what truly sets Sala’s apart is their unwavering dedication to animal conservation and community support. Knowing that this company donates a significant portion of its profits to conservation efforts and local communities made our trip even more meaningful. Their focus on protecting wildlife and giving back to the people of the Mara speaks volumes.

If you want an authentic, immersive, and impactful safari experience—one filled with spectacular wildlife, beautiful accommodations, incredible food, and a mission that truly matters—I would 100% choose Sala’s Camp again. An absolute must-stay for anyone visiting Kenya! 🐆🌿

reviews.author: makutiroofing designs
reviews.text:
Traditional tented safari with modern comforts.

Fantastic setting for river crossings during migration season.

Conservation partnerships and frequent sightings of lions, elephants, leopards, and more.
Great for: Families and classic safari enthusiasts.

name: Spirit of the Masai Mara
address: The Masai Mara! Our Little Piece of Paradise Community and Wildlife As One, Siana Conservancy, Kenya
editorial_summary: Sophisticated all-inclusive game reserve offering dining & a sundeck surrounding an infinity pool.

reviews.author: Shreyamsa Manjunath
reviews.text: Incredible! This property is situated in an absolutely amazing place, filled with amazing people- in short, embodies the spirit of Masai Mara!! The Sekenani gate of the reserve is just a 10 minute drive away. The views are so good, one can't get enough of it. The suites are tastefully curated, and they have made sure everything is in  congruity with the surroundings. The colors chosen and the materials used are a testament to this. As the property is unfenced, many animals roam around freely. The rooms are oriented in such a way that every suite gets a view of the waterhole, where animals come to drink water white often. They offer many activities, enough to keep one engaged even if not going on a game drive. Now the best part of the property- the people who run the show. Led by the dynamic Suzan, each and every single one of them makes sure we have a comfortable stay. You are always attended to, and they walk the extra mile to meet any additional demands/ requests. Mr. McCarthy, the owner, makes sure he has a word with every guest assuring them of a good time. The food is good, with the chef more than willing to customise things as requested. We chose this property over tens of others after many days of deliberation and that was probably the best decision of the trip! This place heals, go for it without hesitation!!

reviews.author: herman blubber
reviews.text:
Amazing Stay at Spirit of Masai Mara
We had an incredible experience at Spirit of Masai Mara. The views are absolutely breathtaking, and our little house with a glass front made us feel immersed in nature while still maintaining total privacy. The staff were attentive and welcoming, the food was fantastic, and the lodge is very family-friendly. Even without a safari, there’s plenty to do, from exploring the vegetable garden to short hikes. A perfect retreat for anyone looking to connect with nature in comfort and style!

reviews.author: Lydz C.
reviews.text: Absolutely delighted with our stay at this luxury lodge in Kenya! The amazing staff went above and beyond to accommodate us, even with our unusual schedule, always ensuring we were well taken care of. The food was a highlight; the beef tartare was surprisingly fresh and delicious, and the breakfast spread offered an impressive variety of options to start the day right. Our room was exceptionally comfortable and spacious, providing a perfect retreat after our adventures. A special thanks to Manager Moray, whose exceptional hospitality made our stay truly memorable. We will definitely be returning!

reviews.author: Ken Hart
reviews.text: A fantastic experience on all fronts.  Breathtaking location inside a valley in the Siana conservancy abutting the Masai Mara.  Appears to be the only lodge or building in the area.  Views of a watering hole with animals from the main lodge and our room.  Game drives during the mornings, day and evenings in the conservancy, and the Masai Mara is only a 15 minute drive.  The lodge, food, and rooms are excellent.  Staff work to ensure that your goals for the day are met, and essentially customize everyone's trip.  The Maasai staff are especially welcoming and keen to share their culture and customs with guests.  The Spirit of the Masai Mara has set my travel experiences to a level that I have never before experienced.  Ken from Canada

reviews.author: ananya sabharwal
reviews.text: Our stay was fantastic due to the super comfortable and aesthetic rooms, as well as the very hospitable and helpful staff. The vibe is very cozy yet intimate with nature. We even saw some wildebeests from our room amidst the lush green surroundings. Chef Moses made one of the best vegetarian quiches we have ever had, and he used local ingredients. He was very attentive to our dietary needs and we had some amazing picnic lunches in the Masai Mara thanks to that. We also really enjoyed the sundowner with the Masai dancing.

name: Sand River Masai Mara by Elewana
editorial_summary: Refined tents with terraces in a relaxed property offering safari excursions & free meals.

reviews.author: Keval Shah
reviews.text:
We recently spent three nights at Elewana Sand River Masai Mara with our family, and it turned out to be one of those trips we’ll be talking about for a long time.

From the moment our guide Alex picked us up at Keekorok airstrip, the experience started on a great note. We were welcomed with a refreshing drink and some bites, and Alex even made a small stop on the way so he could introduce himself properly and get to know what we were hoping to see. It felt very personal right from the beginning.

Our guide Alex was fantastic. He’s incredibly knowledgeable about the Mara and the wildlife, and it felt like he always managed to get us to the right place at the right time. What we appreciated even more was how patient he was with our kids. They had endless questions and he happily answered all of them while keeping the drives fun and interesting for everyone.

Back at camp, the service was just as impressive. Our server Alex was excellent — by the second meal he already knew how we liked our food and what drinks we preferred.

A special mention also goes to Shaban the cook, who is clearly very talented. The set menus were beautifully prepared and presented, but he was also very flexible and happy to adjust things or prepare something slightly different when we asked. Everything we ate was really good.

As always, it’s the small details that make the biggest difference. The camp provided refillable water bottles labelled with our individual names, avoiding any mix-ups and adding a nice sustainable touch. After each game drive, we were greeted with cold eucalyptus towels, which were incredibly refreshing after the dusty Mara drives.

The location of the camp is really special, right along the Sand River. Breakfasts and lunches by the river were magical, especially when we could see elephants grazing just across the water.

Another thing that makes the camp unique is that it’s completely unfenced, which makes the experience feel very real and connected to nature. One night we had an elephant just outside our tent, and another time one was grazing nearby — slightly crazy but also unforgettable.

A big thank you as well to Evans and Collins at the bar, the housekeeping team who kept our tent spotless, the security team who escorted us safely to our tents at night, and Manager Kevin who clearly runs a wonderful team.

Overall, they really get the small things right, and those details make the whole experience memorable.

We would definitely go back.

reviews.author: lynnesawyerrealtor
reviews.text: This was my 3rd safari but my first time at Elewana Sand River Maasi Mara. It is beyond beautiful. The tents, the staff and the food are all amazing!! The location is beautiful on the sand river. A few nights before we were there a lioness had her cub under one of the tents. We could hear her calling to it during the night. This place is a truly amazing experience.

reviews.author: Cathy Smelcer
reviews.text: Sand River Masai Mara was simply amazing. The service was incredible.  The location was perfect. We were very sad to leave.  Everyone was incredibly kind, happy and helpful.  Alex S, our guide, was the best!  We learned so much about the Masai Mara and animals.  I asked sooooo many questions and he answered them all!  It was a bucket list trip for us and I HIGHLY recommend Sand River.  We couldn’t fault anything, best trip ever!

reviews.author: Kerri Clarkson
reviews.text: We loved our experience here! The staff were helpful, accommodating and made sure we had different dining experiences. Daily wildlife sightings and amazing housekeeping services. It was fabulous!

reviews.author: うきん
reviews.text:
It was a wonderful place, and all the staff were kind and courteous—I made great memories there.
The food was delicious too, and they flexibly accommodated various requests.
I’d love to stay again if I get the chance.
Thank you so much to all the staff!

name: JW Marriott Masai Mara Lodge
address: Maasai Mara National Reserve, River, Talek, Kenya

reviews.author: Jill Abraham
reviews.text:
Our safari at the JW Marriott Masai Mara Lodge was truly amazing, and we owe much of that to our fantastic guide, Leperes.

Right from our first game drive, Leperes made our trip unforgettable. His deep knowledge of the land and wildlife truly stood out. He could read the animals and predict what they would do, which made each day exciting. Thanks to Leperes, we even saw the Big Five on our first trip to Kenya.

The lodge itself is beautiful, with luxury that fits in well with the natural surroundings.

We were also exceptionally well cared for by the staff. Elias, our server, truly stood out—he went above and beyond each day with genuine warmth, attentiveness, and kindness, making every meal feel personal and memorable. Victor was also a pleasure, and his cocktails and friendly presence were a lovely way to unwind after game drives.

We also want to thank Dennis for teaching us about Maasai traditions and helping us appreciate their culture even more.

The lodge’s provided cameras were a thoughtful touch that enhanced the entire safari experience.

This trip went beyond all our expectations and will always be one of our most meaningful travel experiences. If you are considering a safari, we highly recommend this lodge, especially Leperes.

reviews.author: Ness
reviews.text:
Our stay at the JW Marriott Masai Mara was truly extraordinary. It is hard to fully capture how special the experience was. From the moment we arrived, it was clear that this property operates at an exceptional level.

The setting itself is breathtaking, but what stood out just as much was the attention to detail. Every element of the property felt thoughtful and intentional. The service was seamless. The staff (Josiah, Elias, Victor, to name a few) always greeted us by name, remembered what we liked, and consistently went out of their way to make us feel genuinely cared for. We felt incredibly valued throughout our stay.

The safari experience was equally remarkable. Our guide, Liz, was outstanding! An incredibly skilled driver who navigated challenging terrain with total confidence and calm. She was kind, intelligent, and clearly passionate about what she does. She worked tirelessly to position us for the best sightings, made thoughtful decisions throughout each drive, and communicated clearly so we always understood what we were seeing and why. Because of her dedication and expertise, we saw nearly everything we had hoped to see. Throughout the week there was always something new and unexpected - a sunset surprise, a thoughtful touch (of wine!) - that made each day out feel different from the last.

We also had the opportunity to visit a local Maasai community where Moses gave us a wonderful tour. It was a privilege to experience the warmth of the community and gain a deeper appreciation for the people who call the Mara home.

This was not just a beautiful hotel stay, it was a once-in-a-lifetime experience delivered with warmth, professionalism, and heart. We left feeling grateful and deeply impressed. Thank you to everyone we crossed paths with who made this such a memorable trip. -Kate and May #11

reviews.author: Emergency_Ward
reviews.text:
The JW Marriott Masai Mara Lodge offers a luxury escape that blends comfort with the beauty of the Savannah. From the moment of arrival, the service is perfect, defined by a level of genuine hospitality that makes every guest feel like the priority. Frank at the front desk sets the tone immediately with an efficient check-in and attentive care, ensuring every logistical detail is handled with grace.
The safari experience is equally flawless, led by Jacob, an exceptional game guide whose expertise and intuition provide unforgettable wildlife encounters. His ability to navigate the Mara and share deep insights into the ecosystem ensures that every drive is both educational and exhilarating. Between the world-class guiding and the proactive staff, the service truly leaves nothing to be desired.
The accommodations are excellent, featuring thoughtfully designed rooms that provide a sanctuary of high-end amenities and refined aesthetics. Each suite offers breathtaking, expansive views of the surrounding landscape, allowing guests to witness the magic of the Mara from the comfort of their private deck. For those seeking a flawless blend of adventure and elegance, this lodge delivers an experience that is truly exceptional.
Ok, I'll remember that. You can always ask me to forget things or manage what I've saved for you on the Saved info page.

reviews.author: Gina Spadavecchio
reviews.text:
A Truly Unforgettable “Welcome Home” Experience

Our stay at the JW Marriott Masai Mara was nothing short of extraordinary and easily one of the most meaningful travel experiences of our lives.
