From the moment Jackson picked us up at the airstrip to the Maasai welcome upon arrival, we felt completely cared for and immersed. The staff are what truly make this place exceptional — they didn’t just deliver service, they made us feel like family. Jackson, Victor, Frank James, Moses, Nickson, Josiah, and Dorris each went above and beyond with warmth, kindness, and genuine hospitality.

The chef was incredibly visible and clearly passionate about the food and guest experience, creating special meals that felt thoughtful and personal. Every dining experience was memorable. A special thank you to General Manager Justin, who curated an unforgettable lunch at the Ritz-Carlton — an incredible highlight of our stay.

We also loved how guests were paired for game drives, allowing us to form new connections and share unforgettable moments with others. It added such a unique and human element to the experience.

Two phrases were repeated often — “Hakuna Matata” and “Welcome Home” — and what made them special is that they were truly meant. Leaving was genuinely emotional. Five days was the perfect amount of time, yet it was so hard to say goodbye.

This was a once-in-a-lifetime experience. We cannot give enough stars.

reviews.author: Yana
reviews.text:
We are completely mind-blown by our experience at JW Marriott Masai Mara. We’ve been to many beautiful places around the world, but we have never experienced such a warm, genuine, and heartfelt welcome! From the very first moment, we felt at home.

Every single person from the team we met was incredible.
A very special thank you to Elizabeth, our guide, who welcomed us at the airstrip with the biggest, warmest smile & the most wonderful energy. From the first minute, it was clear how passionate and dedicated she is. Maybe we were lucky but already on our way to the lodge, we saw the Big Five! That was an unforgettable start. Elizabeth is exceptional at what she does, and beyond that, she is such a caring, fun, and lovely human being. Being on safari with her was a joy.

We also want to deeply thank Frank, who made sure our stay was absolutely top-notch. His warmth, openness, kindness, and genuine care did not go unnoticed. His attentiveness and big heart made a real difference, and we are incredibly grateful.

A big thank you as well to Pristilla and the entire housekeeping team for organizing the most beautiful surprise for us. Our room felt like the coziest castle and filled with love, care, and happiness. And the views are magical.

On a more “technical” note: the lodge itself is just stunning. Being so deeply immersed in nature while feeling completely safe is a rare kind of luxury. The restaurant, the bar with amazing drinks, the beautiful spa, and the rooms - everything is exceptional. But what truly makes the place special are the people: warm, friendly, smiling, hugging you, and making you feel like you never want to leave. Always anticipating our needs.

A small but important note on the safari cars: out of all the safari vehicles we saw, JW Marriott has by far the most comfortable fleet. Perfect visibility, incredibly comfortable, and equipped with everything you might need from snacks, drinks, to warm blankets, ponchos.

Thank you for an unforgettable experience. This place and its people, will stay in our hearts forever.

🦒🦓🦁

name: andBeyond Bateleur Camp
editorial_summary: Refined permanent tents in a posh all-inclusive lodge with an outdoor pool, dining & game drives.

reviews.author: jerome Cauchard
reviews.text:
Bateleur camp is a splendid quiet luxury experience.
Elegance and discretion of the place shall be praised, attention to details was outstanding.
Safariwise we were a family, there for 3 nights saw big 5 almost everyday.
Rooms in sophisticated tents are refined and decorate with an exquisite taste, you feel like the camp was built for you, after the Karen Blixen inspiration.
Team has been of an extreme kindness and demonstrated genuine interest in our wellbeing. Food as well was excellent.

Everything at bateleur camp goes the extra mille...and beyond.

Congrats to the team.

reviews.author: Trevor B
reviews.text:
We stayed at &Beyond Bateleur Camp in the Maasai Mara for the first leg of our honeymoon, and it was absolutely incredible. Within our first two days, we saw four of the Big Five, thanks to our amazing guide Mai Tai, who was not only knowledgeable but also made every drive an unforgettable experience.

The hospitality at the camp was beyond exceptional. Our villa butler, Cedric, exceeded all expectations—surprising us with thoughtful touches like a warm bath after game drives, private dinners at the villa, and breakfasts brought right to our tent. The camp host, Grace and bartender Joseph, was equally wonderful, always so sweet and accommodating, making us feel welcome from the moment we arrived.

The combination of the wildlife, luxury, and genuine warmth of the staff made us feel truly at home. The rooms were very clean and well kept, far enough from each other that it felt incredibly private and perfect for a romantic getaway. This was one of the most memorable parts of our honeymoon, and we cannot wait to return in the near future.

reviews.author: John Tolliver
reviews.text: We spent 3 nights/ 4 days in this camp, And it was truly stunning. I love the little things. Like a welcome note, personalized welcoming you to the camp, and coming back after an excursion and finding a hot bath already drawn. Waiting for someone to sit in it. The people and the food were wonderful, I'm a picky eater and they always had something that was delicious for me. This was the last stop on our tour and was so glad it ended. Was such splendor and fun. Highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Mino Chkachka
reviews.text:
Very cosy camp in Masai Mara. Facilities are great with super professional staff!
Very well positioned to go watch the Great Migration and more. Our guide (Nicholas) was very very knowledgeable and we witness incredible sceneries at each game drive!

reviews.author: Sneha Doshi
reviews.text:
This place can only be described as the first class of lodges!! From the airstrip pick up to the food to the service to the room and everything inbetween this place screams 7* luxury!!
Let me break it down:

We were gifted this place for two nights for our wedding and chose to time it so we celebrate our 2 year anniversary. We landed and were greeted with very friendly staff, mimosas and some snacks! Our luggage was put into the cars and we headed to the camp. Greeted by every single staff member, and introduced to the people looking after us! Shout out to Richard, Joel, Francis and our amazing Chef! We sat at our table for breakfast facing the open plains and started with coffee and tea plus a food tray with many jam options, granola, a green juice and orange juice a cheese plate! Then we ordered our main meal which was fabulous! After a great brekky we were shown our room which has everything you can think of… free laundry, a fully stocked bar with everything you need from high end spirits, wines, tea coffee etc. his and hers sinks, a bath tub, outdoor shower and so much more!

Our game drives were super, Lorna our driver drove far and wide to find us great sightings. The cars are very comfortable and come with a cooler filled with drinks! The only negative is for photographers this car isn’t ideal as it’s not low so those eye level photos are possible! It’s also not got much space to flee expensive lenses or bags safely. But otherwise really good! Our bush breakfasts were hot - literally she cooked us eggs in the wild! I’ve never had that anywhere else… and we weren’t close to the camp! The other thing I’d say, in April is mara triangle has very long grass so finding game is difficult! It’s not a flaw to the camp but for a regular mara visitor, at this time I would stay in the greater mara! But I’d come back and enjoy the camp and all it has to offer over again!

Our food was spectacular - the chef was so talented! Every meal is individually plated and served! And if you don’t like something just ask him and he cooks what you want!! I am leaving a few kgs heavier!

Our service staff - Joel, Francis Richard and the whole team, made this trip perfect! Every need every whim was catered to! And they remember the little things, sparking or still, wine preferences, coffee preferences so I felt like they knew us and were two steps ahead every time!

If you’re looking for the mara experience with a handful of luxury then this is where you need to come. Once in a lifetime experience and I couldn’t have asked for a better way to celebrate our anniversary! Thank you mingi sana to the team - we will see you again soon!

reviews.author: Sayanha Halder
reviews.text:
Our stay at Jambo Mara Safari Lodge was a very pleasant experience. The location is serene and beautifully set amidst nature, perfectly capturing the safari atmosphere. The rooms were comfortable and well-maintained, ideal for relaxing after game drives.
The staff were warm, welcoming, and always helpful, which really added to the overall experience. While there is room for improvement in some aspects, the stay itself was memorable and enjoyable. Considering the remote location, they truly do their best to ensure guests have a comfortable and smooth stay.
A great choice for anyone visiting the Mara.

reviews.author: Eliška
reviews.text: We spent 2 nights in this accommodation a month ago. The accommodation has an excellent location and is located near the main gate to the Maasai Mara National Reserve. The lodges are cozy, spacious and the wooden construction gives them simplicity. I appreciate the large and comfortable bed. There are two bedside tables in the room, one large table where you will find an electric kettle for making tea and coffee which are included. There were two bottles of water in the room upon arrival and new ones are replenished every day. There is a fan, a safe and a bar with hangers for storing clothes. You will also find slippers. The bathroom is simple and includes cosmetics and towels. The shower is large. Women will also appreciate a hairdryer. It is quite cold in the hut at night, so I recommend warmer clothes for sleeping and the same morning for a safari. They leave early. You can see baboons, monkeys and mongooses roaming around the lodges. I have to appreciate that the hotel also thinks about the entertainment of the guests and there is a ping pong table at the reception and a billiards table and mini football table on the upper floor. There is a beautiful covered terrace outside where you can enjoy a drink in the evening. There is also a beautiful swimming pool, which we didn't have time to use due to our schedule. The restaurant was fantastic. From breakfast, lunch to dinner. The only thing I would complain about is that there was no water available for meals, or at least we didn't notice it. The staff was amazing and kept asking us if everything was okay. They were constantly clearing the table and were really prompt. We really enjoyed our stay here and were very satisfied.

reviews.author: Suzana Serdar Lunic
reviews.text: We chose this lodge over budget accomodation for our Masai Mara hotel, it was much pricey but it is worth it. We got glass cottages, the environment is nice. This was best cleanliness and best good we had on our 4 days safari. Room is always clean, towels nice. For breakfast they have fresh pancakes and nutella which was a big plus, and for dinner you have chef and live cooking station, one night we got to choose from variety of noodles and other pasta. On arrival we got juice and wet towels which was nice after a long drive. You can hear wild animals during night but we felt safe. Beautiful terrace in the room, wish we could stay longer. The only downside are maasai baggage handlers who take your bag even you say no thanks, and carry it 10m away to room and wait for tip, that  annoyed me. Other than that, it was a perfect stay, but it should be like that for the amount of money you pay ;)

reviews.author: chan edwards
reviews.text:
DETAILED REVIEW. from UK travellers.

Atmosphere + rooms  is 10/10. Through the glass I saw deer, felt and heard nature. Waking up felt very refreshing but it is very cold. Please come dressed for a Uk winter as well as a Mediterranean summer at midday. Haha.

Location. Good enough. Close to park entrance but journey to and from depends on where the others in your group tour are staying as well.

Room. Best parts. Couple master bedroom is huge!. Shower is powerful. Lovely bathroom.  Slippers and kettle and cups are given. Lots of space for suitcases.

Room improvements. Needs better Cleaning.It’s clear that the rooms are tidyied down and well organised but not wiped with actual cleaning products. This was evident by the dust and dead flies in the exact same spot every day. Also maybe a room mat is needed as the condensation from the water on glass drips and collects into puddles on the wooden floor. Which over time, will make the room soggy and create mildew etc etc..more importantly  someone could easily slip and rightly sue!

Hotel service and dinner service. Otherwise EXCELLENT. The bald gentlemen managing the dining space is extremely good at his job, he really trys to make you comfortable.

Recommendation. YES!!!!!! Best accommodation for mid-budget. I’d come back again.

reviews.author: zły kogut
reviews.text:
Perfect location near Maasai Mara gate. Plenty of well-maintained space that lets you rest and relax in lovely natural surroundings. Generous, delicious meals three times a day!

Staff was incredibly friendly and helpful (shout-out to Dalton who sorted my Mombasa train tickets!).

This is a place worth staying at when you are planning your safari :)

name: Royal Mara Safari Lodge
address: Mara North Conservancy, Mara Rianta, Kenya

reviews.author: Sarah Musyimi
reviews.text:
Looking for luxury experience in the Masai Mara North Conservancy then this is the place.
All rooms face the Mara River and you will see hippos, crocodiles and other animals coming to drink water.
If lucky you might witness a crocodile grabbing his meal from tje thirsty animals
animals
Trip made easy by
Bamba Adventures and Events Ltd

reviews.author: Lia E.
reviews.text:
5 stars
Royal Mara Safari Lodge was a dream! The spacious, renovated tents offer complete privacy and comfort, all nestled along the serene Maasai River. Each day we enjoyed 4-course meals that rival fine dining—paired with stellar wine options and top-tier service. The raw, breathtaking exposure to nature was perfectly balanced with the reassuring presence of Maasai Warriors. Every detail was handled with world-class hospitality. Truly nothing left to be desired... except more time to stay.

reviews.author: RUTH BINGHAM
reviews.text:
The standard of accommodation and service here is outstanding.  The rooms were spacious, very comfortable and beautifully furnished.  Tony and his staff were so hospitable and made our stay truly memorable.  Such a stunning and exciting environment right next to the river where you can see and hear the hippos and view giraffes, zebras and Impalas literally from your lodge.

Do not hesitate to book the Royal Mara, I promise you will not be disappointed.

Thank you Tony and all the staff for making us so welcome.

reviews.author: Shweta Raman
reviews.text:
After checking out a ton of places, we finally decided on Royal Mara Safari Lodge in Mara North Conservancy. I’d seen some pics online, and honestly, the rooms looked a bit old-school compared to some of the fancier resorts. I was a bit nervous about what we’d find.

But as soon as we got there, everything was great! They welcomed us with some delicious apple juice, and the staff was super chill and friendly. They showed us to our room, and wow! It looked nothing like the photos I saw. They’ve totally revamped the place—it’s modern and stylish, just like the other resorts. Plus, we had an amazing view of the Mara River with crocs and hippos right outside!

The room was perfect—bright, airy, and super private. The balcony was huge, and we even had a jacuzzi!

There was this awesome guy assigned to us who showed us around and helped us get to the common areas. He even volunteered to take us out to see the hippos and crocs and gave us a full tour of the property.

Once we settled into our room, I was amazed by how much cabinet and storage space the room had. Since we were a couple traveling, having two wash basins was so amazing ! The storage for our suitcases, toiletries, and clothes was really well thought out, so we didn’t have to live out of our bags.

They had solar heaters outside each room for hot water, which was great. We did have a small issue with the hot water, but they changed our rooms right away! Plus, there were no mosquitoes, though we were careful not to open the canvas too much. The place was clean, and they tidied up every day while we were out on safari.

they provided a safe locker for our valuables and a 5-liter water can for drinking.

The food was really good overall, but the only downside was that they served the same soup every day. A bit repetitive ! But the chef was super accommodating if you didn’t like something on the menu.

My favorite dish had to be the Swahili-style pork curry they served on our last day—it was absolutely delicious!

Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and we’d definitely recommend Royal Mara Safari Lodge to anyone heading to Mara North. Everything from the service to the views made it special. Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.author: MAD
reviews.text: When you come to Masai Mara, come and stay in Royal Mara! What a place! What a service! So good! At this place look for Tony, Simon, Anna and Paul. They are absolutely the best you will see. The rooms are absolutely amazing. The service is extremely good. The people are very helpful and understanding esp Anna and Paul. They will accommodate all your requests. They are excellent and last but not the least we took the night safari with Simon and he knows exactly where to find what. He knows where to find the lions and leopards and elephants. The view of the hotel is insanely too good. It overlooks the Mara river filled with hippos and crocodiles. We got to see a feast of the crocodiles over a hippo. The cool breeze of Kenya along with the sweet smell of nature will make you fall in love with this place.

name: Mara Triangle
editorial_summary: Less-traveled section of the Maasai Mara reserve with abundant big game, a safari lodge & a camp.

reviews.author: Graeme Holroyd
reviews.text: What can you say about the Masai Mara triangle. So much wildlife. Easy to get around on good quality roads and tracks. It is very expensive for no residents at $200 usd a day but we'll worth it.

reviews.author: Wade Bricknell
reviews.text:
Feb 2025: such a special place.
Links to the Serengeti in Tanzania with the great Wildebeest & Zebra migration.
You can see the big 5 here and get pretty close to the animals.
But follow the rules, the game rangers are strict to ensure the well being of the animals.

reviews.author: Dominic
reviews.text: Amazing experience with spectacular wildlife. Highly recommended. We were here for 2 1/2 days and saw pretty much every species with the exception of the elusive leopard and cheetah. At least this warrants an excuse to come back! There were no challenges navigating with the guide during the wet season and it was possible to avoid any showers by driving the other way.

reviews.author: Varun Arora
reviews.text: The best safari experience in Africa because its just the right size so you dont end up driving around for hours in search of animals. And neither is it too short that it seems like a zoo. The rangers are helpful and the drivers and guides are knowledgeable. Seems like the drivers talk to each other via radio to share information about where the animals are. There are a couple of Masaai villages right outside where you can have a look masaai culture from close quarters. You can find lots of lions cheetahs leopards other smaller cats jackals, as well as hyenas apart from elephants buffalo and the others

reviews.author: Oliver K
reviews.text:
The Mara Triangle is a very interesting plateau of 510 sq. kilometers, about one third of Masai Mara National Reserve.
This is the area where the Great Migration takes place. You will also see in normal time herds of animals - wildbeests, zebras, buffalos. antilopes, giraffes...
You are guaranteed to see animals in any period of the year and this, 5 minutes after you have passed the Oloololo Gate.

name: Mahali Mzuri
address: Motorogi Conservancy, Masai Mara, C14, Kenya
editorial_summary: Sophisticated all-inclusive lodge offering a restaurant, an infinity pool & a spa, plus game drives.

reviews.author: Rich Del Monte
reviews.text: Absolutely phenomenal experience! Wonderful staff and the game drives were unforgettable! On-site spa services, a pool, open bar, even a clinic in case you're sick. Such a wonderful place and so sad to leave! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Alexandra Marvar
reviews.text:
Incredibly special, unforgettable stay. Incredibly warm and personal service, great staff. John Kaelo is a talented guide and a wonderful person. Sundowners in the bush super cool. This is a five star property with great views, great game drives, so many animals even in off season.

As for the space - Entirely renovated just this year and the spacious, air conditioned rooms (tents), with their private balconies, are comfortable and cool. Bar very nice. We saw elephants right from our balcony. Try everything Chef Eddie makes and don't miss the chance to get his cookbooks from the on-property shop.

reviews.author: Elena Loghin
reviews.text:
Our stay at Mahali Mzuri was exceptional in every way. The lodge has a wonderful family atmosphere that immediately makes you feel welcome and cared for. The team goes above and beyond to create a warm, home-like environment while still maintaining the highest standards of comfort and service.

One of the absolute highlights of our visit was our safari guide, Betty. Her knowledge, professionalism, and incredible spotting skills transformed each game drive into an unforgettable adventure. Betty not only showed us an amazing variety of wildlife but also took the time to explain behaviors, habitats, and conservation efforts in a way that was both fascinating and engaging. Her warmth and enthusiasm truly made our experience special.
Also, special thanks to the trainee guide, Elvis, who share with us wonderful Masai stories.
Mahali Mzuri offers a perfect blend of luxury, personal connection, and world-class guiding. Thanks to the entire team for making our stay so memorable. We cannot wait to return!  Elena & Simona

reviews.author: Brittany Bartolome
reviews.text:
Our one-year wedding anniversary trip to Mahali Mzuri was nothing short of magical. Beyond the breathtaking views and incredible wildlife, we were so moved by the camp's deep commitment to sustainable tourism and the well-being of the local Maasai community. This isn't just a luxury safari; it's a model for responsible travel that truly resonates with us.

From the moment we arrived, we noticed how genuinely happy and proud every employee was. It was so important to my husband and I to choose a place that values its people, and it's clear why Mahali Mzuri is the camp everyone in the community strives to work at. The fact that the entire staff is Maasai speaks volumes about their commitment to supporting and empowering the local villages.

The camp itself is stunning, with the recent renovations bringing a new level of comfort and elegance. The air conditioning was a welcome luxury (not typical for camps in the Mara), especially as we were celebrating in the heat of the day, and the heated pool was a perfect place to unwind. We also loved seeing the smaller details, from the organic garden that supplies the kitchen to the focus on reducing their environmental footprint.

The staff went above and beyond to make our anniversary special. They surprised us with a private bush dinner under the starry African sky—the Milky Way was absolutely incredible. Later, they presented us with a delicious cake and a beautiful Maasai dance to celebrate. Their generosity and thoughtfulness made our anniversary an experience we will cherish forever.

The food was exceptional, easily rivaling high-end restaurants at hotels in the States. Chef Eddie makes his breads on site and I’m impressed with his range and skill in the kitchen. And a huge thank you to Dennis for his masterful drinks, especially his espresso martinis, which were honestly better than any I've had in New York City.

Lastly, we have to highly recommend our guide, John. His knowledge of the Olare Motorogi Conservancy is phenomenal. He has a gift for anticipating animal movements and a quiet passion for wildlife that is contagious. Within 24 hours of arriving at Mahali, we had already checked off the Big 5 on our list (including a pride finishing off a water buffalo). After our incredible time with him, we moved on to another camp (Entim) in the Mara Reserve and were disappointed by the contrast in guiding quality. John truly set a standard that will be hard to beat.

Mahali Mzuri is more than a luxury getaway; it’s a place that makes a real, positive impact. We can't wait to return.

reviews.author: Jayesh Ravindranath
reviews.text:
Mahali Mzuri is an extraordinary resort. Super comfort, a fabulous team of people to take care of you, led by their ever smiling & caring managed Marianna.

Add to that their stunning location. Just on the ridge of the valley.. So you get to see the wildlife just below the deck & balcony of your tent.
Finally, their guides who take you on the drives into the Mara are all very knowledgeable, proficient and very friendly & helpful.

Would definitely recommend MM to anyone who wants a luxurious stay in the Mara. 👍 🙂

name: Emboo
address: Maasai Mara National Reserve, Masai Mara, Kenya

reviews.author: Himkar Dubey
reviews.text:
Emboo River Camp is a hidden gem that feels like home in the heart of the jungle. Surrounded by the untouched beauty of the Masai Mara, the camp offers a serene escape where giraffes gracefully pass by, hippos splash in the river, elephants roam nearby, and crocodiles bask along the banks. Despite being immersed in the wild, we felt completely safe and at peace throughout our stay.

What truly sets Emboo apart is its world-class hospitality. Manager Pablo and his exceptional team — Edwin, Rhonda, Brenda, Nelson and Priscilla — welcomed us with warmth and made us feel genuinely cared for every step of the way. Their attention to detail and heartfelt service created an unforgettable experience.

The highlight of our stay was my son’s birthday celebration, beautifully organized right in the middle of the jungle. From the cake to the amenities, it was a magical moment that we’ll cherish forever. It was the perfect personal touch—an experience that turned a great trip into an extraordinary one.

Emboo River Camp isn’t just a safari destination; it’s a place where memories are made.

reviews.author: Ivan Fedorov
reviews.text:
From the very first moment, we were warmly welcomed by Valery and her amazing team. We stayed in a beautifully designed, cozy room (everything inside was chosen with care and filled with comfort)

The atmosphere at Emboo is magical: peaceful nature, evenings around the fire on soft poufs under the stars, delicious meals, and a deep connection to the  nature.

We would especially like to thank:
Felix, our safari guide — calm, deeply experienced, and one of the best in his field. He made every game drive feel personal and insightful.

Tobin, the photographer, full of passion and soul. Every photo he took captured something deeper than just an image.

Rhoda, who looked after us during every breakfast, lunch, and dinner with incredible kindness and attention.

And Pedro, who always brought a smile, kindness, and genuine care. he made us feel truly welcomed.

The little things made, like hot water bottles waiting in our room at night and even placed in the safari jeep for those chilly early drives. These thoughtful touches left a lasting impression.

The entire team at Emboo is united by true hospitality, care for nature, and love for what they do.

We’re already home, but our hearts are still with you at Emboo.

Wishing the camp and its creators continued joy and prosperity

reviews.author: Frederik Vanderhoeven
reviews.text:
This is our fifth time here, and it just keeps getting better and better!

- The brand-new, beautiful tents are now built on stilts.
- They’re so spacious—we could easily stay here with the entire family.
- The new camp manager is amazing: always discreetly present and double-checking every detail.
- There’s a new pool with a real sundeck offering a stunning view of the river.
- The “restaurant” feels like a cozy living room, complete with a special fireplace where I easily dozed off.
- Our kids loved the safari bingo, games and creating masai neckless so much !!!
- The food is incredibly fresh, with vegetables straight from their own garden. The lovely chef even came to check on us twice a day!
- Our driver-guide Sylvester was waiting for us—and still remembered where we spotted the leopard five years ago. Another unforgettable day!
- The 100% off-the-grid concept remains so special. No car engine noise during the safari—just perfect.
- This camp was flooded exactly one year ago, and to see it come back even better is truly inspiring.

Well done, everyone! I recommend Emboo River Camp to the whole world.

reviews.author: Tessa Lavdiotis
reviews.text:
We stayed at Emboo for a family reunion, and it truly exceeded our expectations. Having lived in Kenya for a long time and experienced many different camps, we can confidently say that Emboo is something special. As a fully sustainable camp, Emboo offers a unique experience—but what impressed us most was that it never compromised on luxury. The team’s attention to detail was unmatched, ensuring that every moment felt thoughtful and personal. A huge shoutout to Daniel, our guide, whose skill and warmth made our game drives unforgettable.
From surprise activities to pizza in the bush and engaging experiences for our young children, the team went above and beyond to make us feel special. We cannot wait to return!

reviews.author: Sindy P
reviews.text: Spent here 3 nights, with 3 kids. Thry put together 2 tents for our convenience. Amazing view to a river with all types of animals. Staff was so impressive, the waiters are so kind and you get escorted to your room every right. If you dont like camping like me, these luxury tents will suit you perfectly. Food was spectacular and they made sure it was customaized to your liking, extremely helpful for my 3 kids. They wash your clothing daily as well. This is paradise, so exciting to come back, we were literally praying for the flight to get canceled so we could stay at least one more night .

name: Fairmont Mara Safari Club
address: Masai Mara National Reserve, AITONG, Kenya
editorial_summary: Elegant, tented quarters with viewing decks in a refined lodge offering dining & game drives.

reviews.author: Georgia Millie
reviews.text:
The most special place on earth. This was my second time visiting the Fairmont Mara as I bought my partner to celebrate his 30th Birthday! The whole stay was nothing short of exceptional, with memories made to last a lifetime. The staff are beyond incredible and we wish to express our appreciation to all for how wonderful they looked after us and for the special touches for my partners birthday!

We would like to give a special appreciation to Josphat our game driver, who has been my game driver for both stays and is now a very good friend! Also to Moses who is exceptional at what he does and never fails to bring a smile to your face. David for his amazing drinks behind the bar. Adan for the housekeeping of our room, he made a beautiful design for my partners birthday which was so special. Resian & Eddie on front of house were so lovely and kept us well informed of changes to our departure flights. George & Elizabeth on security made us smile every day as we left for our game drives. Also appreciation to Nancy and Mary for making a special effort towards making sure we had a wonderful stay.

We cannot wait to come back again one day, we will miss this place and the staff incredibly!

reviews.author: Becky Pedersen
reviews.text: I would give more then 5 stars if I could! the Fairmont Mara safari club was the most amazing place I have ever been to! Amazing game rides, saw all the big 5 animals, and our guide Henry was the absolute BEST!!! The food was immaculate with so many yummy options, we were totally stuffed after every meal because we had to try it all (and go back for seconds)! The rooms were incredible!! They are absolutely beautiful and cozy, and the people in charge of the rooms were the sweetest people, and so helpful and accommodating, they truly want you to have the best experience! Every worker went above and beyond to make sure you had everything you needed (or didn't even know you needed), and they were all so friendly and kind! I cannot recommend this place enough, it was the best experience, and I hope to go back!

reviews.author: Hemant Jain
reviews.text:
1. Hospitality wise, great. Amazing location and very supportive staff.
2. Booking experience was bad to say the least. We had booked 4 rooms using fora travel advisors well in advance in the month of April. We were informed 20 days before the travel dats that fora bookings don't accept payment by points. This came as a surprise. We had to change bookings just to get a reasonable price. We lost on 100 usd credit which was ensured with fora. When we visited the property last week, we met an individual who told us he had a similar FORA booking and he was allowed to pay by points. This left a feeling of distrust and discrimination. You trust a brand to have consistent policy and also non discriminatory approach. It has been a negative experience as far as booking is concerned. We will be more careful next time and also ask fellow travellers to not trust anything that is told to you blindly. The company can revise any policy anytime and leave customers in chaps and also give preferential treatment to anybody unfairly.
Overall, a great property and people, but very bad booking experience and company policies.

reviews.author: jim doss
reviews.text: We stayed at the resort for 6 nights, two with a tour group and four independently. The staff are amazing! We feel like part of a special African family. The chef and culinary team are exceptional and the property is immaculate. Fairmont is really hard to beat!

reviews.author: Liz White
reviews.text: We absolutely loved our stay here. The staff were among the friendliest and most welcoming we’ve ever encountered. The tents were luxurious, the food selection plentiful, and the setting simply perfect. Our guide, Dominic, was outstanding; extremely knowledgeable and instrumental in helping us experience some unforgettable wildlife encounters. We spent five days with him, and his perfectly tailored schedule made our trip exceptional. We highly recommend him to anyone visiting Fairmont Mara.

name: Maasai Mara National Reserve
editorial_summary: Savanna renowned for its resident & migratory wildlife, including the “big 5” game animals.

reviews.author: Archana Singh
reviews.text: Whether you are a wildlife lover or just starting off, the Maasai Mara will make you fall in love with it. It's the easiest to reach from India, and super easy to spot wildlife. I stayed at Lemek Conservancy and absolutely loved exploring the park and around.

reviews.author: Peter T.
reviews.text: Kenya’s best national reserve!!! We saw everything we would have possibly hoped for. Lions, Leopards, Elephants, Giraffes, Hyena. Als the landscape is very beautiful!

reviews.author: Ivan Boljat
reviews.text: Amazing experience. We loved it so much. Saw so many animals in their natural habitat. On the long day, we just drove around for hours and found elephants and many other animals. Breathtaking

reviews.author: Girija Rajendran
reviews.text:
It is one of the best places to visit. From the moment we entered the park, we were amazed by the stunning landscape, the wide variety of animals roaming close to us, and the vast open sky—it felt like a scene straight out of a documentary. The entrance fee is high for foreign visitors, but the experience is truly worth it.
We went on game drives during sunrise and evening. The driver played a dual role as both driver and guide. He was very knowledgeable, knew the names and behaviors of the animals, and took us to the right spots at the right time. The Land Cruiser was very comfortable for the bumpy roads. We even witnessed a group of lions hunting a buffalo—an unforgettable moment.
Some drivers did not follow the rules and got too close to the animals. During lion hunting time, drivers called others through walkie-talkies, causing many vehicles to rush to the spot, which clearly disturbed them. Hot air balloons were also quite frequent.
We didn’t see rhinos in this park, though we had seen many in another park. We stayed inside the park, and hearing the hippos at night was thrilling. The memories we made here will stay with us forever.

reviews.author: Bob Ferguson
reviews.text:
I’m Australian and this place left a mark on me. The Maasai Mara is wide, open country that reminds me of parts of inland Australia, long horizons, big skies, and a sense that the land has been there forever and will carry on long after we are gone. It felt familiar in the bones, even though the animals are completely different.

Seeing the wildlife out in the open like that is something else. Lions resting in the grass like old hands who know they belong there. Wildebeest moving across the plains in numbers you struggle to wrap your head around. Giraffes slow and steady, same calm feeling you get watching stock drift across a paddock back home. Nothing felt rushed or forced, it all unfolded in its own time.

What I appreciated most was the scale and the quiet. When the engines cut and the wind moves through the grass, it has the same stillness you find in remote parts of Australia. No noise, no nonsense, only land and life doing what it has always done.

At my age, you measure places by how they make you feel, not by photos or hype. The Maasai Mara felt honest, powerful, and humbling. I’m grateful I saw it while I still could

reviews.author: Valerie Amanda
reviews.text: We had the most amazing time at Cottar’s. Mako was a very knowledgeable guide, and we had spectacular service from everyone on the camp (Richard, William to name a few!). We saw lions, cheetah, giraffes, elephants, zebras and more. Even had zebras near the camp fire and monkeys near our tent. The level of personalization and service is truly unmatched. The tents are very comfortable (I’m not a camper at all). The food was also so delicious, they were great about dietary restrictions and had a good array of foods. I would highly recommend coming here!

reviews.author: Merrill Blake
reviews.text:
We had an amazing time at Cottars 1920. From our pickup on the airstrip to our departure they treated us like royalty. The meals, the chaperones, the staff & the guides made sure we were comfortable & taken care of every step of the way. Our guide Mako,along with gnotiek,  was wonderful, house butler Richard anticipated our every need & our waiter William quickly learned our favorites. We felt pampered & taken care of in our wilderness paradise.
Of of course we were there for Arie, Marco and his spotter helped us to see a cheetah and her cubs, many lions & cubs & ooohhh the elephants & girafes. Zebras, buffalo, warthogs, impalas … the list goes on. You will not be disappointed with your stay at Cotters.

reviews.author: Mark Hopton
reviews.text:
I’m slightly lost for words for this review as our trip to Cottars isn’t comparable to any other we’ve ever done.
It’s a very very special place.
The location couldn’t be more perfect, the food is world class, the serenity and peace is like nothing I’ve ever witnessed before and the bush villa we rented was perfect.
But above all of this was the wildlife and the amazing people who gave us a glimpse into another world - a very humbling and beautiful experience which has had a profound impact on my family.

Thank you to all the staff who looked after us with such dedication and thank you to our amazing guides Charity and Letura and their talented spotters.

reviews.author: Ruchika Goel
reviews.text:
I had visited Cottars to celebrate my 50th Birthday with my family. After a lot of survey on which resort to book. I put my trust in Cottars given its passion towards their work.
Cottars was beyond my expectations.
A lot of people go to Mara. But doing the game drives in their conservancy with an intelligent and knowledgeable guide, DOUG. It is magical. Their USP is that there aren’t 100 Jeeps causing a traffic jam to see 3 tigers. And take photos.

Doug takes you close to the animals and you experience their moods, behavior and activities for a good amount of time which is uninterrupted by 100 others.
The food at Cottars is more than outstanding. The spa therapist are brilliant. I have never had a better massage. The team treats you like you’re in your own home. You ask and it’s there. And they are always smiling. They genuinely want you to have a good time and love the experience.
Words cannot do justice to Cottars !!!

I cannot thank you enough for celebrating my birthday better than I ever imagined.

reviews.author: T Wolf
reviews.text: What a fantastic experience at Cottar's—the setting and views are second to none; all the staff was incredibly friendly, including our fabulous waiter Josphat; the food absolutely delicious and easily catered to our vegetarian preferences; and our guide Mako and spotter Palmyria were outstanding—friendly and personable, a great driver, and with an encyclopedic knowledge of the wildlife, nature and local environment. We were also impressed with Cottar's commitment to conservation and community-based tourism supporting the local Masai communities. Thank you for a magical experience!

reviews.author: Reva Tabe
reviews.text:
Our stay at Isharat Hotel was truly amazing. The service, food, and hospitality made us feel like part of the Ishara family, not just guests.
A big thank you to Mr. Cavin for the wonderful safari and guidance, Ms. Helen for her warm restaurant service and Mathew for his lovely hospitality. Special thanks to Isac for the delicious food- especially the cookies and banana cake, which we will surely miss when we return to India! And Judi, thank you for keeping my son happily engaged with fun activities.
A beautiful place with beautiful people-highly recommended! 🌿✨

“If anyone truly wants to experience heaven on earth, Ishara is the place to be.”

reviews.author: Mbugby
reviews.text: Ishara was one the most magical experiences of my life. From the moment you arrive you are made to feel very special. The staff greet you with such warmth, love and enthusiasm and continues throughout your stay making you feel like part of the family. The facilities and experiences Ishara have to offer are quite simply breathtaking. From having breakfasts in the bush whilst out on game drives to coming back to the luxury spa facilities and a beautiful room. To end i want to say the culinary experience was exceptional. Every dish i had throughout my stay was of the highest quality from taste to presentation. If you are reading this i would highly recommend you go experience this for yourself. You will not regret. Thank me later.

reviews.author: Giulia Iovino
reviews.text:
Ishara was, without a doubt, one of the most magical and unforgettable experiences of our lives — and the perfect place to celebrate our honeymoon. From the very moment we arrived, we were made to feel truly special. The warmth, kindness, and genuine enthusiasm of the staff are extraordinary and remain constant throughout the entire stay, making you feel not like a guest, but like part of a family.

Every aspect of Ishara exceeded our expectations. The setting is breathtaking, the facilities are stunning, and the experiences offered are nothing short of exceptional. From unforgettable bush breakfasts and sunset apéros during game drives to returning to our beautifully designed room, every moment felt perfectly curated and deeply memorable.

The culinary experience deserves special recognition — it was absolutely outstanding. Every single dish was fantastic, both in flavor and presentation, and consistently of the highest quality. Dining at Ishara was an experience in itself.

Above all, we want to extend our deepest thanks to the incredible team who made our time in the Masai Mara — and our honeymoon — so extraordinarily special and unforgettable. A heartfelt thank you to Paul, Dalton, Imara, Stanley, and Dani, as well as the entire Ishara team, for your care, passion, and attention to every detail.

We already miss this magical place more than we can say. We cannot recommend Ishara highly enough — if you are considering visiting, do not hesitate. It is an experience you will cherish forever.

Thank you once again from the bottom of our hearts — we will treasure these memories forever and cannot wait to return.

Giulia & Edoardo

reviews.author: Brooke Coleman
reviews.text: My husband and I came here on our honeymoon on the 5 night package and could not have been more happy with our stay. Life changing! Everything about Ishara is magical. Especially the people that work there. They take hospitality to a whole new level. The facilities are luxurious and you are made to feel right at home. I pray we can come back again one day with our kids. One of my favorite things was the Cannon Photography studio and how you could use their professional cameras on drives! You leave with amazing photos! Something that made Ishara stand out to me when choosing a place to book were the experiences they offered. Breakfast out in the bush, professional photo session of us out on safari, a night in the star bed.. and more. I cant remember last time I was this excited about a place. It doesn't happen often that I want to return to the same place, but Ishara I would return to over and over again. Truly exceptional.

reviews.author: jill hersh
reviews.text: J&J from San Francisco:  My husband and I were at Ishara in September of this year.  We have traveled all over and stayed in some of the "great" hotels of the world.  This experience surpassed our previous experiences with hotels or resorts in every way.  The setting is extraordinary and beautiful, set into the lush natural environment along a river.  The accommodations are elegant and beyond comfortable, with a clever combination of being inside with exposure to the beautiful outdoors.  The chef is fabulous and the bar is an amazing glass composite of the animal life in the Mara.  A brief questionnaire before our arrival enabled them, to our surprise, to have my husband's favorite vodka at the bar and my daily dark chocolate in our room.  Our guide, Peter, was outstanding and the coordination between his guidance and driving and amazing knowledge with the lodge's staff provided us with a surprise sunrise breakfast in the bush and another surprise pre-dinner drink/appetizer in the bush as the sun set.  Our trips into the bush to see animals were comfortable and the vehicle had no blind spots along with refreshments and, or course, our guide, Peter.  The serenity of our safari trips into the bush and during our stay at the lodge created such a special experience that my vocabulary is not sufficient.  Our Masai escorts to and from the lodge areas were interesting and really quite beautiful in their shoukas.  From the moment we got off of our plane and were greeted by Peter to our meeting at the center of the lodge with elderberry tea to our lovely accommodations - our experience was really quite exquisite!  We hated to leave!  I would give Ishara more than 5 starts if more were available!  Thanks to everyone.

name: Mara Intrepids Tented Camp
editorial_summary: Warmly furnished tents with 4-poster beds in a relaxed lodge offering free meals & game drives.

reviews.author: Gael 804
reviews.text:
We had a great safari experience with the Mara intrépides.
It’s location is incredible, 2minutes drive from the airstrip, many giraffes, elephants very close.
We could see hippos, baboons and mangoes from our room.
Every morning the giraffes were welcoming us when going out for game drive. We saw cheetah 500m from the camp gate eating its breakfast.
Our safari guide, Samson, was amazing, he loves nature and animals and he was so good to find out animals for us.
We stayed only 2 nights and saw lions feeding, hunting with their cubs, cheetah 3 times, and even twice leopard and leopard-cub.
Swanson was waving to us when we took-off , flying back to Nairobi.

The tent are very beautiful, our tent attendant Samuel was very attentive. Pauline at the restaurant was very kind to us and the food was good with nicely dressed plates.

reviews.author: Rikard Uddström
reviews.text:
Absolutely fantastic stay at Mara Intrepids. Although we don’t have any other Kenya safari experience to compare with, Mara Intrepids clearly exceeded all our expectations.
The staff is amazing, all of them. From the welcoming, to the reception, restaurant, bar, house keeping, exit gate, naturalist, guides etc.
Food was rich, with a variety to choose from for every meal. The tents are comfortable, luxury, and cosy.
We had a fantastic guide in Ezekiel, and we got to see more wildlife than could be expected. We also appreciated the visit to a nearby Masai village.
We would recommend to everyone that has the opportunity, to visit this place and part of the world.

reviews.author: Jacqueline Abilla
reviews.text:
Mara Intrepids – Exceptional Stay

We had a wonderful stay at Mara Intrepids and were truly impressed by the outstanding customer service. On arrival we were welcomed by Massai dancers and offered a glass of fresh fruit.

A special thank you to Yvonne, our server, who was warm, attentive, and consistently excellent, and Simon, our guide, whose deep knowledge of the Mara made our game drives unforgettable. Thanks to him, we were fortunate to see four of the Big Five during our stay. Only animal we did not see was the rhino.

Our luxury tent was modern, well-appointed, and very comfortable, with a private patio and hot water for showers, overlooking the Talek River, which added to the overall experience. On arrival we found a bottle of wine, fruits and chocolate waiting for us.

The food was delicious, with every meal thoughtfully prepared and beautifully presented. Only thing with the food was that they need to change up the daily option of roasted potatoes with every meal.

Cons: no entertainment offered. There was a 30 minute talk in the evenings before dinner by Debbie which wad informative. . There was  no music at all throughout the hotel. Some of the servers never smiled.

Overall, an exceptional blend of comfort, service, and authentic safari experience. Thr General Manager Geoffrey was also very kind and professional. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Paul Thomas
reviews.text:
Excellent tented camp right on the river. Lovely facilities including a beautiful swimming pool.
Good food, mainly a la carte, which is one reason we chose it as we a not a fan of buffets.
As always super staff.
Good game drives saw so much.
Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Nabeela Moosani Khan
reviews.text: Exceptional service, exceptional property, exceptional hospitality. We were here for 5 days and we were taken care off like never before. Our safari guide Mr. Silas was so experienced that we had the best experience ever. Other staff such as Lusciana, Dinah, Daisy and John were the ones who made our stay so so memorable ❤️ we cannot thank them enough

name: Saruni Mara
address: Mara North Conservancy Masai Mara, Kenya

reviews.author: Jayesh Patil
reviews.text:
Our 3-night stay at Saruni Mara in the Mara North conservancy was a unique and memorable experience. The tent was beautifully appointed and very comfortable. The most amazing feature was the direct proximity to the forest - we had wild animals grazing right outside our tent on the lawn next to the porch, which was breathtaking.

The conservancy experience requires more caution, especially with children who need to be accompanied by adults at all times. Armed guards escorted us between tents and common areas after dark, which added to the sense of adventure while ensuring safety.

The dining is different from a buffet-style lodge - it's a limited, three-course meal that you order. The food was fresh and quite good. Ruben deserves special mention for taking excellent care of us during all meal times. David, our guide during this portion, was outstanding and made our experience truly special.

We were fortunate to have a dedicated safari vehicle allocated to us, which was a blessing as we could manage our timings, food, and activities independently. The night safaris here were particularly memorable - hearing lions roaring in the darkness was unforgettable. Overall, a superb experience for those seeking a more intimate wildlife encounter.

reviews.author: Charles McGurin
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at the lodge and an unforgettable experience on safari with Kampala and James. Nothing was too much trouble for the team and the level of attention to detail that the staff went to in looking after us was exceptional. I believe that Duncan, Reuben, Kampala and James and the Mara animals will never be forgotten by my wife and I. This is an amazing experience that I would strongly recommend to anyone interested in the African conservancy programme.

reviews.author: Luke Pitts
reviews.text: We were self-camping, trying to get to Mara Triangle when we ran out of daylight. We made an emergency stop at Saruni and Christine and the staff treated us so well in our time of need! They took hours out of their evening to get us set up, calling around to see where we could go which was ultimately on the property of one of their Masai guides. We could not be more grateful. Martin and Daniel kept a fire going all night and kept us safe. Then they took us on a great safari in the morning. Christine is the manager of the staff and she had every right to tell us to get lost, but instead she took us in and made sure we had a safe place to stay. She is a genuinely wonderful person and I'm sure guests of Saruni Mara will benefit greatly by her and her staff's hospitality. Even though we didn't stay on the property, I think our experience helps show who the Saruni Mara staff really are at heart.

reviews.author: Scot
reviews.text: I've been on 4 safaris.  Masai Mara is an amazing location.  This resort nearly ruined the trip.  I can't think of a positive thing to say about the place.  And way overpriced.  Poor communication and service.  Cold showers.  Bland food.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Amey
reviews.text: We had the most brilliant time at this gorgeous lodge. The team at the lodge couldn’t have been more welcoming and accommodating. Christine and James ensured everything ran smoothly for us. Reuben was charming, funny and helpful - he made every meal a really delightful experience and we enjoyed getting to know him. Our guide, Dickson, was second to none! He went above and beyond to give us a fantastic experience and memorable encounters with wildlife. He was incredibly knowledgable. A highlight was a morning bush walk, plus seeing some gorgeous tiny cubs. A great place to explore Lemek and Mara North from.

reviews.author: Iuniu Stef
reviews.text: I have enjoyed the hospitality of the camp for 4 night stay I have organized to enjoy a safari with my father. And it was, to all intents and purposes, truly memorable. I rarely give the full score but in this case I cannot really think of anything that went bad during the stay or things that the staff could have made to improve the experience. Well, the hippopotamuses in the river adjacent to our room were loud at night but this is not really something the staff could have controlled. To give a few random examples: we have been able to have our laundry done, properly and timely, in the middle of the savanna; the morning yogurt and fruit salad were unbelievably fresh; the bathtub in the tent came with very nice bath salts and we had a gym bike on the tent veranda.

reviews.author: makutiroofing designs
reviews.text:
Fantastic wildlife sightings, especially predators.
Great for: Wildlife photographers, luxury seekers.

reviews.author: Fay C
reviews.text:
Absolutely the best camp we have stayed in. Service is truly top notch! Everyone in the camp truly made us feel at home. Our waiter, William, was the friendliest and always taught us Swahili during our meal time. Food was absolutely delicious, and there were always a lot of options. We were always well-fed even during the game drives.

Our guide, Malingi, was the best—very knowledgeable, always eager to show us the best wildlife and spend quality time with the animals. He knew that we wanted to take good photographs so he always made sure the car was at the prime position. Wildlife spotting was incredible!

The interiors are absolutely tasteful and luxurious. The tent itself is very spacious and there is attention to detail in every aspect—there were different pillows to choose from based on preference, a calming bed spray, a hot compress to keep the bed warm.

reviews.author: Er Fr
reviews.text:
Our trip was perfectly organised by Rustom @ Safari Nut. The itinerary was very carefully drafted for our family and Rustom work did not stop in organising the trip, but was always on during our stay, making sure that everything was dealt safely, smoothly and always professionally. Our only regret is that we have worked with SafariNut only recently.
He suggested to experience the Masai Mara like never before  staying at the Jahazi Suite at Mara Plains. It was our third time in the Mara (always with Safari Nut) and Being the camp a Relais & Chateaux our expectations were quite high from the beginning.
The camp and the team truly exceeded our expectations. Mara Plains is a beautiful camp immersed in the vegetation of the savanna and our words can hardly do justice to its beauty and elegance. Probably one of the best properties in the African continent.
The service was truly impeccable and we enjoyed every moment of our staying.  The entire team was very friendly expecially with our kids.
The quality of the meals and cocktails is at Michelin star level and Rolex that looked after us made memorable cocktails for the entire family.
The camp positioning in the hearth of the conservancy was such that wild life was all around us, from Hippo and crocodiles in the stream that surrounds the Camp to lions and all the big fives just few steps outside.
Our staying was truly as good as it gets and we cannot wait to return.

reviews.author: Kelsey Gwinn
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this place! Shoutout to Catherine, Cate, Malingi, Rolex, Weldon, David, and everyone else whose name I forgot! The rooms are beautiful. The wildlife viewing was second to none (baby hyenas, hyena kills, jackal kills, cheetah, lions... the list goes on). The food was incredible (seriously, they could have their own eating safari). The staff is so incredibly kind and thoughtful. The only complaint I have is that it's about 20 hours of flying time away from me :( Highly recommend!

name: COMFY INN HOTEL ELDORET
address: C.B.D, Comfy Inn Eldoret, Ronald Ngala St, Eldoret, Kenya
editorial_summary: Warm rooms with flat-screens in a casual hotel offering complimentary breakfast & a restaurant.

reviews.author: Lydia Nyaruai
reviews.text:
On the first day,I received very slow reception.
The main main issue for me was their rooms,there was black mold all over the bathroom,even after I changed rooms,I still encountered mold which actually made me sick,The bathrooms are not as clean,their towels too.
The breakfast was terrible and no varieties on the buffet.Menu for food is on the higher side.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Nyoike
reviews.text:
COMFY ✨️ ✨️.
Liked the clean and quiet rooms. Good service. My only(minor) issue was the food 😬

reviews.author: Erickoz Entertainment & Tech
reviews.text: Good service,close to the road and located in Eldoret CBD.

reviews.author: Peter Mumo Masya
reviews.text: Great place, helpful staff and loved the breakfast....

reviews.author: Coach Patrick
reviews.text:
Amazing hotel
The staf is very friendly
The price is cheap
The restaurant is very good

name: Boma Inn Eldoret
address: Elgon View Drive, Ramogi Dr, Eldoret, Kenya
editorial_summary: Unfussy quarters in a casual hotel offering a restaurant, a fitness centre & an outdoor pool.

reviews.author: Anita Omuga
reviews.text: It's a beautiful hotel, located in a serene area. Once you are checked in, you can access the spa at no extra fee. The compound is beautifully planned. The food is delicious , both a la carte and buffet and fairly priced. There's a nice pool, however, I didn't see a children's play area. The facility's washrooms are not wheelchair accessible.

reviews.author: Jules
reviews.text: Amazing location.  Tucked away in the heart of the exclusive and lush Elgon View neighborhood, Boma Inn is the place to come for attentive service, delicious food,  and unforgettable stays. Highly recommended for business breakfasts and business lunches.

reviews.author: John Paul Chacha
reviews.text:
Although Boma Inn is a small hotel and maybe not the newest or greatest, I found my stay there very comfortable and trouble-free.

Boma Inn is located in an upmarket neighbourhood of Eldoret, and the location is very quiet. While this means that there's some distance between you and amenities such as shopping malls, it is only about 2 kilometres away from town, so this isn't a big issue.

The facility includes a gym, steam room and sauna that are accessible to guests at no extra charge. The gym could use some upgrades and gender separation for some facilities, but it is generally okay otherwise. There's also a pool, but weather and time didn't allow me to use it.

The standard rooms have no air-conditioning, but Eldoret weather is cold enough for you not to notice this omission. A fan is provided though, but again, you won't use it.

Boma Inn provides a dental kit in the room. It's a small thing, but I've been to many hotels that are far more expensive that forget this minor detail. Kudos for this; it shows that Boma prioritizes the comfort of guests.

The staff are very helpful and friendly, and are always willing to go above and beyond to ensure guest comfort. If the management of Boma Inn is reading this, please let the waitress Mary know that her attention to detail is noted and appreciated.

Meals are excellent; the steak and soups in particular are pure perfection. They occasionally serve dinner a-la-carte and they are very generous in this regard; if it's cold, they'll keep the hot drinks coming -- speaking of which, their "dawa" is excellent.

Breakfast doesn’t include bacon, so you might miss this if you are a pork fan. Everything else is great though, and the masala tea really "slaps" (i.e. it's very good, for those not familiar with this expression). In general, breakfast is excellent.

Their rooms are generally comfortable and you'll get a good night's sleep. The shower water temperature is more than adequate and the soundproofing between rooms is excellent. The only concern I have in this regard is the number of towels; an extra towel would be nice, but I got the feeling that the staff will gladly provide extras if you ask.

There's a work area in the rooms with excellent views of the garden area (I've included photos of the same in this review). If you're travelling for business and would like to work on your laptop during the day, this space will serve you well.

In general, if you are looking for a midsized hotel in Eldoret that's comfortable, welcoming and has friendly staff, Boma Inn will serve you very well.

reviews.author: B Cecil
reviews.text:
Re moved over from the Eka Hotel because some issues with noise. The service at Boma is amazing. The rooms could use a slight upgrade, such as better pillows, softer mattress. TV is excellent for international news and movies. Location is quiet and serene. Pool is private and lovely.

One main issue is, while the gym is excellent for any gym buffs, there are nice dry and wet saunas, but they are coed. No designated times for women or men. You have to walk through the gym from the changing room to the saunas. Even if wearing my gym clothes, I have little interest in taking a sauna with a hairy mostly naked dude! The saunas are sketchy.

reviews.author: shekhar suman

name: Eka Hotel
address: Rupa’s Mall, West Wing, Malaba Rd, Eldoret, Kenya
editorial_summary: Straightforward rooms & suites in a relaxed hotel offering a rooftop pool, a gym & dining.

reviews.author: Allan Sawyer
reviews.text:
The Eka Hotel at Rupa Mall is truly an oasis in the desert. From the moment you arrive, the quality is evident—the rooms are genuinely five-star. The attention to detail is impressive, particularly the bathroom; the shower is one of the largest I’ve ever seen in a hotel, complete with a fantastic waterfall shower head that makes for a perfect start to the day.

For those who value wellness, the 8th-floor fitness facility is incredible and exceptionally well-equipped. Dining was also a highlight, with a diverse morning buffet and a menu that delivers delicious lunch and dinner options. Finally, the convenience of being attached to Rupa Mall cannot be overstated—having ample shopping and amenities right at your doorstep is a major plus. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Eldoret!

reviews.author: Karen Akena
reviews.text:
This experience was not in my bingo cards..wow wow wow, I absolutely loved my stay here.
The rooms are soo clean like extremely clean, I loved that.The bed was super comfy, I have never got such good deep sleep in such a long time. The curtains black out the lights.

I stayed on the 4th floor and they have as if a lobby in the middle, you must walk to your room at night because there is something so beautiful about that walk to your room in the night.It was magical.I loved the little detail of the light on your room door number haha it had me just smiling and grinning.

Guys, I rarely review but this is worth the share 100/10.

Oh another thing, their kitchen works 24hours, like how cool is that.

Then let me tell you , you get abit confused because the lobby is on 3rd floor to the hotel and then when you arrive,  its like a whole new world..😄

I will definately go back there to rest well for a longer duration. If you want to rest and rest well please say less and check in there.
For me , its as if I slept and left all my 2025 stress and the right boast I needed to start 2026 well rested...☺️

You guys at Eka hotel got me with the cleanliness, freshness of the rooms, hospitality.I am a happy customer.Guys if your thinking of going to Eldoret  just go stay there and thank me later.It was worth every penny. It ticked all my boxes and gave me peace of mind that made me enjoy my stay .. for me the hotel was serendipity🥰🥰.

reviews.author: Muzembi Alfayo
reviews.text: Im an all-time traveller. I had a wonderful stay at Eka Hotel Eldoret with my family, and the experience exceeded our expectations. The interior décor is beautifully done—modern, warm, and very welcoming. The rooms felt highly secure, which gave us great peace of mind as a family, and everything was well maintained and comfortable. For the quality of service, ambience, and overall experience, the hotel offers excellent value for money. reviews.text: If you looking for a great place to stay then this is the place, from the good ambience to the amazing food and services, i liked my stay here definately coming back

reviews.author: OnTay Johnson
reviews.text:
Loved the potential of this place but so many things ensured that I will never go back.
-First thing is the mosquitos in the room... I couldn't sleep.
-Room was decent but wifi wasn't good enough for me to work from.
-Service wasn't bad, especially when requesting food or eating at the rooftop bar but no one even mentioned the rooftop bar until the last night I was there.  The rooftop bar is nice though.
I like the location.  It's a great location.

Now the part that really ticked me off and was so disappointing:

So upon checking in, my card was accidentally charged twice (I assume it was an accident) because the attendant thought I needed a pin and instead of asking, just charged me twice.  No big deal, she was nice and apologetic but I've lived in Kenya enough that I told her, I need to make sure it's reversed and I'm not just told it will be for weeks.  I was promised it would be within the week.  I leave Eldoret and the next week, no one calls to notify me of what's going on, I had to call in.  I talk to a different attendant and she just pacifies me but I can tell she doesn't understand how annoying this is nor how unprofessional it is, she's kind of aloof about it.  They tell me it will be taken care of and that the manager isn't in.

Another week goes by.  No calls to me again as a follow and courtesy to show me they are taking care of this.  I have to call in and if I didn't, I wouldn't have heard from them.  This time the woman who accidentally double-charged me answers and I tell her I'll reverse the charge on my end if they don't rectify it.  I didn't wanna do that because the place is close to where I like to run and I'm willing to give it another try if they do what's right.  I wanted to see what type of business this was and the level of professionalism and honesty they had.  The manager hops on the line while I'm talking to her and starts asking me for my banking info so they can reverse it.  I tell him, there's no way I'm giving him my banking info.  Just by the impetuousness of his tone alone, not to mention it wasn't smart for a couple reasons.  He says he'll mpesa me the refund.

A day or so later I get a text message of him saying that I reversed the charges and I now owe them another 15k ksh.  I'm laughing at the audacity at this point but I wanna see how far this is going to go so I play ball.  I ask for proof as he says his bank notified him.  He said he can't provide me proof.  Then he insinuates that I'm not being a gentlemen and I should just pay it.  I go back and forth with him, he makes a light threat of having means to handle this as he has my info and sends me a pic of my passport and the receipt of the double charge (LOL, why he sent the receipt of the double charge IDK, it strengthens my case).
I call in to talk to him.  The woman who originally checked me in picks up.  I ask for him she says hold on and hangs up.  I'm not sure if it was an accident or not (it's Kenya, people just hang up abruptly without saying bye or anything).  I then get a Whatsapp message from the actual hotel business and I assume it's her, judging by her texting tone (she was nice) and she admits they made a mistake and there was an issue processing my card (yeah it was swiped twice) and I just need to have it reversed on my end.  I'm assuming she doesn't know her boss is being shady.  I ended up reversing the one charge only as the other is legit.

Needless to say, don't go to this place.  Looking at the reviews, a lot of them are from the hotel.  Jeff Omondi has left a review and he's the manager LOL, so just be warned.  It's too bad as I'm so easy to please and despite the mosquitos and bad wifi, I was willing to come back.  I'm not even sure I've ever left a google review before but wanted others to know so this doesn't happen to them.  Good businesses refund when they make mistakes like this, not doing so isn't only unprofessional it makes it look like the business doesn't understand how to treat customers so they can retain them and build the business.
