reviews.text: Good place and a long the transit road. Beds are comfortable and the rooms are big but requires good planning + renovations. Drinks are cheap compared to town but food is so expensive which made us Keep driving to the nearest town to take our meals. Staffs overall good and helpful but the owner is so rude and behaves like a school principal. He should sit at home and wait daily returns from his manager.

reviews.author: Tom Dalton
reviews.text:
The hotel was clean and well situated for a quiet and pleasant stay. I found the bed was extremely firm to the point of being uncomfortable. I was not used to that firmness. The pool was inviting but I never swam (did not have the time). The food was okay, the lamb chops I ate were very tough. However, the beef fillet was very good, tender and nicely seasoned. Breakfast was great although I would like to have some cereals. Plenty of fruit that was juicy and very flavourful.
Disappointed that no milk was provided for early morning coffee in the room. I had to ask for milk which was then charged to my room. Some of the infrastructure was not well maintained.
Lastly, I known that the weather was hot and a cold shower was most likelybthe best, no hot water was provided in the room for showering. This was disappointing.

reviews.author: jenn mabuka
reviews.text:
I had originally booked my stay at the MetBeach Resort because I was looking for a hotel in Malindi with direct beach access. Met advertises that it houses a clean and serene private beach, so I was extremely surprised when I arrived and found a beach that was quite dirty and extremely rocky, hampering its accessibility. When I mentioned the misleading advertising and expressed my disappointment to the staff, they told me there was not much they could do about the natural conditions of the beach. After I told them that they should not advertise that they have an accessible beach, the manager mentioned that they may be able to arrange transport to the Malindi Marine Park so I could access the beach there. The next day, they notified me that the hotel director said that would actually not be possible.

This was just one example of the ways in which the hotel director shut down customer wishes and staff suggestions to reduce personal costs. On the first night, I received some lackluster dinner and brought it up with the waitstaff, who were extremely accommodating and proposed a potential refund for my meal. When I ultimately checked out and mentioned the refund, the staff member checking me out had to call the director before approving the refund. The director attempted to deny me the refund and eventually made the staff member go to the kitchen to verify I had complained in the first place, before reluctantly refunding me.

The staff at MetBeach were by and large kind, accommodating and eager to try to meet requests I had but they were absolutely not well equipped or given the freedom to do their jobs by the director, who is clearly only interested in turning a profit at any and all cost. I was repeatedly given stained towels (a testament to his frugality) and anything that could have incurred an extra cost to the hotel was micromanaged by the director. Met beach was pretty conveniently located within Malindi, had a good breakfast, kind staff, a great ocean view (though as I said the beach was lacking) and a small boutique feel, but the treatment and amenities I received were absolutely not worth the amount of money I paid, nor up to par with the services advertised. Until the top leadership of the hotel changes hands, if you want to get your money’s worth, I would suggest you book your stay elsewhere.

reviews.author: Janelle Kinyua
reviews.text: I didn't sleep at MET however, I was a walkin client and celebrated my birthday there. It's a nice resort. Gotta keep your eyes on the kids while they are swimming, they don't have a life guard. Other than that, it's a nice joint, the beach view fantastic! I really enjoyed that.

reviews.author: Rehema Mwende
reviews.text: I enjoyed and loved my stay in met resort. The beach and ocean view was Euphoric. Loved the room and the balcony rest area with the ocean view, though there were some ants wandering around the second day. The place is quiey and peaceful.The beach is  private and your get to enjoy to the fullest if you don't like huge crowds. The breakfast was delicious, I didn't like the dinner and felt it was average. I would recommend they provide guests toothpaste, and disposable shower cap. The place is near Malindi marine park. Overally I enjoyed my solo stay, and felt safe.

reviews.author: Wilkister Ludenyi
reviews.text: Had brunch with about 90 people. Really picturesque place with views of the ocean, simple but classy decor, good food, excellent service with super helpful staff. Highly recommend!

name: Billionaire Resort and Retreat
address: Post code 8200 Marine Park Road, Malindi, Kenya

reviews.author: Belinda Atieno Smetana
reviews.text:
Always a good time at Billionaire. The best service with a very friendly team that pays great attention to details. Our apartment kitchen is always prepared with what I love in the fridge which shows their great service.
Bravo thanks for the friendly service.
Bruno was so attentive and remembered my love for ginger shot every morning. We loved the mocktails he made us every time we went for dinner.

Swift service at the restaurant with good food and great breakfast as always.

reviews.author: beliya anziya
reviews.text:
I had an exceptional experience at the Billionaire Resort and retreat, thanks to Bruno the mixologist. His drinks were absolutely incredible.
Just perfectly crafted, creative, and full of flavor. You can truly taste the skill and passion in every glass he makes.
Beyond the drinks, Bruno’s people skills are unmatched. He’s funny, engaging, and makes you feel instantly welcome. His energy, charm, and attention to detail elevated the entire experience for me.
I genuinely loved the whole service and would come back just for his cocktails alone.

reviews.author: Mustafa Aden
reviews.text: This trip was absolutely amazing. I enjoyed every aspect of it. The staff was absolutely incredible and very welcoming. Bruno, Margaret and Fatma were incredible and they showed us around. Everything about this facility was like chefs kiss. All the hotel’s activities were just perfect. The food was incredible.

reviews.author: John Carradine Baker
reviews.text: dined at restaurant, still have yet to find superb food in Malindi , the staff & ambience here is excellent , they obviously need a Culinary School trained Chef train and oversee the kitchen to justify their prices though. No water service offered , entrees apparently served with sides ala carte , tirmasu was like from an Applebee's low in chain restaurant in 🇺🇲 If you are Italian you should be embarrased by all the terrible "Italian" food served in Malindi.

reviews.author: Sandra JC
reviews.text:
We had a great stay at Billionaire Resort in Malindi over the holiday season. We rented a 4-bedroom apartment for a multigenerational family trip (grandparents, adults, and young kids 1-7 yo) and stayed for a week. The space was comfortable and worked very well for our group.

We had a couple of minor issues on the first day (AC and some clutter), but they were addressed promptly by the staff.

The resort is well maintained and offers great amenities: a saltwater pool, direct beach access with free private cabanas, a gym, tennis court, and a very good breakfast buffet.

Just a heads-up for those in a hurry: things run pole pole here, especially when ordering food or drinks. Embracing the relaxed pace makes the experience much more enjoyable.

Malindi town has plenty of supermarkets and restaurants and feels less crowded than Watamu.

We would definitely come back and highly recommend it for families.

name: Seaview Resort Malindi, Kenya
address: Opposite Malindi Cottages, Lamu Road Next to Sai Eden Rock Hotel, Malindi, Kenya

reviews.author: ConfusedButExcited
reviews.text: Charming and beautiful rambling resort with spectacular lush green gardens filled with tropicals, frangipani, hibiscus, various palms. Our bathroom was less than ideal with a very low pressure shower and non working water heater but we booked the last room on Christmas season so any other time we probably could have switched rooms. But it was very hot, typical Malindi weather, and room temp showers were refreshing. The room AC worked wonderfully.

reviews.author: Lawrence M
reviews.text:
It is truly a Seaview resort with direct views of the ocean 🌊 woooow. Amazing 🤩. You can actually hear the ocean waves whilst sleeping 🛌 in your room, oooh my ooh 😮 wonderful. Breathtaking views and a place to relax and enjoy yourself while you’re on holiday.

There’s one lady in particular who was so kind and helpful and very professional, I suspect that is the owner of the place, we could spend time talking and sharing life experiences and yet she would serve you well as your guest.

Will visit again definitely 💯. You should also check it out. 😊

reviews.author: Liyan Chen
reviews.text: their AC is functioning well you will love it ， but shower water is a bit small and its not warm enough

reviews.author: Happy Houses
reviews.text: I had a wonderful time parking here over the holidays. The best relaxing experience i was looking for at the end of my year this year.

reviews.author: Eva
reviews.text: Very peaceful getaway within 5-minutes’ walk from the beach. The rooms are spacious and the ample balcony spaces facing the beach area make for a relaxing space, punctuated by the sounds of the ocean.

reviews.author: Autotronix Telematics
reviews.text:
Staying at Villa Ameera in Malindi was an absolute dream. From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with a stunning, lush garden and a serene atmosphere that immediately put us at ease. The villa itself is beautifully designed, blending traditional Swahili architecture with modern comforts. Our room was spacious, immaculately clean, and had a lovely balcony where we could enjoy our morning coffee while listening to the birds.
The staff were exceptional—so warm, friendly, and attentive. They went above and beyond to make our stay special, from preparing delicious fresh meals to offering helpful tips on local activities. The pool area was a highlight; it was the perfect spot to relax and soak up the sun. Villa Ameera is truly a hidden gem, offering a peaceful and luxurious escape. We can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: Stephanie Nendela
reviews.text: My girls and I had an amazing time. The staff are very very friendly and the grounds are ever clean. Our host, Mustafa has been very helpful and informative. I'd highly recommend this place for group trips 'cause it's affordable and the place is spacious. Oh and the WiFi is Strong! The pictures you see online are exactly what you'll get in site. I'm definitely coming back!

reviews.author: Simon Mburu
reviews.text:
This is the place of dreams if you are a "homebody". It's an awesome family getaway and ideal for lone travellers.
They have great facilities that accommodate all ages. A big thumbs up to the owner for sharing this haven.

reviews.author: Docktor Njathika
reviews.text: Beautiful spacious villa with a gorgeous green lawn! The lounge and dining areas are bright and airy overlooking the inviting pool. Rooms are clean and comfortable and the staff are attentive.

reviews.author: Nyadzua Chano
reviews.text:
Serene, calm, peaceful. All things positive you'll find at Villa Ameera. Was my first time here and I enjoyed myself. Kind and social staff to cater for your needs, unlimited access to amenities and as if that is not enough, you've got peacocks, humming birds and parrots as your guest mates.
The owner is super understanding and friendly too.
I would go back anytime! It's that good of a place.
Next visit will be with a group of friends, hopefully.
Book your vacation with them and I promise you won't regret it.

reviews.author: ludovic christin
reviews.text:
We spent three absolutely wonderful days as a family at Mnarani Beach Club.

The place is superb, very well maintained, with direct beach access and plenty of activities suitable for the whole family.
The staff is exceptional: smiling, kind, always available and attentive, which made the stay even more enjoyable.
Our children loved every moment, and so did we.
A perfect place for a family holiday in Kenya. I recommend it 1000%!

name: Double Heart Resort
address: Watamu lamu road (opp. Eden Rock, Kilifi, Kenya

reviews.author: Jim Michels
reviews.text:
First, my perspective is American. The Double Heart is a nice, clean hotel with helpful and available staff. The property is well maintained for the area.
Do not expect a working TV. Do not expect reliable power or reliable running water. This resort does not have a back up generator. WiFi can be inconsistent and do not expect 5g. None of that apprars to be outside of normal for Malindi. If you are expecting the comfort and convenience of a Marriott, stay somewhere else at twice the cost. Simple. The experience is part of the fun for me.
All of that said, the DH is a nice, clean and felt safe. The only reason the location received an average score was availability of transportation, particularly after dark. Tuk tuks will get you everywhere and the staff knows people to call. Getting back can br an issue from some places. I enjoyed my stay and would be comfortable coming back.

reviews.author: Jamie Rocky
reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at  double heart .The check-in was smooth and the staff were warm and welcoming. My room was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. I enjoyed breakfast buffet, the view, the pool and the atmosphere. The location was convenient, making it easy to  explore  ,it was an excellent experience and I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Malindi . Definitely looking forward to coming back!

reviews.author: Roxietah Roz
reviews.text: A wonderful place to stay in Malindi. The rooms are clean and comfortable, the pool is perfect for relaxation and the staff are always friendly and helpful.The location is perfect -close to the beach and local attractions. Wether for relaxation or a fun getaway, I highly recommend this resort

reviews.text: Super nd good natural resources used in the construction

reviews.author: Robert Washe
reviews.text: Wonderful

reviews.author: Kai Magne Mauseth
reviews.text:
An unforgettable experience from start to finish.

This is a beautiful place with tasteful décor and many inviting areas where you can enjoy privacy and tranquility. From the very moment we arrived, we were met with genuine hospitality and warm smiles that made us feel at home right away. The hosts were exceptional and took us on unforgettable trips to special places in and around Malindi.

The room was spacious and beautifully furnished, with plenty of wardrobe and storage space. Breakfast was thoughtfully tailored to our preferences, accompanied by wonderfully fresh-pressed juice. The staff were always available yet never intrusive, and they went above and beyond to adapt our stay to our wishes.

The location was perfect – peaceful and serene, yet just a short tuk-tuk ride from the city’s many restaurants and attractions. We travel a lot, but this resort has truly set a new benchmark for hospitality and service. We will most certainly return and warmly recommend it to anyone seeking a combination of luxury, comfort, and genuine warmth.

reviews.author: Irene Tindi
reviews.text:
recently attended the Moda.fashion event at Lion’s Luxury eco Resort ,with two friends. While the food was good (my steak was well prepared and enjoyable), the service was extremely disappointing.

We were seated for over one hour without being attended to. No one came to greet us, offer water, or take an order. Waiters were walking around, yet we had to actively look for someone and complain just to get basic service. At one point, a friend had to call someone and ask if we were even going to be served. We were not the only ones — nearby tables were also complaining about the same issue.

Considering that we paid for entrance and the event, this level of service is unacceptable. Hospitality starts with simple things: greeting guests, checking on them, and offering water. Unfortunately, none of that happened.

The place has great potential because of its ambience and food, but the service was one of the worst I’ve experienced. Sadly, it’s not a place I would choose to visit again unless major improvements are made in customer service.

reviews.author: Massimo Khairallah
reviews.text: Wonderful place if you seek peace, rest, plug off from the world. Very gentle and professional staff, serving you almost unheard. Free ocean beach just 500 meters away that extends for kilometers without nonone around.

reviews.author: Muzembi Alfayo
reviews.text: If such a is a luxury villa, then the other hotels in Malindi are heaven? It is very expensive for nothing. If you are a couple you pay 19k inclusive of breakfast and 13k without breakfast, while you can experience heaven in some hotels like Q butique and Billionares Club. Amenities and the beds are just ordinary with mosquito nets. I paid 10k for some few drinks, fries and chicken. The owner should really check on the overall services, charges and decor.

reviews.author: Judy Kamau
reviews.text: We loved our stay here. We were the only guests so we had all the attention of the staff. Kitchen staff were superb and offered to make special food for our infant.

name: Pole Pole Beach House
address: kanani road 3°18'54.9"S 40°04'56.7"E Watamu KE, Jacaranda Area, Watamu, Kenya

reviews.author: Vale K
reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay at Pole Pole, came back already twice! Location is just a few minutes walking from a stunning beach. Rooms are nice and common areas are also very welcoming and comfortable. Safari has been really kind with us and also helped us organizing a safari. Looking forward to be back again!

reviews.author: Joey Mukenyi
reviews.text: What I loved about the place is that it's close to the beach, and the pool is also well maintained. The rooms need more love and renovation, but the beach house is okay. Lots of activities provided and a capable chef. It's a good place to escape the city and managed by friendly people.

reviews.author: Robin Mutugi
reviews.text: Excellent place. very clean rooms, awesome ocean view, clean swimming pool tho its not favourable for children and beginner swimmers.Excellent service from staff. Everyone is friendly. The beach has few people and is cleaned.it felt like our own private beach! Some good sea restaurants near the beach. A place worth returning to

reviews.author: Patricia Alves de Araujo
reviews.text:
We stay in the house for 4 nights with our 2 years old son. The house location is great, very close to the beautiful Jacaranda beach. The house also have a pool to be used for all guests. The living room is very convenient, with a smart tv where our son could watch tv in the end of the day. The room is a bit small and the bathroom was the low point of the house: beside of being small it is completely wet after one shower. We also had Leakage one day.
The lady who works in the house and cooks the breakfast is very nice, Esther. She also cooked our dinner for an extra cost of 10 euros a day (we providing the food of course). Her food was delicious!
The reason for the low rate is the owner: From the first day there was a confusion Becouse he renting a room already occupied and we were supposed to change rooms in the second day. After that everyday we had to complain about something in the breakfast: no fruits one day, no coffe another day… anyway isn’t not the kind of inconvenient you want to have in there during your vacation.

reviews.author: Julie Guérenne
reviews.text: It was a lovely stay but the low season was coming with a lot of works around the residence. We mostly enjoyed the pool because of the beach boys in the area

reviews.author: Meryeanneh Martin
reviews.text:
I visited Saffron Garden Hotel yesterday while looking for a nice place to bring my family in February for a relaxed day out, and I absolutely loved it. The place looks amazing the plants, garden space, and overall setup create such a peaceful environment that feels perfect for quality family time.
Angeline was very welcoming and showed me around the property so well. She also mentioned that they host movie nights every Saturday, which I found really exciting. The menu looks well balanced, and I loved the extra touches like the clothes shop and flower section. The swimming pool was very clean and inviting.
I honestly can’t wait to bring my family in February. Saffron Garden feels like the kind of place where you can truly relax, connect, and enjoy the moment.

reviews.author: Arteja Winters
reviews.text: This experience was absolutely amazing, the manager Ruth and Effie went out of her way to accommodate us. Ruth even went to the bank with us in a Tuk Tuk. All of the managers were amazing, the pool was cleaned everyday, the food and food service members were amazing. The rooms feel like a warm hug, This place is heaven on earth! If you're a content creator, this resort is for you! I did all my content here and every inch of this resort is an amazing back drop!💕

reviews.author: Loina Thiribi
reviews.text:
We stayed at Saffron Gardens for 4 nights and truly appreciated the hospitality. The staff were incredibly warm, welcoming, and flexible, which made our stay very comfortable — and my kids were genuinely happy throughout, which always matters.
The property is truly charming and beautiful, with a peaceful, private atmosphere that makes it perfect for couples as well as families looking for a relaxed getaway. The rooms were okay and well equipped, and I especially loved the eco-friendly approach, which adds to the overall character of the place.
During peak season, having a few more housekeepers could help speed up turnaround times, but overall the experience was pleasant and restful. Highly recommend Saffron Gardens.

reviews.author: GRACE MUTHONI MWANGI
reviews.text:
We spent 4 nights at Saffron, and the experience was nothing short of amazing. The mornings were calm and complemented hearty, delicious breakfasts 😋 (at an additional charge).  Room service was done daily.

The lovely ladies at the reception, especially Lavender, made our stay even better. They gave helpful local tips and assisted in arranging reliable transportation, which made getting around very convenient.

Kelvin, the mixologist, was very professional and attentive; he took time to understand our drink preferences. I appreciated the delicate balance between the sweet and tangy passion mojitos he'd make 💯.

I loved that the pool was accessible 24/7; the late-night swims were amazing. The overall experience was wonderful, and I’ll definitely be coming back whenever I visit Malindi.

reviews.author: Penu Dama
reviews.text: Coming back to Saffron Garden Hotel Malindi felt like coming home. There’s something about the calm atmosphere and consistency that keeps drawing me back. Everything runs smoothly, the vibes are always right, and the service is excellent. Saffron has truly become my go-to place in Malindi, with great service especially from Angeline.

reviews.author: Kellyjoy Gacheri
reviews.text: Humble, cool and enjoyable place to be especially when  out for a vacation with friends, family and a lover too ❤️. The place is soo muah...... 💋💋💋💋.

reviews.author: Batu1215
reviews.text:
Absolutely unforgettable stay,  a true boutique gem in Kenya

Line in the Sun Hotel exceeded every single expectation.

From the very first moment, you feel that this is not just a hotel, but a place created with heart, care, and an exceptional sense for hospitality. The entire property is beautifully maintained, calm, and elegant, every detail reflects a very high standard.

The staff is outstandingly friendly, warm, and attentive. You are welcomed with genuine smiles and treated with a level of care that feels incredibly personal. A very special mention goes to Julia and Katharina – they are truly exceptional. Their warmth, intuition, and professionalism make you feel less like a guest and more like part of a small family. It’s rare to experience service that feels so natural, thoughtful, and almost anticipatory as if your needs are understood before you even express them.

The food is excellent fresh, delicious, and prepared with great attention to quality and taste. Every meal feels like a highlight and perfectly matches the overall refined yet relaxed atmosphere of the hotel.

What makes this place truly special is the sense of trust, comfort, and belonging it creates. The service is not only high-end but deeply human, warm, and sincere  something that is very hard to find.

If you are looking for a boutique hotel in Kenya that combines elegance, exceptional service, incredible staff, and a family-like atmosphere, this is the place.
Highly recommended – and a place you will want to return to.

Senol & Sengül

Stunning, peaceful and warming boutique hotel. The location is truly amazing, the breakfast delicious and the staff extra welcoming.
I loved the Kenya typical dinner on the pool and I cannot recommend enough their SPA treatments!! Surely a must do during your visit!
Will come back for sure!

reviews.author: Svetlana Orlova
reviews.text:
Lately had a lunch there.
It’s always a good surprise- the food is just delicious and services is so fast, professional and waiters are so kind
Thanks 🙏

reviews.author: Joanna
reviews.text: I tried to reach the hotel from 2 different email addresses + Instagram. No reply at all. If this is their customer service, then I’d rather not go there at all.

reviews.author: Rico Sanchez
reviews.text: It was a birthday celebration weekend this was a perfect place to celebrate. Both properties were absolutely stunning. We truly enjoyed the ambiance and how chill the vibe was. The only negative part of the trip was the service. The food took entirely too long to come to our table. For instance, at the billionaire resort, upon arrival, it took 30-35 mins just for someone to ask for our drinks. Unacceptable. At the Lions we had lunch and it took the food 2.5 hours to come and the order was wrong. Just unacceptable. Why still give this a 5 star? Because Sheila, Fatima, and Chris were absolutely ON IT. They truly made us feel at home. With each complaint they compensated us with upgrades and free food. They were so pleasant, warm and empathetic. They are truly gems at that resort. Thank you Sheila, Fatima and Chris for listening to us and also taking care of our problems. Because of you all we will definitely be coming back because we know we will be in good hands. *Please work on the customer service at the restaurants*

reviews.author: Catherine Shimechero
reviews.text:
​A Hidden Gem with Exceptional Service
This charming, budget-friendly hotel exceeded my expectations with its spacious rooms and lovely ambiance. The breakfast was a highlight—the cake and soup were particularly delicious. What truly stood out, however, was the warm and attentive staff. They went above and beyond by arranging a reliable driver for my trip to Saffron Garden Resort, ensuring I had a seamless journey to enjoy some quiet time.

reviews.author: Esther Macharia
reviews.text: I loved the place. Good service. I definitely recommend. Their meals are so delicious 😋. The pool is very clean. ✅✅✅

reviews.author: Dhadho Mohamed
reviews.text: The place is nice, cool environment,liked their services

reviews.author: David Mbatia
reviews.text: Great location, and some old world charm with lots of greenery. with an easy commute to town...actually you could walk there. Breakfast is what they serve you, no option to customize for dietary preferences. Rooms are very old school and service is typically slow but very friendly. The hotel cam be more. They've added conference facilities but it still lacks some sheen. It's very budget friendly. No frills, unpretentious just your plain "meat and potatoes" variety of a hotel. If that's not your thing, then this isn't for you. Been here severally over the past seven years and it's clearly contending with the changes in an increasingly difficult operating environment with many in the hospitality industry seemingly struggling to stay afloat.

reviews.author: G R

reviews.author: Raliya Adan
reviews.text:
I had an amazing stay at Kasa Malindi! The property is beautiful, peaceful, and incredibly well maintained the perfect place to relax.
A special thank you to Jane from housekeeping, who kept my room spotless and always added such thoughtful touches. Marcel and Emmanuel from the concierge team were outstanding professional, friendly and always ready to help with anything I needed. They truly made my stay seamless and enjoyable.
Exceptional service, wonderful staff, and a stunning place. I can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: Eunice Douglas
reviews.text: Amazing stay at Kasa! The facilities, staff, food, and overall experience were all excellent. Our favorite part was the privacy—it truly felt like staying in our own private home. We spent the day relaxing in our villa’s private pool, playing music and enjoying the peaceful atmosphere. Would definitely stay here again!!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Muthoni Mwai
reviews.text:
An absolutely sublime seafood experience!

We came for the seafood at Mawimbi Restaurant and it was everything we hoped for and more.

· Service: Impeccable! A special thanks to our waitress, Elton, who provided great recommendations.
· Drinks: Fantastic for everyone. The non-alcoholic "Brain Power" tea is a must-try, and the alcoholic cocktails (ask for their special cocktails) were amazing.
· Food: We had the Mawimbi Poseidon platter for our main meal. It was absolutely scrumptious, and the fries and salad complemented it perfectly.
· Ambiance: The restaurant itself is beautiful.

We loved every moment and will definitely be back again and again

reviews.author: Alloys Patrick
reviews.text: Just on the road there's a nice signboard showing a cafe amkeni located at the same facility but surprisingly the security guards had no idea about it. We were turned away am not sure if it was the colour of our skin or the cafe actually doesn't exist inside the kasa. I'm still following up because everything pointed inside the hotel except for the security guards.

reviews.author: Mathilde Vu
reviews.text:
This review concerns the restaurant, not the hotel.

The location is beautiful, and our waitress was genuinely kind and attentive. Unfortunately, the overall experience deteriorated from disappointing to unacceptable.

We waited over two hours for our food, after already waiting around 30 minutes just to receive menus and place our order. Delays can happen, but what made this particularly frustrating was the lack of clear communication or accurate updates. When the manager eventually came to speak with us, the explanation was uncomfortable and dismissive — framed as the restaurant being a “victim of its own success,” and implying that we had ordered too much (!)… but no real apologies.

The irony was that when the food finally arrived, it was minor borderline bad. The pasta was soggy, the fish fingers and fries were cold, and the calamari dry. Espresso Martini bland. Three dishes had to be sent back, only to be returned reheated. It was only after insisting again that they were finally removed from the bill.

Delays and mistakes can happen in any restaurant. It happened that night - to us and all the tables around us, and that’s ok. However, what’s important is to acknowledge it with grace and honesty. Instead, the explanation of management was defensive and dismissive, including remarks that appeared to blame local staff training and referenced the absence of a école hôtelière in Kenya. Coming from a foreign manager, this framing felt uncomfortable and inappropriate. A calm, respectful acknowledgment of the issue would have gone a long way.

name: Silver Rock Boutique Resort by Mokawa
address: Silversand Road, off Casuarina Rd, Malindi, Kenya
editorial_summary: Relaxed quarters in a modest hotel set a 2-minute walk from a beach, plus dining & an outdoor pool.

reviews.author: Cate catherine
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely wonderful stay at this hotel during my vacation! The rooms were impeccably clean, making it a truly comfortable and relaxing experience. The staff went above and beyond always kind, friendly, and ready to help with a smile. Every morning, we enjoyed a delicious breakfast that set the perfect tone for the day.
What truly stood out was the exceptional hospitality on our last day. The management kindly allowed us to extend our stay for a few hours because our bus was leaving a little later, which was such a thoughtful gesture.
I can’t recommend this hotel enough it’s a perfect blend of comfort, great service, and genuine care for guests. I’ll definitely be coming back on my next trip.

reviews.author: J K
reviews.text:
Our stay at Silver Rock was a very good experience.
The Staff are welcoming and very friendly.
The rooms are well maintained and cleaned daily (they even decorated our bed!!!)with a working AC,fan,working fridge, WIFI and a specious balcony with a beach view.
The beach is aproximately 3 minutes and the highlight of it all were the guards on the beach side, they made sure we were not disturbed by beach boys as per our request that made us enjoy the magnificent sun rise! Thank you.🙏
Definately recoment.

reviews.author: Laura Jobs
reviews.text: If there was a zero star it would have suited this hotel better. This hotel has ruined my vacation experience. I no longer want to go to air bnbs and hotels due to fear. The amount of insecurity in Silver Rock is just shocking. People entrust you with their lives but you end up putting them at risk and excluding yourselves from responsibility with some cliche notice in the room stating you are not liable for lost items and that valuable stuff should be taken to the reception. What is more alarming is you know the loophole that thieves use to enter people’s rooms yet have done nothing to deal with that. Even a mere cctv to capture the thief? Nothing! When my electronic was stollen all you guys offered was rudeness and telling me to check out if I felt unsafe. This is so low of you silver rock. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS HOTEL TO ANYONE THAT LOVES THEIR LIVES.

reviews.author: Patrick Kosewe
reviews.text:
The location is pretty convenient to all sites and restaurants within Malindi town.

There was a persistent stuffy smell coming from the bathroom and toilet. Several facilities, including the fans and toilet fittings, were either faulty or not functioning properly, and our bathroom experienced frequent clogging. The presence of fire ants around the property was also an issue, as they made their way into the rooms.

For guests traveling with families, the pool is not particularly child-friendly. Breakfast is scheduled between 8:00 and 10:00 AM; however, arriving after 8:30 AM often means waiting for items to be replenished. It appeared that the breakfast service was not adequately prepared to cater for the number of guests and reservations.

The hotel advertised as beach front but its not.

reviews.author: Evalyn Mwangi
reviews.text:
Martin will sort you and sort you properly.
And when you get to the facility, everyone is out and about ensuring you have a spectacular time.

The hotel is near so many sites like Vasco Da Gama, Marine Park and Malindi Town.

Highly Recommend!!!!

name: Kipepeo B&B House
address: Nyumba Baharini, Kanani Road, Watamu, Kenya

name: The One Watamu Bay
editorial_summary: Upmarket all-inclusive resort offering a private beach, a spa & outdoor pools, plus 2 restaurants.

reviews.author: 沈钰轩
reviews.text: The doors in my room all require a lot of force and multiple attempts to properly close or lock. Could these be fixed, please? Also, I understand that the staff need to clean the room, but could they please check what's inside the containers or baskets before clearing them? Some items are clearly not trash, but they still get thrown away. They might not realize how sad a guest would feel to find that the seashells they collected have been tossed out.

reviews.author: Mike Watoko
reviews.text:
There is something missing here which I can't place a finger on.
The rooms are ok but.... I don't know whether it's the old curtains or the plain walls or the lack of tv but a present remote control. The missing study table and a chair but a present cabinet.... Just something is missing.

The food is good but the variety missing. The food is well done but something is still missing...

The ambience, the dusty surroundings..the unpaved parking.. the paled walkways to the rooms but something is missing. I think the paved ways to the rooms zimeparara. Also the vegetation around the hotel are scorched buy the hot sun of Watamu. I think I need to come during the rainy season. But they can do better with watering.

The swimming pools.... I don't know how to comment about them. I don't see the bottom it's not clean.

The staff... I think most of the time an employee reflects the employers attitudes, the employer treatment of employees.

I think I will write more.
Am still enjoying the hotel

reviews.author: Delisa Malone
reviews.text: This place is the worse resort I’ve ever stayed in. We traveled 12 hours to reach this resort arriving at 5:00 pm rooms were so dirty they had to reclean it. Then to add insult to injury there was no running water in the room it also smelled bad. There was no telephone in the room to contact the front desk. My advice do not book this resort you will be highly disappointed.

reviews.author: Nikita Tabitha
reviews.text: The one watamu is a good space physically but the directors and management can do better especially when it comes to partnerships and service towards clients and business partners. I thought it was a trusted establishment but 👎.

reviews.author: Sean Hettema
reviews.text: Large resort although it was thankfully quiet. Beautoful sea views but not a swimming beach. Great service.

reviews.author: Nikki McGenn
reviews.text:
We spent 12 nights at Turtle Bay Beach Club this February. We had the most wonderful stay here. The hotel was clean and staff were super friendly and really cared about making our stay special.
I am vegan snd gluten free and there was always an option for me at meal times. I can recommend the homemade pizzas! The Location was stunning- right in the most beautiful beach. The Turtle Bay tour guides on the beach are also very friendly and we did book a dolphin watching trip through them- booked with Allen - Nothing was too much trouble for Allen. (He even took us into the town to help get my phone fixed - if you want the best advice and help look for Allen!!)
This is the most friendly and beautiful place I have ever stayed !
We will be returning!

reviews.author: Valentina Eble Siddu
reviews.text:
We had an amazing two-week stay at Turtle Bay. The staff truly made the experience, especially Head Chef Justus, who went above and beyond to accommodate my gluten-free needs with incredible food including pancakes, homemade bread, Black Forest cake and more. John and the wider kitchen team were great, though clearer allergen labelling would be a helpful improvement.

Reception was outstanding – Patrick and Ken were incredibly kind and attentive, even offering to fix my broken shoe overnight. Bar staff were friendly and welcoming, and the entertainment team provided fun daytime activities and great DJ nights.

Rooms were clean and comfortable, though could do with a small refresh. Overall, a fantastic stay with exceptional service and food. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Fifi O
reviews.text: I stayed at the hotel on a school trip for 4 days and I found the waiters to be quite rude as at breakfast when me and a group of friends sat on a table as a group of 6 near the buffet, in the middle of eating a waiter told us that we had to get up immediately and move to tables much further from the buffet as he said ‘we were taking too much space for the other guests’ and we weren’t informed that we had a specific seating area prior to serving so we kindly asked to finish our food where we were seated and then leave the buffet but the waiter completely refused in quite a rude manner and told us to carry all our plates of food away from where we were. Overall the rooms are fine, though the wifi is not the best in them but the facilities are good and the beach is nice. I would recommend informing the waiters that even if it’s a school group we are still guests that paid to stay so we shouldn’t be treated as if we’re a chore to attend to by waiters.

reviews.author: Laura M.
reviews.text:
Rooms weren’t clean at all and had a weird old smell.

Food was okay, but not a lot of variety.
The staff was very friendly, but not very shocked after telling them about our rooms.

They didn’t really care at least it seemed like that, so we decided to leave and continue our stay elsewhere.

The only beautiful thing about my stay was the beach.

reviews.author: judy kahure
reviews.text:
My stay at Turtle Bay Beach Club in Watamu was nothing short of outstanding. The resort itself is beautiful, well maintained, and perfectly located, but what truly sets it apart is the incredible staff and their genuine commitment to guest satisfaction.

Every member of the team was warm, professional, and attentive, creating an atmosphere that felt both welcoming and personal.

However, special recognition must go to Ken Tune, whose integrity and exceptional service left a lasting impression. His professionalism, reliability, and genuine desire to help exemplify the very best of hospitality.

I would highly recommend Turtle Bay Watamu to anyone looking for a memorable, relaxing, and well-cared-for stay. With staff like Ken Tune and the rest of the amazing team, this is a destination I will gladly return to and confidently recommend to others.

name: Hemingways Watamu
editorial_summary: Relaxed beachfront getaway with 2 restaurants offering big game fishing & kite-surfing.

reviews.author: Milo Taylor
reviews.text: I sat out on the terrace looking out towards all the deep sea fishing boats that chase marlin and sailfish while enjoying a lovely white and complimentary bbq'd barracuda- later we feasted on chicken curries in  their beachfront restaurant. The place is heavenly....

reviews.author: George Mathew
reviews.text:
Excellent hotel, fantastic staff, especially Patrick in the dining room.
I also went to the Spa, and I have to say Marion is definitely one of the best therapists I've ever had.
She removed a troublesome knot in my shoulder  within two sessions.
Thank you Marion, you're the best.
Don't hesitate,  this place is worth it absolutely.

reviews.author: king henry
reviews.text:
Absolutely beautiful hotel with the most amazing staff. They're always so helpful. The hotel rooms are stunning and cleaned everyday. The food is ok'ish with different theme nights.
The only warning I'd give is organise your own transfer from the airport. They charged me Ksh 8000 for a round-trip taxi while Uber would have charged maximum Ksh 5000. Overall, extremely satisfied with our stay.

reviews.author: Tom Faulkner
reviews.text:
Having stayed with Hemingways for 5 days now with a few left, I have to say I'm left feeling disappointed.

The rooms are lovely, clean and well appointed, as you would expect.

The staff are friendly, but service, despite it including some nice touches, is slow and rather disjointed. More staff would be appropriate particularly in the restaurant/bar areas at peak times in order to reduce the waiting time for guests (of which there was a lot).

We also had an issue with our board, we booked the half board package but on finishing our first dinner with the restaurant, the hotel attempted to charge us for it. Despite explaining we were half board they were insistent we sign for the bill as they believed we were B&B only, resulting in a rather uncomfortable situation in what should have been an enjoyable first evening away with my wife.

Following some contact with our travel agent (and us showing the booking multiple times) the hotel finally relented the next day and agreed we were half board. No effort was made to compensate us for the uncomfortable situation we were put in by this.

The food from the breakfast and dinner buffets is average, with minimal choice and some dishes running out before the end of the service. Far below the standard I would expect from a 5 star hotel. The remaining menu (which we sampled at lunchtimes), was of a good standard and reasonably priced, its  a shame that quality was not reflected throughout.

The WiFi is very poor and we experienced multiple interruptions and poor signal unless you're in the room.

Other than that, the hotel is well located with good access to a beach where we enjoyed the snorkeling from the shore with plenty of wildlife to see. It unfortunately feels like Hemingways is leaning on a legacy of high quality whilst having fallen behind the standard I would expect from a 5 star hotel, more like a 4 star but unfortunately with the premium price tag attached. Not value for money and I highly doubt we will be returning.

reviews.author: Paul Thomas
reviews.text:
Stayed here many times, were disappointed a few years ago and stayed elsewhere.
Having got good reviews from local friends decided to give it another go.
So glad we did, so much better now under new manager.
Staff were on the whole fantastic, special praise to Hassan at the pool, who has always been their best asset.
Room was beautiful appointed with fresh flowers and a classic design.
Food was generally good but could be better, breakfast was a bit poor for a 5 star hotel.
Housekeeping could be better, often forgetting towels, tea or robes.
Phones not working properly.
A good  4.5 🌟
Overall very good will return soon!

name: 7 Islands Resort Watamu
address: Watamu Jacaranda Rd Kilifi North, Watamu, Kenya

reviews.author: Rebecca Minayo
reviews.text: Seven Island Watamu is absolutely beautiful. Crystal clear water, peaceful vibes, and stunning views. A perfect place to relax and enjoy nature.

reviews.author: MADZO TOURS SAFARIS
reviews.text: Very close to the beach and watamu mall nice and cool place

reviews.author: Minal Ganatra (Minsky)
reviews.text:
The place is good but needs some sprucing up. Dinner was average. Breakfast average.

No welcome drink, no confirmation if can be picked from the airport.

To their credit, they gave us extended check out time.

Place is good, but they need to improve the variety of food on their buffet menu. I understand it's off peak but can do better.

Rooms are average, no kettle for tea or coffee.

Waiters are polite and kind.

There is no option to order any food between lunch and dinner. However they serve some biscuits and cake at 5.00p.m. foc.

The pool is of good size and kept very clean.

Many beach boys but no security from the hotel outside at the beach.

The view is good. For the price, the hotel is not bad.

reviews.author: Caroline Maina
reviews.text:
If you are not white, or Italian, you will feel the shade from the gateman harassing you to confirm your booking while still in your taxi.
After the reception, all other staff are friendly and the services are good. The only downside is that everything (signage, menu, music) is in Italian so you may need to brush up on that or use google translate.

reviews.author: Liz Hixon
reviews.text:
Note: day trip, did not stay the night

This is a great place to come for a day at the pool. At low tide, you can walk to the little islands which is a very fun and unique experience. We did not eat here, but the cocktails are very good.

reviews.author: Rithwik Gokhale
reviews.text:
Pros:
•	Polite and friendly hotel staff (excluding management)
•	Unique and scenic hotel location

Cons:
•	The air conditioners in the rooms are ancient and barely work
•	A sewage smell comes from the bathroom taps and showers
•	Management is lax and completely unreceptive to feedback
•	Limited meal options

(Scroll down for TL;DR)

Full story

I booked a 2-night, 3-day stay at AHG Lion Beach with my family. This was meant to be a special weekend—something relaxing and beachside. We were assigned an ocean-facing room, and the moment we walked in, it was obvious the room was extremely hot and the AC wasn’t cooling at all.

Since the room faced the setting sun, I assumed it would improve after sunset and went ahead with our planned activities. We returned after dark, and the room was still unbearably hot. At that point, I contacted reception. A technician was sent to confirm the issue, and he immediately suggested we change rooms. Despite that, no action was taken until I went back again and requested a room change myself.

Because no other sea-facing rooms were available, my family was split up and moved into two indoor-facing rooms. You’d think management would have the common sense to clean the rooms, turn on the AC, and confirm everything worked before sending guests over—especially after the inconvenience they caused. But no. Nothing was done until I spoke with reception again after dinner—for the third time. This wasted several precious hours of our evening that I would have rather spent with my family.

We finally moved into the two new rooms, and the same problems continued. In one room, the AC was barely working and the room stayed extremely hot. The units at this resort are clearly outdated and seem to require running for a full day before they can cool a room properly.

The second room had a better AC, but it came with its own issues. It was beyond dirty and dusty and was clearly not cleaned before we were transferred. The bathroom door didn’t close, and the water from the taps and shower smelled like sewage (and yes, I noticed other reviews mention the same issue).

Since the AC in the first room still wasn’t working properly, our entire family ended up squeezing into the smaller room. Once extra beds were added, it felt like we were sleeping in a cramped backpackers’ hostel—not a supposed 4-star resort. This entire mess took up our whole evening, and by the time we were finally crammed into one room with extra beds, it was close to midnight.

I’ll also note: meal options at AHG are quite limited compared to other resorts in the area. If you’re vegetarian, keep that in mind. The only real saving grace here is the unique bay location and the friendly staff (minus the general manager and reception staff).

Now, based on other reviews, I’m sure the manager will respond to this with some baseless justifications and explanations. It doesn’t matter. The general manager met with me the next morning and offered generic, useless explanations, and even getting a sincere apology felt like pulling teeth. To the GM: you ruined our weekend. Instead of spending your time drafting a response I don’t care about, use that time to reflect on this feedback and make the improvements this place clearly needs. I’ll be sure not to recommend this place to anyone again. Thanks, Ricardo.

TL;DR

Great location and friendly staff, but the rooms are a disaster: ancient AC units that barely cool, sewage-smelling water from taps/showers, dirty replacement rooms, and a frustratingly unresponsive reception/management team. We spent most of our first night dealing with room changes and ended up crammed into one room like a hostel. Limited food options too—especially for vegetarians. Not worth it.

reviews.author: Amaya Dissanayake
reviews.text: The hotel is pretty but the rooms by the pool view are so hot and the air-conditioning is not enough to help. We sweated the whole time. They later changed us to the sea view rooms ...it was a bit better but theh air conditioning is weak.  Kindly look into it

reviews.author: Giulia Romano
reviews.text:
If you're looking for a place where relaxation and adventure come together perfectly, this is the perfect place!
Our experience was fantastic. The rooms are super spacious, spotless, and offer an incredible view. The beach is just a few steps away, perfect for a sunset stroll or soaking up the sun. 🌞
The food? WOW!
An amazing buffet with incredible variety, always fresh and absolutely delicious. And let’s not even get started on the cocktails! 🍹
The staff are incredibly friendly and make you feel right at home. A special shout-out to the entertainment team, who made each day special without ever being over the top. And the safari? An experience not to be missed! 🐘
If you're looking to escape the daily grind and dive into a warm, welcoming, and authentic atmosphere, look no further! We can't wait to come back! 😄

reviews.author: Moc zdraví
reviews.text: Noisy music untill midnight and higher light pollution. You come here to rest and you come home exhausted because poor sleep. No palms in the resort so you cannot see climbing staff and have a fresh coconut anytime. There is lawn and no flowers nor trees. Beach is not good because full of waste and boats.

reviews.author: fri frugt
reviews.text:
Light pollution.
The night lamps are so bright I feel dejavu from being tortured with spot lights in a Mexico prison.
Watamu is a natural reserve. These guys are bringing Las Vegas night life vibes. Unrelaxing and unhealthy for human sleep. Ruining watamu paradise vibes

reviews.author: Brenda Kajuju
reviews.text: The hotel highlights beautifully the Swahili architecture of the Kenyan coastline. As a native kenyan I have to say that the hotel is almost entirely catered to Italian guests first and natives second which isn’t a huge deal. Otherwise I had one of the most relaxing stays here…

reviews.author: vanessa njuguna
reviews.text: We spent Christmas at jacaranda beach resort in watamu. And me and my family had a horrible time. My first complaint was the food they served during breakfast, lunch and dinner. They had the same options everyday not changing anything. My next complaint was the room. The rooms looked horrible especially the bathrooms. They look old and ugly. My last complaint was the resort itself. As an American visitor they treated anyone that wasn’t Italian horribly. They only catered to the Italians, only  speaking Italian and ignoring everyone’s wishes. This is generally a horrible place to stay during any time of the year. WONT COME AGAIN!

reviews.author: PINE TOURS SOLUTIONS
reviews.text: We had an amazing stay at Jacaranda Beach Resort in Watamu! The location is absolutely stunning, with breathtaking ocean views and a beautiful, well-maintained beach. The rooms were comfortable, clean, and offered great views. The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, always making sure we felt welcome. The food was delicious, offering a great mix of local and international dishes. I especially loved the relaxing atmosphere by the pool and the various activities available. If you're looking for a perfect beach getaway in Watamu, Jacaranda Beach Resort is the place to be!

reviews.author: Cherryl D'mello
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful stay at this stunning resort! The pool was excellent, and the location was perfect—just a short walk to the beach. The buffet breakfast was fantastic, with a great variety to choose from, and the staff made the experience even better. The room facing the ocean were fantartic

Special thanks to Carol, the manager, and Duncan for their excellent service. Bahati at the reception was incredibly helpful and welcoming as well. Enjoyed the coconut water welcome drink.   I appreciated the instructor at the pool, Hassan who accommodated some water exercises, even though no one else showed up at the scheduled time for water aerobics

Unfortunately, I didn’t get a chance to enjoy all the resort’s activities as my trip was short and packed with outdoor adventures. Nevertheless, the resort’s location is ideal—close to the beach for relaxation, yet Uber makes trips to the city easy and convenient. I would definitely come back and stay again! Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Ian Macharia
reviews.text:
I had an amazing 3-night stay at Jacaranda Beach Resort in Watamu, and I couldn’t be more impressed! The resort’s beachfront location offers stunning ocean views, and the white sandy beaches are perfect for a relaxing getaway. My room was spacious, clean, and tastefully decorated with a cozy veranda leading to the beach and the ocean.

The food was a real treat—delicious local and international dishes, with fresh seafood being the highlight. I especially enjoyed the Swahili-themed dinners and dining with a view of the ocean. The staff were warm, attentive, and made me feel at home from the moment I arrived.

Jacaranda offers a wide range of activities, from lounging by the pool to  playing beach volleyball. Evening entertainment was a bonus, with live performances adding a lively touch to the nights.

If you’re looking for a serene, beachside escape with excellent service and a variety of activities, Jacaranda Beach Resort is the perfect choice. I left feeling refreshed and eager to return!

name: Temple Point
editorial_summary: Tropical, beachside escape with thatched roof bungalows, plus sports activities & free dining.

reviews.author: IsaM.
reviews.text:
I mean, where do I even begin. Again I rarely write reviews, but every now and then you stumble on a true gem and you just have to shout it from the mountaintops! Fr...

Temple Point in Watamu is an absolute standout. It’s simple, elegant, and effortlessly stylish—nothing overdone, just very intentional and serene. My cousin and I had an amazing stay here and we’ll definitely be back for the vibes.

Service was top-tier. Emmanuel, Randu at Lichthaus, Steve and Charo on the boat experience, and all the ladies at the spa were exceptional—warm, professional, and genuinely attentive. They’re a big part of why this place hits different!!

This is another “run, don’t walk” there situation guys. Thank you for a wonderful experience, and looking forward to being back very soon. Ciao xoxo...

reviews.author: Mtofu Kenya
reviews.text: A wonderful 5 day stay. The rooms are nice and cozy with a view of Mida Creek. Excellent Service and Food, a la carte and Buffet. Very nice breakfast with a good Bread and Cold Cut selection. SMall private beach with a bar.

reviews.author: Brenda Omburo
reviews.text: This is our second time at this restaurant. The place seems recently renovated and the rooms look nice. The reception was great too. The restaurant is the problem. We were in a group of 2 Kenyans and other white people we’re getting served with menus at dinner and we were left sitting for almost 30 minutes before we wandered around and figured out the buffet for ourselves. It’s shameful that in this day and age this is still happening. Also, the food was a bit bland. Everything else is a five star, including service from the rest of the staff (hence the 2 stars), but the restaurant gets a zero. Racial bias is just plain inexcusable. Do better.

reviews.author: Ethos Nairobi
reviews.text: Stayed a couple of days with friends and business partners. good service and excellent food. lichthaus is a gem, vibes and yummy bbq. natural environment with a lot of beautiful small spots to hang out and chill. rooms are beautiful

reviews.author: Zawadi Hat Fashion Limited
reviews.text: We came in for the Swahili dinner, and it sure was a good night. The selection of food was not so wide, but whatever was available was delicious.

name: Medina Palms
address: Plot, Off Turtle Bay Road, Watamu, Kenya
editorial_summary: Lavish suites & villas in a posh beach resort with an open-air restaurant, an outdoor pool & a spa.

reviews.author: Mercy Muriuki
reviews.text:
Beautiful place but worst experience; we experienced racism first hand and the worst is that it came from our fellow Kenyans!. Instead of them celebrating their own, they were busy idolizing their bosses.

Luckily we avoided their food after we made an order that took 2hrs to prepare and when it eventually arrived past midnight. The 1800bob burger was terrible with the burger bread as hard as a tortoise shell, while the 1500bob tiramisu looked like the size of small cupuccino cup☹️☹️☹️.

All in all it's a beautiful and amazing place but you will only enjoy the beauty not hospitality.

reviews.author: maddalena rimassa
reviews.text: The place is truly amazing and the location is breathtaking! The service is fast, polite and always ready to accommodate you. Special thanks to Innocent, who was our waiter and was very welcoming and nice!! Totally recommend!

reviews.author: Amunny A
reviews.text: deserves to be a 5 star hotel, worth the price, the people are great, service is incredible, had booked for one night for a holiday vacay but after reviewing other hotels, i ended up extending my full holiday in medina palms, for its beauty and great outstanding service and safety

reviews.author: Mick Kimutai
reviews.text: Awesome place to have dinner. Abit pricey though. But its a nice menu, nice lighting with dinner by a pool in a garden.

reviews.author: Serena M.
reviews.text:
We had a fabulous time at Medina Palms, the staff is friendly, and the location and amenities are truly top-notch. From the entrance to the conception of the outdoorsy gardens, swimming pools, lounge area everything gives a peaceful feeling.
The real surprise was at the very first moment we stepped in, the reception informed us that we got upgraded. Instead of the 2 rooms booking they gave us the penthouse. The stay was a 2-floor with rooms and a living room on the ground floor and an open living room, balconies, and a jacuzzi on the rooftop, opened to a nice view of the Medina Palms Resort. The place is ideal for a couple of family accommodations.

name: Garoda Resort
address: Watamu, Turtle Bay Road, Kilifi, Kenya

reviews.author: Winniesarah Njeru
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our 5 day stay here great service and good food too.

reviews.author: JACKSON NGAO CHARO
reviews.text: Local operators also offer airport transfers, safari packages, boat rides, and tuk-tuk tours around town.

reviews.author: Abdulwahab Jambeni
reviews.text: Nice place!!! Love the environment and the its at the beach!! Good vibes

reviews.author: Maytag International
reviews.text: Spacious, clean and lovely rooms with garden view. Great pool side vibes. Chill out music and yummy cocktails. Couple of meters away from the lovely white sandy beach and blue ocean. I am still that person who needs a TV and WiFi in the room for my lazy moments.

reviews.author: Mark 3563
reviews.text: Spent a total of 15 days here.  Original plan was 5.  Great beach.   Great staff.  We only had breakfast plan so we use the Gecko restaurant for dinner almost everyday.   Great pizza and seafood at reasonable prices.  Very nice happy hour drink specials with good snacks included.  Bar staff David & Shuku were great.  Chef Eric and waiter Erastus cooked and served up some great food.  Staff spook very good English.  Almost all other guest seemed to speak Italian so limited communication for us Canadians with them but everyone friendly.  Thanks to Elizabeth at the front desk to allow us to extend our stay.

name: Watamu Adventist Beach Resort
address: Next Watamu Police Station, Richland Road, J2X8+2WX, Watamu, Kenya

reviews.author: Garry Harris
reviews.text:
The worst part is the deep sand in front of the entrance.  It’s unsafe for motorcyclists.

It’s right on the beach.  Walk down the steps and you’re on the beach.  The rooms have air.  There’s strong breezes on the mezzanine overlooking the pool.

Kitchen isn’t so good.

reviews.author: Kagochi talks
reviews.text:
This is one of the resort that is situated next to the beach therefore the location is perfect. The place was a little bit deserted when I was there and we were the only guests in the hotel.
The staff are quite helpful but you can tell they are used to not having so much traffic.
The hotel restaurant only offers non-meat options this means we did not have any meal at the hotel.
The rooms are well cleaned but they do need a bit more servicing. The AC had rust on it and the tap in the toilet had some damage but still functional. We got the beach front view room but that came with a noise challenge. The room overlooked a beach bar that played loud music through the night.
The rest of the hotel facilities are okay, the swimming pool was not functional and it hadn’t been cleaned for a while.

reviews.author: Ville Saarni
reviews.text: The pool was not clean, the bed sheets had stains and holes and the mosquito net barely stayed on the rail. Our room (with small kids) was just next to the beach bars which played loud music until 2 am. With same price you can get so much better accommodation in Watamu.

reviews.author: Felister Mukui
reviews.text: The place is not kept,  it's in a good location to the beach. Dirty swimming pool, no hot water and the place was windy. I had to leave the place before time. The facility is contrally to what is shown on Internet. The place is quiet for holiday. No meat but the vegetarian diet is boring with eggs in each meal.

reviews.author: Tabilanie Tabz
reviews.text: My stay at the resort was amaizing the scenic views of the ocean from my room was breathtaking NGL. It's location is well placed as there are nearby shopping centers to buy foodstuff plus have a hotel you can dine at, both affordable and expensive options to choose from. Pricing was fair compared to those around the same area. Customer service was okay too willing to help when requested the rooms need a little renovation but nothing to stress about when on vacation you are literally never there, LoL.

name: Jumbo Resort, Watamu
editorial_summary: Casual rural resort on a white-sand beach offering dining, pools & entertainment, plus activities.

reviews.author: Benard Jillo
reviews.text: Jumbo resort the rules you  have of discriminating other tour companies from bringing and picking clients outside the  gate is very  wrong if you all had  a  private parking area for other companies it could be better but  keep  us on the dusty  side way ain't  good,  If  you don't want us to get into the hotel with our clients why don't you put a rule only the contracted companies like  alpitour and the selected few  to be the only ones to be bringing guests  this is not good  please.  We are business people let's do business in a equal  manner. I personally did not like that.

reviews.author: Coach Roy Okonji
reviews.text: We enjoyed our 5 day stay at Jumbo. The all inclussive arrangement was fantastic, the rooms were great, staff were welcoming. The hotel was predominantly occupied by Italian Patrons. We felt at home every minute of our stay

reviews.author: M
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort, rooms, pathways to the  beach, sun chairs were all clean and staff were always helpful and kind. Highly recommended. Do note that  mid July isn't the best period to go as the weather was windy and a little cloudy. A great idea if you want to relax on the beach for a couple of days after a week of Safari ( which is what we did )

All in all, we had a lovely experience at Jumbo, we were also greeted by a family of cats which was a pleasant surprise.

Just a note for the Italians and French who go there ( as some of the staff serving food can't speak your language let alone understand ) . For the love of god, learn some basic English. Rather than pointing to the food you want to eat at the buffet, learn to say ' Can I please have some of ...  ' or ' I would like some of..., please '  Also,  say THANK YOU to the staff who take your drinks and plates from your table.

reviews.author: Bc. Patrik Boháč
reviews.text: Very nice place with unfortunatelly not so interesting sea. Nice beach, very nice hotel staff, plenty of food of any type in the buffet-style restaurant. Most of the visitors are italian, as the neighbouring hotel. There are 3 pools, all of them salty. Beach bar, bar near the restaurant and some food available through the whole day. Friendly animation team that made the vacation more interesting and fun. All the staff was very friendly and willing to help you. Hakuna matata.

reviews.author: Traveler
reviews.text: Great satisfaction with the hotel and even more satisfaction with the staff.  The room is beautifully cleaned every day, everyone in the restaurant works hard and takes away the dishes quickly, brings drinks and everyone smiles. We really liked the food, especially the seafood at dinner, the selection was not huge but it was enough.  Maybe for breakfast I would have more non-sweet pastries.  Rooms huge, a bit outdated.  What bothered me was the air conditioning right above the bed, it couldn't be adjusted very well and it blew behind our necks.  The dining times could also be adjusted better, for example dinner at 8 in the evening is quite late and closing the bar at 10 when the evening program starts at 10 is a bad idea in my opinion.  I was missing a "do not disturb" sign in the room, otherwise I am satisfied with everything, the program was also good and I praise the hotel, that the beach boys cannot go to the sunbeds.  I warmly recommend.

name: Ocean Sports
address: 1 Ocean Sports Road Off, Turtle Bay Road, Watamu, Kenya
editorial_summary: Casual beach resort offering a restaurant & a bar, plus an outdoor pool, tennis & water sports.

reviews.author: Sharer Sale
reviews.text: I quite enjoyed my meal. They do fish & chips quite well, and my takeaway sushi was good, too. The service was good, too. I went there on a Sunday, and there was jazz. That, along with the views, was superb! I will definitely visit again.

reviews.author: Kim Maritz
reviews.text: Wow wow wow! Ocean Sports never disappoints. We had a swim in the new upgraded pool, the whole area was beautiful. The food was spectacular and fish was incredibly fresh. Staff are very friendly and everything we needed was tended to with care! The OS boutique had everything we needed and more! Sunday buffet curry lunch was delicious with a wonderful band playing and a breathtaking view. Truly one of my favourite places on earth. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Vittorio Ilio Carboni
reviews.text:
As usual , since 2005 , we approach Ocean Sport x dinner and aperitifs.
Special prawns served in several ways , good GinTonic fantastic , amazing location. Good prices ;   sadness due one reason  ; I'm italian and if you desire good service, good quality, nice service and constantly quality  ,sometimes need escape from location with italian management.

reviews.author: Geoffrey
reviews.text: One of the best hotels and with good beaches in Turtle Bay beach. Majority of customers speaks Spanish and Italian. However, most foods are sea foods ---so, I didn't find most foods meeting my lists.

reviews.author: Alan Welsh
reviews.text: What a fabulous stay at Ocean Sports – we could not have been happier. The staff are fantastic: warm, helpful, and they really care. This is not a 5-star hotel, but it is an authentic 3-star with 5-star service. The location is amazing, and we were absolutely delighted with our stay.

name: Kobe Suite Resort
address: Plot 40 Turtle Bay Road, Watamu, Kenya
editorial_summary: Relaxed quarters in a casual resort offering a restaurant & 2 outdoor pools, plus beach access.

reviews.author: Ulyana Vincheva
reviews.text:
At the end of January 2026, we spent 4 unforgettable days at Kobe Suite Resort, and our stay was so exceptional that when we decided to extend our time in Kenya, as soon as we found an available suite slot, we grabbed it immediately — and very soon (in 3 days) we will be returning for another 5 nights at this magical place!
We visited almost all the beaches in Watamu and we can say without a doubt that Kobe Suite Resort is located on one of the most beautiful beaches in the area. Fine white sand, turquoise water, and a sense of peace and harmony with nature. The hotel features two wonderful saltwater pools set in a very beautiful garden.
The restaurant offers an incredible view and is of an extremely high standard — delicious food, fresh seafood, and an amazing atmosphere. The service is exceptionally professional, warm, and personal, and the staff make guests feel truly special.
What makes this place truly unique is that it offers everything — complete privacy and tranquility when you want it, but also the opportunity to socialize. The restaurant is one of the best places in the area for lunch and meeting people from different parts of the world.
The view of the Indian Ocean, the kites soaring above the water, and the stunning photographs that are part of the hotel’s interior and add an incredible African charm are things that will stay in my heart forever.
The place exudes comfort, style, and authenticity — perfect both for a full relaxation holiday and for a romantic getaway.
An amazing place with one of the best value-for-money ratios we have ever experienced (me and my husband travel a lot).
We wholeheartedly recommend this place as “must stayed” in the magic Watamu:-) 🤎

reviews.author: hamish phillips
reviews.text:
Very disappointing stay

After a 3-hour drive from Diani, where we’d had a fantastic stay elsewhere, the welcome here felt lukewarm. We were placed in a “Standard Suite” (No. 22), which was more like a budget apartment: windowless bedroom, dated décor, stained bedding, very firm bed, mosquitoes but no net, and no AC in the living area. At £290 per night, this was extremely poor value.

The bathroom was hot, dark, and smelly, with a weak, noisy shower. When we raised concerns shortly after arrival, staff seemed confused rather than apologetic and offered no solution or follow-up, despite alternative rooms showing online availability.

Non-guests are allowed to use facilities, meaning no priority for paying guests — sunbeds were often unavailable, once entirely. Service overall was inconsistent, sometimes slow or rude, and bills contained errors. Breakfast was repetitive and basic.

We moved rooms after two nights to a higher category, but aside from more light it wasn’t much better, and again no one checked in. A dolphin excursion booked through the hotel was late, disorganised, and poor value.

Check-out was equally indifferent — no one asked how our stay was until we raised issues ourselves. For a property positioning itself as high-end and charging premium prices, the lack of service and attention to detail was striking. This was one of the most disappointing hotel experiences we’ve had

reviews.author: Holly Suzanne Brown
reviews.text:
A wonderful property for couples and families, stunning beach, great staff and fab facilities.

Liked · The beach location was superb with good amounts of loungers to view the ocean and access to the beach was great allow for privacy and protection from those on the beach without obstructing views of the beach. The various locations to sit around the 2 pools were above what is normal provided at other properties. The staff across the whole hotel were exceptional, professional and helpful.
The beach front restaurant had a great variety of locations to sit, drink and eat, from lunch to dinner time, with menu choices and prices comparable to lots of other Watamu restaurants.
Beautiful lush gardens are well maintained and the paths through the compound give a relaxed and tropical feel.
All in all a great hotel to stay at for the price, location and facilities.

Disliked · The breakfast whilst the quality was not bad, it was limited in variety and quantity based on other properties in the same price point.
Whilst parking is offered, there is no onsite parking at all. It is noted that the hotel does have helpful security staff outside the compound on the public beach access road, assisting guests to find parking spots.

reviews.author: Melissa M.
reviews.text:
I came here with some friends to enjoy the premises with a day pass and have lunch at their beachside restaurant. The location is beautiful with friendly and attentive staff and nice comfortable loungers. The staff served us fresh orange juice when we arrived, which was a nice touch. In addition to the beach, there are two pools with sparkling crystalline waters what were calling my name. A beautiful setting all around.

The restaurant overlooks the water and has a great menu — my friends and I all ordered different meals and shared from each other. Looking forward to coming back here.

reviews.author: Jone K H
reviews.text:
Nice and very clean rooms. The staff was amazing, thumbs up to everyone for being nice and welcoming (this was the best overall hotell staff we had on our 2 week trip around in Kenya). Food is good at prices at the same level as similar places in Watamu.

The beach access is great to have. Location is also good, you get a bit of a private, not so crowdy feel, with only 15 mins drive to the city of Watamu.

All in all an easy given 5 star review.

reviews.author: Loui K
reviews.text: Very decent resort, stayed at the house, the lounge too small, bedrooms are ok, the showers oh dear they need work the water trickles down, kitchen needs work, lacks utensils!the pool is practical, very tranquil a place! so cool in the mist of the Watamu heat, super close to the beach,beautiful beach I might add & Willies restaurant & bar & many other eateries…Stuff’s alright, Joseph is more than helpful better than the indifferent manager! I’d visit again but sure hope they fix the showers!

reviews.author: Colleen
reviews.text: We had an amazing stay here! The property is beautiful with cool hangout areas scattered around, some with sea views if you climb upstairs. Rooms were large, comfortable and had hot showers. Location excellent and staff wonderful. Beautiful pool and short walk to the beach and lots of shops and restaurants. They were kind enough to let us leave our bakkie parked there for a few days while we flew to Lamu in exchange for a staff tip at our discretion. However there is very limited parking so be sure to ask in advance if this is possible. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Martine de Z
reviews.text: Great place! Best to take a room with aircon as it is hot at the Kenyan coast. But they have good fans otherwise. We loved the pool, the fresh coconuts, the great breakfast on the beautiful terrace. And it is very close to a beautiful beach

reviews.author: Dražen Stanković
reviews.text:
A beautiful resort, near the beach. Amazing garden and the pool. The staff was very helpful and service was excellent.
Freshly made juices and sea food were exceptional.

reviews.author: eñaut Betiri irazabalbeitia Barandiaran
reviews.text:
A small paradise 300m from the beach.

Beautiful resort, nicely decorated, with a clean pool and very friendly staff.

Unbeatable value for money for the rooms, even though breakfast and other food options are expensive.

The room was compact but had a nice outdoor patio to relax.

It's out of the main road, but really close to the beach.

Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Emily Bourke
reviews.text:
Not Italian? Avoid!!!

I helped pay for my friend’s honeymoon here and was sad to hear they had such awful experience that I can see is reflected in the other reviews left here. Staff are polite and accommodating to Italian guests, but openly cold and dismissive to non-Italians. The difference in service was blatant and unacceptable. Discrimination like this has no place in hospitality, avoid if you expect to be treated with basic respect.

Stick to the local Kenyan places!!

reviews.author: E V
reviews.text:
