Beautiful location and complex.
The beach is made of white soft flour sand and the pool large and beautiful.

It is more of a club than a hotel. There is no room service but a very good buffet and very attentive service in the restaurant.
It is tend by and customers are mostly Italian but they do translate whenever it is possible in English.

Valentina is brilliant. Very effective and professional.

The place is spotless, clean, beautifully decorated, and tended.
They were able to organise a special diner for us on the beach to celebrate a special occasion. It was just perfect.

We had a very good family time overall after a lukewarm start with "not so good" rooms assigned, and they were quite adamant to see us leave the room on time and, if possible, before.
Apart from that, there is nothing to complain about.
It would have been a perfect stay without it, but we are still very close to it anyway.

reviews.author: Zuzanna Dziewirz
reviews.text: I am disappointed with my stay at the hotel. It seems like they prioritize Italian guests over others. For example, the spa menu or any other atractions are in Italian which made it difficult to navigate. When we went on a private safari, our car wasn’t allowed to drop us off properly at the hotel lobby (like come on seriously this is how you treat your guests?) it felt like very poor treatment towards non-Italian guests (as their safari cars went to the lobby without any problems - we saw it). I’ve also never encountered in a good hotel a rule when you have to pay for WiFi if you want to have it in the room. Additionally, the staff’s English skills were quite limited as they were communicating in italian, making it difficult to understands the guest needs. If it comes to the food service – there’s a high risk that some dishes will be gone super fast as the staff is not changing the plates or is very slow to replenish the food. The meal times are restrictive too, only 1,5 h window for lunch and dinner with dinner starting as late as 8 PM or even later as they were never on time. Breakfast ends at 10 as well as the checkout time which is not convenient at all. Overall, the quality of service is poor and if you’re not fluent in Italian you must be aware that you might encounter such inconvenience.

reviews.author: courtney rey
reviews.text: This place is beautiful but it is impossible to sleep. The clubs on the beach are super noisy and keep us up all night. Then the mosque blasts ghoulish prayers from 4-530am every day. We are exhausted. Not exactly a restful vacation.

reviews.author: Alexandros
reviews.text: I am speechless. A lot of seaweed washes up on the beach in front of the hotel every day. A whole lot of plastic waste in the middle of the algae. The hotel staff collects the algae and throws it and the plastic 50 meters further back into the sea so that the guests have a "clean" beach. All the plastic waste ends up back in the sea. Really sad to see!!! That’s a shame!

name: Aquarius Beach Resort
editorial_summary: Simply furnished rooms in an elegant seasonal resort featuring a lagoon-style pool & a restaurant.

reviews.author: Lissa Green
reviews.text: Very well cooked food and lovely staff. Beautiful pool. Standard room with poor water pressure. Overpriced laundry. Miserably lost a bit of the "African Vibe" as heavily populated and catering for Italians, could well be in Europe inside the resort.

reviews.author: Mary Langan
reviews.text:
I stayed here for 3 nights and found it to be great value for money. I did the all inclusive option (which does not include alcohol) and the food was varied and delicious throughout my stay. I had no problem finding food I liked in the buffet even as a vegetarian and I found the pasta station and fresh fruit station really lovely. Also much better coffee than expected.

The grounds are lush and well maintained and it's a very relaxing pleasant atmosphere. There's a lot of lounges everywhere that invite sitting and chilling.

The pool was well maintained with plenty of pool chairs and shade as needed. Lots of staff around as well.

The bar was fine (though gave off a smell of wood sealant) and the recommended red was delicious. The daily cocktail is also a great option, at 3.5USD it's a steal.

The room was more than adequate (I chose a basic room) with functional ac, good pillows and daily servicing. However I did have a problem with no water for a few hours. I also was in a room (38b) near the reception area which may account for why my Internet seemed to be better than many others. I was able to stream music and video which was far more than I expected.

The photos showing the beach are deceptive. This hotel is not oceanfront as much as it is adjacent to a hotel that is oceanfront and maintains a relationship with said hotel where guests can access their pools and beach. It's a 5 minute walk up a catwalk which crosses a road and a hike across the entire lily palm property to reach the beach. I thought there might be some sort of distinctions between Aquarius club patrons and lily palm patrons while using these facilities but there was not (which was great). After the first walk, the hike also did not seem very far either, you just need to be prepared for it.

Other reviewers had an issue with paying up front. I find it perfectly fine and that's how they did it so please be prepared to do so.

Mauro, the property manager was super nice and went out of his way to make everyone's stay pleasant.

This place is much much better if you speak italian and I really hesitate to recommend it to non-italian speakers. Also, avoid watamu in late July if you can since the chance of rain is still very high.

reviews.author: Holly Suzanne Brown
reviews.text:
A lastminute booking over new year, Aquarius was an ok choice.  The rooms were clean if not a little cramped. The pool was nice and relatively empty,  this only applies to the pool and accommodation set back off the beach.
The pool on the beach front was loud, full and terrible.
Food was basic but ok, very little choice and as expected from malindi Italian in style and theme.
All inclusive is a con, drinks served in pathetic small plastic cups, warm warm and horrible, bar staff were unhelpful and unwilling to do pool side drinks service even though we were the only guests around the common areas.
The manager was lovely though assisting us to book place at a private beach.
For the money there are better options, especially if you are not Italian, however it is central and the back property(not be accepted front) is well maintained and peaceful.

reviews.author: Dr. Ramesh Shah
reviews.text: Very nice self catered cottages and you are provided with a house help and a cook. Very helpful and the cook is simply amazing with sea food and pastas. Their are 2 swimming pools and surrounding gardens are beautiful. The beach is very nice as it is in a bay.

reviews.author: Michela Mauri
reviews.text:
Really nice Resort in Watamu.
Elena, the owner is really kind and always available for any need. Italian cucine, very clean and peaceful place to spend and enjoy your time in Africa

name: Crystal Bay Resort
editorial_summary: Relaxed seaside resort with a private beach area, a golf course & 2 outdoor pools, plus dining.

reviews.author: Lujain Abbas
reviews.text:
This was a great stay! My friends and I thoroughly enjoyed our vacation. The staff and manager were helpful and quite flexible when needed.

The food was good as well. The Italian influence could definitely be felt. If you feel a little adventurous, Tamu Restaurant is also a few steps away from the resort and you can sample more authentic Italian dishes.

We booked the sea front rooms and couldn't get enough of the amazing property. I mean, just look at the pictures.

They will be seeing me soon! That's for sure.

reviews.author: Huzaifa Hameed
reviews.text:
Great location. Amazing beach, beautiful pool. The food is great too. The rooms are spacious and the beds comfortable.

Service is fast and the hospitality is amazing..I went with a seven months old baby, and they were very accommodating on all our requirements. Thank you...

reviews.author: Mwangi Kirubi
reviews.text: In most hotels I've stayed at in the coast, I've found cleanliness not be a strength. Crystal Bay has changed that. The rooms are spanking clean and well appointed, making one feel very welcome. My highlight was the buffet spread in the restaurant, especially the dinner. Lots of options with a sprinkling of Swahili delicacies to choose from. The service was also very good, despite the hotel being at capacity. Crystal Bay is definitely a consideration next time I'm in Watamu.

reviews.author: Khalil Jessani
reviews.text: The location is absurdly stunning, the views of the ocean with rock islands and sand y beach although with a lot of seaweed is beautiful. Lots of small pcs of plastic visible from the sea creeping in to or ingrained visibly in to the sand on this coast, the hotel seemed to be doing their best to weed tons of it out. Rooms are ok, food is ok, service is a little below par for tourism especially on work speed but have somewhat the right attitude. Very beautiful location and decent place to stay, I would be back comfortably.

reviews.author: Brian Matini
reviews.text: WOW it's a fantastic hotel at the heart of Watamu immediately next to the beach with two very clean swimming pools a beautiful garden view and a breathtaking Seaview. The resort has a poolside bar but there is also a beach bar with a variety of pocket friendly exotic foods drinks and cocktails. The rooms have air conditioner and a fan. I would recommend this resort anytime

name: The Charming Lonno Lodge Watamu
address: Kanani RD - Malindi - Kilifi District KE, Watamu, Kenya
editorial_summary: Chic, airy rooms & suites in an upscale, castle-style hotel offering a restaurant & a pool.

reviews.author: Jen Lindsay
reviews.text: What a gorgeous and relaxing place to enjoy!! Sylvia and the entire team were wonderful! The care and attention put into all details at Lonna Lodge are so amazing and enjoyable. The food is natural and delicious with plenty of variety!  It was so sweet that for two mornings we needed to leave early they packed us a breakfast to go, we hadn’t even asked! I wish I were still laying at the pool enjoying the serenity of it and the beautiful ocean view and breeze.  They can connect you with a Tuk Tuk contact which makes it super easy to get around Watamu. You definitely will enjoy your stay here!

reviews.author: Malte Weidemann
reviews.text: We can only full-heartedly recommend to stay at Lonno Lodge. It's the best place to stay at Watamu. It's a small, boutique-style resort with great houses, an amazing pool, very friendly staff, good food and charming hosts, Silvia and Aldo. When our domestic  flights back to Nairobi got cancelled, Silvia helped us plan and book an alternative route incl. drivers and train rides. If you're looking for a nice place to relax after a safari or hike, this is you place. You can also easily explore Watamu and the staff will help you around. Can only recommend.

reviews.author: Markayla Stroubakis
reviews.text: We would HIGHLY recommend staying at the Lonno Lodge! It is a beautifully, thoughtfully laid out and appointed, peaceful property (very few guest rooms) with an expansive view of the sea. We loved the saltwater pool and the restaurant. This is the place you book if you want to relax, but still can be close to many other attractions in the area. Silvia and her team (all of whom exemplified hospitality) are proactive and so helpful with their recommendations and helping you have the best vacation possible!  On a personal note, I was dealing with some medical issues upon arriving and Silvia was extremely helpful and patient in explaining how to navigate the Kenyan medical system and providing a supportive and helpful ear (I say this to show just how wonderful of people they are.) This place is truly such a gem and made our vacation!

reviews.author: Ulyana Vincheva
reviews.text:
Fantastic experience at The Charming Loono Lodge, Watamu, Kenya
We spent 5 unforgettable days at The Charming Loono Lodge together with my husband, and we can honestly say that this place exceeded all our expectations. From the moment we arrived, we discovered a wonderful atmosphere – peaceful, cozy, and truly inspiring, combining the beauty of nature with the feeling of a real home away from home.
The place is exceptionally clean, and the interior is designed with great attention to every detail. The feeling of Africa is 100% authentic, warm, and very inspiring. The Charming Loono Lodge offers something rare: true privacy, Swahili-inspired design, Italian warmth, and an oceanfront setting that invites silence and wonder.
The service was truly incredible – professional, attentive, and always with a smile. What impressed us the most was the kind and sincere attitude from the owner, Silvia, which during our stay grew into a genuine friendship.
The breakfast was prepared with high-quality products, and you could feel the attention to every detail. The chef in the kitchen is amazing – every dish was delicious, fresh, and served with care.
We would especially like to thank Silvia – a person with a big heart and exceptional professionalism. She answered all our questions and wishes, introduced us to valuable people, and helped us with quality contacts and recommendations that made our experience even more meaningful and unforgettable.
We didn’t feel just like guests, but like truly welcomed friends. This human approach turned our stay into something much more than just a vacation.
We would definitely return if we travel to Kenya in the future.
Silvia, thank you for the warm hospitality!

reviews.author: Be A
reviews.text:
e Charming Lonno Lodge was just what we needed and it did not disappoint.
We found it homely and welcoming when we first arrived.
The staff are all amazing. Nixon our driver was ever so helpful from when we were picked up at the airport to when we wanted to go for sightseeing around Watamu. Grace made sure we received the best stay at Lonno. The staff were all attentive, kind and friendly.
The rooms were nicely decorated, spacious, clean and with excellent views of the beach and ocean, we really enjoyed our rooms.
Food was specially prepared and served with different dishes.
There was no unnecessary noise so it was a relaxing experience for us.

name: Lily Palm Resort
editorial_summary: Colourful rooms in a laid-back beachfront resort offering a restaurant & an outdoor pool.

reviews.author: Simone Guida
reviews.text:
•Lily Palm Resort is an excellent choice for travellers visiting Watamu, offering a romantic environment alongside many helpful amenities designed to enhance your stay.
You’ll enjoy relaxing #rooms that offer a refrigerator and air conditioning, and you can stay connected during your stay as Lily Palm Resort offers guests free internet access.
Plus, Lily Palm Resort offers a #pool and breakfast, providing a pleasant respite from your busy day. •.

reviews.author: Joy Mugao
reviews.text:
The place is amazing and stunning. Perfect for couples , photos nice views and the perfect vacation.

However the WiFi is very bad not good to work with or even receive calls.
They definitely need to improve on that. In a world where people want to work remotely this should not be a concern .
If you are looking to work while on your trip this is not the place for you.

reviews.author: June Leech
reviews.text: I came here a few times about 3 years ago, my experience then was wonderful. I am not usually a repeat traveler but my first experience was too great it made me come back 3 more times. I traveled during off-peak seasons so I enjoyed the resort and services thoroughly. I had nothing to complain about. The food was great, the staff were friendly and always helpful, the room was clean and being cleaned daily as well, I had the time of my life by their multiple pools and the beach. The Resort is beach front with white sands, really breathtaking especially during sunrise. I made so many international and local friends here with whom I'm still in touch today. I loved my times here. I hope the standards have held up.

reviews.author: Bianca Njoki
reviews.text: Gentrification. All games are run in Italian only. Zero stars. Bella ciao ciao or wtv

reviews.author: Jade Louise
reviews.text:
I stayed here with 3 friends for a weekend.

Positives-
•Pool facilities were great
•Location was good
• Value for money
• Front of house staff were friendly
• Book process and as easy and check in was simple
• Pizza at the restaurant was good

Negatives-
• The staff round the pool chat up women. All of us were made to feel uncomfortable at some point. While i understand that sometimes people are being friendly, being pestered and bothered while trying to relax is not okay. Staff asked for photos with us, To come hang and lingered.
• The spa. while it was average the price was good
• The cocktails didn’t really have ice and came lukewarm. Menu items were not as described
• You are given one small bottle of water in your room at check in and it’s not restocked throughout your whole stay

reviews.author: Becky Wanga
reviews.text:
Our experience at Cacuki boutique house,within Rafiki Tamu.was wonderful.
We got a warm welcome and we were immediately shown to our unit. However, we did experience initial difficulty locating the property as the map directions provided were inaccurate, requiring us to ask local assistance from boda boda riders.(Before we checked out, we pinned the correct location on the map)
The house was spotlessly clean, spacious, and beautiful. We particularly enjoyed the outdoor dining area where we had our breakfast and evening meals. My children truly loved the entire space. I would highly recommend this house.

Minor Downside:The only minor inconvenience involved my young son's money (a small amount )which he had placed in the safe and later forgot about. After informing the manager Winnie, the follow-up process to confirm the situation was delayed and the matter was unresolved.

Despite this small matter, I would definitely go back and I would highly recommend this beautiful place

reviews.author: Eve
reviews.text: Clean spacious rooms, very friendly service.  Breakfast was simple, we loved the fruits 😊. We enjoyed our 3days stay.

reviews.author: Ahmed Said
reviews.text:
Rafiki Tamu Residential Resort is a hidden gem when it comes to spacious rooms and expert staff service. From the moment you arrive, you are greeted with warm hospitality and attentive care from the knowledgeable staff. The rooms are impeccably clean, well-designed, and offer ample space to relax and unwind.

One of the highlights of the resort is the breathtaking beach view that can be enjoyed from the rooms. Waking up to the sound of the waves crashing against the shore and the sight of the sun rising over the horizon is a truly magical experience. Whether you choose to sit on your private balcony or take a leisurely stroll along the sandy beach, the view is simply mesmerizing.

The staff at Rafiki Tamu Residential Resort are truly exceptional, providing top-notch service that caters to every guest's needs. They go above and beyond to ensure that your stay is comfortable and memorable, offering personalized attention and friendly assistance at every turn.

Overall, Rafiki Tamu Residential Resort is a perfect choice for those seeking a luxurious getaway with spacious rooms, expert staff service, and stunning beach views. It is a place where you can truly relax and rejuvenate amidst the beauty of nature and the comforts of a well-appointed resort.

reviews.author: Coral Reef Care
reviews.text: This is a beautiful place, spacious and nicely designed. We stayed at low season, so it was relatively quiet. The staff is super friendly and helpful. All the apartments have a separate generator in case the electricity shuts down. This happens on a regular basis. All these generators together create an enormous noise, which is truly annoying. And of course, the pollution/emission it creates  is a matter of concern. Why not use solar? Furthermore, there are no refill water stations in the rooms, so everyone buys plastic bottles. And we all know waste management in the area is very poorly organised. A hotel like this can save 1000s of bottles per month by making this simple extra effort. We discussed both problems with the owners and they are looking into solar as we speak and will hopefully solve the water issue.

reviews.author: David L Watson
reviews.text: Very nice accomodation. Breakfast is cooked fresh in your room and served on the balcony. You can walk to the beachbut it's easy to take a Tuktuk. We got a good price with one driver and called when we needed him. He recommended places we would not have found alone. Diving in Winter is limited to inside the reef as it's very windy every day.

reviews.author: Kcey Wanjiku
reviews.text: 5 bedroom houses, can be booked for less rooms on low seasons. The location is perfect, like 7mins away from town. All kitchen equipments available but need to sharpen their knives. Heated pool, guard can wash your car…at a small fee. However, the lady, liz was moving around too much like wanting to be invited for drinks 🫢 we did not like that.

reviews.author: Chelsea Mukuha
reviews.text: Such an amazing house especially if you have a large group. It’s very spacious and beautiful. The pool had to be the best part especially because it’s heated at night. My friends and I had the best weekend there and would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Nanyuki. The host, Liz was incredibly welcoming and was always there to assist us in anything. 10/10 place for sure!!

reviews.author: Isaac Nzainga
reviews.text: Liz was a super host. We loved the heated pool and the great customer service plus the chefs were on point. Very delicious and yuuuuuuummy food. Thanks see you soon.

reviews.author: MUTUKU PATRICK MWANGANGI
reviews.text:
We had an excellent Roadtrip and Getaway with Family and friends for our Kids Birthday..Cozy home..Good space for kids to play..and swim..though the pool was not heating well as expected.. can do better.
The best thing that happened to us was the Chef...That Ninja can cook🙌!!
I would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Mitchelle Mwaura
reviews.text: Exceptional customer service, perfect location, and the House is so huge! It's really such a great stay. Highly recommend. 👌🏼👌🏼👌🏼

name: Esiankiki Resort & Spa
address: Esiankiki Resort - Nanyuki Highway Esiankiki resort, Nanyuki, Kenya

reviews.author: Rono Geoffrey
reviews.text:
Have you ever been to a place where when you leave you feel like  you will leave your heart behind?
Come to Esiankiki in Nanyuki.

It's a wonderful place with fresh air and away from noise and bustle. Its setting and service is  of a class of its own.e
and the swimming pool is heated.  Trust me you want to dive in and feel the goodness.

Entertainment includes a band playing outside bear a fountain which keeps changing colors g

The Conference rooms come with state of the art tech and a wall to wall carpet that leaves you wanting to roll around on the floor.

reviews.author: Eric Mwangi
reviews.text: Very good food, restaurant and accomodation is top notch,nice green grounds.

reviews.author: anne gathirwa
reviews.text: Am a regular customer there quality service.just love their food especially the kienyeji chicken.very dedicated staffs

reviews.author: IRENE MUCHINA
reviews.text: Best of the Best. Waiters attentive, foood amaziiing . Rooms very clean and beautifullll lighting n everything just right

reviews.author: Michelle Mbuthia
reviews.text: The service is great but food is bad. My entire team had food poisoning but it was termed an isolated incident. The internet is also very shaky.

reviews.author: ONESMUS MUTUNGA
reviews.text: A very lovely place excellent service  in every perspective from foods and drinks to accommodation

reviews.author: Asaline Kiok
reviews.text: Very good services and clean rooms, and a very worm and lovely receptionist Lavender. We really enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: Dr. Allan Wafula Wekesa
reviews.text: Good location - Right in Nanyuki town. Close to Nanyuki Mall. Service was good. Loved the breakfast. Rooms are average but well priced.

reviews.author: Rodah Chepkorir
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay here, good services

reviews.author: Calvin Peter's
reviews.text: Well designed for holding meeting ..I highly recommend .

name: Tufaha Resort
address: Daiga, Nyariginu, Box 244 Laikipia, District:, Laikipia East District, Nanyuki, Kenya

reviews.author: Priscilla Wangeci
reviews.text:
Our family had an absolutely wonderful stay at Tufaha Resort in Nanyuki. We were a large group, and despite making some last-minute changes, the staff and management were incredibly accommodating and flexible. They truly went above and beyond to ensure our stay was comfortable and stress-free.

What really stood out was their level of care and attentiveness. Both the staff and management checked in on us frequently to make sure we had everything we needed and that we were enjoying our stay. They even helped organize a last-minute game drive to Ol Pejeta Conservancy, which turned out to be one of the highlights of our trip.

From the warm hospitality to the exceptional service, Tufaha Resort made us feel genuinely welcomed and well taken care of. We are very grateful for the effort they put into making our family stay so memorable, and we would highly recommend this resort to anyone visiting Nanyuki—especially families or large groups. We would happily stay here again!

reviews.author: Angela Muthoni
reviews.text:
Tufaha Resort is a hidden gem!
This was a rare occurrence where the pictures of the Resort matched the real deal. It's beautiful place, that gave us the boutique hotel experience.

The rooms were clean! Beautiful layout for the studio and they had terraces so big you could host a party.

The main building and restaurant were cozy, having the right ratio of comfort and warmth in all the guest spaces.

At the restaurant we were treated to a fine dining experience every night and proper buffet every morning. Our 1st night meal portions were small but as soon as we said it, the chef adjusted the servings every other night. Thanks Chef!

The staff listened and attended to our needs. Special thanks to Joy, Ruth, Elizabeth, Dorcas and Kezia who made our booking and accommodation so seamless.
And the whole staff for restoring our faith in customer service.

reviews.author: Gift Maseno
reviews.text:
Tufaha is a beautiful restaurant and resort nestled in the highlands of Nanyuki. While the main downside is the access road — it’s off-road with a long, rough murram stretch that can be quite tedious — the experience once you arrive makes the journey worthwhile.

The resort itself is very ambient, quiet, and serene. When we visited, there weren’t many people around, which made the stay even more enjoyable and peaceful. The rooms were lovely — very spacious, self-contained, and equipped with a bathtub, which was a great touch and added to the comfort of the stay.

The food was good overall, though I do feel the service could be improved. The staff was friendly and welcoming, but there’s room for growth in terms of professionalism and table etiquette.

That said, Tufaha is a beautiful place with a calm atmosphere and great accommodation, and overall, we had a pleasant experience. It’s definitely worth visiting if you’re looking for a peaceful getaway in Nanyuki.

reviews.author: Jennie Wachira
reviews.text:
Tufaha Resort, Nanyuki, is truly a hidden gem.
From the moment we arrived, the tranquility and beautiful ambience set the tone for a perfect getaway. The studios are exceptionally clean, classy, and well-maintained, offering true 5-star comfort and treatment.
The food was fresh from the farm, delicious, and thoughtfully prepared, while the games and entertainment were simply amazing—and the heated pool, there was something for everyone to enjoy. What truly stood out was the hospitality: warm, caring reception, always accompanied by inviting smiles that made us feel right at home.
Tufaha Resort is an ideal destination for both family and friends. Special kudos to the manager, Kiptum, for his hands-on approach, ensuring everything ran smoothly and for genuinely connecting with the guests.
We had an incredible experience and will definitely be back again.

reviews.author: Winnie Wambugu
reviews.text:
The resort is beautiful. We really enjoyed visiting the farm and learning about how they produce their fresh vegetables; it adds a unique, educational touch to the visit.

A tip for those coming from Nanyuki town: avoid the shortest route as it can be confusing through rural areas….take the longer, easier-to-navigate route instead.

We visited during the festive season, and the place was very busy. It took about 45 minutes for someone to take our orders, so if you go during peak times, be prepared for a wait. That said, the ambiance and overall experience made it worthwhile.

I would definitely recommend visiting during the offseason for a more relaxed experience.

reviews.author: Shanice Asoma
reviews.text:
Great clean place that’s on the road and not too difficult to locate.
Thank you Diana for your professionalism and I’ll sure be back again

reviews.author: Jullie Blake
reviews.text: Such an amazing place the Cozy Haven, great view, artistic decor, very chic, very high-tech and the host Diana, is also very warm, always available when you need her, welcoming and friendly. I really enjoyed my stay. Want to come back real soon.

reviews.author: MICHAEL MAJIMBO
reviews.text:
If you're looking for a peaceful and well-kept place to stay in Nanyuki, I highly recommend Cozy Haven Homestay. It's conveniently located just off the Nanyuki Highway, directly opposite Moran Lounge.

The space is spotless, beautifully arranged, and equipped with all the amenities you’d need for a comfortable stay. Whether you're passing through or planning a longer visit, this place truly feels like a home away from home. I had an amazing experience and would definitely go back!

reviews.author: Evans Adagala
reviews.text: In deed it's a cozy haven just as the name suggests. One of the best places I've been too. The ambience is top notch. Enough secure parking, water available throughout, the decor wueh superb. Did I mention they have a strong reliable WiFi what else am I leaving out...it was a home away from home and it's good to note that I've got a hidden spot whenever I'm around Nanyuki and its environs. I vouch for Cozy Haven. Will be sure to come back again

reviews.author: Alex Williams
reviews.text:
We stayed here twice either side of trekking Mt Kenya and it was absolutely perfect!
Diana couldn't have been more helpful and the accommodation itself was clean, spacious and kitchen well equipped. Quickmart and several good food places less than 10mins walk away. Club opposite was a bit  noisy at the weekend but didn't bother us.

Highly recommend if you need somewhere to stay in Nanyuki!

reviews.author: Sam Miqi
reviews.text: Great hidden gem with really grand villas each with a pool & a Jacuzzi at the top. You get to live how you’d wish to live for a couple of days. They also have a tennis court in the compound and serve great meals.

reviews.author: mehreen adam
reviews.text:
The villas are lovely and the private plunge pool and jacuzzi were a real highlight—perfect for relaxing and enjoying the surroundings.

The staff were generally very helpful and friendly. On the first day, there was a hiccup where specific dietary requirements for members of the group, which had been communicated in advance, were unfortunately overlooked. However, the team handled it well and completely made up for it during dinner that evening and breakfast the next day. The manager was especially helpful and ensured everything was sorted promptly.

One downside is the road Google Maps directs you through—it’s in very poor condition and can be quite challenging, so plan accordingly.

Overall, a lovely place to stay with great service and beautiful grounds.would definitely recommend, just be mindful of the access road.

reviews.author: Nakandi Daphine
reviews.text: First of all, the food was on point. My villa was good. The villa settings is most suitable for families. The place is big enough to have a morning walk or run and hit your target, in other words it huge! I walked from the restaurant to my villa late in the night (willingly coz I enjoyed it) peacefully. My room was spacious with a balcony. The roof top pool had heated water. Generally, I loved and enjoyed my stay at my villa. It's about 45 minutes from Nanyuki town...maybe because of the rough road...but that part of the experience.

reviews.author: Suz
reviews.text:
Not a good experience. No hot water in the shower after the 1st guest showered. Hot tub is advised as rooftop and open until 10. You have to reserve a tine. At noon at check in we reserved a 9 pm time, confirmed the time before dinner with front desk worker Lizzy.Hot tub was half filled & cold at 9.
Also we asked for a luggage pickup at checkout, Lizzy said ‘not possible the golf cart is broken’. So guests needed to walk from the villas with their luggage to lobby on a cobblestone street over quarter of a mile . Front desk service worker was not only not helpful but extremely rude. Restaurant workers were all excellent. All the other  workers we encountered beyond the front desk were above average.
Grounds, amenities & villas need updates & maintenance.

reviews.author: Wacoli F
reviews.text: Great place to unwind and chill. Serene, good food and drinks. Ask for Edna for the Spa massage experience, horseback riding was awesome too.

reviews.author: fred njora
reviews.text: We stayed at Rafiki House for two days and had a wonderful experience. The room service was excellent, prompt, attentive, and very accommodating. The food was absolutely delicious, with great variety and quality in every meal. Our stay was comfortable, relaxing, and thoroughly enjoyable. We would definitely recommend Rafiki House to anyone looking for a pleasant and memorable stay.

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.text: I've traveled to a bunch of random places over the last few months and this is the nicest place I've stayed - the cottage was pretty amazing, breakfast was great, and Obadiah was always helpful if I had questions about traveling places, etc. - I wish all the places I've stayed had been this great!

reviews.author: Nambubbi Arnold
reviews.text: A serene and convenient tiny home. It offers easy access to Nanyuki's amenities while serving as a perfect central base for exploring Laikipia, Meru, and Isiolo counties.

reviews.author: John Goro
reviews.text:
Warm host, amazing food, and flawless service. The bonfire nights and breakfast by the gazebo made it feel like home away from home.
Highly recommend you try them out!

reviews.author: Rowan Bassett
reviews.text: I spent 17 nights here, and after 9 months in Africa i have not felt more welcome anywhere else.  Obadiah is a genteman and a schollar, and is totally service minded.  The man is creative, and has thought of everything.  His new cottage is beautiful, and the rooms were we later stayed are clean, comfortable and have eveything needed.

name: Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club
address: Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club, Nanyuki, Kenya
editorial_summary: Elegant, upmarket hotel on 40 landscaped hectares offering a golf course, a spa & an outdoor pool.

reviews.author: Tina Dematos
reviews.text:
This place was spectacular the service the location and The experience was a 10 on 10.  They not only made my bucket list of reality, but it made beautiful memories for me.  I would recommend this resort to anyone who has a desire to see Kenya to have an experience of a safari and to have one that's extraordinary.   My husband and I both said it exceeded our expectations.

This service at this place was exceptional.

reviews.author: Mandy Sound
reviews.text:
Our stay at the Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club was once again exceptional. The level of service is truly outstanding, and the staff are incredibly warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. From the moment you arrive, you feel well taken care of, and their hospitality makes the entire experience even more special.

The food is excellent, with a wonderful variety and beautifully prepared dishes. Every meal is something to look forward to. The stunning surroundings and peaceful atmosphere add to the charm of the property, making it the perfect place to relax and unwind.

We have visited Fairmont many times over the years, and what stands out is their consistency. They never fail to impress us, and each visit feels just as memorable as the last. It remains one of our favourite places to return to, and we always leave looking forward to the next stay.

reviews.author: Neral Shah
reviews.text: Attending a wedding here was a truly magical experience. The backdrop of Mount Kenya is unmatched, and waking up to those views was breathtaking. The service was impeccable and refined—from the warm welcome with colobus’ on the rooftops to the attentive staff who made every guest feel special. The blend of colonial charm and modern luxury created a very romantic and historic atmosphere. Be sure to bring warm clothes, as it gets quite chilly in the evenings, though the indoor crackling fireplaces and cozy hot water bottles in the rooms were a wonderful extra touch.

reviews.author: suresh kanotra
reviews.text:
We stayed two nights and we had an amazing experience, all around, value for money. The property is upgraded and maintained to a very high standards, it is lush green, both nature and maintained. The hospitality is spot on, ask and it will be provided. I believe the leader on the ground exactly knows what is important for the guest. It takes half a ring and the phone is picked, our request was sorted out under five minutes.
The restaurant layout  during Xmas eve and the buffet spread was amazing. I am sure these standards will be maintained. I am glad we didn't travel to Dubai and Mauritius, we decided to take Holiday in Kenya. Kudos to the team!

reviews.author: Nelson Kondiwa
reviews.text: THe hotel set up is extremely perfect and comfortable. We did enjoy the stay. The staff and everyone else was just more than welcoming. A surprise änniversary"room set-up, the cake slice, decoration, was wonderful. We shall definely come back to the hotel, this time, with the kids

name: Hotel 62 Paradise, Nanyuki's Most affordable Hotel
address: Kieni Rd, Off Kimathi Rd, Nanyuki, Kenya

reviews.author: Eunice Narotho
reviews.text:
I love this place I enjoy spending at HOTEL 62 everytime I visit Nanyuki

Accessible
Clean
Friendly staff
Everything you want in a resting place

reviews.author: Martin Owino
reviews.text: Friendly attendants affordable and peaceful place

reviews.author: Juliet Waruingi
reviews.text: Good service and affordable and central to major utilities like banks malls etc

reviews.author: Stella Osore
reviews.text: Beautiful place. It's in a quiet area,the security is also great. The rooms are spacious and clean. Loved the hotel generally. Anyone visiting Nanyuki,this is the hotel to book.

reviews.author: Joel Mutai
reviews.text: Mosquitoes messed my night

reviews.author: Roselyne Kihara
reviews.text:
Farmhouse Inn is a cosy little place tucked away in a peaceful, quiet place, off Nanyuki Meru Rd, just 300 metres from the highway, and about 5minutes from Nanyuki town. It has a beautiful manicured garden with plenty of blooming flowers, a lounge with fire place/dining area make the common areas. The rooms are very spacious, clean, with plenty of natural light. If, you are a parent with kids, their spacious family room comes in handy👌
The food was tasty (highly recommend the wet fry mutton). Kelvin was very welcoming and detailed, I enjoyed my stay.

reviews.author: Miss Gachara
reviews.text: Short drive from the Nanyuki town. Clean rooms and excellent service. Beautiful and homely grounds. Bonfire available on request. Breakfast was good. Car washed on the last day. Accessible by small car when the roads are relatively dry.

reviews.author: Abdul Abdalla
reviews.text: Nice little Inn. We spent two nights. The rooms and bathrooms are as shown in the pics. Service a bit slow but acceptable. Menu was restricted and not adequate for our group but not a problem as Nanyuki town has variety of restaurants and fast food joints. Nevertheless, the Inn's Manager and his team did their best to ensure we were comfortable and well cared for - thank you so much for your great hospitality 🙏

reviews.author: Manuela Mueller
reviews.text:
Calm, green environment. Friendly, helpful staff and really comfortable bed. The hot shower had really good pressure.
I only wish there was a way to access the nearby river for a walk, but it's all blocked by fences, which is none of the hotel's fault of course.

reviews.author: EVAH MURIUKI
reviews.text: This is a real getaway plug. A very beautiful, quiet and serene place. I loved the ambience. My family loved the food and the kids games.

reviews.author: Rodgers C. Gold
reviews.text: Superb chef. Great views with a fireplace. Warm service. Wonderful experience albeit we were there for one night only, supplied us with our toddler's cot on request.

reviews.author: Zipporah van der Vijver
reviews.text: We had a quiet/ chilled out & wonderful stay at Olesamara! It’s a little hidden gem tucked away from the Nyeri–Nanyuki Highway, offering peace and privacy. The paths and trails nearby are lovely and safe for a walk, including a scenic riverside path. Breakfast was delightful and the location is very convenient — just a 7-minute drive from the Nanyuki airstrip and close to other nice spots for food. A car is recommended to explore the area comfortably. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it!

reviews.author: Manuela Mueller
reviews.text:
There are lots of cute little details in the decor and some nice landscaping with little lakes near the gate and restaurant.
I found the food not so flavourful personally speaking (dinner and breakfast). Good for a night if you want to relax: comfortable bed and the hot shower was working well.

reviews.author: Esther Nambi
reviews.text:
We visited this hotel to celebrate my husband’s birthday, and from the moment we arrived, we felt so welcomed. It was raining when we got there, and the staff thoughtfully provided umbrellas from the car to our room, such a lovely gesture.

The room was beautiful, clean, and very homely. Our meals always arrived on time, with generous portions that were incredibly filling. We also enjoyed the heated pool; it was relaxing, well maintained, and not crowded at all.

One of the highlights was the guided walk to the river. Our guide was patient, knowledgeable, and happily answered all our questions, making the experience even more memorable.

We only stayed for the weekend, but we truly wish we had planned for a longer visit. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: cheruiyot sheilah
reviews.text:
My preferred place every time I'm in Nanyuki. An exceptional stay from start to finish. Outstanding service, warm hospitality, and great attention to detail. Truly exemplary in every way—highly recommended!
A big shout out to Raymond, Tony and Jennifer (Spa Lady) for wonderful services.

name: Aberdare Royal Cottages
address: 1km from Nanyuki Airstrip, Nyeri – Nanyuki Highway, Nanyuki, Kenya

reviews.author: Erwin Ketel
reviews.text: Super reception, nice juice at check-in. We were driven with our luggage to our room just for fun, as our rooms were only 25 meters away from the reception. We arrived at 5:30 p.m. and could still enjoy the pool for half an hour. The pool attendant brought us four supervised towels for me and my son swimming. They started playing some really old music, which we liked, on a super sound system with a nice bass. Without asking once more, we were given a ball to play with in the pool. Really royal-sized shower with plenty of hot water, all the nice accessories, such as a shaver, toothbrushes, shampoo, and body wash. You're getting my point; the rooms are very well fitted out, with a really comfortable mattress combined with high-standard blankets, pillows, and such. I have traveled the world and seen many hotels in many countries. This Aberdare, super high standard, I have to say. We are going for some food now; let's see how that is. I'll report about that also. I am not an influencer, just a Kenya resident giving an honest opinion.

reviews.author: Lucy Mwangi
reviews.text:
I went here on a treat for my birthday 🎂🎉🎈.I do random trip btw 😄.And yooh this one was it.I remember soaking in the moment and enjoying my trip.Meet with new people networked, did a team building.The ambience of Aberdare royal cottage is 10/10🔥🔥🔥.The cleanliness of the place is unmatched.The swimming pool also is well maintained 🥹. Perfect for a swim on a hot day .I took my chances too utilized the chance and hopped into the deep end🫨☺️😂😂😂.Am not a swimmer but am trying😅
The green grass ooh my very good for grounding it did my legs justice 🤗💚.👉
Would I go back?! Yes Absolutely⏩⏩⏩🥰

reviews.author: Rono Geoffrey
reviews.text:
Have you ever veen to a place where when you leave you feel like  you will leave your heart behind?
Come to Aberdare prestige & royal cottages.
It's a wonderful place with fresh air and away from noise and bustle. Its setting and service is in a class of its own
The swimming pool is heated. Say that is not class! Trust me you want to dive in and feel the goodness.

Entertainment includes a band playing outside bear a fountain which keeps changing colors.

The Conference rooms come with state of the art tech.

reviews.author: Tabitha Kigo
reviews.text:
I stayed at Aberdare Cottages in the Lake Elementaita room, and it was such a lovely experience. The room was spacious, spotless, and all the appliances worked perfectly, which made the stay super comfortable.

The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful throughout. My biggest highlight was that they prepared fresh, baby-friendly meals for my 7-month-old, such a thoughtful touch that made my stay feel even more special.

Overall, a peaceful, family-friendly place with genuine hospitality. I’d definitely go back!

reviews.author: Nita Jankharia
reviews.text: Fantastic place. Seems like a hidden gem. They could probably use an upgrade to their logo. The cottage was top notch. Good quality furnishings.  Only a slight blunder with the bathroom  doors being see through and the fact that you can't open them fully.

reviews.author: Peter Kiragu
reviews.text: I highly recommend Geanna Suites Nanyuki for their incredible customer service,customized clean and secure rooms, consider booking with Geanna as individual, family or organized groups.

reviews.author: Tony Wamwea
reviews.text: This guys though has been so awesome willing to help with my laundry despite not knowing the area well and connecting me with their best rider getting me what I want on time. Anytime am in Nanyuki this is the best place to come. No strict rules no hidden costs, Thank you team

reviews.author: saju salim saidad
reviews.text: Very clean, quick response from owner and staff. Safe environment close to roads and supermarkets.

reviews.author: hyesil Kim
reviews.text:
There was no toilet bowl in the bathroom and the shower temperature was too hot, yet they did not correct it.
Other than that, the stay was fine.

reviews.author: Santana Oyoko
reviews.text: I loved the two weeks I was there, the rooms are always clean. The lady was serving us well.

name: Peaks Hotel Nanyuki
address: Along Nanyuki Meru/Isiolo Highway, 24M4+45G, Nanyuki, Kenya
editorial_summary: Low-key rooms, some offering mountain views, in a relaxed hotel featuring a restaurant & a bar.

reviews.author: Wesley Nyandika
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay here. The customer service is top notch. The rooms are amazing, the swimming pool and Sauna are so amazing.

reviews.author: Philip Maina
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at peaks Hotel.The service was top notch from the moment I arrived and the staff was incredibly warm. One thing that really stood out for me was super fast and reliable wife connection it made my stay so convenient. Big up to the IT team. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: NTEMEI YENKO
reviews.text: My stay at The Peak Hotel was wonderful. The staff were very friendly, and the beds were comfortable. However, it may not be the most suitable place for families with small children, as the upper floors (from the 2nd floor upwards) have wide veranda  grills that could pose safety risks.

reviews.author: Ian Joseph Mukabi
reviews.text: I was there with my 3 friends on January 24th... Thanks to all the staff including Brian the receptionist; they are so welcome and ready to offer exceptional hospitality.

reviews.author: winnie
reviews.text: The services are very great..and the staff is very friendly,warm and welcoming..The food is also absolutely very delish!!❤️

reviews.author: lolwe alego
reviews.text:
Really basic standard.
Friendly staff and ready to assist.
Shower head disfuntional. Found it too hard to use. Splashes water and made it hard to wash.

reviews.author: David Kiprop
reviews.text:
Wonderful services - Bed and breakfast.
Delicious meals, cozy beds. Generally recommended to anyone

reviews.author: Ngigi Asaph
reviews.text: The hotel location is quiet good for relaxing from the CBD.

reviews.author: Alex Ndungu
reviews.text: Good rooms and great value

reviews.author: Shyla Myna Investments
reviews.text: Nice place to hide , serene n nice

reviews.author: Alfred Mwaniki
reviews.text: Nice hotel, with great and welcoming staff. Food and the rooms are also great. Good place to chill and catch a vibe.

reviews.author: Armin Lewinski
reviews.text: It was clean, but not equiped with modern bathroom and wrote noisy since windows are not soundproof at all. Breakfast was okay from a European standpoint.

reviews.author: Beth Karanja
reviews.text: We had a lovely stay, the customer service was exceptional,the food delicious and very well presented. Very helpful and friendly staff.Highly recommend staying here and would stay again when visiting Nanyuki.

reviews.author: Katrina M M
reviews.text: The hotel offers a warm and welcoming atmosphere, thanks to its exceptionally friendly and attentive staff. The highlight of the stay was the delicious breakfast buffet, which featured a wide variety of fresh and tasty options to suit every palate. A truly pleasant experience overall.

reviews.author: Herb Miedema
reviews.text:
Service, check in and breakfast all friendly and reasonably up to standard.
The room is too small. Can't move around the bed, bathroom is an afterthought. Won't stay again.

reviews.author: Eva Mwangi
reviews.text:
My stay was great.

Loved the service, the staff was extremely helpful, especially since it was my first time in Nanyuki. And the proximity to everywhere I was scheduled to go was a plus. The prices are also very pocket-friendly.

reviews.author: kimeli noah
reviews.text:
Tidy cool place within town. Its neatly kept. No restaurant but you can order food.
It conveniently located at the heart of Nanyuki CBD hence conveniently accessible.
Didn't see any parking space but I am confident that your car won't lack parking spot.
Its also pocket friendly! Try it...

reviews.author: Simon Kaba
reviews.text: Clean and quiet rooms with a great rooftop view of the Nanyuki hills plus their rates are favorable. If in Nanyuki this is a great place to spend your night. Thou no restaurant.

reviews.author: Alice Muthoni
reviews.text:
Nice place.
The room was clean, apart from the sink at the entrance was not cleaned, toilet water was linking and the toilet door was also not cleaned lot of soaps at the back

reviews.author: ramas abdisitar10
reviews.text: I would definitely recommend this place...affordable,comfortable,Clean,peaceful and most importantly the host was amazing we really enjoyed our stay 🥰

name: Leisure Gardens
address: 1277 Nanyuki Meru Road, next to Kongoni camp, Nanyuki, Kenya

reviews.author: Calvin Peter's
reviews.text: The site is amazing .a cool breeze near a river...services were well offered....

reviews.author: RoamingNomads254 (Roaming Nomad254)
reviews.text:
Enjoyed though the visit was too short. promise to be back soonest possible. keep on improving.
Impressed by the creativity. Polish up in a few areas and will be a great out of town atmosphere. The location is awesome. Was able to enjoy roasted chicken with friends around a bonfire within their well kept garden. The is actually set within a cedar forest touching river Likii with a great view of Mt Kenya

reviews.author: Mbuthia Samuel Mwariri
reviews.text: The experience here was fabulous, i love the place so much. I would recommend all those who love adventure, visit the place,, the third time being there now. I'll rate it 5! Love it!

reviews.author: Dr. Simon Peter Njoroge
reviews.text: Took a couple of friends for lunch here. The service was superb and the food was excellent. The ambience was great especially with the sound of the river Likii in the background. It is a hidden gem in Nanyuki and I'd recommend it to anyone looking for a nice meal, good place to stay and all that at a reasonable price. This is a place to visit again and again

reviews.author: Farikay Suleiman
reviews.text:
This is awesome place to take a family, loved ones and friends.
Their foods are so delicious, cold drinks, nature and many more💕💞💞🥰🥰 #Justnow

reviews.author: Brian Wamugi
reviews.text: Amazing Experience we had. Jackie the host was super friendly. Lots of restaurants nearby. The facility has ziplining and a swimming pool.

reviews.author: Roselyne Wanjiru
reviews.text:
Koselig homes are awesome and perfect for a tranquil stay; as an introvert I found them a great fit.

The host is excellent and the homes give an aura of thoughtfulness, calm and serenity. They're easy to get to and the cleanliness is top notch..

They're worth every minute and the only downside is having to go back to business as usual.

reviews.author: Margaret Muthoni
reviews.text: My stay at Koselig homes  was simply fantastic. The Rooms were spotless clean and have very thoughtful touches which made us feel right at home. The host was very responsive and ensured that we had a very enjoyable stay. Location is also very accessible making it easy to explore Nanyuki town. So happy to have found my go to place when in Nanyuki!

reviews.author: James Muthuri
reviews.text:
A Wonderful Stay at Koselig Homes

I recently stayed at Koselig Homes, and I was thoroughly impressed by the overall experience.

Rooms: The rooms are impeccably clean, spacious, and thoughtfully designed for comfort. The décor strikes a perfect balance between modern elegance and cozy charm, creating a truly relaxing atmosphere. Every detail, from the bedding to the furnishings, has been carefully curated to ensure guests feel at home.

Service: The staff at Koselig Homes are exceptional. They are friendly, attentive, and go above and beyond to ensure guests have a memorable stay. From the seamless check-in process to their prompt response to requests, the team exemplifies professionalism and genuine hospitality.

Location: Koselig Homes is ideally situated, making it easy to access key attractions and amenities in the area. Whether you’re there for business or leisure, the location is both convenient and serene, offering the perfect mix of accessibility and tranquility.

Overall, I highly recommend Koselig Homes for anyone seeking a top-tier accommodation experience. I look forward to returning in the future!

reviews.author: Sam Turia
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at Koselig Homes in Nanyuki, and it was an unforgettable experience! The cozy accommodations made us feel right at home, and the amenities, including a lovely swimming pool and exciting ziplining, added so much fun to our trip.

The owner was incredibly friendly and attentive, ensuring we had everything we needed for a perfect getaway. If you're looking for a charming and comfortable place to stay in Nanyuki, I highly recommend Koselig Homes. We can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Vinit kulkarni
reviews.text:
A Highly Recommended Stay at AA Amboseli
AA Amboseli delivered an absolutely wonderful experience, blending comfort and accessibility perfectly for an unforgettable safari trip.
The commitment to guest satisfaction starts and ends with the people. The staff here are genuinely super friendly and attentive; their warmth made us feel instantly welcome and cared for throughout our stay. They even went above and beyond to celebrate my birthday with a special dance and a lovely cake—a truly memorable touch! This attention to detail extends to the facilities, as the rooms and all resort grounds were immaculately clean, reflecting a true pride in maintenance.
Dining was a major highlight. The food buffet was consistently nice, offering a wide variety of freshly prepared, delicious options for every meal. Evenings are particularly special, featuring a relaxed campfire setting and engaging cultural performances, like the traditional Masai or other local dances, alongside a generous and enjoyable drink selection at the bar.
The amenities further enhance the stay significantly. The swimming pool is large and spotlessly clean, offering a refreshing break from the Kenyan heat. A special mention must go to the spa: the massage services are truly nice and an absolute must-have experience for complete relaxation.
Highly recommend AA Amboseli for its quality, outstanding staff, and excellent overall value.

reviews.author: Emilia Pazdur
reviews.text:
It was truly very positive stay. We have never slept in tend-houseish object before, so it was great experience to us.
The only one thing that I would like to mention is that sometimes could be really hard to fall asleep, bc the tends during the wind making loud noises - but maybe it is the part of the experience.

One of the best thing in the loudge is direct view to Kilimanjaro :).

reviews.author: Lydia Muli
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at AA Lodges Amboseli. From the moment we arrived, we received a very warm and heartfelt welcome that truly made us feel at home. The management is excellent and well-organized, under the able leadership of the manager, Mr. Johnson, whose professionalism and dedication are clearly reflected throughout the lodge.
The food was exceptionally good,fresh, well-prepared, and very enjoyable. The staff demonstrated outstanding courtesy at all times; they were friendly, respectful, and always ready to assist with a smile.
A special highlight of our stay was the entertainment at the swimming pool area, led by Steve Matheka. The entertainment was lively, engaging, and extremely enjoyable, creating a great atmosphere for guests to relax and have fun.
Overall, AA Lodges Amboseli offers an excellent experience with great service, warm hospitality, and memorable moments. I highly recommend AA Lodges to anyone looking for comfort, quality service, and an unforgettable stay.

reviews.author: Shaddie Chris
reviews.text:
My 03 nights were pure bliss, from excellent service and care from all staff. Johnson is a fantastic manager, a problem solver, quick to attend to any concern, has a customer first approach and positively taking feedback including the uncomfortable ones. The food was great and abundant, the rooms spacious, a very clean swimming pool, nature well preserved at the Lodge. The Lodge is close to Kimana Gate giving quick access to the park.
There are a lot of improvements and ongoing upgrading and I could tell the future will be better for AA Amboseli.
Looking forward to being back and experiencing the more improved Lodge.

reviews.author: Joyce Nganga
reviews.text:
AA Lodges  Amboseli,truly delivers an outstanding hospitality experience. From the moment you arrive, the service is topnotch and consistently professional, making guests feel genuinely welcomed and well cared for. The staff’s courtesy is superb friendly, attentive, and always ready to assist with a warm smile.

The management is clearly well organized, with strong leadership from the manager Mr Johnson whose presence and coordination ensure everything runs smoothly and efficiently. This level of organization reflects in every aspect of the lodge’s operations.

The food is another highlight—delicious, well-prepared, and served with great presentation, catering to a variety of tastes. In addition, the entertainment options are enjoyable and thoughtfully arranged, creating a relaxing and engaging atmosphere for guests.

Overall, AA Lodges stands out for its excellent service, exceptional staff, quality food, and enjoyable entertainment. It is a place I would highly recommend to anyone looking for comfort, professionalism, and a memorable stay.

name: Amboseli Serena Safari Lodge
address: Amboseli National Park, Ol Tukai, Kenya
editorial_summary: Casual game reserve set in Absoeli National Park, featuring a restaurant & an outdoor pool.

reviews.author: Camilla Randell
reviews.text:
This is truly a dream location we left Nairobi and travelled by train to Emali where we were picked up by the wonderful Joseph Our driver and guide for our visit. A wonderful welcome drink at reception at one of only 2 resorts in the reserve. We were shown to our beautiful room looking straight out onto the plains.
The rooms are beautifully decorated in fact the entire camp is covered with stunning native artwork. The Maasai warriors protecting the camp and  guests from some of the not so shy monkeys were kind warm and happy to share stories of their tribal culture and history.
We enjoyed time relaxing by the beautiful pool and could actually see elephant walking by.
The Lodge and gardens are serene and beautiful all the staff are very helpful courteous and friendly.
Food in the restaurant is varied and excellent. With dishes to suit all tastes.
Again helpful friendly chefs are around to tell you about the different food and a station where they cook for you. The game drives were amazing sunset sunrise we saw elephant so many and so close lions and many many more. Stunning views of Kilimangaro in the mornings. On our last evening we enjoyed the fabulous bush barbecue delicious food cooked right there under the stars and finished with beautiful singing and dancing of the Maasai . We collected some lovely souvenirs at the gift shop and had a delicious lunch box organised for our departure.
This is a truly magical place for its location surroundings and excellent facilities most of all for the people the make the experience.
I would definitely return and recommend staying here.

reviews.author: I
reviews.text:
5/5, great lodge, good value for money.
We stayed in Jan 2026.
* Food was great, especially fruits. While, they don't provide a wide chose, that's even better. All food was excellent.
* Staff is very friendly and welcoming
* Rooms are cozy
* Lodge's territory is well maintained.

Recommended.

reviews.author: Ryan Conway
reviews.text: Beautiful setting in the heart of the Amboseli Park. Good hospitality and clean rooms. The buffet was decent and the salad bar was excellent with a variety of options. The outlook is beautiful as you can sit by the pool, have a cocktail and watch the animals walking past. Definitely worth a visit.

reviews.author: Madhu Sen
reviews.text:
We stayed for one night at Amboseli Serena Safari Lodge. The lodge store has a decent collection, and we enjoyed some shopping. The restaurant offered a good variety of meals, and the property is lively with monkeys around, adding a fun wildlife touch.

The Wi-Fi is available only in the reception area, and the rooms do not have proper fans. We were initially given three separate beds, and only after our request did they join two beds. The manager mentioned they weren’t informed it was a family booking, only that it was for three pax. The room size felt small for a family with a child and was a bit depressing. Also, there was no phone or walkie-talkie in the room for communication, which would have been useful in case of emergencies.

Overall, it’s a pleasant lodge with helpful staff, but families with kids should request room arrangements in advance and note the lack of in-room communication and cooling.

reviews.author: Osckin Gankoue
reviews.text: Located inside the Amboseli national park, Serena Safari Lodge is a very beautiful place to have many activities at the same time like, conferences, meeting, national park visit, camping, clean rooms, quite. All  with a nice view of the Kilimanjaro  mountain summit.

name: Sentrim Amboseli
editorial_summary: Low-key tents & cottages in a rural property offering a pool, dining & Mount Kilimanjaro views.

reviews.author: Kinga Olejnik
reviews.text: Fantastic property ! The Kilimanjaro view is exceptional, monkeys make it so fun and enjoyable, the food is fantastic, the staff are polite and helpful. There was a fire pit at night as a truly romantic addition to this place. The pool has a Kilimanjaro view as well, if the weather was better I could spend hours there ! Rooms have all mosquito netting too. This camp was probably my favourite out of all places we've visited in Kenya. Thank you for your amazing service !

reviews.author: Nathan B
reviews.text:
We had a good overall stay at this hotel. The rooms are a bit old and clearly need renovation. The location is close to the park gate.

The surroundings are a little dusty compared to some other hotels with more greenery, but it didn’t take away from the experience too much.

The food was good, and the staff were very welcoming and friendly throughout our stay. Overall, it was a pleasant visit, just don’t expect very modern facilities and a lot of greenery around.

reviews.author: Marcus Kysela
reviews.text: The Sentrim Amboseli Lodge stands out for its incredibly friendly staff and its superb location at the base of Kilimanjaro. Cleanliness and well-maintained grounds create a pleasant atmosphere, while the food is tasty and varied. The accommodation is simple but has everything needed for a relaxed stay—ideal for enjoying the wildlife and the breathtaking views all around.

reviews.author: Eliška
reviews.text: We spent one night at Sentrim Amboseli. The accommodation is located near the entrance to the national park. It is a large complex full of beautiful tents close to the wilderness. There is a large restaurant, partially covered. A beautiful swimming pool, which we unfortunately did not have time to try. There is also a fireplace where you can stop at in the evening after a long day and realize the beauty around, including the endless sky of stars, which absolutely disarmed us. All the staff were very pleasant. When entering the area, you will be offered a welcome drink at the reception. Opposite the reception there are toilets and a souvenir shop, where a very nice employee works and where we spent almost an hour talking. What makes Sentrim Amboseli exceptional is its view directly on Kilimanjaro. I recommend getting up and being there for dawn at 6 am. There is a marked path there, but the staff will be happy to advise you on how to get there. Around 5 am they inflate a hot air balloon next to the view point, which starts to slowly rise upwards around 6:15 am. It is wonderful to watch. We fell asleep to the sound of hyenas howling in the evening, which was a truly amazing experience. Monkeys and small Dikdik deer roam the grounds. The evenings and mornings are much warmer here than in the parks around Nairobi, which pleasantly surprised us. The accommodation was very nice and we really liked it here. ❤️

reviews.author: Lisa Mutschler
reviews.text:
This was my second stay here, and this time I brought my family with me. I absolutely love this place.

The lodge is very peaceful, surrounded by nature, and feels like a true escape. The rooms are comfortable, the staff is incredibly kind and welcoming, and the buffet is really good.

Another big plus is the location — it’s very close to the entrance of Amboseli National Park, which makes everything easy and convenient.

Overall, I find the value for money excellent. I would happily come back and highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: James Allen
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful stay here. A lovely lodge, with great views - when the clouds part - of Kilimanjaro. Staff could not be more professional, friendly and helpful. Food range and quality was excellent. Hemingway bar is a great place for a drink with a view. The game drive was excellent - Wilson managed to find lions resting by the water, in addition to cheetas, hyenas and other wonderful wildlife. I shall be returning.

reviews.author: Brian Johnson
reviews.text: I had a very nice stay at Amboseli Sopa Lodge earlier this month. The grounds and setting are beautiful (including an amazing view of Mt. Kilimanjaro). The rooms were adequate and spacious, but a bit dated and could use a bit of a refresh. The food selection at each meal was extensive and well prepared. But what really makes this lodge stand out was the amazing service and hospitality. Every staff member was friendly, welcoming, helpful, and a delight to get to know. Joan, Natasha, Berrel, Moses, and Joyce (among many others) took such great care of us and made our stay memorable.

reviews.author: HR Pié
reviews.text:
We just finished our second stay at Amboseli Sopa. We stayed last year in Feb and now in Nov. and we really enjoyed our stay. The reception greeting is great with hot towels and drinks. Sam, the Maasai Warrior, greets you warmly and we told him we are back again.
They quickly check you in and take your bags to your room.
The rooms are individual bungalows that are decent size and has all the amenities you need. The shower water is very hot all day and water pressure is good. The rooms were clean and felt comfortable. The rooms are very quiet and we never heard other guests.
We enjoyed the food. Breakfast, lunch and dinner are buffet and the service is excellent. Everyone is so helpful and friendly. Each meal Mercy greeted us and knew our room number. She was so pleasant to talk to. We liked the food a lot it was a lot of choices and was fresh. The dining area is very clean and has perfect views of Mt Kilamanjaro.
We went to our room to get our bags and the porters just showed up out of nowhere to take our bags to the front. I don’t know how they knew we were leaving but I was impressed.
The grounds are nice with wildlife all around including very crafty monkeys. The whole lodge had a rustic charm to it.
It’s about 20 min drive to the park entrance and didn’t feel excessive or out of the way.
Overall we really enjoyed our stay and we know we will be back again.
I think any negative reviews are based on unreasonable expectations for being in the African bush. I felt Sopa wen above and beyond for our stay.

reviews.author: Jasmin Haslinger
reviews.text:
The staff was very friendly and welcoming. The room was a good size, and the bed was very comfortable.

The pool was absolutely beautiful – a great spot to relax. There were also several cozy seating areas throughout the property.

A mosquito net was provided over the bed, although the fan was located outside the net, which made it a bit less effective.

One of the highlights was enjoying breakfast with a stunning view of Mount Kilimanjaro – truly unforgettable!

reviews.author: Darren Page
reviews.text:
A brilliant lodge, highly recommended.

The rooms were spacious, well equipped. The gardens were immaculate and very beautiful with an abundance of wildlife in them.

The bar had a great range of drinks at friendly prices and always served well.

All of the meals, breakfast, lunch and dinner always had a large variety and always of a high standard, with a choice of eating inside or outside.

All of the staff were friendly and efficient and could have a smile and laugh with them.

I wish we could have spent another couple of nights with you as it was a really special stay. Many thanks

name: Kibo Safari Camp, Amboseli, Kenya
editorial_summary: Rustic lodge within Amboseli National Reserve, offering tents, open-air dining & an outdoor pool.

reviews.author: Samantha
reviews.text:
The atmosphere of this place is truly relaxing and instantly made us happy. What really makes it special is the staff. Their genuine smiles are what give this place its magic. Every single person was kind, always willing to help with anything we needed, and happy to chat, which made us feel so welcome.

The lodge and tents felt both luxurious and calming, like you were truly unplugged from the outside world. The rooms were very comfortable and came with pretty much everything you could need, making the stay effortless and relaxing from start to finish.
Breakfast, lunch, and dinner buffets were all very pleasant and more than met our expectations. There was an abundance of variety to choose from, including hot and cold drinks, a fresh salad bar, hot dishes, and plenty of fruits and desserts.

Another big plus is the location. It is super close to the park gate entrance, which made getting in and out very easy. As an added bonus, you can see the hotel’s ostrich and other animals walking around the property, like peacocks and more, which really adds to the experience.

We would 100% come back here!! ☺️

reviews.author: Februus Wang
reviews.text: The facilities were well maintained and thoughtfully equipped, with a full range of amenities provided. The food was of good quality, and the environment was quiet and comfortable. On the downside, there were relatively few power outlets in the room, which made charging devices somewhat inconvenient. In addition, there was no internet access available inside the room.

reviews.author: Pavan Gowda
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at Kibo Safari Camp during our visit to Amboseli. The staff were very friendly, welcoming, and always ready to assist with a smile. Their warm hospitality made the experience comfortable and enjoyable from start to finish.

The camp offers a pleasant atmosphere, good food, and well-maintained tents that provide a nice balance between comfort and the wild surroundings. The service was attentive, and the overall experience was smooth and relaxing.

A great choice for anyone visiting Amboseli and looking for a comfortable, friendly stay in the heart of nature. ⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Sairi A.
reviews.text:
Nice place with good service.  Clean rooms. Just too much smoke for mosquitos in the bar area
Area is very nice. But if you are on safari you dont have nothing to do more than 2days. Its really big area, not so often to see animals

reviews.author: Daisy
reviews.text:
My favorite hotel in this 8 days trip in Kenya.
This camp feels well equipped and clean the minute we stepped into the reception.
I would really recommend this place and I will also choose it again in my next trip to Kenya!

name: Elewana Tortilis Camp Amboseli
address: Kitirua Conservancy, Amboseli National Park, Kenya
editorial_summary: Elegant tented camps at an upscale safari property offering dining & game drives, plus a pool.

reviews.author: Sophia Artioli
reviews.text:
Our stay at the camp was truly unforgettable. The venue itself is exceptional, offering a breathtaking view of a water point where giraffes and monkeys come to quench their thirst. The rooms are incredibly comfortable, well-appointed, and meticulously designed, providing everything you need and more!

The staff at the camp was incredibly attentive, accommodating, and genuinely friendly. They made us feel like we were in a warm and welcoming home in the heart of Amboseli.

The food selection is refined and delicious, offering a wide variety of options. I truly appreciate the wake-up call with tea, coffee, and biscuits, which sets a great tone for the game drive.

reviews.author: Jenny Coombs
reviews.text: If I could give this place an extra star I would! The staff was amazing — so kind and welcoming, plus the little hand written notes, flowers, and bracelet gifts made our stay extra special! I’m sure the full view of Kilimanjaro is amazing, but unfortunately during our stay it was covered by clouds. The meals were great and our table server, James, was so great! I was really happy to see that every meal had a “tastes of Africa” option, so we got to actually experience some local cuisine and get acquainted with the local flavors. We asked for our guide to join us at our meals and although it was a bit “iffy” to get that allowed, it was all good — we had an amazing stay! I’ve included some photos from around the room and grounds. There are some extra precautions to take to protect your room from being invaded by wildlife, but nothing inconvenient or excessive. There was a pair of dikdiks near our tent that even had a little baby with them 🥹 The pool was also really nice — in between game drives, it’s a nice place to relax. Overall, this was quite the introduction to Kenya…and Africa. We’d go back in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Giulia Iovino
reviews.text: Our stay at this lodge was absolutely wonderful and truly unforgettable. The staff were exceptional—kind, attentive, and incredibly thoughtful, with every detail handled with care. The atmosphere was quiet, intimate, and perfect for a honeymoon, making us feel relaxed and genuinely special from the very first moment. The location is stunning and ideal for enjoying the beauty of Amboseli. The sweet and thoughtful touches throughout our stay made our honeymoon even more memorable. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience and highly recommend this lodge to anyone looking for something truly special.

reviews.author: Kimberly Laidman
reviews.text: I want to tell you what an absolute wonderful time my husband, Craig, and I had while staying at Elewana Tortillas this October.  We absolutely loved our accommodations and were pleasantly surprised by the RODI water for brushing teeth and the presence of a hair dryer!  The bed was more comfortable than most hotels I've stayed in! The water was abundantly hot and the wifi was strong enough to keep me connected with no issues!We are pretty plain jane eaters and our waiter Donald was a bit bewildered at our lack of appetite initially.  He went out of his way to find Craig his beloved brownies and make sure we were well fed the entire time.  We skipped lunch one day (we aren't accustomed to 3x daily four course meals).  I joked with Craig that I think Donald would be wondering where we were.  Like clock-work he arrived at our tent to make sure we hadn't accidentally slept through lunch.  We very much appreciated his service!We opted for exclusive use of the safari vehicle and that was a great decision!  We had Simon to ourselves for the entire 3 days.  We loved him and he was the crown on top of the Tortilas experience.  He knew right where to take us and showed us many things!  He is very knowledgeable about his environment and the animals that reside there.  When I return I hope he is still there and I can request he be our guide again!

reviews.author: Deirdre Brodie
reviews.text: What an absolutely wonderful place the team at Elewana has created. Our stay for 3 nights was outstanding. Huge thanks to our guide Dickson, whose knowledge, hospitality and sense of humor absolutely made our trip.
