The property itself is gorgeous, thoughtfully designed and incorporates small touches like filtered water on tap in the rooms and very comfortable safari vehicles. Don't skip the massage! The access Tortilis afforded to the Conservancy made our wildlife sightings exceptional, the view of Mt. Kilimanjaro and the bush breakfast couldn't be beat!

reviews.author: Barbara Karimi
reviews.text:
Location wise, it’s centrally located within the town centre, close to a medical clinic and shops.

Service was lacking due to few staff present, however, some of the waiters were really attentive and ready to assist, willing to go above and beyond to ensure guests were well taken care of.

Food wise, it was OK, there wasn’t much variety but what was provided was good quality, especially the goat meat.

Room wise, the rooms are spacious, beds are comfortable and have mosquito nets around the bed, but small details were missing for example, mats for bathrooms.

All in all, it was an OK experience.

reviews.author: emmaculate kamanthe
reviews.text:
The resort is the best. Everything is good. Especially the meals, the rooms are spaceous and the beds are so comfy. The swimming pool is great. And the pool assistant Mr Jacom Imote was really helpful.
Generally your staff are friendly, couteous and very proffesional. I highly recommend it

reviews.author: Wilson Munene
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of staying at Penety Amboseli Resort while working with the East African Classic Safari Rally, and I can confidently say it was the best accommodation experience I’ve had throughout my assignments.

From the moment I checked in, the warmth and professionalism of the staff stood out. Despite the demanding and unpredictable rally schedule, the team consistently went above and beyond to ensure every need was met. Early breakfasts, late meals, last-minute requests nothing was ever too much for them.

The rooms were immaculate, spacious, and extremely comfortable, offering the perfect environment to rest and recharge after long days on the route. The attention to detail in cleanliness, comfort, and overall ambience was exceptional.

The food was another highlight. Every meal was fresh, flavourful, and thoughtfully prepared, with enough variety to keep things interesting even over a long stay. The kitchen team clearly takes pride in what they do.

What truly made the stay unforgettable was the genuine hospitality. The staff understood the pressures and time demands of rally work, and they offered support with a level of care that felt personal and sincere. Their consistency, reliability, and friendliness made this hotel feel less like a stopover and more like a home base.

Without a doubt, this has been my best hotel experience during the East African Classic Safari Rally outstanding service, excellent facilities, and a team that truly understands hospitality. Highly recommended.

Penety Amboseli Resort is truly a hidden gem.

reviews.author: Utana Kinuthia
reviews.text:
Penety Lodge in Amboseli is truly a gem. The rooms are clean, cozy, and perfectly positioned to give you a stunning, uninterrupted view of Mt. Kilimanjaro - especially at sunrise. The staff are warm, and always ready to assist, making you feel at home from the moment you arrive.
Their food is fresh and delicious, and the overall service is exceptional. Whether you’re visiting for work or relaxation, Penety Lodge offers comfort, great hospitality, and one of the best mountain views in Amboseli.

Highly recommended!💯

reviews.author: Alexander Muranja
reviews.text:
Guiding with southern sky safaris, penety offers the best guides accomodation and hospitality. The staffs are lively, sumptuous meals in a great ambience and environment.
Easy location  to access and to the Amboseli ntl park.

name: Ol Tukai Lodge Amboseli
address: Iloodokilani Off Kajiado/Namanga Rd Amboseli, Airstrip, Kajiado, Kenya
editorial_summary: Warm rooms, some with Mount Kilimanjaro views, in a casual lodge offering a pool & wildlife safaris.

reviews.author: Andrew McDonald
reviews.text: This lodge was a great end to our trip.  We were sad that we were here only one evening as the grounds, the people, the views, and the rooms were some of the best.  We arrived here just after dusk, so missed out on the views of the park and Mount Kilimanjaro, it was such a wonderful view in the morning. We were able to enjoy the fireplace in the evening and chat with some other guests - we were happy that we had brought our marshmellows to enjoy and share. We got out for an early morning game drive, and it was so great, the views of the mountain, lots of elephants and lots of flamingos too. The only downside was not being here long enough and also one our group had a leaky roof so got a little water during the night.

reviews.author: fielight
reviews.text:
We stayed here Jan 2026. This is a really beautiful Lodge, one of 2, that is actually located inside of Amboseli. This makes it extremely convenient to go for game drives.
The scale of the Lodge is very grand, with large beams, soaring 20ft ceilings, an elaborate chandelier over the bar featuring elephant tusks, and an wooden carved elephant frieze in the lobby.
4 rooms are housed within each chalet style house, scattered over the grounds. Rooms are nicely appointed, slightly dated, but comfortable. No ac in the room (which is common across all lodges we experienced in Kenya) - while the temps do drop at night, there is only 1 screened window for the room that opens, so cross ventilation was a little tricky. All rooms face Kilimanjaro, which was a treat to see at dawn, when the clouds seem to consistently part. My favorite spots are their pool, which is raised on a platform overlooking the Plains (don't forget your binoculars, as you can easily spot elephants, warthogs, gazelle and more all day long), and the second floor balcony area above the bar (though it sadly doesn't have a great view due to the amount of tree cover).
Food was plentiful but I didn't think particularly tasty; all meals were served buffet style; there were about 15 hot items, salads, fruits, and a dessert table. I was pleasantly surprised to find that lunch was just as elaborate as dinner, which is sometimes not the case at lodges.
The Lodge seems to bill itself as a high end property, and I would agree with this, albeit an aging one. Overall it has great views of Amboseli and Kilimanjaro, terrific location, and a very cool bar and pool.

reviews.author: Anna Heermann
reviews.text:
From the moment I stepped into the hotel, I was enveloped in an atmosphere of luxury and impeccable cleanliness. The rooms were not just clean, they were pristine, offering a sanctuary of comfort and elegance.
However, what truly set this hotel apart was its exceptional service. The staff members were the friendliest and most helpful people I have ever encountered. Their unwavering smiles and willingness to assist with any request made me feel like a valued guest. I was blown away by their genuine warmth and dedication to providing an unforgettable experience.
The culinary offerings were equally impressive, with each dish bursting with flavor and artfully presented. The hotel's ambiance was simply breathtaking, with stunning architecture and meticulously manicured grounds. Overall, my stay was an extraordinary experience that exceeded all expectations. If I could give more than five stars, I would without hesitation. I wholeheartedly recommend this hotel to anyone seeking a truly unforgettable getaway. Lot's of love Tomo & Anna

reviews.author: Feadynard Nyambu
reviews.text: Ol Tukai Lodge is one of the best safari lodges I’ve ever stayed at. The location is unbeatable — right in the heart of Amboseli with stunning views of Mount Kilimanjaro and wildlife literally roaming near the lodge. The rooms are spacious, clean, and beautifully designed with a true bush-luxury feel. The staff were incredibly welcoming, attentive, and always ready to help. The food was delicious with great variety. Waking up to elephants grazing nearby was simply magical. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Amboseli

reviews.author: Sanjeeta Sharma Pokharel
reviews.text: Just had the best time at Ol Tukai Amboseli! 🤩 The hut was cosy, the wildlife was LITERAL (elephants roaming around 😍), and the food was on point! If you're an animal lover, esp. elephants, this place is a dream. 10/10 would recommend!

reviews.author: Luka Bojanic
reviews.text: It was very nice. When we came, the host Rose greeted us with a nice fresh towel and a glass of watermelon juice. After that she showed us around the Lodge. Our housekeeper Ben was very friendly and carried our luggages to our cottage. Every night while we were at dinner he came and put the net around our bed and sprayed the spray for mosquitoes. The menu was really nice and the food was delicious. We went to the sundowner and it was fantastic. We had a view of mountain Kilimanjaro! We had drinks and it was truly amazing. We saw a lot of different animals close to the lodge, and even Warthogs close to the restaurant! If your coming to visit Amboseli, I recommend to stay at this lodge.

reviews.author: Danny Swallow
reviews.text: A really magical location; far off the beaten track. The staff couldn’t be friendlier or more helpful. The food was good. Our room (number 15) is one of the suites with the plunge pool. It has a totally magical view of Kilimanjaro, which I could never tire of. It’s very peaceful and quiet. A special mention to Moses, our guide. He was the best; so friendly, knowledgeable and fun. Don’t hesitate to book here’s and choose the suite if you can

reviews.author: Steph
reviews.text:
Tawi is an incredible lodge! Before choosing to stay there we ran comparisons between dozens of lodges in and around the area and Tawi came out the “winner” in terms of price, menu, accommodations, and activities.
Their beautiful rooms, which all face Mount Kilimanjaro, looked onto watering holes where the elephants, giraffes, zebras et al visited daily, and the grounds and pool areas flourished with beautiful plants and an endless variety of birds! The food was spectacular and EVERY single one of the staff members made you feel like you were the only guest being catered to!
The game drives were simply breathtaking with an abundance of wildlife, and the sheer magnificence of the sunsets during the sundowners along with the awareness that you were surrounded, from a distance, by some of the most beautiful animals on the planet,  offered a complete disconnect from the rest of the world!
We would like to offer a special THANK YOU to Claire whose attention to detail, her kindness, efficiency, friendliness, and patience (with our never ending questions) throughout the booking process and during our stay, further confirmed that choosing Tawi was the obvious choice!

reviews.author: Miranda Perkins
reviews.text: Our room was fantastic - right at the base of Mt. Kilimanjaro and the wildlife right outside our room with the nearby watering hole was next level - the food and service of the staff was outstanding - I had a wonderful massage as well; I would highly recommend this resort!!

reviews.author: Harry Bennett
reviews.text: We had the most amazing time staying in Amboseli and at Tawi Lodge. John, Boniface, Titus & Rose really looked after us and we’re truly grateful. The location was incredible and the food was divine. When it came to the game drives, we were looked after by Gabriel… who was simply the best. His knowledge blew us away. He was charismatic, thoughtful, kind and funny. We really couldn’t have asked for a better person to show us around. We learnt so much from him and he made our whole experience so special. We will endeavour to return!!

reviews.author: Burton F. Metzger
reviews.text: Landing at Amboseli airport, we had a long bumpy road before arriving at the lodge.  But when we arrived, it was sensational.  The staff was warm, engaging and responsive.  Because we had come from Angama Mara, the staff at Amboseli knew all about us, even what we usually had for breakfast!!   Our guide, Salash, had been briefed by our Mara guide, and knew we were particularly looking for cheetah.  FIrst day, he spotted a cheetah with her two cubs, and our photos were amazing.  This lodge is smaller than Mara and only two years old, but many of the staff actually trained at Mara, and they learned well.  Physical plant very interesting, as they are independent suites, giving perfect privacy and quiet.  The suites are beautiful, well equipped and efficient.  Absolutely five star experience.

reviews.author: H K
reviews.text: Yes, wildlife is upclose - literally at my doorstep, outside my sliding door, next to my table at the lawn. But its the staff that made the most difference. Faith was clear in introducing us the compound and program, followed by outlining what to expect. Paul was a diligent butler and Morinke made sure our tent was always comfortable. Elvis knew the every species so well that he knew what, when and how to bring us close to the beasts without disrupting the ecosystem. Thank you Angama Amboseli. You have my gratitude.

reviews.author: Vineyard P.
reviews.text: Perfect from start to finish. With Faith at the helm, our stay was perfectly curated and planned with just the right mix of relaxation and activity. Staff were attentive and efficient (Andrew and Caroline for meals) and game drives had expert guides who were friendly, fun, and knowledgeable (Elvis and Salash).  They took care of our multi generational group including special touches for the children. Location in Kimana Sanctuary gave up-close game drives while a day in Amboseli offered a different experience including the privilege of meeting Craig the super tusker days before his final rest. Book this place- you will be blown away.

reviews.author: Sam Marrell
reviews.text: What a treat to be able to stay in one of the most beautiful settings in the world. Enjoy incredible food and spectacular game drives while you stay here. Faith, the manager, and Andrew, our concierge saw to our every need and made this a truly memorable experience.

reviews.author: Mino Chkachka
reviews.text:
Wonderful camp in Amboseli for an unforgettable experience.
The staff is super nice with an excellent service, in particular the food was awesome.
Of course, our guide was very knowledgeable and we enjoyed very much all our game drives.
Definitely a place to go!

reviews.author: Lisa Bartels
reviews.text: We stayed three nights, the rooms are clean and we had fresh towels and soap. The stuff is very friendly and the food super yummy and big portions (they make breakfast and dinner at request). The camp is located in a quiet area half n hour away from the Amboseli-Nationalpark. There are a lot of nice birds and flowers and you can really calm down at this place. We also did a safari. We asked the host for help and he organised a ranger, who picked us up the next morning directly from the camp, drove with us to the national park and gave us a full-day experience at the national park. In the end he drove us back to the camp. By night and also early in the morning we were able to see the Kilimanjaro from the camp that was awesome! Thanks a lot again Amboseli Eco Camp!

reviews.author: Maria Beard
reviews.text: I am aware that its an eco camp and actually a nice experience, i have read not so good reviews and had low expectations but during our stay we had a decent and good time. They dont have wifi at all so you must have ample data, its a good detox i must say. We have a very nice view of Mt. Kilimanjaro in our balcony, the room itself is big.. Bed and pillows are comfy, there are sockets to charge your gadgets. No bidet in the toilet but hot shower in the middle of nowhere is a major plus! It was quiet and peaceful, hearing so many birds chirping which is so relaxing. They have mosquito nets, yet surprisingly no bugs or mosquitoes. We stayed a night, month of September, t'was chilly and had rainshowers all night, we slept well. It was kind of muddy in the morning but still doable to walk.. Food is good and yummy in my liking, apart from bfast other meals aren't included, gotta pay them cash. So far the staff are polite and helpful, check in and out were both smooth. We requested and they provided airport pick up and naivasha drop off, with a decent price but dont expect a big car but did the job. You will see giraffee, on the way casually hanging out on the side of the road. The road going to the eco camp is kind of bumpy. If you decide to go Amboseli Eco Park, its about 30mins drive. We had a good stay, so i do recommend them😊

reviews.author: Jac Stienen
reviews.text: We had already booked and paid for three rooms a few months ago. Now we arrived, and they had given our rooms to someone else for more money. We were told to try the neighbors. That's not how a company treats customers.

reviews.author: P. B.
reviews.text:
Room downgrade without excuse or explanation - do NOT book the double room with shared bathroom!
Our tour operator booked one of the cottages for us so they checked us in a cottage, and I have to say they are very beautiful. After 2 hours they said they gave us the wrong room and put us into the room shown in the photos and the difference was stark. Very small dark room. Community toilet and shower, the light in the toilet and shower did not function and the shower could not be closed. No power socket in the room. Shared sitting area with only broken chairs. A truly run-down, desolate place.
We checked with our tour guide, he assured us he did not book this room so probably they overbooked and put us there.
Also strangely all other rooms were empty (there are ~5 which share one toilet) even though online the eco camp is fully booked.
If we had booked this room knowing it was very simple, okay. But relocating us from the cottage in this room is unacceptable in my opinion.

reviews.author: Stephane Demaegdt
reviews.text:
This place must have been a great place some years ago but it clearly lacks maintenance.
Our lodge was clean but armchairs and table on the balcony were broken, the mosquito net had several holes, the bathroom door handle was loose and the shower pipe was not well fixed on the wall.
We were not confident on the water heating system since electric connectors were close to the shower head.
Great view on the Kilimanjaro in the morning. The food was good.
The manager didn’t seem really concerned when my wife suggested him to fix the lodge.

reviews.author: Myoung Kim
reviews.text:
Make sure you have a proper car, as driving here is much more challenging than driving inside Amboseli National Park.

Overall, it was a very pleasant stay. I chose this place because it was surprisingly hard to find good accommodation near the park ; most options were either very expensive or rough camping. I didn’t feel like staying in a fancy resort just to get spoiled, but I also wanted something more comfortable than basic camping, and this place turned out to be the perfect balance and exactly my style.

Finding the place was a bit challenging, but thanks to Jane, the owner, we were able to use an alternative park gate (not official) that was about 12 km away from the lodge, which was very helpful. Other than that, I really loved the place. The house was beautifully decorated and had everything we needed. The kitchen was very well equipped, and the place truly felt like home. The staff, especially Julius and Sam, were incredibly kind and sweet, which made the stay even better.

As a bonus, we actually saw more animals near the lodge than inside the park! There were many zebras and giraffes living nearby. We even met a Maasai man who told us he had seen a lion in the bush just a few days before, believe it or not.

reviews.author: Daniel Mutiso
reviews.text:
Adventure ✔️Isolation, Peaceful & Quiet👌
Getting there is a proper geographical adventure. I strongly suggest you make sure to get there early( before dark) because it can get very tricky to find the house after sundown.
Staying there is nothing short of refreshing and rejuvenating. Departing from there is a slow and sad process because one wishes they could stay forever.
The hosts are super kind and very engaging to help you get there and throughout your stay. The team on the ground are helpful.

reviews.author: Roberta Sferrazzo
reviews.text:
The Wild Amboseli Ndovu Cottage is the perfect place to relax and enjoy the beauty of the nature close to Amboseli park.
We enjoyed very much our stay in the cottage!

reviews.author: Peter Žilavý
reviews.text: When you go to amboseli, that's the place you want to wake up at. Just try to get the during the day because when it's get dark it's not easy to find 😃

reviews.author: Jackson Gona
reviews.text: Luxury cottage

reviews.author: Paula
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our time here! Truely amazing huts, beautiful view, welcoming and helpful staff who really went out of their way to make you feel at home! Food was good (you can even take your breakfast for a morning game drive!!) Close to amboselli gate. Would definitely recommend staying here! :)

reviews.author: irungu irene
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at Olemaiyan Amboseli Cottages, with a truly spectacular view of Mount Kilimanjaro. The cottages were clean and comfortable, making our stay very pleasant.

Our host Levi was exceptionally friendly and always available whenever we needed anything. Chef David treated us to delicious, well-prepared meals, while Purity and Sylvia were warm, welcoming, and attentive.

Levi also connected us with an excellent guide for Amboseli National Park - John K, who knows the park like the back of his hand and made our game drive unforgettable.

We highly recommend Olemaiyan Amboseli Cottages for anyone looking for great hospitality, comfort, and stunning views.

reviews.author: Billy Karuga
reviews.text:
Olemaiyan Camping Site is an absolute gem in Amboseli. I truly enjoyed the wide open space, the off-grid power setup, and the calm, serene atmosphere throughout our stay. It’s the kind of place that allows you to fully disconnect and enjoy nature at its best.

The staff were impressive, very helpful, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. The host was top-notch and always available, making sure all our needs were taken care of without hesitation. The chef was simply amazing; everything you’d hope for and more.

Overall, it was a great stay and a place I’d highly recommend to anyone looking for a peaceful, well-run camping experience in Amboseli.

reviews.author: Derek Farley
reviews.text: Great place to stay in good location close to both Kimana, if you want to take a boda to go eat or purchase things in town, as well as the Kimana Gate entrance to Amboseli to take a game drive and see the park. There’s cheap tents for lodging if budget-conscious, a very peaceful setting, and the staff are very helpful and laid back. The manager Levy is a wonderful guy and will take good care of you. They can set you up a game drive, dinner or other meals (breakfast was included with stay), as well as transport to wherever you’d like. The lounge upstairs in the main building has electricity for charging, good WiFi, and a fridge for general use as well. Nice home base for checking out Amboseli National Park. Ask Levy to try some emomoi if you’re feeling adventurous 😉

reviews.author: Regina Kinoti
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my night at this amazing 😍 hideout. It's conviniently located, surrounded by a calm feel of nature with great mountain views. I definitely will be back. A very welcoming staff, keep it up Olemaiyan💪.

reviews.author: dhanapal kondasmy
reviews.text:
This is the best stay during our two weeks Kenya trip. Location and the property is awesome. Our rooms (tent) are very spacious overlooking the awesome sight of Kilimanjaro mountain.
Restaurant is huge with a watch tower in the centre. There are plenty of food option and it's very tasty as well.
Staff are very courteous.

Though the price is on the higher side, it's worth staying whoever visits Kenya.
Fantastic property.

reviews.author: Suhas
reviews.text:
Positives
*Located next to Kimana gate.
* Spacious, beautiful rooms with spacious ensuite bathrooms
* Most if not all rooms have great views of Kilimanjaro
* Cottages are spread across large area, great privacy
* Staffs are friendly, especially Steven at resturant was very helpful.

Negatives
* Staffs though friendly appear confused to general requests, seems like management skipped on orotenation. Even reception staff needed lot of explanation and hand actions to understand requests for basic items (shower caps, body lotions etc)
* Strange policies makes you leave with a bad experience. (Example: only tea sachets provided in room along with kettle, for coffee sachets you need to get approval from manager, in our case it took 3 hours and multiple visits to reception to get it done)
* Helpdesk is non existent, we had to visit reception 3 times to request for toilet paper, each time being promised delivery immediately. Finally had to chase down housekeeping person on cleaning duty and get the same.
* 2 liters of water provided in bottle each day for a room. Apart from this, there is no water provided anywhere else. One can't get a glass of water during meals at resturant too. Similarly, your safari snacks boxes gets packed without water bottles making it very difficult.  Only other option is to purchase additional water bottles from the bar at really jacked up price ( ~370 Kenyan shilling for 1 litre)
* No option to contact helpdesk apart from walking to reception. You make a request there, walk back to room and do the same walk back to repeat the request since there is complete lack of accountability. Not a fun process when the distance from reception to rooms are around 300 meters. We asked reception what is the other option, answer was to make a call from our mobile to reception .But majority of the property doesn't have network coverage, to that the reception just answered, ya in that case can't make call .

Safety/ Security concerns
* As mentioned above, no way to communicate to reception or helpdesk. Hence during any emergency/ night it becomes difficult to reach out. Hope they provided an intercom in each rooms. Most important since it's bordering forest and there can be sudden need to call for help. One night we had a ~10 cms long millipede inside the room, another night we spotted a baby snake near to food area. Staff mentioned it was a baby black mamba, one of the most poisonous snakes on earth. There were monkeys all across the camp and tent in day time. These are understable and expected while staying next to forest. But lack of option to contact for any help was concerning
* Monkeys were seen regularly raiding food from dining area and even licking water from condensation droplets of cold cabinet holding deserts. Running over dining tables and plates.  There was one staff employed to chase monkeys away, but he was surely overwhelmed on all days. In other similar resorts, while inside forest, there is usually net or some enclosure to prevent them from getting in to food area. Hope Kilima also does something like that.

reviews.author: Saeeda Quaisar
reviews.text:
What an amazing experience at Kilima resort. We went in September and enjoyed everything they had to offer.
The Masai people added to the experience, a special shout out to Mike Ole Lepayon who shared stories about his tribe and family. Beautiful views of Mt Kilimanjaro from the resort.

reviews.author: Jone K H
reviews.text:
Good location, just by the gate with views to Kilimanjaro.

Rooms are OK, a bit outdated and would’ve needed a new mattress.

Also a bit annoying that the WiFi only work in the reception and not in the restaurant and bar.

Staff is nice and welcoming.

reviews.author: Mel
reviews.text: We had such a lovely time here during our visit to Amboseli National Park! The staff were incredibly kind and attentive — always smiling and ready to help with anything we needed. The location couldn’t be better, right on the edge of the park with stunning views of Mount Kilimanjaro, especially in the early morning. After a day of safari, we loved relaxing at the bar (greetings to Johnathan, the bartender) and watching the sunset — such a peaceful and unforgettable atmosphere. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy Amboseli with great people and amazing views!

name: Tulia Amboseli Safari Camp
address: Kimana Gate Amboseli National Park, Kenya

reviews.author: Jan St.
reviews.text:
We stayed at this beautiful tented camp in Amboseli National Park for two nights and had such a wonderful and relaxing experience.

The tents were incredibly comfy and luxurious while still being right in the heart of nature. Waking up surrounded by the wild was already special – but the absolute highlight was the perfect view of Mount Kilimanjaro right from our tent. Seeing Africa’s highest peak in the early morning light was simply breathtaking and made our stay even more unforgettable.

The camp grounds were very pretty and well maintained, and the nearby water hole attracted amazing wildlife. We were lucky enough to see elephants directly from the camp, along with countless beautiful birds. It felt like a safari experience without even leaving the property.

The service was absolutely perfect. The entire team was kind, attentive, and always ready to help with a smile. A special thank you to Christine, our waitress, who did an amazing job and made us feel very welcome throughout our stay.

The food was outstanding – every meal was delicious – and the cocktails made by David were especially tasty and the perfect way to end the day after safari drives.

Overall, we had a very comfortable and relaxing stay in this perfect camp close to the national park, with the added bonus of that iconic Kilimanjaro view. We would definitely come again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Amboseli!

reviews.author: Rebecca O'Dette
reviews.text:
Overall our group of 6 had a wonderful experience here Oct 2025. The staff was very warm, welcoming and worked hard to ensure a great experience. The tents were simple and nothing fancy, everything was clean and comfortable. We were thrilled to consistently have hot water for showers (this wasn’t always the case at other “luxury” camps we visited). All the food was decent to pretty good. Vegetarian meals had limited variety, but there was always a vegetarian option at least. The WiFi consistently worked well throughout the property.

Our group stayed at the tents in front of the watering hole, and this was a really stand out experience! Dawn and dusk here were teeming with wildlife coming to visit from elephants, to zebras, gazelles, warthogs, birds and more. The plunge pools on the deck were a nice amenity. The morning views of Mount Kilimanjaro were beautiful and the evening stars were so abundant and bright.

We visited during the dry season and it was incredibly dusty and bumpy with big ditches on the route to / from the park which took ~35-45mins to get to the gate with the difficult to navigate roads. Once inside the park, the roads were very similar, so ensure you’ll be in a comfortable vehicle for the game drives. Definitely pack face coverings for the dust and ladies make sure to pack sports bras.

reviews.author: Matt McKellar
reviews.text: The experience at Tulia was great. The staff were always so friendly, the tent was very large and had everything you would need. Being able to overlook Mount Kilimanjaro from your tent, and just sit outside under the stars was incredible. Each meal was treated as though you were at a 5 star restaurant with multiple courses available.

reviews.author: Sheena Desai
reviews.text: Wow!!!! This camp was our favourite camp of the trip, it was breathtaking with insane views of Kilimanjaro. It feels a lot more at nature than some of the bigger camps we stayed at. Animals at Ambroselli are lesser than the Masai Mara and Lake Narakuru but the views here were much more incredible. Make sure you do two parks! We fell in love with Tulia, thanks for making our honeymoon special.

reviews.author: Michaela Atchison
reviews.text:
Tulia Camp: Our Absolute Favorite—Harnessing the Magic of Amboseli!
Out of all the places we stayed during our five-day safari, Tulia Camp was, without a doubt, our favorite.
The setting alone is spectacular: the breathtaking backdrop of Mount Kilimanjaro is visible right from the camp. Combined with the friendly, upbeat staff, they create an atmosphere that is both excited and wonderfully relaxed during breakfast and dinner.
Luxury Tents & Incredible Details
Our tent was simply incredible. While it looks like a tent, it felt much more permanent and secure. You could actually see the mountain view from inside the tent! The pool set right on the decking was a fantastic, luxurious addition.
Inside, the attention to detail was top-notch: we had instant hot water and even two sinks, which felt impressive for a camp. The bathroom wasn't canvas; it was a permanent, tiled space. It’s a tent, yes, but it’s definitely elevated luxury camping!
Location, Food, and Atmosphere
The food was excellent, and we appreciated that you could watch it being cooked if you wanted to. The decor and little thoughtful touches really added to the special occasion feel of the camp.
It's also perfectly located just outside the park's gates, making access easy. Starting the day with that view, and ending it around the fire pit in the evening, was just amazing. They even prepared us an excellent packed lunch for our departure day.
Final Verdict
We were lucky enough to have the perfect mountain view, but even without it, Tulia Camp felt like a truly special place. In terms of location, food, accommodation, and atmosphere, they clearly harness the magic of Amboseli National Park. We would highly, highly recommend Tulia Camp for your stay!

reviews.author: Jens Hofer
reviews.text:
The stay we had at Oilepo Amboseli was super and we were impressed with everything there.
The lodge has a very beautiful and tasteful atmosphere. One of the most memorable aspects of this lodge was the view that we had of Mount Kilimanjaro right from our bed, which was simply breathtaking.
The à la carte restaurant with a three-course menu was really good. The quality was high, the dishes were exquisitely prepared and the food was delicious. The restaurant itself is a magical place: from there, one has a view of a watering hole where gazelles and even elephants are known to drop by to take a drink. Having a meal with a view of wild animals in their natural habitat was a thrilling experience.
The staff were very warm and kind to us throughout our visit. They were so welcoming and taken care of us in every manner.
Our room was also super: it had a very good shower, a bathtub too and reliable Wi-Fi.
Even though the lodge is not inside the park, the entrance to Amboseli National Park is only 2 to 3 minutes away.
Together with our time in Amboseli, this was perfect as a last stop of our honeymoon safari. We would have loved to stay here longer and will certainly come back if we are ever in the area again. A really special place and highly recommended.

reviews.author: Sascha Waidmann
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at Oilepo Amboseli Lodge and truly enjoyed our time there. The rooms were beautiful and newly renovated — modern, clean, and very comfortable. After long and exciting safari days, it was the perfect place to relax and unwind.

The staff were exceptionally friendly, welcoming, and attentive throughout our stay. They made us feel genuinely cared for and were always ready to help with a warm smile.

We would highly recommend Oilepo Amboseli Lodge to anyone visiting the area and would happily stay there again.

reviews.author: Krisztina Radó
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, fantastic location with picturesque views of Kilimanjaro. Excellent restaurant, great staff, special thanks to the manager for taking care about my daughters 18th birthday-gift. Do not hesitate to book!!

reviews.author: Katie Sanders
reviews.text:
A Truly Magical Experience

We recently had the pleasure of staying here for two nights, and our entire experience was simply fantastic. What truly sets this place apart is the incredible staff, who make you feel right at home.

The grounds are absolutely stunning, meticulously maintained by the dedicated gardening team. We enjoyed relaxing by the watering hole opposite the bar, where we were fortunate enough to see elephants, zebras, baboons, and warthogs while sipping our drinks.

Our room was lovely, featuring a very comfortable bed. Each evening, the staff came to turn down the room, closing the curtains and mosquito nets, which added a special touch to our stay.

The restaurant is excellent; every meal we had was delicious and exceeded our expectations.

The owners of this establishment should be immensely proud of their team. Every single member we encountered was incredibly hospitable and made us feel genuinely welcome.

Thank you once again for an unforgettable experience!

reviews.author: Rodrigo Pineda
reviews.text: Oilepo is an amazing choice for Amboseli National Park. The staff was incredible and our suite had some amazing views of the mountains Kilimanjaro, also the sky was the best. There’s power outlets on the rooms and a main building with the restaurant that has some amazing views of a water hole where animals normally gather to drink (baboons, antílopes and elephants). The food was also amazing! A la carte with some great options and a small lounge space to chill with some drinks during the evening. Hotel is some minutes away from the park entrance, will definitely recommend it!

reviews.author: Alessiya Tosun
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay here with our family. The service was absolutely fabulous — everyone was always checking in to see if we needed anything and made sure everything was perfect.

The food was outstanding, made with fresh ingredients and incredibly tasty. The location is beautifully secluded, far from town and cars, making it feel like we were in the middle of the jungle. It was so quiet and peaceful, surrounded by nature.

Lenny, the owner, is incredibly kind and helpful and made our stay even more special. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking to truly relax and reconnect with nature. Thank you!

reviews.author: Mwangi Kirubi
reviews.text: I stayed a couple of nights and would highly recommend. I had great interaction with the owner who kept checking on us to make sure all was OK and it was. The cabins being few means it never gets crowded and so you get personal attention. Breakfast was simple but delicious, what I needed to start the day. Being 25 Mon from Amboseli gate makes access quick. Lots of trees, a river and birds chirping mostly in the morning make this a perfect chillaxing spot.

reviews.author: AiShah
reviews.text: If U plan to stay out of the city noise to relax or plan to go to Amboselli National Park with Family or friends. I highly recommend this place. So beautiful, greenery, just enjoy the sound of birds & river flows, Just relax in your room or hammock. The food is so delicious (breakfast & dinner). Affordable price. We wanted to stay 1 more night, but unfortunately it was fullybooked. We are delighted with the hospitality of Mr. Leni. We Wish U more success in future ahead. 🙏

reviews.author: Imran Shah
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
An absolute paradise for nature lovers! The property is surrounded by stunning natural beauty, offering peace, fresh air, and a true escape from the city. Waking up to the sound of birds and breathtaking views made the stay unforgettable. Perfect for anyone who loves serenity, greenery, and being close to nature. Highly recommended!
And food? Just perfect. Not more, not less.

reviews.author: Kelly Murila
reviews.text: We loved our stay here! They have lovely A-frame cabins. Meals are provided in the package and they kindly sent us with packed lunches while we visited Amboseli. It’s nice and shaded and has a lovely garden as well.

reviews.author: Lien Van Der Schueren
reviews.text:
Staying at Amboseli Trails was nothing short of magical! The cabin is perfectly situated with a breathtaking view of Mount Kilimanjaro, and waking up to that scenery felt like a dream come true. What makes this place even more special is knowing that Brian, the owner and visionary behind it, built the cabin with his own hands over several years. That personal touch is evident everywhere.

The surrounding garden is rustic yet lush, creating a serene atmosphere that instantly makes you feel at peace. In the evenings, we gathered around a cozy campfire, sharing stories under the stars—a truly unforgettable experience.
Mornings were pure bliss: opening the door to the most stunning view imaginable. During the day, we went on a genuine nature walk, exploring the beauty of the area. The highlight? Spotting a rare species of wild monkey that we hadn’t seen in any other national park! It was an incredible moment that made the adventure even more unique.

If you’re looking for a place that combines natural beauty, tranquility, and authentic craftsmanship, Amboseli Trails is the perfect choice. Highly recommended for anyone who wants an experience that feels both personal and extraordinary!

reviews.author: Elsa Renaud
reviews.text:
It’s a lovely place ! The staff is very reactive and helpful. I thought it would have several cabin houses but in fact there is only one, was a bit surprised but makes sense they opened not long ago.

Would recommend it ! The location is not directly at the parks gate it’s a bit further away.

reviews.author: bonnie
reviews.text:
We checked in late after a dusty day at Amboseli, only to find there was no water for a shower. Check in was fine. The owner boiled some water in a bucket, so we tried to wipe off the dust in the bathroom which was ok. However, the bathroom was open on two sides and full of dust as its not far from highway. After a quick wipe, we were bitten several times by mosquitoes as it is an open room.

The bed was very small for two, and the mosquito net couldn’t fully cover the bed so it was useless. In the morning, we woke up to find that our phones hadn’t charged, as there was no power, no water, and no internet. We text the owner for help. He then quietly dropped off a bucket of water outside then left without respond to our calls or messages until we checked out.

Overall, it was a very uncomfortable stay. The environment is close to nature, but basic needs like water, power, and communication were not met. It is a very basic camp. Definitely not worth the money we have paid.

reviews.author: Maisha Fairuz Rahman
reviews.text: Amazing stay at Amboseli Trails! The property is well-maintained. The absolute highlight was the breathtaking view of Mount Kilimanjaro right from the cabin. Our host, Brian, was very cordial and prompt in his responses. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Mashrif Hasan Adib
reviews.text: Amazing view of Mount Kilimanjaro (if you’re lucky) and the host is very prompt with requests. Overall, very peaceful and rustic setting.

reviews.author: Hassan Khambiye
reviews.text:
The rooms and hotel experience is a 10 for me. One of the best in the amboseli sides, though it is 40 mins from the amboseli national park gate.
The service and rooms are exceptional and food it top notch. Food is served as alakat no buffet. The hotel has a water hole where animals come to drink water, awesome to have a good chill there as well.
Better to go here around late December or January to May.
The drive is perfect upto the last stretch off the main road on a dirt road for 20 mins before getting to the hotel.
Definitely a place to go again.

reviews.author: Susan Jenkins
reviews.text:
I recently spent 3 fabulous nights at Elephant Gorge Camp. Our arrival was met by our Elephant Gorge head guide/driver Issac. Issac is an extremely knowledgeable man about all the fabulous wild life that we saw during our time in Amboseli. We  learned so much about the animals and birds that we didn't know previously.
The staff are are all wonderful,our room was superb, the food fantastic and the waterhole below the dining area always gave many viewings of the animals taking a drink. Luxury all around and  I highly recommend this camp for any safari traveller.

reviews.author: Sander Kõiv
reviews.text: We loved our time there! Pictures online don’t do the justice. Everything is much much better in person and service is amazing. You get to see different animals who come to drink, while having your breakfast or a glass of wine. Amazing place and we were very happy! Would come back 100%

reviews.author: mturrado
reviews.text:
An absolutely spectacular hotel!

The rooms are beautiful, modern, and best of all, they offer breathtaking views of Kilimanjaro. Waking up to see that mountain from your bed is truly priceless.

The service is extraordinarily kind and helpful. The staff always has a smile and is willing to assist with anything you need. They also arranged a sunset excursion, which was an unforgettable experience.

Highly recommended! If you're looking for luxury, incredible views, and impeccable service, this is the place to be.

reviews.author: Emma Dow
reviews.text: My husband and I recently completed a 3 night stay at Elephant Gorge Camp. This was our first safari experience in Amboseli and it set the tone for the rest of our trip. The accommodations are beautiful, well staffed and well maintained. Located in an unfenced conservancy adjacent to the park there are of course opportunities for wildlife spotting around the camp, from elephants drinking during our meals (which were all excellent) to lions hunting around the camp at night (you are required to shuttle to and from your room by golf cart or walk with someone on staff for this reason). The views of Kilimanjaro are amazing in the morning and evening. It did take a bit of time to get to and from the park for game drives with most time spent in the national park in the first half of the day, although this was not a problem due to the animals to see on the way in and out. After a morning exploring the park, the pool was amazing to cool off in. We learned new and insightful information each day to better understand Maasai language and culture and were able to visit a lovely village nearby. Many thanks to our amazing guide Dan, Jade, Steve, John, and the rest of the team that helped ensure we had a comfortable and special experience. Your hospitality is unmatched!

reviews.author: Jonas Wagener
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at Kilimanjaro Cottages Amboseli and would highly recommend this place to others. The simply furnished rooms are clean and the staff are always available to help with any requests. The food tastes excellent. I would like to emphasize the excellent service. I felt very comfortable and spent two eventful days here. I especially remember the game drive that we were able to organize at the camp, the amazing view of Mount Kilimanjaro from the camp, the impressive night sky and the beautiful campfire in the evening. Thank you very much for your hospitality, I would love to come back!

reviews.author: Toshian Miriti
reviews.text:
This experience was the best while looking to catch in culture and not luxury, humanhood and not richness, campy style and wild life nature. From the rooms, to the services to the location, I'll give this all 5!
Great host!!!!

reviews.author: anvni h
reviews.text:
I can definitely recommend a stay at Kilimanjaro Cottages!
The view is amazing, since you are right at the foot of the mountain. The breakfast, lunch bag, and the dinner is super delicious. Also, the service is amazing. The team fulfills every individual wish and takes great care of the guests. My personal highlight was the daily campfire in the evening. The rooms are quite simple, but the showers worked perfectly. I recommend booking a safari tour with Dickson! We spendt an amazing day exploring the savannah and getting to know Masai culture, thank you!

reviews.author: Marcia
reviews.text: Great place to stay for 2 nights. Affordable offer for Amboseli safari trip and great garden view on the Kilimanjaro.

reviews.author: Leslie Lensen
reviews.text: Kilimanjaro cottages is a beautiful place to stay with a fantastic view on the kilimanjaro. Staff makes you feel very welcomed.
